from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import math
import numpy as np

from .config import Config
from .types import Assignment, IDLE, Observation, Scenario, complete_roles, role_offset
from .physics import rollout_target


@dataclass
class StepResult:
    reward: float
    done: bool
    info: dict


class Environment:
    """Atomic 3-second steps; actions can change only between step calls."""
    def __init__(self, cfg: Config, scenario: Scenario):
        self.cfg = cfg
        self.scenario = scenario
        from .observation_geometry import required_roles, identity
        self._geometry_identity = identity(cfg)
        if scenario.pursuers.shape != (cfg.robots, 2):
            raise ValueError("Pursuer shape must be [robots, xy]")
        if not np.isfinite(scenario.pursuers).all() or len(scenario.targets) != cfg.task_count:
            raise ValueError("Invalid scenario positions or task count")
        for i, target in enumerate(scenario.targets):
            required_roles(target.required_robots, cfg)
            if cfg.capture_mode == "stepwise_service" and target.service_duration is None:
                raise ValueError("stepwise_service requires explicit service_duration on every target")
            if target.id != i or target.birth >= cfg.end_time:
                raise ValueError("Target IDs must be contiguous; births must precede episode end")
            if not math.isclose(target.birth / cfg.stage_dt, round(target.birth / cfg.stage_dt),
                                abs_tol=1e-9):
                raise ValueError("Births must occur at stage boundaries")
            if not 0 <= target.position_at_birth[0] < cfg.side:
                raise ValueError("Targets must be born before the escape line")
            if (cfg.turn_max_angle > 0 or cfg.speed_delta_max > 0 or
                    cfg.motion_model == "continuous_turn"):
                velocities = (target.velocity,) + tuple((vx, vy) for _, vx, vy in target.turns)
                if any(np.linalg.norm(velocity) > cfg.target_speed_max + 1e-9
                       for velocity in velocities):
                    raise ValueError("Turning target exceeds configured speed bound")
                if any(not math.isclose(time / cfg.step_dt, round(time / cfg.step_dt), abs_tol=1e-9)
                       for time, _, _ in target.turns):
                    raise ValueError("Turn times must align with control step")
            if cfg.motion_model == "continuous_turn":
                if not target.arc_rates or target.turns:
                    raise ValueError("Continuous-turn targets need arc rates")
                if any(not math.isclose(time / cfg.step_dt, round(time / cfg.step_dt),
                                        abs_tol=1e-9) for time, _ in target.arc_rates):
                    raise ValueError("Arc rate changes must align with control step")
                if any(abs(rate) > cfg.turn_max_angle / cfg.turn_interval + 1e-9
                       for _, rate in target.arc_rates):
                    raise ValueError("Arc turn rate exceeds the configured bound")
                if any(abs(math.atan2(target.velocity_at(time)[1],
                                      target.velocity_at(time)[0])) > cfg.turn_max_angle + 1e-8
                       for time, _ in target.arc_rates):
                    raise ValueError("Arc heading leaves the eastward envelope")
        self.positions = scenario.pursuers.copy()
        self.stage = 0
        self.status = ["hidden"] * cfg.task_count
        self.capture_times = np.full(cfg.task_count, np.nan)
        if cfg.capture_mode == "stepwise_service":
            from .service import initial_state
            self.service_progress = np.zeros(cfg.task_count)
            self.service_team = [()] * cfg.task_count
            self._service_states = [initial_state(cfg) for _ in scenario.targets]
            self.completion_times = np.full(cfg.task_count, np.nan)
        self.escape_times = np.full(cfg.task_count, np.nan)
        self.last_assignment = (IDLE,) * cfg.robots
        self.ended_ids = ()
        self.new_ids = self._activate()
        self.total_reward = 0.0
        self.total_change_cost = 0.0
        self.total_changes = 0
        self.total_effort = 0.0
        self.total_partner_wait = 0.0
        self.peak_speed = 0.0
        self.mismatch_count = 0
        self._stepping = False

    @property
    def time(self):
        return self.stage * self.cfg.stage_dt

    @property
    def done(self):
        return self.stage >= self.cfg.max_stages

    @property
    def active_ids(self):
        return tuple(i for i, s in enumerate(self.status) if s == "active")

    def _activate(self):
        ids = []
        for task in self.scenario.targets:
            if self.status[task.id] == "hidden" and task.birth <= self.time + 1e-10:
                self.status[task.id] = "active"
                ids.append(task.id)
        return tuple(ids)

    def clean_assignment(self):
        active = set(self.active_ids)
        return tuple(a if a.target in active else IDLE for a in self.last_assignment)

    def observe(self) -> Observation:
        positions = self.positions.copy()
        positions.setflags(write=False)
        return Observation(self.cfg, self.stage, positions,
                           tuple(self.scenario.targets[i].observed(self.time) for i in self.active_ids),
                           self.clean_assignment(), self.new_ids, self.ended_ids,
                           self.time if (self.cfg.turn_max_angle > 0 or
                                         self.cfg.speed_delta_max > 0 or
                                         self.cfg.motion_model == "continuous_turn") else None,
                           tuple((j, self._service_states[j]) for j in self.active_ids)
                           if self.cfg.capture_mode == "stepwise_service" else ())

    def _validate(self, actions):
        from .observation_geometry import required_roles, identity, validate_roles
        if identity(self.cfg) != self._geometry_identity:
            raise ValueError('Runtime geometry change is forbidden')
        actions = tuple(actions)
        if len(actions) != self.cfg.robots or any(not isinstance(a, Assignment) for a in actions):
            raise ValueError("Supply one immutable Assignment per robot")
        counts = {}
        for action in actions:
            if action.target is None:
                if action.role != "none":
                    raise ValueError("Idle must use role=none")
                continue
            if isinstance(action.target, bool) or not isinstance(action.target, (int, np.integer)):
                raise ValueError("Target ID must be an integer")
            if action.target not in self.active_ids:
                raise ValueError("Cannot assign a hidden, captured, escaped or unknown target")
            task = self.scenario.targets[action.target]
            legal = required_roles(task.required_robots, self.cfg)
            if action.role not in legal:
                raise ValueError("Role is incompatible with task demand")
            counts[action.target] = counts.get(action.target, 0) + 1
            if counts[action.target] > task.required_robots:
                raise ValueError("Too many robots assigned to one task")
        if self.cfg.geometry_mode != 'legacy_anchor':
            for j in counts:
                validate_roles(self.scenario.targets[j].required_robots,
                               [a.role for a in actions if a.target == j], self.cfg)
        return actions

    @staticmethod
    def _coalition_log(old, new):
        targets = sorted({a.target for a in (*old, *new) if a.target is not None})
        events = []
        for target in targets:
            before = [k for k, a in enumerate(old) if a.target == target]
            after = [k for k, a in enumerate(new) if a.target == target]
            labels = []
            if before == after:
                labels.append("maintain")
            if set(after) - set(before):
                labels.append("join")
            if set(before) - set(after):
                labels.append("leave")
            destinations = {new[k].target for k in before if new[k].target is not None}
            origins = {old[k].target for k in after if old[k].target is not None}
            if len(destinations) > 1:
                labels.append("split")
            if len(origins) > 1:
                labels.append("merge")
            if any(old[k].target == new[k].target == target and old[k].role != new[k].role
                   for k in range(len(new))):
                labels.append("role_change")
            events.append({"target": target, "before": before, "after": after, "labels": labels})
        return events

    def step(self, actions, trace: bool = False) -> StepResult:
        if self.done or self._stepping:
            raise RuntimeError("Step requires a live environment at a stage boundary")
        actions = self._validate(actions)
        self._stepping = True
        try:
            return self._step(actions, trace)
        finally:
            self._stepping = False

    def _release_events(self, info, actions):
        """One release per ended target, at its numerical event time."""
        if self.cfg.capture_mode != "stepwise_instant":
            return
        events = [(kind, event) for kind in ("escape", "capture")
                  for event in info[kind + "_events"]]
        info["release_events"] = [
            {"target": event["target"], "time": event["time"], "reason": kind,
             "robots": [k for k, action in enumerate(actions)
                          if action.target == event["target"]]}
            for kind, event in sorted(events, key=lambda row: (
                row[1]["time"], row[0] != "escape", row[1]["target"]))
            if any(action.target == event["target"] for action in actions)]

    def _step(self, actions, trace):
        if self.cfg.capture_mode == "stepwise_service":
            from .service_environment import step_service
            return step_service(self, actions, trace)
        cfg, start = self.cfg, self.time
        end = start + cfg.stage_dt
        old = self.clean_assignment()
        changes = sum(a != b for a, b in zip(actions, old))
        forced_release = [k for k, a in enumerate(self.last_assignment)
                          if a.target is not None and old[k] == IDLE]
        active = self.active_ids
        before = self.positions.copy()
        captured, escaped = [], []
        effort = partner_wait = peak = 0.0
        mismatch = 0
        modes = ["IDLE"] * cfg.robots
        guards = [None] * cfg.robots
        frame_times = [start + i * cfg.step_dt for i in range(round(cfg.stage_dt / cfg.step_dt) + 1)]
        frame_positions = [before.copy() for _ in frame_times] if trace else []
        frame_indices = {round(t, 9): i for i, t in enumerate(frame_times)}
        for target_id in active:
            target = self.scenario.targets[target_id]
            robots = [k for k, a in enumerate(actions) if a.target == target_id]
            if robots:
                roles = [actions[k].role for k in robots]
                result = rollout_target(
                    cfg, target, self.positions[robots][None],
                    np.array([role_offset(r, cfg) for r in roles])[None],
                    np.array([complete_roles(target, roles)]), start, trace=trace)
                self.positions[robots] = result.positions[0]
                effort += float(result.effort[0])
                partner_wait += float(result.partner_wait[0])
                peak = max(peak, float(result.peak_speed[0]))
                mismatch += int(result.mismatch_count[0])
                for local, k in enumerate(robots):
                    modes[k] = str(result.stages[0]["modes"][0])
                    guards[k] = float(result.stages[0]["guard_peaks"][0, local])
                if np.isfinite(result.capture_times[0]):
                    self.capture_times[target_id] = result.capture_times[0]
                    self.status[target_id] = "captured"
                    captured.append(target_id)
                elif np.isfinite(result.escape_times[0]):
                    self.escape_times[target_id] = result.escape_times[0]
                    self.status[target_id] = "escaped"
                    escaped.append(target_id)
                if trace:
                    for time, positions in result.frames:
                        index = frame_indices.get(round(time, 9))
                        if index is not None:
                            frame_positions[index][robots] = positions[0]
            elif target.escape_time(cfg.side) <= end + 1e-10:
                self.escape_times[target_id] = target.escape_time(cfg.side)
                self.status[target_id] = "escaped"
                escaped.append(target_id)

        flow = late = 0.0
        for i in active:
            target = self.scenario.targets[i]
            stop = (self.capture_times[i] if i in captured else
                    self.escape_times[i] if i in escaped else end)
            flow += target.weight * max(0.0, stop - max(start, target.birth))
            late += target.weight * max(0.0, stop - max(start, target.birth, target.deadline))
        capture_gain = sum(self.scenario.targets[i].weight for i in captured) / cfg.weight_reference
        flow_penalty = cfg.flow_weight * flow / (cfg.weight_reference * cfg.stage_dt)
        late_penalty = cfg.late_weight * late / (cfg.weight_reference * cfg.stage_dt)
        effort_penalty = cfg.control_weight * effort / cfg.effort_reference
        terminal_penalty = 0.0
        if self.stage + 1 == cfg.max_stages:
            terminal_penalty = cfg.unfinished_weight * sum(
                t.weight for t in self.scenario.targets if self.status[t.id] != "captured"
            ) / cfg.weight_reference
        reward = capture_gain - flow_penalty - late_penalty - effort_penalty - terminal_penalty
        cost = cfg.change_cost * changes
        self.total_reward += reward
        self.total_change_cost += cost
        self.total_changes += changes
        self.total_effort += effort
        self.total_partner_wait += partner_wait
        self.peak_speed = max(self.peak_speed, peak)
        self.mismatch_count += mismatch

        info = {
            "stage": self.stage, "start": start, "end": end, "visible_ids": list(active),
            "new_ids": list(self.new_ids), "assignment": [a.to_dict() for a in actions],
            "coalition_changes": self._coalition_log(old, actions),
            "forced_release_robots": forced_release, "changed_robots": changes,
            "modes": modes, "guard_peaks": guards, "positions_start": before.tolist(),
            "positions_end": self.positions.tolist(), "captured": captured, "escaped": escaped,
            "capture_events": [{"target": i, "time": float(self.capture_times[i])} for i in captured],
            "escape_events": [{"target": i, "time": float(self.escape_times[i])} for i in escaped],
            "flow": flow, "late": late, "effort": effort, "peak_speed": peak,
            "partner_wait": partner_wait, "model_mismatches": mismatch,
            "reward": reward, "change_cost": cost, "reward_with_changes": reward - cost,
            "reward_components": {"capture": capture_gain, "flow": -flow_penalty,
                                  "late": -late_penalty, "effort": -effort_penalty,
                                  "terminal": -terminal_penalty},
            "overdue_ids": [i for i in active if self.scenario.targets[i].deadline < end],
        }
        self._release_events(info, actions)
        if trace:
            frames = []
            for time, positions in zip(frame_times, frame_positions):
                actual_modes = modes.copy()
                for k, a in enumerate(actions):
                    if a.target is None:
                        continue
                    stopped = ((np.isfinite(self.capture_times[a.target]) and
                                time >= self.capture_times[a.target] - 1e-10) or
                               (np.isfinite(self.escape_times[a.target]) and
                                time >= self.escape_times[a.target] - 1e-10))
                    if stopped:
                        actual_modes[k] = "HOLD"
                frames.append({"time": round(time, 10), "positions": positions.tolist(),
                               "modes": actual_modes, "assignment": info["assignment"]})
            info["frames"] = frames
        self.last_assignment = actions
        if cfg.capture_mode == "stepwise_instant":
            self.last_assignment = self.clean_assignment()
        self.ended_ids = tuple(captured + escaped)
        self.stage += 1
        self.new_ids = self._activate()
        return StepResult(float(reward), self.done, info)

    def metrics(self):
        if self.cfg.capture_mode == "stepwise_service":
            from .service_environment import service_metrics
            return service_metrics(self)
        weights = np.array([t.weight for t in self.scenario.targets])
        deadlines = np.array([t.deadline for t in self.scenario.targets])
        captured = np.isfinite(self.capture_times)
        escaped = np.isfinite(self.escape_times)
        on_time = captured & (self.capture_times <= deadlines + 1e-9)
        stop = np.where(captured, self.capture_times, np.where(escaped, self.escape_times, self.time))
        elapsed = np.maximum(0, stop - np.array([t.birth for t in self.scenario.targets]))
        return {
            "return": float(self.total_reward),
            "return_with_changes": float(self.total_reward - self.total_change_cost),
            "completion_rate": float(np.mean(captured)),
            "weighted_on_time_rate": float(weights @ on_time / weights.sum()),
            "captured_count": int(captured.sum()), "escaped_count": int(escaped.sum()),
            "escaped_weight_fraction": float(weights @ escaped / weights.sum()),
            "unfinished_weight_fraction": float(weights @ (~captured) / weights.sum()),
            "assignment_changes": self.total_changes, "control_effort": self.total_effort,
            "partner_wait_robot_seconds": self.total_partner_wait,
            "max_task_sojourn": float(elapsed.max()), "peak_speed": self.peak_speed,
            "model_mismatches": self.mismatch_count, "stages": self.stage,
            "capture_mode": self.cfg.capture_mode,
        }


class TimedEnvironment(Environment):
    """Decisions each turn_interval; capture follows Config.capture_mode."""

    def __init__(self, cfg: Config, scenario: Scenario):
        if (cfg.turn_max_angle <= 0 and cfg.speed_delta_max <= 0 and
                cfg.motion_model != "continuous_turn"):
            raise ValueError("TimedEnvironment requires a changing target motion")
        self._time = 0.0
        super().__init__(cfg, scenario)

    @property
    def time(self):
        return self._time

    def step(self, actions, trace: bool = False) -> StepResult:
        if self.done or self._stepping:
            raise RuntimeError("Step requires a live observation tick")
        actions = self._validate(actions)
        self._stepping = True
        try:
            return self._step_tick(actions, trace)
        finally:
            self._stepping = False

    def _step_tick(self, actions, trace):
        if self.cfg.capture_mode == "stepwise_service":
            from .service_environment import step_service
            return step_service(self, actions, trace)
        cfg, start = self.cfg, self.time
        end = min(cfg.end_time, start + cfg.turn_interval)
        old = self.clean_assignment()
        changes = sum(a != b for a, b in zip(actions, old))
        active = self.active_ids
        before = self.positions.copy()
        captured, escaped = [], []
        effort = partner_wait = peak = 0.0
        modes = ["IDLE"] * cfg.robots
        guards = [None] * cfg.robots
        frame_times = [round(start + i * cfg.step_dt, 10)
                       for i in range(round((end - start) / cfg.step_dt) + 1)]
        frame_positions = {time: before.copy() for time in frame_times} if trace else {}
        for target_id in active:
            target = self.scenario.targets[target_id]
            robots = [k for k, a in enumerate(actions) if a.target == target_id]
            if robots:
                roles = [actions[k].role for k in robots]
                result = rollout_target(cfg, target, self.positions[robots][None],
                                        np.array([role_offset(r, cfg) for r in roles])[None],
                                        np.array([complete_roles(target, roles)]),
                                        start, trace=trace, until=end)
                self.positions[robots] = result.positions[0]
                effort += float(result.effort[0])
                partner_wait += float(result.partner_wait[0])
                peak = max(peak, float(result.peak_speed[0]))
                for k in robots:
                    modes[k] = "TRAVEL"
                    guards[k] = 0.0
                if np.isfinite(result.capture_times[0]):
                    self.capture_times[target_id] = result.capture_times[0]
                    self.status[target_id] = "captured"
                    captured.append(target_id)
                elif np.isfinite(result.escape_times[0]):
                    self.escape_times[target_id] = result.escape_times[0]
                    self.status[target_id] = "escaped"
                    escaped.append(target_id)
                if trace:
                    for time, positions in result.frames:
                        key = round(time, 10)
                        if key in frame_positions:
                            frame_positions[key][robots] = positions[0]
            elif target.escape_time(cfg.side) <= end + 1e-10:
                self.escape_times[target_id] = target.escape_time(cfg.side)
                self.status[target_id] = "escaped"
                escaped.append(target_id)
        flow = late = 0.0
        for i in active:
            target = self.scenario.targets[i]
            stop = (self.capture_times[i] if i in captured else
                    self.escape_times[i] if i in escaped else end)
            flow += target.weight * max(0.0, stop - max(start, target.birth))
            late += target.weight * max(0.0, stop - max(start, target.birth, target.deadline))
        capture_gain = sum(self.scenario.targets[i].weight for i in captured) / cfg.weight_reference
        flow_penalty = cfg.flow_weight * flow / (cfg.weight_reference * cfg.stage_dt)
        late_penalty = cfg.late_weight * late / (cfg.weight_reference * cfg.stage_dt)
        effort_penalty = cfg.control_weight * effort / cfg.effort_reference
        terminal_penalty = (cfg.unfinished_weight * sum(
            t.weight for t in self.scenario.targets if self.status[t.id] != "captured")
            / cfg.weight_reference if end >= cfg.end_time - 1e-10 else 0.0)
        reward = capture_gain - flow_penalty - late_penalty - effort_penalty - terminal_penalty
        cost = cfg.change_cost * changes
        self.total_reward += reward
        self.total_change_cost += cost
        self.total_changes += changes
        self.total_effort += effort
        self.total_partner_wait += partner_wait
        self.peak_speed = max(self.peak_speed, peak)
        info = {
            "stage": self.stage, "start": start, "end": end, "visible_ids": list(active),
            "new_ids": list(self.new_ids), "assignment": [a.to_dict() for a in actions],
            "coalition_changes": self._coalition_log(old, actions),
            "changed_robots": changes, "modes": modes, "guard_peaks": guards,
            "positions_start": before.tolist(), "positions_end": self.positions.tolist(),
            "captured": captured, "escaped": escaped,
            "capture_events": [{"target": i, "time": float(self.capture_times[i])} for i in captured],
            "escape_events": [{"target": i, "time": float(self.escape_times[i])} for i in escaped],
            "flow": flow, "late": late, "effort": effort, "peak_speed": peak,
            "partner_wait": partner_wait, "model_mismatches": 0,
            "reward": reward, "change_cost": cost, "reward_with_changes": reward - cost,
            "reward_components": {"capture": capture_gain, "flow": -flow_penalty,
                                  "late": -late_penalty, "effort": -effort_penalty,
                                  "terminal": -terminal_penalty},
            "overdue_ids": [i for i in active if self.scenario.targets[i].deadline < end],
        }
        self._release_events(info, actions)
        if trace:
            frames = []
            for time in frame_times:
                actual_modes = modes.copy()
                if cfg.capture_mode == "stepwise_instant":
                    for k, action in enumerate(actions):
                        if action.target in captured + escaped:
                            stop = (self.capture_times[action.target] if action.target in captured
                                    else self.escape_times[action.target])
                            if time >= stop - 1e-10:
                                actual_modes[k] = "HOLD"
                frames.append({"time": time, "positions": frame_positions[time].tolist(),
                               "modes": actual_modes, "assignment": info["assignment"]})
            info["frames"] = frames
        self.last_assignment = actions
        if cfg.capture_mode == "stepwise_instant":
            self.last_assignment = self.clean_assignment()
        self.ended_ids = tuple(captured + escaped)
        self._time = end
        self.stage = min(cfg.max_stages, int(round(end / cfg.stage_dt))
                         if math.isclose(end / cfg.stage_dt, round(end / cfg.stage_dt), abs_tol=1e-9)
                         else math.floor(end / cfg.stage_dt))
        self.new_ids = self._activate()
        return StepResult(float(reward), self.done, info)

=== FILE: pursuit_v2/experiment.py ===
"""Immutable input and implementation fingerprints for resumable experiments."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import platform

import numpy as np


MANIFEST_SCHEMA = 2


def file_sha256(path: str | Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def method_sha256(root: str | Path, runner: str | Path) -> str:
    """Hash the experiment entry point and every implementation module."""
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    paths = [*sorted((root / "pursuit_v2").glob("*.py")), Path(runner)]
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    for path in sorted(paths, key=lambda item: item.relative_to(root).as_posix()):
        name = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        digest.update(name.encode("utf-8"))
        digest.update(b"\0")
        digest.update(path.read_bytes())
        digest.update(b"\0")
    return digest.hexdigest()


def experiment_manifest(root: str | Path, runner: str | Path,
                        source_paths: dict[str, Path], **design) -> dict:
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    return {
        "schema_version": MANIFEST_SCHEMA,
        "method_sha256": method_sha256(root, runner),
        "source_sha256": {key: file_sha256(path)
                          for key, path in sorted(source_paths.items())},
        "runtime": {"python": platform.python_version(), "numpy": np.__version__},
        **design,
    }


def ensure_manifest(output: str | Path, expected: dict) -> None:
    """Reject stale or unverifiable cached runs without changing their files."""
    output = Path(output)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path = output / "manifest.json"
    if path.exists():
        current = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if current != expected:
            changed = sorted(key for key in set(current) | set(expected)
                             if current.get(key) != expected.get(key))
            raise ValueError("Experiment manifest differs in " + ", ".join(changed) +
                             "; use a new output directory. Existing results were not changed.")
        return
    if any(output.iterdir()):
        raise ValueError("Output has data but no versioned manifest; use a new directory")
    path.write_text(json.dumps(expected, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
                    encoding="utf-8")

=== FILE: pursuit_v2/io.py ===
from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np


def clean_json(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {str(k): clean_json(v) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return [clean_json(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, np.ndarray):
        return clean_json(value.tolist())
    if isinstance(value, np.generic):
        return clean_json(value.item())
    if isinstance(value, float) and not math.isfinite(value):
        return None
    return value


def dump_json(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(clean_json(value), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2,
                                    allow_nan=False), encoding="utf-8")


def write_csv(path, rows):
    if not rows:
        return
    fields = list(dict.fromkeys(k for row in rows for k in row))
    with Path(path).open("w", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as stream:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=fields)
        writer.writeheader()
        for row in rows:
            writer.writerow({k: json.dumps(clean_json(v), ensure_ascii=False)
                             if isinstance(v, (list, tuple, dict)) else v for k, v in row.items()})


=== FILE: pursuit_v2/motion.py ===
"""Shared discrete target-motion update for scenario truth and online forecasts."""
from __future__ import annotations

import math

import numpy as np


def motion_step(cfg, angle: float, speed: float, turn_increment: float,
                event_index: int, turn_rng, speed_rng):
    """Advance one motion tick; a sampled heading increment can persist for several ticks."""
    if cfg.turn_max_angle > 0:
        innovation = float(turn_rng.uniform(-cfg.turn_max_angle, cfg.turn_max_angle))
        if (event_index - 1) % cfg.turn_hold_ticks == 0:
            turn_increment = innovation
        angle = float(np.clip(angle + turn_increment,
                              -cfg.turn_max_angle, cfg.turn_max_angle))
    if cfg.speed_delta_max > 0:
        speed = float(np.clip(speed + speed_rng.uniform(-cfg.speed_delta_max,
                                                       cfg.speed_delta_max),
                              cfg.target_speed_min, cfg.target_speed_max))
    return angle, speed, turn_increment, (speed * math.cos(angle), speed * math.sin(angle))

"""Fixed world-frame geometry only; no sensor accuracy or allocation model."""
import math
import numpy as np

LEGACY = ('center', 'upper', 'lower')
ANGULAR = {1: ('solo_0',), 2: ('dual_neg45', 'dual_pos45'),
           3: ('tri_0', 'tri_120', 'tri_240')}
ANGLES = dict(zip(sum(ANGULAR.values(), ()), (0., -45., 45., 0., 120., 240.)))
ALL_ROLES = LEGACY + tuple(ANGLES)
TOL = 1e-10


def required_roles(q, cfg):
    if cfg.geometry_mode == 'angular_standoff_v1':
        if cfg.capture_mode != 'stepwise_service' or q not in ANGULAR:
            raise ValueError('Angular geometry requires service with q=1/2/3')
        return ANGULAR[q]
    if q not in (1, 2):
        raise ValueError('Legacy geometry requires q=1/2')
    return ('center',) if q == 1 else ('upper', 'lower')


def identity(cfg):
    if cfg.geometry_mode == 'legacy_anchor':
        return None
    return ('angular_standoff_v1', 1, cfg.observation_radius, cfg.observation_tolerance,
            tuple(ANGLES.items()))


def offset(role, cfg):
    if cfg.geometry_mode == 'legacy_anchor':
        if role not in LEGACY:
            raise ValueError('Role incompatible with legacy geometry')
        return np.array([0., {'center': 0., 'upper': cfg.anchor_offset,
                              'lower': -cfg.anchor_offset}[role]])
    if role not in ANGLES:
        raise ValueError('Role incompatible with angular geometry')
    a = math.radians(ANGLES[role])
    return cfg.observation_radius * np.array([math.cos(a), math.sin(a)])


def validate_roles(q, roles, cfg):
    required = required_roles(q, cfg)
    if any(r not in required for r in roles):
        raise ValueError('Role incompatible with task geometry')
    if cfg.geometry_mode != 'legacy_anchor' and len(set(roles)) != len(roles):
        raise ValueError('Duplicate angular role')
    if len(roles) > q:
        raise ValueError('Too many service members')
    return len(roles) == q and set(roles) == set(required)


def radius(cfg):
    return (cfg.capture_radius if cfg.geometry_mode == 'legacy_anchor'
            else cfg.observation_tolerance) + TOL


def diagnostics(cfg, target_position, positions, roles):
    pos = np.asarray(positions, float).reshape((-1, 2))
    x = np.asarray(target_position)
    anchors = np.array([x + offset(r, cfg) for r in roles]).reshape((-1, 2))
    vectors = pos - x
    distances = np.linalg.norm(vectors, axis=1)
    bearings = [math.atan2(v[1], v[0]) if d > 0 else None
                for v, d in zip(vectors, distances)]
    pairs = []
    separations = []
    for i in range(len(pos)):
        for k in range(i+1, len(pos)):
            a, b = bearings[i], bearings[k]
            angle = None if a is None or b is None else abs(math.atan2(math.sin(a-b), math.cos(a-b)))
            pairs.append(dict(members=[i, k], angle_radians=angle))
            separations.append(float(np.linalg.norm(pos[i]-pos[k])))
    outside = lambda p: bool(p[0] < 0 or p[0] > cfg.side or p[1] < 0 or p[1] > cfg.side)
    return dict(anchors=anchors.tolist(), errors=np.linalg.norm(pos-anchors, axis=1).tolist(),
                distances=distances.tolist(), bearings_radians=bearings,
                undefined_bearing_members=[i for i, a in enumerate(bearings) if a is None],
                pair_angles=pairs, minimum_robot_distance=min(separations, default=None),
                anchors_outside_reference_region=[outside(a) for a in anchors],
                robots_outside_reference_region=[outside(p) for p in pos])

=== FILE: pursuit_v2/physics.py ===
"""Shared vectorized physics for real execution and candidate predictions.

Only TRAVEL uses forward Euler. COMMIT uses the exact capped-gain trajectory,
with an analytic energy integral and endpoint speed bound.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from pursuit_v2.service import reject_service

from dataclasses import dataclass
import math
import numpy as np

from .config import Config
from .types import Target


class TrackingController:
    def __init__(self, cfg: Config):
        self.cfg = cfg

    def residual(self, s: float) -> float:
        c, tp, eps = self.cfg.time_gain, self.cfg.capture_check, self.cfg.singularity_epsilon
        if s < -1e-10 or s > self.cfg.stage_dt + 1e-10:
            raise ValueError("Local time outside stage")
        s = max(0.0, s)
        if s > tp:
            return self.residual(tp) * math.exp(-self.cfg.hold_gain * (s - tp))
        if s <= tp - eps:
            return ((tp - s) / tp) ** (2 * c)
        return (eps / tp) ** (2 * c) * math.exp(-2 * c * (s - tp + eps) / eps)

    def alpha(self, s: float, hold_start: bool = False) -> float:
        cfg = self.cfg
        if s > cfg.capture_check or hold_start:
            return cfg.hold_gain * self.residual(s)
        return 2 * cfg.time_gain / max(cfg.capture_check - s, cfg.singularity_epsilon) * self.residual(s)

    def peak(self, error: np.ndarray, velocity: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        """Return exact per-robot peaks [batch, robots], to floating accuracy."""
        cfg = self.cfg
        points = (0.0, cfg.capture_check - cfg.singularity_epsilon,
                  cfg.capture_check, cfg.stage_dt)
        multipliers = [self.alpha(s) for s in points]
        multipliers.append(self.alpha(cfg.capture_check, hold_start=True))
        peaks = [np.linalg.norm(velocity - a * error, axis=-1) for a in multipliers]
        return np.maximum.reduce(peaks)

    def _alpha_square_integral(self, lo: float, hi: float) -> float:
        cfg = self.cfg
        c, tp, eps = cfg.time_gain, cfg.capture_check, cfg.singularity_epsilon
        cut = tp - eps
        total = 0.0
        a, b = lo, min(hi, cut)
        if b > a:
            power = 4 * c - 1
            total += 4 * c * c / tp ** (4 * c) * (
                (tp - a) ** power - (tp - b) ** power) / power
        a, b = max(lo, cut), min(hi, tp)
        if b > a:
            rate = 2 * c / eps
            amplitude = rate * (eps / tp) ** (2 * c)
            total += amplitude ** 2 / (2 * rate) * (
                math.exp(-2 * rate * (a - cut)) - math.exp(-2 * rate * (b - cut)))
        a, b = max(lo, tp), hi
        if b > a:
            rate = cfg.hold_gain
            amplitude = rate * self.residual(tp)
            total += amplitude ** 2 / (2 * rate) * (
                math.exp(-2 * rate * (a - tp)) - math.exp(-2 * rate * (b - tp)))
        return total

    def energy(self, error: np.ndarray, velocity: np.ndarray, lo: float, hi: float):
        axes = tuple(range(1, error.ndim))
        count = np.prod(error.shape[1:-1])
        cross = np.sum(error * velocity, axis=axes)
        squared = np.sum(error * error, axis=axes)
        result = (count * float(np.dot(velocity, velocity)) * (hi - lo)
                  - 2 * cross * (self.residual(lo) - self.residual(hi))
                  + squared * self._alpha_square_integral(lo, hi))
        return np.maximum(0.0, result)

    def interval_peak(self, error, velocity, lo, hi):
        points = [lo, hi]
        cfg = self.cfg
        if lo < cfg.capture_check < hi:
            points += [cfg.capture_check]
        values = [self.alpha(s, hold_start=(s == lo and lo >= cfg.capture_check))
                  for s in points]
        if lo <= cfg.capture_check < hi:
            values += [self.alpha(cfg.capture_check, hold_start=True)]
        return np.maximum.reduce([
            np.linalg.norm(velocity - a * error, axis=-1).max(axis=1) for a in values
        ])


@dataclass
class Rollout:
    positions: np.ndarray
    capture_times: np.ndarray
    escape_times: np.ndarray
    effort: np.ndarray
    peak_speed: np.ndarray
    partner_wait: np.ndarray
    first_commit_times: np.ndarray
    stages: list[dict]
    frames: list[tuple[float, np.ndarray]]
    mismatch_count: np.ndarray


def _stepwise_checks(cfg: Config, start: float, end: float):
    """Global detection ticks; extra integration endpoints are not capture ticks."""
    return [round(index * cfg.step_dt, 10)
            for index in range(math.floor(start / cfg.step_dt) + 1,
                               math.floor((end + 1e-10) / cfg.step_dt) + 1)
            if start + 1e-10 < index * cfg.step_dt <= end + 1e-10]


def _is_stepwise_check(cfg: Config, time: float):
    return math.isclose(time, round(time / cfg.step_dt) * cfg.step_dt,
                        rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=1e-10)


def _capture_success(cfg, target, pos, offsets, complete, alive, time):
    anchor = target.position(time)[None, None, :] + offsets
    return (alive & complete &
            (np.linalg.norm(pos - anchor, axis=-1)
             .max(axis=1) <= cfg.capture_radius + 1e-10))


def rollout_target(cfg: Config, target: Target, positions: np.ndarray, offsets: np.ndarray,
                   complete: np.ndarray, start: float, stages: int = 1,
                   trace: bool = False, until: float | None = None) -> Rollout:
    """Batch candidates for ONE target, shape [batch, participating robots, xy].

    Each batch element is an independent counterfactual. No births, assignment
    changes, or access to an Environment occur during this function.
    """
    reject_service(cfg)
    if cfg.turn_max_angle > 0 or cfg.speed_delta_max > 0 or \
            cfg.motion_model == "continuous_turn":
        return rollout_turning_target(cfg, target, positions, offsets, complete, start,
                                      stages, trace, until)
    pos = np.array(positions, dtype=float, copy=True)
    offsets = np.asarray(offsets, dtype=float)
    batch, robots, dimension = pos.shape
    if dimension != 2 or robots < 1 or offsets.shape != (batch, robots, 2):
        raise ValueError("Invalid batch or offset shape")
    complete = np.asarray(complete, dtype=bool)
    if complete.shape != (batch,):
        raise ValueError("Invalid completion mask")
    controller = TrackingController(cfg)
    velocity = target.velocity_at(start)
    captured = np.full(batch, np.nan)
    escaped = np.full(batch, np.nan)
    effort = np.zeros(batch)
    peak_speed = np.zeros(batch)
    wait = np.zeros(batch)
    first_commit = np.full(batch, np.nan)
    mismatches = np.zeros(batch, dtype=int)
    summaries, frames = [], []
    escape_at = target.escape_time(cfg.side)
    instant = cfg.capture_mode == "stepwise_instant"
    end = min(cfg.end_time, start + stages * cfg.stage_dt if until is None else until)
    if trace:
        frames.append((start, pos.copy()))

    for stage_index in range(stages):
        now = start + stage_index * cfg.stage_dt
        if instant and now >= end - 1e-10:
            break
        stage_end = min(now + cfg.stage_dt, end) if instant else now + cfg.stage_dt
        alive = np.isnan(captured) & np.isnan(escaped)
        escaped[alive & (escape_at <= now + 1e-10)] = escape_at
        alive &= np.isnan(escaped)
        if instant:
            success = _capture_success(cfg, target, pos, offsets, complete, alive, now)
            captured[success] = now
            alive &= ~success
        anchor0 = target.position(now)[None, None, :] + offsets
        error0 = pos - anchor0
        guard_peak = controller.peak(error0, velocity)
        residual_error = np.linalg.norm(error0, axis=-1).max(axis=1) * controller.residual(cfg.capture_check)
        commit = (alive & complete & (cfg.turn_max_angle == 0) & (not target.turns)
                  & (not target.arc_rates)
                  & (escape_at > now + cfg.capture_check + 1e-10)
                  & (guard_peak.max(axis=1) <= cfg.max_speed + 1e-10)
                  & (residual_error <= cfg.capture_radius + 1e-10))
        first_commit[commit & np.isnan(first_commit)] = now
        modes = np.where(alive, np.where(commit, "COMMIT", "TRAVEL"), "HOLD")
        stage_effort = np.zeros(batch)
        stage_peak = np.zeros(batch)
        times = [i * cfg.step_dt for i in range(round(cfg.stage_dt / cfg.step_dt) + 1)]
        checks = _stepwise_checks(cfg, now, stage_end) if instant else [now + cfg.capture_check]
        if instant:
            times = [s for s in times if s <= stage_end - now + 1e-10]
            times.append(stage_end - now)
            times.extend(check - now for check in checks)
        if now < escape_at < stage_end:
            times.append(escape_at - now)
        times.extend(turn_time - now for turn_time, _, _ in target.turns
                     if now < turn_time < stage_end)
        times = sorted(set(round(s, 12) for s in times))

        for lo, hi in zip(times[:-1], times[1:]):
            duration = hi - lo
            if duration <= 0:
                continue
            alive = np.isnan(captured) & np.isnan(escaped)
            anchor = target.position(now + lo)[None, None, :] + offsets
            ready = np.linalg.norm(pos - anchor, axis=-1) <= cfg.capture_radius
            waiting = ready.sum(axis=1) * (~(ready.all(axis=1) & complete)) * alive
            wait += waiting * duration

            analytic = alive & commit
            if np.any(analytic):
                peaks = controller.interval_peak(error0, velocity, lo, hi)
                bad = analytic & (peaks > cfg.max_speed + 1e-8)
                if np.any(bad):
                    commit[bad] = False
                    modes[bad] = "FALLBACK"
                    mismatches[bad] += 1
                analytic &= ~bad
                if np.any(analytic):
                    new_anchor = target.position(now + hi)[None, None, :] + offsets
                    analytic_positions = new_anchor + controller.residual(hi) * error0
                    pos[analytic] = analytic_positions[analytic]
                    energy = controller.energy(error0, velocity, lo, hi)
                    stage_effort[analytic] += energy[analytic]
                    stage_peak[analytic] = np.maximum(stage_peak[analytic], peaks[analytic])

            numerical = alive & ~commit
            if np.any(numerical):
                current_velocity = target.velocity_at(now + lo)
                command = current_velocity + cfg.travel_gain * (anchor - pos)
                speed = np.linalg.norm(command, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
                command *= np.minimum(1.0, cfg.max_speed / np.maximum(speed, 1e-15))
                pos[numerical] += command[numerical] * duration
                energy = np.sum(command ** 2, axis=(1, 2)) * duration
                speeds = np.linalg.norm(command, axis=-1).max(axis=1)
                stage_effort[numerical] += energy[numerical]
                stage_peak[numerical] = np.maximum(stage_peak[numerical], speeds[numerical])

            # Escape has precedence, including an exact tie with the capture check.
            if escape_at <= now + hi + 1e-10:
                escaped[alive] = escape_at
            is_check = (_is_stepwise_check(cfg, now + hi) if instant else
                        math.isclose(hi, cfg.capture_check, abs_tol=1e-10))
            if is_check:
                success = _capture_success(cfg, target, pos, offsets, complete,
                                           alive & np.isnan(escaped), now + hi)
                captured[success] = now + hi
            if trace:
                frames.append((now + hi, pos.copy()))
        effort += stage_effort
        peak_speed = np.maximum(peak_speed, stage_peak)
        summaries.append({"time": now, "modes": modes, "guard_peaks": guard_peak,
                          "effort": stage_effort, "peak_speed": stage_peak})
    return Rollout(pos, captured, escaped, effort, peak_speed, wait, first_commit,
                   summaries, frames, mismatches)


def rollout_turning_target(cfg: Config, target: Target, positions: np.ndarray,
                           offsets: np.ndarray, complete: np.ndarray, start: float,
                           stages: int, trace: bool, until: float | None) -> Rollout:
    """Feedback execution; the selected capture clock is shared by every caller."""
    reject_service(cfg)
    pos = np.array(positions, dtype=float, copy=True)
    offsets = np.asarray(offsets, dtype=float)
    complete = np.asarray(complete, dtype=bool)
    if pos.ndim != 3 or pos.shape[2:] != (2,) or offsets.shape != pos.shape[:2] + (2,):
        raise ValueError("Invalid batch or offset shape")
    batch, robots = pos.shape[:2]
    if complete.shape != (batch,):
        raise ValueError("Invalid completion mask")
    end = min(cfg.end_time, start + stages * cfg.stage_dt if until is None else until)
    captured, escaped = np.full(batch, np.nan), np.full(batch, np.nan)
    effort, peak, wait = np.zeros(batch), np.zeros(batch), np.zeros(batch)
    escape_at = target.escape_time(cfg.side)
    alive_at_start = escape_at > start + 1e-10
    if not alive_at_start:
        escaped[:] = escape_at
    instant = cfg.capture_mode == "stepwise_instant"
    if instant and start < cfg.end_time - 1e-10:
        success = _capture_success(cfg, target, pos, offsets, complete,
                                   np.isnan(escaped), start)
        captured[success] = start
    frames = [(start, pos.copy())] if trace else []
    grid = [start + i * cfg.step_dt for i in range(round((end - start) / cfg.step_dt) + 1)]
    grid.append(end)
    if start < escape_at < end:
        grid.append(escape_at)
    grid.extend(t for t, _, _ in target.turns if start < t < end)
    grid.extend(t for t, _ in target.arc_rates if start < t < end)
    checks = [n * cfg.stage_dt + cfg.capture_check
              for n in range(math.floor(start / cfg.stage_dt),
                              math.ceil(end / cfg.stage_dt) + 1)]
    if instant:
        checks = _stepwise_checks(cfg, start, end)
    grid.extend(t for t in checks if start < t <= end + 1e-10)
    times = sorted(set(round(t, 10) for t in grid if start - 1e-10 <= t <= end + 1e-10))
    for lo, hi in zip(times[:-1], times[1:]):
        duration = hi - lo
        if duration <= 0:
            continue
        alive = np.isnan(captured) & np.isnan(escaped)
        anchor = target.position(lo)[None, None, :] + offsets
        ready = np.linalg.norm(pos - anchor, axis=-1) <= cfg.capture_radius
        wait += ready.sum(axis=1) * (~(ready.all(axis=1) & complete)) * alive * duration
        command = target.velocity_at(lo) + cfg.travel_gain * (anchor - pos)
        speed = np.linalg.norm(command, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
        command *= np.minimum(1.0, cfg.max_speed / np.maximum(speed, 1e-15))
        pos[alive] += command[alive] * duration
        effort[alive] += np.sum(command[alive] ** 2, axis=(1, 2)) * duration
        interval_peak = np.linalg.norm(command, axis=-1).max(axis=1)
        peak[alive] = np.maximum(peak[alive], interval_peak[alive])
        if escape_at <= hi + 1e-10:
            escaped[alive] = escape_at
        is_check = (_is_stepwise_check(cfg, hi) if instant else
                    any(math.isclose(hi, check, abs_tol=1e-9) for check in checks))
        if is_check:
            success = _capture_success(cfg, target, pos, offsets, complete,
                                       alive & np.isnan(escaped), hi)
            captured[success] = hi
        if trace:
            frames.append((hi, pos.copy()))
    modes = "TRAVEL" if alive_at_start else "HOLD"
    return Rollout(pos, captured, escaped, effort, peak, wait, np.full(batch, np.nan),
                   [{"time": start, "modes": np.full(batch, modes),
                     "guard_peaks": np.zeros((batch, robots)), "effort": effort,
                     "peak_speed": peak}], frames, np.zeros(batch, dtype=int))


def candidate_benefit(cfg: Config, target: Target, result: Rollout, start: float, stages: int,
                      until: float | None = None):
    """Incremental finite-horizon reward versus leaving this task unattended."""
    reject_service(cfg)
    end = min(cfg.end_time, start + stages * cfg.stage_dt if until is None else until)
    unattended_stop = min(end, target.escape_time(cfg.side))
    stop = np.where(np.isfinite(result.capture_times), result.capture_times, unattended_stop)
    flow_saved = target.weight * np.maximum(0.0, unattended_stop - stop)
    late_origin = max(start, target.birth, target.deadline)
    late_saved = target.weight * (max(0.0, unattended_stop - late_origin)
                                  - np.maximum(0.0, stop - late_origin))
    success = np.isfinite(result.capture_times)
    score = (target.weight * success / cfg.weight_reference
             + cfg.flow_weight * flow_saved / (cfg.weight_reference * cfg.stage_dt)
             + cfg.late_weight * late_saved / (cfg.weight_reference * cfg.stage_dt)
             - cfg.control_weight * result.effort / cfg.effort_reference)
    if end >= cfg.end_time - 1e-9:
        score += cfg.unfinished_weight * target.weight * success / cfg.weight_reference
    return score

=== FILE: pursuit_v2/policies.py ===
from __future__ import annotations

from pursuit_v2.service import reject_service

from dataclasses import dataclass
from time import perf_counter
import numpy as np

from .allocation import allocate
from .types import IDLE, Observation, complete_roles, role_offset
from .physics import rollout_target
from .risk import assess_options, risk_horizon, travel_certificate


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Decision:
    assignment: tuple
    log: dict


def forecast_risk(obs: Observation):
    reject_service(obs.config)
    reasons = []
    horizon = min(obs.config.prediction_stages, obs.config.max_stages - obs.stage)
    for target in obs.targets:
        robots = [k for k, a in enumerate(obs.assignment) if a.target == target.id]
        if not robots:
            continue
        roles = [obs.assignment[k].role for k in robots]
        if not complete_roles(target, roles):
            reasons.append(f"incomplete_coalition:{target.id}")
            continue
        result = rollout_target(
            obs.config, target, obs.positions[robots][None],
            np.array([role_offset(r, obs.config) for r in roles])[None],
            np.ones(1, dtype=bool), obs.time, horizon)
        if np.isfinite(result.escape_times[0]) and not np.isfinite(result.capture_times[0]):
            reasons.append(f"predicted_escape:{target.id}")
    return reasons


def incumbent_risks(obs: Observation):
    reject_service(obs.config)
    reports, risky = [], []
    for target in obs.targets:
        group = tuple(k for k, a in enumerate(obs.assignment) if a.target == target.id)
        if not group:
            continue
        roles = tuple(obs.assignment[k].role for k in group)
        if not complete_roles(target, roles):
            reports.append({"target": target.id, "probability": 0.0, "complete": False})
            risky.append(target.id)
            continue
        certificate = travel_certificate(obs, target, group, roles)
        if certificate["certified_on_time"] or (target.deadline < obs.time and
                                                 certificate["certified_next_check"]):
            reports.append({"target": target.id, "probability": 1.0,
                            "complete": True, "certified": True,
                            "estimate": {"on_time_probability": float(
                                certificate["certified_on_time"])}})
            continue
        estimate = assess_options(obs, target, [(group, roles)], risk_horizon(obs, target),
                                  samples=obs.config.risk_trigger_samples)[0]
        probability = (estimate["on_time_probability"] if target.deadline >= obs.time
                       else estimate["completion_probability"])
        reports.append({"target": target.id, "probability": probability,
                        "complete": True, "estimate": estimate})
        if probability < obs.config.risk_threshold:
            risky.append(target.id)
    return reports, tuple(risky)


def local_scope(obs: Observation, risky_targets):
    """One-hop closure: replacement robots bring their incumbent task and partners."""
    ids = set(risky_targets)
    available = {k for k, a in enumerate(obs.assignment) if a.target in ids}
    for target in obs.targets:
        if target.id not in ids:
            continue
        point = target.position(obs.time)
        ranked = sorted((float(np.linalg.norm(obs.positions[k] - point)), k)
                        for k in range(obs.config.robots) if k not in available)
        for _, k in ranked[:obs.config.local_substitutes]:
            available.add(k)
            original = obs.assignment[k].target
            if original is not None:
                ids.add(original)
                available.update(j for j, a in enumerate(obs.assignment) if a.target == original)
    excluded = tuple(t.id for t in obs.targets if t.id not in ids)
    return tuple(sorted(available)), excluded


class Policy:
    def __init__(self, mode: str, solver: str = "exact"):
        if mode not in ("fixed", "periodic", "event", "risk_periodic", "risk_event",
                        "risk_local"):
            raise ValueError("Unknown policy mode")
        self.mode = mode
        self.solver = solver
        self.local_mode = mode == "risk_local"
        self.last_replan_stage = -10**9
        self.last_global_fallback_stage = -10**9

    def decide(self, obs: Observation) -> Decision:
        reject_service(obs.config)
        start = perf_counter()
        reasons = []
        available = None
        excluded = ()
        risk_checked = False
        risk_mode = self.mode.startswith("risk_")
        reports, risky = [], ()
        if not obs.targets:
            return Decision((IDLE,) * obs.config.robots,
                            {"replanned": False, "reasons": ["no_active_tasks"],
                             "candidate_count": 0, "selected": [], "prediction_seconds": 0.0,
                             "solver_seconds": 0.0, "trigger_seconds": 0.0,
                             "decision_seconds": perf_counter() - start, "risk_checked": False})
        if self.mode == "fixed":
            # Nonpreemptive: retain all live jobs; dispatch only idle/released robots.
            available = tuple(k for k, a in enumerate(obs.assignment) if a == IDLE)
            excluded = tuple({a.target for a in obs.assignment if a.target is not None})
            if available and any(t.id not in excluded for t in obs.targets):
                reasons.append("dispatch_free_robots")
        elif self.mode in ("periodic", "risk_periodic"):
            reasons.append("periodic_boundary")
        else:
            if obs.stage == 0 and obs.time == 0:
                reasons.append("initial")
            if obs.new_ids:
                reasons.append("birth")
            if obs.ended_ids:
                reasons.append("task_ended")
            if obs.stage - self.last_replan_stage >= obs.config.max_plan_age:
                reasons.append("max_plan_age")
            if not reasons:
                risk_checked = True
                if risk_mode:
                    reports, risky = incumbent_risks(obs)
                    reasons.extend(f"low_joint_success:{i}" for i in risky)
                else:
                    reasons.extend(forecast_risk(obs))
        triggered = perf_counter()
        log = {"replanned": bool(reasons), "reasons": reasons or ["maintain"],
               "trigger_seconds": triggered - start, "risk_checked": risk_checked,
               "incumbent_risks": reports}
        if reasons:
            if self.local_mode and risky and all(r.startswith("low_joint_success:")
                                                 for r in reasons):
                available, excluded = local_scope(obs, risky)
                actions, allocation_log = allocate(obs, self.solver, available, excluded,
                                                   risk=True)
                log["repair_scope"] = {"robots": available,
                                       "targets": [t.id for t in obs.targets
                                                   if t.id not in excluded]}
                selected = {c["target"]: c for c in allocation_log["selected"]}
                missing_risky = any(i not in selected for i in risky)
                legacy_fallback = (self.last_global_fallback_stage != obs.stage and
                                   len(available) < obs.config.robots and missing_risky)
                if legacy_fallback:
                    local_log = allocation_log
                    global_actions, global_log = allocate(obs, self.solver, risk=True)
                    gain = (global_log["candidate_objective"] -
                            local_log["candidate_objective"])
                    accept = legacy_fallback or gain > obs.config.change_cost + 1e-12
                    log["scope_screen_gain"] = gain
                    log["scope_screen_margin"] = obs.config.change_cost
                    log["scope_screen_accepted"] = bool(accept)
                    if accept:
                        actions, allocation_log = global_actions, global_log
                        log["fallback_global"] = True
                        log["fallback_reason"] = ("legacy_missing_risky" if legacy_fallback
                                                  else "excluded_target_value")
                        self.last_global_fallback_stage = obs.stage
                    other_log = local_log if accept else global_log
                    allocation_log["candidate_count"] += other_log["candidate_count"]
                    allocation_log["prediction_seconds"] += other_log["prediction_seconds"]
                    allocation_log["solver_seconds"] += other_log["solver_seconds"]
            else:
                actions, allocation_log = allocate(obs, self.solver, available, excluded,
                                                   risk=risk_mode)
            log.update(allocation_log)
            self.last_replan_stage = obs.stage
        else:
            actions = obs.assignment
            log.update({"candidate_count": 0, "selected": [], "prediction_seconds": 0.0,
                        "solver_seconds": 0.0, "solver": self.solver})
        log["decision_seconds"] = perf_counter() - start
        return Decision(actions, log)

"""Self-contained canvas replay; no CDN or local web server required."""
import json
from pathlib import Path

from .io import clean_json


def write_replay(path, record):
    template = Path(__file__).with_name("replay_template.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    payload = json.dumps(clean_json(record), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False).replace("<", "\\u003c")
