def static_preflight(root):
    root=Path(root).resolve();report=root/'reports/stfbs_lite_d1b_qm1b_eng_001';base=read(report/'BASELINE.json')
    if subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip()!=HEAD:raise ValueError('QM1BENG_HEAD_MISMATCH')
    for p,s in {**base['existing_source_pins'],**base['protected_archives'],**base['protected_manifests']}.items():
        if sha(root/p)!=s:raise ValueError('FROZEN_FILE_CHANGED: '+p)
    changed=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).splitlines()
    if changed:raise ValueError('EXISTING_TRACKED_FILE_CHANGED: '+repr(changed))
    others=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],cwd=root,text=True).splitlines()
    if any(p not in NEW_FILES and not p.startswith('reports/stfbs_lite_d1b_qm1b_eng_001/') for p in others):raise ValueError('UNAPPROVED_NEW_PATH')
    for p in NEW_FILES:
        text=(root/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig');compile(text,str(root/p),'exec')
    tree=ast.parse((root/NEW_FILES[3]).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
    names=[n.name for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name.startswith('test_')]
    if sorted(names)!=sorted(NAMES) or len(names)!=10:raise ValueError('TEST_AST_WHITELIST_MISMATCH')
    for n in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(n,(ast.Assign,ast.AnnAssign)):
            targets=n.targets if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) else [n.target]
            if any(isinstance(t,ast.Attribute) and t.attr in ('estimate','least_squares','run','advance','step','process','fuse') for t in targets):raise ValueError('TEST_RESTORES_SCIENTIFIC_ENTRY')
        if isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Name) and n.func.id in ('eval','exec','__import__'):raise ValueError('DYNAMIC_TEST_IMPORT_OR_EXEC')
    return dict(source_pins={**base['existing_source_pins'],**{p:sha(root/p) for p in NEW_FILES}},new_source_pins={p:sha(root/p) for p in NEW_FILES},baseline_sha256=sha(report/'BASELINE.json'))

def verify_launch(root,args):
    """Called before importing any test or scientific module."""
    import psutil
    from ctypes import wintypes as W
    root=Path(root).resolve();policy_path=Path(args.run_policy).resolve()
    if not sys.flags.isolated or not sys.dont_write_bytecode:raise ValueError('ISOLATED_NO_BYTECODE_REQUIRED')
    if sha(policy_path)!=args.policy_sha256:raise ValueError('RUN_POLICY_DIGEST_MISMATCH')
    p=read(policy_path);launch_path=Path(args.launch_ticket).resolve();launch=read(launch_path)
    if p['task']!=TASK or p['suite']!=SUITE or args.suite!=SUITE or p['test_ids']!=list(IDS):raise ValueError('QM1BENG_SUITE_IDENTITY')
    if Path(p['root']).resolve()!=root or Path.cwd().resolve()!=root:raise ValueError('QM1BENG_ROOT_OR_CWD')
    if Path(sys.argv[0]).resolve()!=Path(p['entry_script']).resolve() or Path(sys.executable).resolve()!=Path(p['python']).resolve():raise ValueError('QM1BENG_SCRIPT_OR_PYTHON')
    expected=[args.policy_sha256 if s=='<RUN_POLICY_SHA256>' else s for s in p['allowed_child_command']]
    me=psutil.Process();parent=psutil.Process(os.getppid())
    if me.cmdline()!=expected or parent.cmdline()!=p['watchdog_command']:raise ValueError('QM1BENG_COMMAND_MISMATCH')
    if launch['child_pid']!=os.getpid() or launch['watchdog_pid']!=parent.pid or p['watchdog_pid']!=parent.pid:raise ValueError('QM1BENG_PID_BINDING')
    if parent.create_time()!=p['watchdog_create_time'] or not parent.create_time()<=me.create_time()<=time.time()+1:raise ValueError('QM1BENG_PROCESS_CREATION_BINDING')
    if Path(p['watchdog_script']).resolve() not in [Path(a).resolve() for a in parent.cmdline() if a.endswith('.py')]:raise ValueError('QM1BENG_PARENT_SCRIPT')
    if (p['wall_limit'],p['cpu_limit'],p['attempts'])!=(180,120,1) or launch['wall_limit']!=180 or launch['assigned_before_resume'] is not True or launch.get('approval_sha256') is not None:raise ValueError('QM1BENG_LIMIT_OR_JOB_TICKET')
    if launch_path!=Path(p['evidence_dir'])/'LAUNCH.json':raise ValueError('QM1BENG_LAUNCH_PATH')
    api=ctypes.WinDLL('kernel32',use_last_error=True);api.GetCurrentProcess.restype=W.HANDLE
    api.IsProcessInJob.argtypes=[W.HANDLE,W.HANDLE,ctypes.POINTER(W.BOOL)];api.IsProcessInJob.restype=W.BOOL
    member=W.BOOL()
    if not api.IsProcessInJob(api.GetCurrentProcess(),None,ctypes.byref(member)):raise ctypes.WinError(ctypes.get_last_error())
    if not member.value:raise ValueError('QM1BENG_NOT_IN_WINDOWS_JOB')
    for name,s in p['source_pins'].items():
        if sha(root/name)!=s:raise ValueError('QM1BENG_SOURCE_IDENTITY: '+name)
    if subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip()!=p['head']:raise ValueError('QM1BENG_HEAD_CHANGED')
    if sha(sys.executable)!=p['python_sha256']:raise ValueError('QM1BENG_PYTHON_IDENTITY')
    attempt=read(policy_path.parent/'TEST_ATTEMPT.json')
    if attempt['policy_sha256']!=args.policy_sha256 or attempt['attempt']!=1 or attempt['watchdog_pid']!=parent.pid:raise ValueError('QM1BENG_ATTEMPT_BINDING')
    return p,dict(status='PASS',child_pid=me.pid,parent_pid=parent.pid,parent_create_time=parent.create_time(),child_create_time=me.create_time(),actual_command=me.cmdline(),watchdog_command=parent.cmdline(),cwd=str(Path.cwd()),in_windows_job=True,policy_sha256=args.policy_sha256,launch_sha256=sha(launch_path),isolated=True,no_bytecode=True)

class ForbiddenScienceCall(RuntimeError):pass
class GuardRegistry:
    def __init__(self):
        self.entries=[];self.calls=[];self.checks=[];self.scopes=[];self.current_test=None;self.allowed_fake=None;self.overwritten=False
    def add(self,owner,attribute,category):
        original=getattr(owner,attribute)
        if getattr(original,'_qm1a_guard',False):guard=original
        else:
            label=getattr(owner,'__name__',repr(owner))+'.'+attribute
            def guard(*args,**kwargs):
                self.calls.append(dict(category=category,entry=label,test=self.current_test,stack=traceback.format_stack(limit=8)))
                raise ForbiddenScienceCall('FORBIDDEN_SCIENTIFIC_CALL: '+label)
            guard._qm1a_guard=True
        setattr(owner,attribute,guard);self.entries.append((owner,attribute,guard,category))
        return original,guard
    def integrity(self,phase):
        broken=[]
        for owner,attr,guard,category in self.entries:
            expected=self.allowed_fake if self.allowed_fake is not None and getattr(owner,'__name__','')=='Branch' and attr=='fuse' else guard
            if getattr(owner,attr) is not expected:broken.append(getattr(owner,'__name__','')+'.'+attr)
        self.checks.append(dict(phase=phase,broken=broken,forbidden_attempts=len(self.calls),fake_scope=self.allowed_fake is not None))
        if broken:self.overwritten=True;raise RuntimeError('GUARD_OVERWRITTEN: '+repr(broken))
    def note_double(self,description):
        self.scopes.append(dict(test=self.current_test,label=LABEL,description=description,kind='pure synthetic data',physical_evidence=False))
    @contextmanager
    def fake_scope(self,description,fn):
        from .stfbs_d1a_model import Branch
        if getattr(fn,'evidence_kind',None)!=LABEL or self.allowed_fake is not None:raise ValueError('Unregistered/nested fake fusion')
        self.integrity('before fake: '+description)
        previous=Branch.fuse;record=dict(test=self.current_test,label=LABEL,description=description,kind='fusion substitute',closed=False,physical_evidence=False)
        self.scopes.append(record);self.allowed_fake=fn;Branch.fuse=fn
        try:
            self.integrity('entered fake: '+description);yield
        finally:
            Branch.fuse=previous;self.allowed_fake=None;record['closed']=True
            self.integrity('after fake: '+description)
    def ledger(self):
        categories=('WLS','FUSION','MODEL_ADVANCE','ACTUAL_STEP','SAMPLING','QUALITY','POLICY_SEARCH')
        return dict(installed_entries=[dict(owner=getattr(o,'__name__',repr(o)),attribute=a,category=c,guard_installed=getattr(o,a) is g) for o,a,g,c in self.entries],
            forbidden_attempts={c:sum(x['category']==c for x in self.calls) for c in categories},attempt_details=self.calls,actual_scientific_execution={k:None if self.overwritten else 0 for k in ('WLS','MODEL_advance','ACTUAL_STEP')},
            guard_checks=self.checks,fake_fuse_scopes=self.scopes,ever_overwritten=self.overwritten,scope='Known reachable whitelist call graph; no intentional guard calls; substitutes are not physical evidence')

def install_guards():
    """No original solver reference is exposed to the tests; aliases are patched too."""
    global _ACTIVE
    import scipy.optimize as opt
    from research.cooperative_sensing import estimator
    registry=GuardRegistry();_ACTIVE=registry;originals=[]
    for owner,attr in ((estimator,'estimate'),(estimator,'least_squares'),(opt,'least_squares')):
        originals.append(registry.add(owner,attr,'WLS'))
    from research.non_oracle import stfbs_d1a_model as m,policy
    from research.non_oracle import stfbs_d1b_qm_model as qm
    from research.non_oracle import stfbs_d1b_qm_execution as execution
    from research.information_service_bridge import public_stream as bridge
    from research.information_service import public_quality as quality
    from research.information_service_online.execution import OnlineEnvironment
    from pursuit_v2.environment import Environment,TimedEnvironment
    from pursuit_v2 import service
    targets=[(m,'estimate','WLS'),(policy,'estimate','WLS'),(m.Budget,'estimator','WLS'),
        (bridge,'_estimate','WLS'),(quality,'_estimate','WLS'),(quality,'assess_quality','QUALITY'),(bridge,'assess_quality','QUALITY'),(policy,'assess_quality','QUALITY'),
        (execution.DynamicSchedule,'run_to_end','MODEL_ADVANCE'),(m.Branch,'fuse','FUSION'),(bridge.BridgeFrameProcessor,'process','FUSION'),(quality.FrameProcessor,'process','FUSION'),
        (m.Branch,'raw','SAMPLING'),(qm.QMBranch,'raw','SAMPLING'),(m.Branch,'advance','MODEL_ADVANCE'),(m.Branch,'run','MODEL_ADVANCE'),(m.Branch,'finish','MODEL_ADVANCE'),(qm.QMBranch,'run','MODEL_ADVANCE'),
        (OnlineEnvironment,'step','ACTUAL_STEP'),(OnlineEnvironment,'_advance_tick','ACTUAL_STEP'),(OnlineEnvironment,'_sample','SAMPLING'),(OnlineEnvironment,'_fuse','FUSION'),(Environment,'step','ACTUAL_STEP'),(TimedEnvironment,'step','ACTUAL_STEP'),
        (service,'rollout_fixed_service','MODEL_ADVANCE'),(service,'advance_clock','MODEL_ADVANCE'),(m,'advance_clock','MODEL_ADVANCE'),(policy,'advance_clock','MODEL_ADVANCE'),(policy,'decide','POLICY_SEARCH'),(policy,'evaluate','POLICY_SEARCH')]
    for owner,attr,category in targets:originals.append(registry.add(owner,attr,category))
    # Catch already-imported estimate/solver/processor aliases, including SciPy exports.
    for module in list(sys.modules.values()):
        if module is None:continue
        for attr,value in list(vars(module).items()):
            for original,guard in originals:
                if value is original and original is not guard:
                    setattr(module,attr,guard);registry.entries.append((module,attr,guard,'ALIAS'));break
    originals.clear();registry.integrity('installed before test import')
    return registry

def active_registry():
    if _ACTIVE is None:raise RuntimeError('Protected test runner required')
    return _ACTIVE

def assert_public_surface(value):
    """Inspect actual reachable objects, not just JSON key spellings."""
    from .stfbs_d1b_qm_model import PublicProfiles,SensorAuthority,QMBranch
    seen=set()
    def visit(obj):
        if id(obj) in seen:return
        seen.add(id(obj))
        if obj is None or type(obj) in (str,int,float,bool):return
        if isinstance(obj,(SensorAuthority,QMBranch)):raise ValueError('PRIVATE_EXECUTOR_REACHABLE')
        if type(obj) is PublicProfiles:
            if obj.public_profile_at.__func__.__closure__:raise ValueError('PUBLIC_CLOSURE_REACHABLE')
            visit(obj.to_public_dict());return
        if isinstance(obj,dict):
            if any(k in obj for k in ('_schedule','private_schedule','sensor_declaration_schedule','private_environment')):raise ValueError('PRIVATE_SCHEDULE_FIELD')
            for k,v in obj.items():visit(k);visit(v)
            return
        if isinstance(obj,(list,tuple,set)):
            for child in obj:visit(child)
            return
        if callable(obj):raise ValueError('PUBLIC_CALLABLE_OR_CLOSURE_REACHABLE')
        raise ValueError('UNAPPROVED_PUBLIC_OBJECT: '+type(obj).__name__)
    visit(value)
    return dict(status='PASS',scope='Detached public data/snapshot reachable graph, no private instance or captured callbacks; not a malicious-Python sandbox')

def verify_receipts(report):
    report=Path(report);p=read(report/'RUN_POLICY.json');attempt=read(report/'TEST_ATTEMPT.json')
    w=read(Path(p['evidence_dir'])/'WATCHDOG_RECEIPT.json');launch=read(Path(p['evidence_dir'])/'LAUNCH.json')
    bind=read(report/'LAUNCH_BINDING.json');tests=read(report/'DETERMINISTIC_TEST_RESULTS.json');ledger=read(report/'FORBIDDEN_CALL_LEDGER.json')
    if p['task']!=TASK or p['suite']!=SUITE or p['test_ids']!=list(IDS) or attempt['policy_sha256']!=sha(report/'RUN_POLICY.json'):raise ValueError('POLICY_NOT_VERIFIED')
    if (w['wall_limit'],w['cpu_limit'],w['attempts'],w['status'],w['exit_code'])!=(180,120,1,'EXITED',0):raise ValueError('SUPERVISION_NOT_VERIFIED')
    if not w['cpu_complete'] or w['active_processes']!=0 or w.get('descendant_cleanup'):raise ValueError('JOB_ACCOUNTING_NOT_VERIFIED')
    for key,limit in (('tree_cpu_seconds',120),('process_cpu_seconds',120),('wall_seconds',180)):
        v=w.get(key)
        if type(v) not in (int,float) or not math.isfinite(v) or not 0<=v<=limit:raise ValueError('RESOURCE_NOT_VERIFIED: '+key)
    if launch['wall_limit']!=180 or not launch['assigned_before_resume'] or not bind['in_windows_job']:raise ValueError('JOB_BINDING_NOT_VERIFIED')
    if launch['child_pid']!=w['child_pid'] or bind['child_pid']!=w['child_pid'] or launch['watchdog_pid']!=w['watchdog_pid'] or bind['parent_pid']!=w['watchdog_pid']:raise ValueError('PID_NOT_VERIFIED')
    if bind['policy_sha256']!=sha(report/'RUN_POLICY.json') or bind['actual_command']!=w['command']:raise ValueError('COMMAND_NOT_VERIFIED')
    if tests['executed_ids']!=list(IDS) or len(set(tests['executed_ids']))!=10 or not tests['all_passed'] or tests['skips'] or tests['unexpected_successes']:raise ValueError('TWELVE_TESTS_NOT_VERIFIED')
    if ledger['ever_overwritten'] or any(ledger['forbidden_attempts'].values()) or any(ledger['actual_scientific_execution'].values()):raise ValueError('ZERO_SCIENCE_NOT_VERIFIED')
    if any(c['broken'] for c in ledger['guard_checks']) or any(not x['guard_installed'] for x in ledger['installed_entries']):raise ValueError('GUARDS_NOT_VERIFIED')
    if any(s.get('kind')=='fusion substitute' and not s['closed'] for s in ledger['fake_fuse_scopes']):raise ValueError('FAKE_SCOPE_NOT_CLOSED')
    for name,s in p['source_pins'].items():
        if sha(Path(p['root'])/name)!=s:raise ValueError('POSTRUN_SOURCE_CHANGED')
    return dict(status='PASS',task=TASK,suite=SUITE,policy_sha256=sha(report/'RUN_POLICY.json'),production_launch_marker=w.get('production_launch'),production_marker_note='None approval is correct for this engineering suite; no H1 validator used',test_count=10,zero_science=True)

# External fixture registrations are frozen BEFORE branch construction.
from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ExternalRegistration:
    branch_id: str
    fixture_digest: str
    prefix_json: str
    source_pins_json: str
    registration_digest: str

def register_fixture(fixture,branch_id,source_pins):
    from .stfbs_d1b_qm_scenario import validate_fixture
    from .stfbs_d1b_qm_execution import IDENTITIES
    from .stfbs_d1a_replay import digest
    validate_fixture(fixture)
    if branch_id not in IDENTITIES or not source_pins:raise ValueError('External registration identity/pins required')
    prefix=json.dumps({h['target_id']:h for h in fixture.view['histories']},sort_keys=True)
    payload=dict(branch_id=branch_id,fixture_digest=digest(dict(view=fixture.view,seed=fixture.seed,world=fixture.world,identity=fixture.identity)),prefix_json=prefix,source_pins_json=json.dumps(source_pins,sort_keys=True))
    return ExternalRegistration(**payload,registration_digest=digest(payload))

def verify_registration(registration,fixture,branch_id):
    if type(registration) is not ExternalRegistration:raise ValueError('External registration required')
    expected=register_fixture(fixture,branch_id,json.loads(registration.source_pins_json))
    if expected!=registration:raise ValueError('Fixture/prefix/branch registration mismatch')
    return True

def audit_registered(branch,registration):
    from .stfbs_d1a_history_audit import AuditContext,audit_branch_independent
    from .stfbs_d1a_replay import digest
    if type(registration) is not ExternalRegistration:raise ValueError('External registration required')
    payload={k:getattr(registration,k) for k in ('branch_id','fixture_digest','prefix_json','source_pins_json')}
    if digest(payload)!=registration.registration_digest or branch.name!=registration.branch_id:raise ValueError('External identity mismatch')
    # Never reads branch._audit_context; frozen prefix supplied by external registration.
    return audit_branch_independent(branch,context=AuditContext(registration.branch_id,registration.prefix_json))

"""D1B profile/public interfaces and preset actions, no automatic execution."""
from copy import deepcopy
import json,math
from .stfbs_d1a_model import Branch,Budget,point
from .stfbs_d1a_replay import digest
from .stfbs_d1b_qm_scenario import validate_fixture

class PublicQueryRejected(ValueError):pass
class CandidateAdmissionRejected(ValueError):pass

class PublicProfiles:
    """Detached immutable publication snapshot, with no authority/closure reference."""
    __slots__=('_published_json','_watermark')
    def __init__(self,watermark,published):
        object.__setattr__(self,'_watermark',watermark)
        object.__setattr__(self,'_published_json',json.dumps(published,sort_keys=True))
    def __setattr__(self,name,value):raise AttributeError('Immutable public publication snapshot')
    def __deepcopy__(self,memo):return self
    @property
    def watermark(self):return self._watermark
    def public_profile_at(self,tick):
        if type(tick) is not int or tick>self._watermark:raise PublicQueryRejected('PUBLIC_QUERY_REJECTED_AS_FUTURE')
        rows=json.loads(self._published_json);eligible=[r for r in rows if r['effective_tick']<=tick]
        if not eligible:raise PublicQueryRejected('PUBLIC_QUERY_OUTSIDE_PUBLISHED_HISTORY')
        return [dict(p,observed_tick=tick) for p in eligible[-1]['profiles']]
    def to_public_dict(self):return dict(watermark=self._watermark,published=json.loads(self._published_json))

class SensorAuthority:
    """Trusted executor only. This object is never a policy-visible object."""
    def __init__(self,degraded_sigma=.08):
        if type(degraded_sigma) not in (int,float) or not math.isfinite(degraded_sigma) or degraded_sigma<=0:raise ValueError('Invalid sigma')
        normal=[dict(sensor_id='U'+str(i),sigma=.02,health='available') for i in range(3)]
        changed=deepcopy(normal);changed[1]['sigma']=degraded_sigma
        self._schedule=[dict(effective_tick=60,public_tick=60,profiles=normal),dict(effective_tick=80,public_tick=80,profiles=changed)]
        self._watermark=60;self._published=[deepcopy(self._schedule[0])]
    def physical_profile_at(self,tick):
        if type(tick) is not int or not 60<=tick<=120:raise ValueError('Invalid MODEL physical profile tick')
        row=next(r for r in reversed(self._schedule) if r['effective_tick']<=tick)
        return [dict(p,observed_tick=tick) for p in deepcopy(row['profiles'])]
    def publish_from_executor(self,executor_tick):
        if type(executor_tick) is not int or not self._watermark<=executor_tick<=120:raise ValueError('Invalid trusted publication cut')
        self._published=[deepcopy(r) for r in self._schedule if r['public_tick']<=executor_tick]
        self._watermark=executor_tick
    def public_snapshot(self):return PublicProfiles(self._watermark,self._published)

def initial_team():return [dict(target=0,role='dual_neg45'),dict(target=0,role='dual_pos45'),dict(target=None,role='none')]
def changed_team():return [dict(target=0,role='dual_neg45'),dict(target=None,role='none'),dict(target=0,role='dual_pos45')]

def validate_assignment(view,actions):
    if not isinstance(actions,list) or len(actions)!=view['config']['robots']:raise ValueError('Complete Assignment required')
    targets={t['id']:t for t in view['targets']};teams={j:[] for j in targets}
    for i,a in enumerate(actions):
        if not isinstance(a,dict) or set(a)!={'target','role'}:raise ValueError('Malformed Assignment')
        if a['target'] is None:
            if a['role']!='none':raise ValueError('Idle role mismatch')
        else:
            if type(a['target']) is not int or a['target'] not in targets:raise ValueError('Inactive/foreign target')
            teams[a['target']].append((i,a['role']))
    for j,team in teams.items():
        if team and (len(team)!=targets[j]['required_robots'] or len(team)!=2 or {role for _,role in team}!={'dual_neg45','dual_pos45'}):raise ValueError('Invalid complete q2 team')
    return deepcopy(actions)

def admit_substitute(robot_ids,team,retained=0,outgoing=1):
    if len(set(robot_ids))!=len(robot_ids) or len(set(team))!=2 or retained not in team or outgoing not in team or retained==outgoing:raise CandidateAdmissionRejected('INVALID_PUBLIC_CANDIDATE_STATE')
    available=[r for r in robot_ids if r not in team]
    if not available:raise CandidateAdmissionRejected('PUBLIC_CANDIDATE_ADMISSION_REJECTED_AS_EXPECTED')
    return tuple(available)

def preset_action(view,branch):
    if branch not in ('B0','B1') or view['tick'] not in (60,80,100):raise ValueError('Unknown preset branch/cut')
    if view['tick']==80 and any(t['id']==0 for t in view['targets']) and view['assignment']!=initial_team():raise ValueError('Unexpected pre-intervention team')
    if not any(t['id']==0 for t in view['targets']):actions=deepcopy(view['assignment'])
    elif view['tick']==60:actions=initial_team()
    elif view['tick']==80 and branch=='B1':
        candidates=admit_substitute(tuple(range(view['config']['robots'])),(0,1))
        if 2 not in candidates or view['assignment'][2]['target'] is not None:raise CandidateAdmissionRejected('R2_NOT_AVAILABLE')
        actions=changed_team()
    else:actions=deepcopy(view['assignment'])
    return dict(contract_id='D1B_PRESET_ACTION_V1',source='EXPERIMENT_PRESET_NOT_AUTONOMOUS',branch=branch,
                tick=view['tick'],public_digest=digest(view),actions=validate_assignment(view,actions))

class QMBranch(Branch):
    def __init__(self,fixture,name='B0',degraded_sigma=.08):
        validate_fixture(fixture)
        super().__init__(fixture.view,fixture.seed,fixture.world,name,Budget())
        self._sensor_authority=SensorAuthority(degraded_sigma);self._last_public_cut=60
    def public_inputs(self):
        public=self._sensor_authority.public_snapshot()
        v=self.policy_view()
        return dict(policy_view=v,config=deepcopy(v['config']),public_profiles=public)
    def policy_view(self):
        public=self._sensor_authority.public_snapshot()
        profiles=public.public_profile_at(self.tick)  # Reject before state mutation.
        if self.tick not in (60,80,100):raise ValueError('Illegal public decision cut')
        if self.tick!=self._last_public_cut:
            self.frozen=self.consumer.freeze(self.tick);self._last_public_cut=self.tick
        active=[j for j in self.targets if self.status[j]=='active']
        v=deepcopy(self.view);v.update(tick=self.tick,positions=self.positions.tolist(),assignment=deepcopy(self.actions),
            targets=[deepcopy(self.targets[j]) for j in active],histories=[deepcopy(self.histories[j]) for j in active],
            beliefs=deepcopy(self.frozen),sensor_profiles=profiles,

class ForbiddenScienceCall(RuntimeError):pass
class GuardRegistry:
    def __init__(self):
        self.entries=[];self.calls=[];self.checks=[];self.scopes=[];self.current_test=None;self.allowed_fake=None;self.overwritten=False
    def add(self,owner,attribute,category):
        original=getattr(owner,attribute)
        if getattr(original,'_qm1a_guard',False):guard=original
        else:
            label=getattr(owner,'__name__',repr(owner))+'.'+attribute
            def guard(*args,**kwargs):
                self.calls.append(dict(category=category,entry=label,test=self.current_test,stack=traceback.format_stack(limit=8)))
                raise ForbiddenScienceCall('FORBIDDEN_SCIENTIFIC_CALL: '+label)
            guard._qm1a_guard=True
        setattr(owner,attribute,guard);self.entries.append((owner,attribute,guard,category))
        return original,guard
    def integrity(self,phase):
        broken=[]
        for owner,attr,guard,category in self.entries:
            expected=self.allowed_fake if self.allowed_fake is not None and getattr(owner,'__name__','')=='Branch' and attr=='fuse' else guard
            if getattr(owner,attr) is not expected:broken.append(getattr(owner,'__name__','')+'.'+attr)
        self.checks.append(dict(phase=phase,broken=broken,forbidden_attempts=len(self.calls),fake_scope=self.allowed_fake is not None))
        if broken:self.overwritten=True;raise RuntimeError('GUARD_OVERWRITTEN: '+repr(broken))
    def note_double(self,description):
        self.scopes.append(dict(test=self.current_test,label=LABEL,description=description,kind='pure synthetic data',physical_evidence=False))
    @contextmanager
    def fake_scope(self,description,fn):
        from .stfbs_d1a_model import Branch
        if getattr(fn,'evidence_kind',None)!=LABEL or self.allowed_fake is not None:raise ValueError('Unregistered/nested fake fusion')
        self.integrity('before fake: '+description)
        previous=Branch.fuse;record=dict(test=self.current_test,label=LABEL,description=description,kind='fusion substitute',closed=False,physical_evidence=False)
        self.scopes.append(record);self.allowed_fake=fn;Branch.fuse=fn
        try:
            self.integrity('entered fake: '+description);yield
        finally:
            Branch.fuse=previous;self.allowed_fake=None;record['closed']=True
            self.integrity('after fake: '+description)
    def ledger(self):
        categories=('WLS','FUSION','MODEL_ADVANCE','ACTUAL_STEP','SAMPLING','QUALITY','POLICY_SEARCH')
        return dict(installed_entries=[dict(owner=getattr(o,'__name__',repr(o)),attribute=a,category=c,guard_installed=getattr(o,a) is g) for o,a,g,c in self.entries],
            forbidden_attempts={c:sum(x['category']==c for x in self.calls) for c in categories},attempt_details=self.calls,actual_scientific_execution={k:None if self.overwritten else 0 for k in ('WLS','MODEL_advance','ACTUAL_STEP')},
            guard_checks=self.checks,fake_fuse_scopes=self.scopes,ever_overwritten=self.overwritten,scope='Known reachable whitelist call graph; no intentional guard calls; substitutes are not physical evidence')

def assert_public_surface(value):
    """Inspect actual reachable objects, not just JSON key spellings."""
    from .stfbs_d1b_qm_model import PublicProfiles,SensorAuthority,QMBranch
    seen=set()
    def visit(obj):
        if id(obj) in seen:return
        seen.add(id(obj))
        if obj is None or type(obj) in (str,int,float,bool):return
        if isinstance(obj,(SensorAuthority,QMBranch)):raise ValueError('PRIVATE_EXECUTOR_REACHABLE')
        if type(obj) is PublicProfiles:
            if obj.public_profile_at.__func__.__closure__:raise ValueError('PUBLIC_CLOSURE_REACHABLE')
            visit(obj.to_public_dict());return
        if isinstance(obj,dict):
            if any(k in obj for k in ('_schedule','private_schedule','sensor_declaration_schedule','private_environment')):raise ValueError('PRIVATE_SCHEDULE_FIELD')
            for k,v in obj.items():visit(k);visit(v)
            return
        if isinstance(obj,(list,tuple,set)):
            for child in obj:visit(child)
            return
        if callable(obj):raise ValueError('PUBLIC_CALLABLE_OR_CLOSURE_REACHABLE')
        raise ValueError('UNAPPROVED_PUBLIC_OBJECT: '+type(obj).__name__)
    visit(value)
    return dict(status='PASS',scope='Detached public data/snapshot reachable graph, no private instance or captured callbacks; not a malicious-Python sandbox')

# External fixture registrations are frozen BEFORE branch construction.
from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ExternalRegistration:
    branch_id: str
    fixture_digest: str
    prefix_json: str
    source_pins_json: str
    registration_digest: str

def register_fixture(fixture,branch_id,source_pins):
    from .stfbs_d1b_qm_scenario import validate_fixture
    from .stfbs_d1b_qm_execution import IDENTITIES
    from .stfbs_d1a_replay import digest
    validate_fixture(fixture)
    if branch_id not in IDENTITIES or not source_pins:raise ValueError('External registration identity/pins required')
    prefix=json.dumps({h['target_id']:h for h in fixture.view['histories']},sort_keys=True)
    payload=dict(branch_id=branch_id,fixture_digest=digest(dict(view=fixture.view,seed=fixture.seed,world=fixture.world,identity=fixture.identity)),prefix_json=prefix,source_pins_json=json.dumps(source_pins,sort_keys=True))
    return ExternalRegistration(**payload,registration_digest=digest(payload))

def verify_registration(registration,fixture,branch_id):
    if type(registration) is not ExternalRegistration:raise ValueError('External registration required')
    expected=register_fixture(fixture,branch_id,json.loads(registration.source_pins_json))
    if expected!=registration:raise ValueError('Fixture/prefix/branch registration mismatch')
    return True

def audit_registered(branch,registration):
    from .stfbs_d1a_history_audit import AuditContext,audit_branch_independent
    from .stfbs_d1a_replay import digest
    if type(registration) is not ExternalRegistration:raise ValueError('External registration required')
    payload={k:getattr(registration,k) for k in ('branch_id','fixture_digest','prefix_json','source_pins_json')}
    if digest(payload)!=registration.registration_digest or branch.name!=registration.branch_id:raise ValueError('External identity mismatch')
    # Never reads branch._audit_context; frozen prefix supplied by external registration.
    return audit_branch_independent(branch,context=AuditContext(registration.branch_id,registration.prefix_json))

# RUN-G0 scientific evidence joins: only reads existing schema fields.
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SourceAnchor:
    source_version: str
    expected_json: str

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class VerifiedRegistration:
    registration: object
    anchor: SourceAnchor

def verify_source_pins(root,provided,anchor):
    if type(anchor) is not SourceAnchor or not anchor.source_version:raise ValueError('EXTERNAL_SOURCE_ANCHOR_REQUIRED')
    root=Path(root).resolve();expected=json.loads(anchor.expected_json)
    if provided!=expected or not expected:raise ValueError('SOURCE_ANCHOR_MISMATCH')
    results=[]
    for name,want in expected.items():
        path=Path(name)
        if path.is_absolute() or '..' in path.parts or path.as_posix()!=name or ':' in name:raise ValueError('SOURCE_PATH_REJECTED')
        target=(root/path).resolve()
        if not target.is_relative_to(root) or not target.is_file():raise ValueError('SOURCE_FILE_MISSING_OR_OUTSIDE_ROOT')
        actual=sha(target)
        if actual!=want:raise ValueError('SOURCE_BYTES_MISMATCH: '+name)
        results.append(dict(path=name,actual_sha256=actual,expected_sha256=want,bytes=target.stat().st_size,source_version=anchor.source_version,checked_utc=time.time(),match=True))
    return results

def register_verified_fixture(root,fixture,branch_id,provided,anchor):
    from .stfbs_d1b_qm_independent_audit import register_fixture
    verify_source_pins(root,provided,anchor)
    return VerifiedRegistration(register_fixture(fixture,branch_id,provided),anchor)

def verify_verified_registration(root,fixture,branch_id,verified):
    from .stfbs_d1b_qm_independent_audit import verify_registration
    if type(verified) is not VerifiedRegistration:raise ValueError('VERIFIED_EXTERNAL_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED')
    verify_source_pins(root,json.loads(verified.registration.source_pins_json),verified.anchor)
    verify_registration(verified.registration,fixture,branch_id)
    return verified.registration

class EndpointEvidenceError(ValueError):pass

def endpoint_join(endpoint,records,registration,*,segment_id=None,side=None):
    """The caller supplies an independently frozen external registration, not endpoint fields."""
    from .stfbs_d1a_replay import digest
    from research.information_service_online.public import seal_slot
    from research.information_service.public_quality import prepare_frame
    branch=registration.expected_branch_id if hasattr(registration,'expected_branch_id') else registration.branch_id
    def reject(detail):raise EndpointEvidenceError('ENDPOINT_PROVENANCE_MISMATCH: '+detail)
    if endpoint['branch']!=branch or endpoint['observation_origin']!='MODEL' or endpoint['provenance']!='SIMULATED':reject('external branch/source')
    # quality.frame_id is an existing scientific field supplied by the real processor.
    fid=endpoint['quality']['frame_id']
    candidates=[]
    for row in records['feedback']:
        frame=row['frame'];result=row['result']
        if frame['frame_id']==fid and result['frame_id']==fid:
            candidates.append(row)
    if len(candidates)!=1:reject('fusion link is missing or ambiguous')
    row=candidates[0];frame=row['frame'];result=row['result']
    if row['endpoint']!=endpoint:reject('feedback endpoint scientific identity conflict')
    if not frame['stream_id'].startswith(branch+':T'+str(endpoint['target_id'])+':first') or frame['frame_id']!=frame['stream_id']+':tick'+str(endpoint['tick']):reject('frame/stream scientific identity')
    if result['stream_id']!=frame['stream_id'] or result['target_id']!=endpoint['target_id'] or result['tick']!=endpoint['tick'] or result['quality']!=endpoint['quality']:reject('fusion result/quality')
    if frame['tick']!=endpoint['tick'] or frame['target_id']!=endpoint['target_id']:reject('frame target/time')
    segments=[s for s in records['histories'][endpoint['target_id']]['segments'] if s['team']==endpoint['team'] and s['start_tick']<=endpoint['tick'] and (s['closure'] is None or s['closure']['at']['time_seconds']>=endpoint['tick']*.05)]
    if segment_id is not None:segments=[s for s in segments if s['segment_id']==segment_id]
    if len(segments)!=1:reject('service segment ambiguity')
    segment=segments[0]
    if segment['model_branch_id']!=branch:reject('segment branch')
    if side=='LEFT' and segment['start_tick']!=endpoint['tick']:reject('left endpoint outside opening transaction')
    if side=='RIGHT' and segment['start_tick']>=endpoint['tick']:reject('right endpoint before first interval')
    # Feedback order must agree with old-right then new-left for equal tick.
    index=records['feedback'].index(row)
    for earlier in records['feedback'][:index]:
        if earlier['endpoint']['tick']>endpoint['tick']:reject('fusion event order')
        if side=='RIGHT' and earlier['endpoint']['tick']==endpoint['tick'] and earlier['endpoint']['team']!=endpoint['team']:reject('right after competing left')
    expected_sensors=['U'+str(m['robot_id']) for m in endpoint['team']]
    clean=prepare_frame(frame,expected_sensors)
    for field in ('payload','payload_sha256','frame_sha256','normalized_frame'):
        if result[field]!=clean[field]:reject('normalized WLS input '+field)
    if len(row['slots'])!=len(endpoint['team']):reject('slot/team cardinality')
    for member,slot in zip(endpoint['team'],row['slots']):
        robot=member['robot_id'];key=(branch,endpoint['target_id'],robot,endpoint['tick'])
        if key not in records['cache']:reject('raw key scientific identity')
        raw=records['cache'][key]
        if seal_slot(slot)!=slot or raw['slot']!=slot or raw['slot_digest']!=digest(slot):reject('slot/raw content')
        physical=records['physical_profiles'][endpoint['tick']][robot]
        context=dict(position=records['positions'][endpoint['tick']][robot],sigma=physical['sigma'],health=physical['health'])
        if raw['context_digest']!=digest(context):reject('raw context')
        found=[x for x in frame['records'] if x['sensor_id']=='U'+str(robot)]
        if slot['state']=='MISSING':
            if slot['packet'] is not None or found or physical['health']=='available':reject('missing semantics')
        elif slot['state']=='VALID':
            if len(found)!=1 or physical['health']!='available':reject('valid semantics')
            packet=deepcopy(found[0]);packet_id=packet.pop('packet_id')
            if packet!=slot['packet'] or packet['sigma']!=physical['sigma'] or packet['position']!=context['position']:reject('packet/frame/physical sigma')
            if packet_id!=frame['stream_id']+':tick'+str(endpoint['tick'])+':U'+str(robot):reject('frame packet identity')
        else:reject('unqueried endpoint slot')
    return dict(status='PASS',branch=branch,target_id=endpoint['target_id'],tick=endpoint['tick'],segment_id=segment['segment_id'],stream_id=frame['stream_id'],frame_id=fid,feedback_index=index,side=side,endpoint_digest=digest(endpoint),source='READ_ONLY_CROSS_RECORD_JOIN')

class BudgetAwareQMBranch(QMBranch):
    def __init__(self,*args,**kwargs):
        from .stfbs_d1b_qm_run_release import require_run_g1
        permit=require_run_g1();super().__init__(*args,**kwargs)
        folder=Path(permit.bindings['output_dir'])/'branch_journals';folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        self._trace_path=str(folder/(self.name+'.jsonl'));Path(self._trace_path).open('x').close()
        self._trace_cursor=0;self._trace_sequence=0;self.raw_trace=[]
    def raw(self,j,i,tick):
        from .stfbs_d1b_qm_run_release import require_run_g1
        require_run_g1()
        before=dict(self.cache.counts);slot=super().raw(j,i,tick)
        self.raw_trace.append(dict(branch=self.name,target=j,robot=i,tick=tick,new=self.cache.counts['new']-before['new'],reuses=self.cache.counts['reuses']-before['reuses']))
        return slot
    def checkpoint(self,phase):
        self._trace_sequence+=1
        row=dict(sequence=self._trace_sequence,phase=phase,branch=self.name,tick=self.tick,positions=self.positions.tolist(),actions=self.actions,
                 histories=self.histories,feedback=self.feedback[self._trace_cursor:],frame=self.frames[-1] if self.frames else None,
                 pending=self.consumer.pending,frozen=self.frozen,events=self.events,components=self.components,change_cost=self.change_cost,status=self.status)
        with Path(self._trace_path).open('a',encoding='utf-8') as f:f.write(json.dumps(row,sort_keys=True)+'\n');f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
        self._trace_cursor=len(self.feedback)
    def assign(self,*args,**kwargs):
        from .stfbs_d1b_qm_run_release import require_run_g1
        require_run_g1()
        super().assign(*args,**kwargs);self.checkpoint('ASSIGN_COMMITTED')
    def advance(self):
        from .stfbs_d1b_qm_run_release import require_run_g1
        require_run_g1()
        super().advance();self.checkpoint('ADVANCE_COMMITTED')
    def fuse(self,j,segment,tick):
        from .stfbs_d1b_qm_run_release import require_run_g1
        require_run_g1()
        frame_id=f'{self.name}:T{j}:first{segment["first_fusion_tick"]}:tick{tick}'
        with self.budget.for_frame(frame_id):return super().fuse(j,segment,tick)

def result_from_branch(b):
    return dict(branch=b.name,world=deepcopy(b.world),provenance='SIMULATED',observation_origin='MODEL',components=deepcopy(b.components),
                change_cost=b.change_cost,net=sum(b.components.values())-b.change_cost,frames=deepcopy(b.frames),events=deepcopy(b.events),
                boundaries=deepcopy(b.boundaries),decisions=deepcopy(b.decisions),feedback=deepcopy(b.feedback),status=deepcopy(b.status),
                histories=deepcopy(b.histories),actions=deepcopy(b.actions),tick=b.tick,view=deepcopy(b.view),
                pending=deepcopy(b.consumer.pending),frozen_beliefs=deepcopy(b.frozen),raw_counts=deepcopy(b.cache.counts),endpoint_fusions=b.fusions,raw_trace=deepcopy(getattr(b,'raw_trace',[])))

def records_from_branch(b):
    positions={60:deepcopy(b.view['positions'])}
    positions.update({f['tick']:deepcopy(f['positions']) for f in b.frames})
    ticks={row['frame']['tick'] for row in b.feedback}
    return dict(feedback=deepcopy(b.feedback),histories=deepcopy(b.histories),cache=deepcopy(b.cache.rows),positions=positions,
                physical_profiles={k:b._sensor_authority.physical_profile_at(k) for k in ticks})

def serial_records(records):
    out=deepcopy(records);out['cache']=[dict(key=list(k),value=v) for k,v in out['cache'].items()];return out

def restore_records(records):
    out=deepcopy(records);out['cache']={tuple(x['key']):x['value'] for x in out['cache']}
    for key in ('histories','positions','physical_profiles'):out[key]={int(k):v for k,v in out[key].items()}
    return out

def normalize_int_maps(result):
    for key in ('histories','status'):result[key]={int(k):v for k,v in result[key].items()}
    result['world']['motion']={int(k):v for k,v in result['world']['motion'].items()}
    for frame in result['frames']:frame['clocks']={int(k):v for k,v in frame['clocks'].items()}
    return result

def independent_gq(endpoint,records,world,config,registration,*,segment_id=None,side=None):
    from pursuit_v2.config import Config
    from pursuit_v2.observation_geometry import offset,radius
    from research.information_service.public_quality import assess_quality,prepare_frame
    link=endpoint_join(endpoint,records,registration,segment_id=segment_id,side=side)
    tick=endpoint['tick'];motion=world['motion'][endpoint['target_id']];cfg=Config(**config)
    target=np.asarray(motion['position'])+np.asarray(motion['velocity'])*((tick-60)*.05)
    actual=all(np.linalg.norm(np.asarray(records['positions'][tick][m['robot_id']])-target-offset(m['role'],cfg))<=radius(cfg) for m in endpoint['team'])
    if bool(actual)!=endpoint['G']:raise ValueError('INDEPENDENT_G_MISMATCH')
    row=records['feedback'][link['feedback_index']]
    for packet in row['frame']['records']:
        pos=packet['position'];expected=(math.atan2(float(target[1]-pos[1]),float(target[0]-pos[0]))+math.pi)%(2*math.pi)-math.pi
        if packet['bearing']!=expected:raise ValueError('INDEPENDENT_ZERO_NOISE_BEARING_MISMATCH')
    prepared=prepare_frame(row['frame'],['U'+str(m['robot_id']) for m in endpoint['team']])
    quality=assess_quality(prepared['payload'],row['result']['estimate_result']);quality['frame_id']=row['frame']['frame_id']
    if quality!=endpoint['quality'] or quality!=row['result']['quality']:raise ValueError('INDEPENDENT_Q_MISMATCH')
    return dict(status='PASS',G=bool(actual),Q=quality['status'],radius_proxy=quality['radius_proxy'],link=link)

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FrozenBranchSource:
    batch_id: str
    branch_id: str
    path: str
    file_sha256: str
    registration: object
    evidence_kind: str
    seal: object

def save_branch_source(branch,verified_registration,path,batch_id):
    from .stfbs_d1b_qm_run_release import require_run_g1
    from .stfbs_d1b_qm_independent_audit import audit_registered
    permit=require_run_g1()
    if permit.bindings['batch_id']!=batch_id:raise ValueError('Batch identity mismatch')
    audit=audit_registered(branch,verified_registration.registration)
    records=records_from_branch(branch)
    for row in records['feedback']:independent_gq(row['endpoint'],records,branch.world,branch.view['config'],verified_registration.registration)
    payload=dict(batch_id=batch_id,branch_id=branch.name,result=result_from_branch(branch),records=serial_records(records),external_history_audit=audit,evidence_kind='MODEL')
    path=Path(path)
    with path.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:json.dump(payload,f,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    return FrozenBranchSource(batch_id,branch.name,str(path),hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),verified_registration.registration,'MODEL',_SOURCE_SEAL)

def read_verified_source(source,*,test=False):
    if type(source) is not FrozenBranchSource or source.seal is not _SOURCE_SEAL:raise ValueError('SOURCE_NOT_VERIFIED')
    if source.evidence_kind==LABEL:
        if not test:raise PermissionError('Test source cannot enter real special')
    else:
        from .stfbs_d1b_qm_run_release import require_run_g1
        if require_run_g1().bindings['batch_id']!=source.batch_id:raise ValueError('SOURCE_BATCH_MISMATCH')
    raw=Path(source.path).read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()!=source.file_sha256:raise ValueError('SOURCE_FILE_HASH_MISMATCH')
    payload=json.loads(raw)
    if payload['batch_id']!=source.batch_id or payload['branch_id']!=source.branch_id or payload['evidence_kind']!=source.evidence_kind:raise ValueError('SOURCE_RUN_IDENTITY_MISMATCH')
    records=restore_records(payload['records']);result=normalize_int_maps(payload['result'])
    if result['branch']!=source.branch_id or records['histories']!=result['histories'] or records['feedback']!=result['feedback']:raise ValueError('SOURCE_CROSS_RECORD_MISMATCH')
    from .stfbs_d1a_history_audit import AuditContext,audit_branch_independent
    from pursuit_v2.config import Config
    branch=SimpleNamespace(name=source.branch_id,histories=result['histories'],actions=result['actions'],status=result['status'],tick=result['tick'],events=result['events'],boundaries=result['boundaries'],cfg=Config(**result['view']['config']),change_cost=result['change_cost'])
    audit_branch_independent(branch,context=AuditContext(source.registration.branch_id,source.registration.prefix_json))
    if payload['external_history_audit']['status']!='PASS':raise ValueError('SOURCE_EXTERNAL_AUDIT_FAILED')
    return payload,result,records

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TrustedCandidate:
    row_json: str
    evidence_kind: str
    seal: object

def candidate_from_sources(old_source,new_source,sigma,*,test=False):
    _,old,orecords=read_verified_source(old_source,test=test);_,new,nrecords=read_verified_source(new_source,test=test)
    expected=('QM_PROBE_DEGRADED_'+str((.04,.08,.16,.32).index(sigma)+1))
    if old_source.branch_id!='QM_PROBE_OLD' or new_source.branch_id!=expected or old_source.batch_id!=new_source.batch_id:raise ValueError('CANDIDATE_SOURCE_IDENTITY')
    def right80(records):
        rows=[x for x in records['feedback'] if x['endpoint']['tick']==80]
        if len(rows)!=1:raise ValueError('Probe right80 ambiguity')
        return rows[0]['endpoint']
    oe=right80(orecords);ne=right80(nrecords)
    if old['world']!=new['world'] or orecords['positions'][80]!=nrecords['positions'][80] or oe['team']!=ne['team']:raise ValueError('PROBE_GEOMETRY_NOT_IDENTICAL')
    for records in (orecords,nrecords):
        if records['physical_profiles'][79][1]['sigma']!=.02:raise ValueError('Probe prefix not normal')
    if orecords['physical_profiles'][80][1]['sigma']!=.02 or nrecords['physical_profiles'][80][1]['sigma']!=sigma:raise ValueError('Probe sigma mismatch')
    og=independent_gq(oe,orecords,old['world'],old['view']['config'],old_source.registration,side='RIGHT')
    ng=independent_gq(ne,nrecords,new['world'],new['view']['config'],new_source.registration,side='RIGHT')
    row=dict(probe_id=expected,sigma=sigma,old_G=og['G'],new_G=ng['G'],old_Q=og['Q'],new_Q=ng['Q'],old_source_sha=old_source.file_sha256,new_source_sha=new_source.file_sha256)
    return TrustedCandidate(json.dumps(row,sort_keys=True),LABEL if test else 'MODEL',_CANDIDATE_SEAL)

def service_and_control_audit(result,view):
    """Independent walk: same-tick competing endpoints are resolved by full team."""
    from .belief import trajectory
    from pursuit_v2.config import Config
    from pursuit_v2.observation_geometry import offset
    cfg=Config(**view['config']);boundaries={b['tick']:b for b in result['boundaries']}
    actions=deepcopy(view['assignment']);frozen=view['beliefs'];clock=0;left=None;team=[];checked=0;resets=[]
    decisions={d['view']['tick']:d['view'] for d in result['decisions']}
    terminal=next(e for e in result['events'] if e['target']==0 and e['kind'] in ('completed','escaped','unfinished'))
    def endpoint(tick,members):
        rows=[f['endpoint'] for f in result['feedback'] if f['endpoint']['tick']==tick and f['endpoint']['team']==members]
        if len(rows)!=1:raise ValueError('Service endpoint identity ambiguity')
        return rows[0]
    for frame in result['frames']:
        n=frame['tick'];lo=(n-1)*.05
        if n-1 in decisions:frozen=decisions[n-1]['beliefs']
        if n-1 in boundaries:
            actions=boundaries[n-1]['after'];new=[dict(robot_id=i,role=a['role']) for i,a in enumerate(actions) if a['target']==0]
            if new!=team:team=new;clock=0;left=endpoint(n-1,team) if team else None
        for i,a in enumerate(actions):
            u=np.zeros(2);elapsed=0.
            if a['target'] is not None and (terminal['time']>lo or terminal['time']==lo and terminal['tick']>=n):
                belief=frozen.get(0,frozen.get('0'));p,v=trajectory(belief,n-1)
                force=np.asarray(v)+cfg.travel_gain*(np.asarray(p)+offset(a['role'],cfg)-np.asarray(frame['before'][i]))
                u=force*min(1.,cfg.max_speed/max(float(np.linalg.norm(force)),1e-15))
                m=result['world']['motion'][0];x=m['position'][0]+m['velocity'][0]*(lo-3.)
                escape=lo if x>=cfg.side else lo+(cfg.side-x)/m['velocity'][0] if m['velocity'][0]>0 else math.inf
                elapsed=max(0.,min(n*.05,escape)-lo)
            bound=16*math.ulp(max(1.,float(np.max(np.abs(u)))))
            if np.max(np.abs(u-np.asarray(frame['control'][i])))>bound or elapsed!=frame['elapsed'][i]:raise ValueError('Independent control/elapsed mismatch')
        if team and terminal['time']>=lo and not (terminal['kind']=='escaped' and terminal['time']<=n*.05+1e-10) and not (terminal['tick']<n):
            right=endpoint(n,team);valid=left['G'] and right['G'] and left['quality']['status']==right['quality']['status']=='PASS'
            if not valid and clock>0:resets.append(dict(target=0,kind='reset',tick=n,time=n*.05,reason='observation_invalid',progress_before=clock*.05))
            clock=clock+1 if valid else 0;done=clock*.05>=view['targets'][0]['service_duration']-1e-10
            if done and not (terminal['kind']=='completed' and terminal['tick']==n):raise ValueError('Independent service completion mismatch')
            raw=frame['clocks'][0]
            if not done and raw is not None and (raw['base']!=0. or raw['intervals']!=clock):raise ValueError('Independent service clock mismatch')
            left=right;checked+=1
    from .stfbs_d1a_audit import audit
    if resets!=[e for e in result['events'] if e['kind']=='reset']:raise ValueError('Independent reset event mismatch')
    accounting=audit(result,view)
    return dict(status='PASS',service_intervals=checked,control=True,accounting=accounting)

def _early_scientific_result(reason,stages,old_quality,tested_sigmas,candidate_evidence,*,b0=None,b1=None):
    """Evidence-scoped reporting only; this helper performs no scientific audit."""
    keys=('EXECUTION_VALID','Q_ONLY_FAILURE_OBSERVED','GQ_RESTORED','SERVICE_RESUMED','TASK_COMPLETED')
    science=dict.fromkeys(keys,None)
    disposition={k:'NOT_EVALUATED_GATE_NOT_MET' for k in keys}
    disposition['EXECUTION_VALID']='EXECUTED_AWAITING_FINAL_AUDIT'
    probe_observed=None;dynamic_gate='NOT_EVALUATED';q_scope='NORMAL_REFERENCE_ADMISSION_ONLY'
    if reason=='SCENARIO_ADMISSION_FAILED':
        disposition['Q_ONLY_FAILURE_OBSERVED']='NOT_EVALUATED_NORMAL_REFERENCE_ADMISSION_FAILED'
    elif reason=='NO_Q_ONLY_FAIL_FOUND':
        science['Q_ONLY_FAILURE_OBSERVED']=False;probe_observed=False;q_scope='FIXED_FOUR_SIGMA_PROBES'
        disposition['Q_ONLY_FAILURE_OBSERVED']='NOT_OBSERVED_IN_TESTED_PROBES'
    elif reason=='DYNAMIC_Q_ONLY_NOT_REALIZED':
        # A failed joint predicate does not establish absence of every dynamic failure.
        probe_observed=True;dynamic_gate='NOT_CONFIRMED';q_scope='FORMAL_DYNAMIC_JOINT_PREDICATE_NOT_CONFIRMED'
        disposition['Q_ONLY_FAILURE_OBSERVED']='NOT_CONFIRMED_IN_FORMAL_DYNAMIC_BRANCH'
        for key in ('GQ_RESTORED','SERVICE_RESUMED','TASK_COMPLETED'):disposition[key]='EXECUTED_AWAITING_FINAL_AUDIT'
    else:raise ValueError('Unknown early scientific result')
    def artifact(value):
        if isinstance(value,FrozenBranchSource):
            return dict(branch_id=value.branch_id,batch_id=value.batch_id,path=value.path,file_sha256=value.file_sha256,evidence_kind=value.evidence_kind)
        return deepcopy(value)
    scope=dict(reference_probe=dict(branch_id='QM_PROBE_OLD',stage='EXECUTED',returned_quality_evidence=deepcopy(old_quality)),
        tested_probe_sigmas=list(tested_sigmas),candidate_evidence=deepcopy(candidate_evidence),
        probe_stages={'QM_PROBE_OLD':'EXECUTED',**{'QM_PROBE_DEGRADED_'+str(i+1):'EXECUTED' if i<len(tested_sigmas) else 'NOT_EXECUTED_GATE_NOT_MET' for i in range(4)}},
        Q_ONLY_FAILURE_OBSERVED=q_scope,probe_q_only_failure_observed=probe_observed,formal_dynamic_q_only_gate=dynamic_gate,
        execution_validity_audit='NOT_ESTABLISHED_BY_EARLY_STOP_ROUTINE',
        dynamic_branch_disposition={key:'EXECUTED_AWAITING_FINAL_AUDIT' if stages[key]=='EXECUTED' else 'NOT_EXECUTED_GATE_NOT_MET' for key in ('B0','B1')},
        dynamic_result_references=dict(B0=artifact(b0),B1=artifact(b1)))
    return dict(status=reason,stages=stages,science=science,science_disposition=disposition,science_evidence_scope=scope,
                probe_q_only_failure_observed=probe_observed,formal_dynamic_q_only_gate=dynamic_gate)

def coordinate_batch(ops):
    """Single fixed order, also exercised by a fully synthetic operation port."""
    status={k:'NOT_EXECUTED_GATE_NOT_MET' for k in ('B0','B1','B3','F1','F2','F3A','F3B')}
    old=ops.probe('QM_PROBE_OLD');old_quality=ops.old_quality(old)
    if not old_quality['G'] or old_quality['Q']!='PASS':return _early_scientific_result('SCENARIO_ADMISSION_FAILED',status,old_quality,[],[])
    candidates=[];selected=None
    tested_sigmas=[];candidate_evidence=[]
    for index,sigma in enumerate((.04,.08,.16,.32),1):
        new=ops.probe('QM_PROBE_DEGRADED_'+str(index));row=ops.candidate(old,new,sigma);candidates.append(row)
        values=ops.candidate_values(row)
        tested_sigmas.append(sigma);candidate_evidence.append(deepcopy(values))
        if values['old_G'] and values['new_G'] and values['old_Q']=='PASS' and values['new_Q']=='FAIL':selected=sigma;break
    if selected is None:return _early_scientific_result('NO_Q_ONLY_FAIL_FOUND',status,old_quality,tested_sigmas,candidate_evidence)
    admitted=ops.admit(candidates)
    b0=ops.dynamic('QM_B0_KEEP',selected,admitted);status['B0']='EXECUTED'
    b1=ops.dynamic('QM_B1_MEMBER_CHANGE',selected,admitted);status['B1']='EXECUTED'
    if not ops.dynamic_realized(b0,b1,selected):return _early_scientific_result('DYNAMIC_Q_ONLY_NOT_REALIZED',status,old_quality,tested_sigmas,candidate_evidence,b0=b0,b1=b1)
    b3=ops.b3();status['B3']='EXECUTED'
    ops.f1(b1);status['F1']='PASS'
    ops.special('QM_F2_VALID_HISTORY',b1);status['F2']='PASS'
    ops.special('QM_F3_STREAM_A',b0);status['F3A']='PASS'
    ops.special('QM_F3_STREAM_B',b1);status['F3B']='PASS'
    return dict(status='EXECUTED_AWAITING_FINAL_AUDIT',selected_sigma=selected,stages=status,science=ops.final_science(b0,b1,b3))

class RealBatchOps:

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Admission:
    selected_sigma: float
    selected_factor: int
    selected_probe_id: str
    selection_rule: str
    selection_evidence_digest: str
    admission_status: str
    source_run_identity: str

def _freeze_rows(rows,source_run_identity):
    import json
    if not source_run_identity or not rows:raise ValueError('Admission evidence required')
    selected=None
    for index,row in enumerate(rows):
        if index>=4 or row['probe_id']!='QM_PROBE_DEGRADED_'+str(index+1) or row['sigma']!=SIGMAS[index]:raise ValueError('Probe selection order changed')
        if row['old_G'] is not True or row['new_G'] is not True or row['old_Q']!='PASS':raise ValueError('Scenario admission failed')
        if row['new_Q'] not in ('PASS','FAIL','UNKNOWN'):raise ValueError('Invalid quality category')
        if row['new_Q']=='FAIL':
            selected=(index,row);break
    if selected is None:raise ValueError('NO_Q_ONLY_FAIL_FOUND')
    index,row=selected
    if len(rows)!=index+1:raise ValueError('Post-selection probe results forbidden')
    frozen=json.dumps(rows,sort_keys=True)
    return Admission(row['sigma'],(2,4,8,16)[index],row['probe_id'],'FIRST_EXPLICIT_Q_ONLY_FAIL',digest(rows),'ADMITTED',source_run_identity,frozen)

def freeze_admission(candidates,source_run_identity):

    result=_freeze_rows([json.loads(c.row_json) for c in candidates],source_run_identity)

def verify_special_source(special_id,source,*,test=False):
    if special_id not in SPECS:raise ValueError('Unregistered special identity')
    expected,side,robots=SPECS[special_id]
    reason='F2_SOURCE_NOT_AVAILABLE' if special_id=='QM_F2_VALID_HISTORY' else 'F3_SOURCE_NOT_AVAILABLE'
    if source.branch_id!=expected:raise ValueError(reason+': fixed branch mismatch')
    payload,result,records=read_verified_source(source,test=test)
    team=[dict(robot_id=i,role='dual_neg45' if i==0 else 'dual_pos45') for i in robots]
    segments=[s for s in records['histories'][0]['segments'] if s['team']==team and (s['start_tick']==80 if side=='LEFT' else s['start_tick']<80)]
    rows=[f for f in records['feedback'] if f['endpoint']['tick']==80 and f['endpoint']['team']==team]
    if len(segments)!=1 or len(rows)!=1:raise ValueError(reason+': required endpoint/segment missing')
    segment=segments[0];row=rows[0]
    if side=='LEFT':
        boundaries=[b for b in result['boundaries'] if b['tick']==80 and b['after']==changed_team()]
        events=records['histories'][0]['events']
        if len(boundaries)!=1 or not any(e['kind']=='TEAM_CHANGED' and e['at']['event_tick']==80 for e in events) or segment['start_tick']!=80:raise ValueError(reason+': member change not committed')
    audit=independent_gq(row['endpoint'],records,result['world'],result['view']['config'],source.registration,segment_id=segment['segment_id'],side=side)
    slots=[]
    for i in robots:
        key=(expected,0,i,80)
        if key not in records['cache']:raise ValueError(reason+': raw source key')
        raw=records['cache'][key];slot=raw['slot']
        if slot['state']!='VALID' or slot['packet'] is None or slot['packet']['measurement_tick']!=80:raise ValueError(reason+': VALID source required')
        context=dict(position=records['positions'][80][i],sigma=records['physical_profiles'][80][i]['sigma'],health=records['physical_profiles'][80][i]['health'])
        if raw['context_digest']!=digest(context):raise ValueError(reason+': source context mismatch')
        slots.append(dict(slot=deepcopy(slot),context_digest=raw['context_digest'],context=context))
    link=dict(source_run_identity=source.batch_id,source_branch=source.branch_id,source_file=source.path,source_file_sha256=source.file_sha256,
              target_id=0,measurement_tick=80,robots=list(robots),segment_id=segment['segment_id'],frame_id=row['frame']['frame_id'],external_audit=audit,
              source_verification='BEFORE_HISTORY_CACHE_INITIALIZATION',special_id=special_id)
    return VerifiedSlots(special_id,json.dumps(link,sort_keys=True),json.dumps(slots,sort_keys=True),source.evidence_kind,_SLOT_SEAL)

def inherited_cache(bundle,*,test=False):
    if type(bundle) is not VerifiedSlots or bundle.seal is not _SLOT_SEAL:raise ValueError('Verified source required before cache')
    if bundle.evidence_kind==LABEL:
        if not test:raise PermissionError('Test slots cannot enter real special')
    else:
        from .stfbs_d1b_qm_run_release import require_run_g1
        require_run_g1()
    rows=json.loads(bundle.slots_json)
    return ModelRawCache(bundle.special_id,[dict(slot=x['slot'],context_digest=x['context_digest']) for x in rows])

def special_frame(bundle,cache):
    if cache.branch!=bundle.special_id:raise ValueError('Special cache branch mismatch')
    stream=bundle.special_id+':T0:inherited80';records=[]
    def no_producer():raise RuntimeError('Inherited VALID slot must not be sampled')
    for item in json.loads(bundle.slots_json):
        i=item['slot']['slot_key']['robot_id']
        slot=cache.query(bundle.special_id,0,i,80,item['context'],no_producer)
        if slot!=item['slot']:raise ValueError('Inherited measurement changed')
        packet=deepcopy(slot['packet']);packet['packet_id']=stream+':tick80:U'+str(i);records.append(packet)
    return dict(contract_id='STAGE2A5B-A-MINIMAL-v0.2',stream_id=stream,frame_id=stream+':tick80',target_id=0,tick=80,measurement_time=4.,available_time=4.,records=records)

def validate_special_frame(frame,special_id,bundle=None):
    if special_id not in SPECS or frame['stream_id']!=special_id+':T0:inherited80' or frame['frame_id']!=frame['stream_id']+':tick80':raise ValueError('Special frame identity mismatch')
    if frame['target_id']!=0 or frame['tick']!=80:raise ValueError('Special frame target/tick mismatch')
    expected=['U'+str(i) for i in SPECS[special_id][2]]
    if [r['sensor_id'] for r in frame['records']]!=expected or any(r['packet_id']!=frame['stream_id']+':tick80:'+r['sensor_id'] for r in frame['records']):raise ValueError('Special packet identity mismatch')
    if bundle is not None:
        if bundle.special_id!=special_id:raise ValueError('Special source identity mismatch')
        for item,record in zip(json.loads(bundle.slots_json),frame['records']):
            packet=dict(record);packet.pop('packet_id')
            if packet!=item['slot']['packet']:raise ValueError('Special packet differs from verified raw source')

def run_special(special_id,source,budget,*,test_processor_factory=None):
    test=test_processor_factory is not None
    if test:
        if getattr(test_processor_factory,'evidence_kind',None)!=LABEL or budget.real_ready:raise PermissionError('Invalid special double')
    else:
        from .stfbs_d1b_qm_run_release import require_run_g1
        require_run_g1()
        if not budget.real_ready:raise PermissionError('Real special requires shared real budget')
    # Source verification precedes cache construction, not the other way around.
    bundle=verify_special_source(special_id,source,test=test);cache=inherited_cache(bundle,test=test);frame=special_frame(bundle,cache)
    validate_special_frame(frame,special_id,bundle)
    factory=test_processor_factory
    if factory is None:
        from research.information_service_bridge.public_stream import BridgeFrameProcessor
        factory=BridgeFrameProcessor
    before=budget.snapshot()['total']
    with budget.for_branch(special_id),budget.for_frame(frame['frame_id']):
        processor=factory([r['sensor_id'] for r in frame['records']],80,frame['stream_id'],0,estimator_fn=budget.estimator('MODEL_SPECIAL_TEST_WLS'))
        result=processor.process(frame)
    if budget.snapshot()['total']-before!=1 or not result['estimator_called']:raise ValueError('Special must consume exactly one outer WLS')
    return dict(special_id=special_id,source=json.loads(bundle.source_json),frame=frame,result=result,raw_counts=cache.counts,source_slots=json.loads(bundle.slots_json),
                budget_ledger_id=budget.ledger_id,evidence_kind=LABEL if test else 'MODEL')

def validate_pending_identity(row,special_id):
    if row['branch_id']!=special_id or row['target_id']!=0 or row['stream_id']!=special_id+':T0:inherited80':raise ValueError('Special pending identity mismatch')
    return True
