def _validate_consumer(cut):
    tick = cut['cut_tick']
    boundary = cut['freeze_boundary_identity']
    _require(boundary['cut_tick'] == tick and type(boundary['freeze_ordinal']) is int)
    freezes = cut['freeze_boundaries']
    _require(freezes[str(tick)] == boundary['freeze_ordinal'])
    freeze_ticks = sorted(int(k) for k in freezes)
    _require(all(0 <= k <= tick and type(freezes[str(k)]) is int for k in freeze_ticks))
    _require([freezes[str(k)] for k in freeze_ticks] == sorted(set(freezes.values())))
    journal = cut['observation_arrivals']
    ordinals = [r['arrival_ordinal'] for r in journal]
    _require(all(type(n) is int and n >= 0 for n in ordinals) and ordinals == sorted(set(ordinals)))
    pending, consumed = [], []
    for entry in journal:
        row = entry['observation']
        _require(row['source'] == 'ACTUAL' and str(row['target_id']) in cut['consumer_states'])
        _require(all(type(row[k]) is int for k in ('measurement_tick', 'available_tick')))
        _require(0 <= row['measurement_tick'] <= tick and row['measurement_tick'] <= row['available_tick'])
        # Future delivery is permitted for already occurred measurements.
        ct = entry['consumed_tick']
        eligible = [k for k in freeze_ticks if row['available_tick'] <= k
                    and entry['arrival_ordinal'] < freezes[str(k)]]
        expected = eligible[0] if eligible else None
        _require(ct == expected, 'OBSERVATION_FREEZE_BOUNDARY_CONFLICT')
        if ct is None:
            pending.append(deepcopy(row))
        else:
            _require(type(ct) is int)
            consumed.append(dict(target_id=row['target_id'], measurement_tick=row['measurement_tick'],
                                 available_tick=row['available_tick'], consumed_tick=ct))
    # Consumer processes queued rows in arrival order at each freeze.
    consumed.sort(key=lambda row: row['consumed_tick'])
    _require(cut['pending_observations'] == pending, 'PENDING_QUEUE_CONFLICT')
    _require(cut['consumed_records'] == consumed, 'CONSUMED_ORDER_CONFLICT')
    identities = [(r['target_id'], r['measurement_tick'], r['available_tick']) for r in consumed]
    _require(len(identities) == len(set(identities)), 'DUPLICATE_CONSUMPTION')
    states = cut['consumer_states']
    _require(set(states) == set(cut['accepted_position_history']) == set(cut['frozen_public_beliefs']))
    projected = deepcopy(states)
    for j, b in states.items():
        _require(b['target_id'] == int(j) and b['estimate_tick'] <= tick and b['available_tick'] <= tick)
        history = cut['accepted_position_history'][j]
        times = [r[0] for r in history]
        _require(times == sorted(set(times)) and all(type(k) is int and k <= tick for k in times))
        for when, position in history:
            matches = [e for e in journal if e['consumed_tick'] is not None
                       and e['observation']['target_id'] == int(j)
                       and e['observation']['measurement_tick'] == when]
            _require(len(matches) == 1 and matches[0]['observation']['estimate'] is not None)
            estimate = matches[0]['observation']['estimate']
            _require(estimate.get('has_accepted_estimate') is True
                     and estimate.get('optimizer_converged') is True
                     and all(estimate.get(k, True) is False for k in (
                         'numerical_ill_conditioned', 'ambiguity_detected', 'boundary_active', 'numeric_contract_violation'))
                     and estimate['estimate'] == position, 'ACCEPTED_HISTORY_CONFLICT')
        if history:
            _require(b['estimate_tick'] == history[-1][0] and b['position_estimate'] == history[-1][1])
            receipt = cut['accepted_receipts'][j]
            _require(receipt in consumed and receipt['target_id'] == int(j)
                     and receipt['measurement_tick'] == history[-1][0], 'ACCEPTED_RECEIPT_CONFLICT')
        else:
            _require(j not in cut['accepted_receipts'] and b['last_observation_tick'] is None)
        if b['last_observation_tick'] is not None and tick-b['last_observation_tick'] > 20:
            projected[j]['status'] = 'DEGRADED'
    _require(set(cut['accepted_receipts']) <= set(states))
    _require(projected == cut['frozen_public_beliefs'], 'FROZEN_BELIEF_CONFLICT')
    _require(boundary['consumer_digest'] == digest(dict(states=states,
             history=cut['accepted_position_history'], consumed=cut['consumed_records'],
             receipts=cut['accepted_receipts'])), 'FREEZE_CONSUMER_IDENTITY_CONFLICT')


def _validate_histories_and_raw(cut):
    tick = cut['cut_tick']
    histories = {int(j): h for j, h in cut['task_histories'].items()}
    statuses = {int(j): status for j, status in cut['terminal_status'].items()}
    _require(set(histories) == set(statuses))
    _require(all(s in ('active', 'completed', 'escaped', 'unfinished') for s in statuses.values()))
    terminal_times = {}
    for j, h in histories.items():
        _require(h['target_id'] == j)
        if statuses[j] != 'active':
            events = [e for e in h['events'] if e['kind'] in ('COMPLETED', 'ESCAPED', 'EPISODE_END')]
            _require(len(events) == 1)
            terminal_times[j] = events[0]['at']['time_seconds']
        # Current-cut assignment transactions would already violate PRE_ASSIGNMENT.
        _require(not any(e['kind'] in ('ASSIGNED', 'WITHDRAWN', 'TEAM_CHANGED', 'ROLE_CHANGED')
                         and e['at']['time_seconds'] == tick*.05 for e in h['events']),
                 'CURRENT_CUT_ASSIGNMENT_ALREADY_COMMITTED')
    audit_histories(histories, cut['current_assignment'], statuses, tick, terminal_times)
    segments = [s for j in sorted(histories) for s in histories[j]['segments']]
    _require(segments == cut['service_segments'], 'SERVICE_SEGMENT_CONFLICT')
    slots = {}
    for h in histories.values():
        for segment in h['segments']:
            clock = segment['latest_clock']
            ServiceState(clock['base'], clock['intervals'], tuple((m['robot_id'], m['role']) for m in clock['team']))
            ep = segment['latest_endpoint']
            _require(type(ep['G']) is bool and ep['quality']['status'] in ('PASS', 'FAIL', 'UNKNOWN'))
            _require(ep['target_id'] == h['target_id'] and ep['team'] == segment['team'])
            for slot in ep['slots']:
                key = tuple(slot['slot_key'][k] for k in ('target_id', 'robot_id', 'tick'))
                _require(key not in slots or slots[key] == slot, 'RAW_SLOT_CONFLICT')
                slots[key] = slot
    current = cut['current_slots']
    active = sorted(j for j, status in statuses.items() if status == 'active')
    expected = [(j, i, tick) for j in active for i in range(3)]
    _require([tuple(s['slot_key'][k] for k in ('target_id', 'robot_id', 'tick')) for s in current] == expected)
    for slot in current:
        key = tuple(slot['slot_key'][k] for k in ('target_id', 'robot_id', 'tick'))
        _require(key not in slots or slots[key] == slot, 'RAW_SLOT_CONFLICT')
        slots[key] = slot
    cache = {}
    for row in cut['raw_cache_history']:
        slot = row['slot']
        key = tuple(slot['slot_key'][k] for k in ('target_id', 'robot_id', 'tick'))
        _require(key not in cache and 0 <= key[2] <= tick and key[0] in histories
                 and type(key[1]) is int and 0 <= key[1] < 3, 'RAW_CACHE_IDENTITY_CONFLICT')
        _require(row['slot_digest'] == digest(slot) and row['context_digest'] == digest(row['context']))
        _require(row['context']['episode_id'] == cut['episode_id'])
        _require(slot['state'] in ('VALID', 'MISSING'), 'INVALID_RAW_STATE')
        cache[key] = slot
    for key, slot in slots.items():
        _require(slot['state'] in ('VALID', 'MISSING', 'UNQUERIED'))
        if slot['state'] != 'UNQUERIED':
            _require(cache.get(key) == slot, 'RAW_CACHE_SLOT_CONFLICT')
        else:
            _require(key not in cache, 'UNQUERIED_RAW_CACHE_CONFLICT')


def verify_trusted_cut(candidate_cut_state, *, trusted_root=None, requested_certification=None):
    """Structural interface verification, never authenticates a real execution."""
    if type(trusted_root) is not ExternalTrustRoot:
        return dict(status='EXTERNAL_TRUST_ROOT_REQUIRED')
    if trusted_root.evidence_kind != SYNTHETIC_ROOT:
        return dict(status='REAL_TRUST_PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED')
    if requested_certification not in (None, SYNTHETIC_CUT):
        return dict(status='REAL_CERTIFICATION_NOT_AVAILABLE')
    try:
        cut = candidate_cut_state
        _plain(cut)
        _require(set(cut) == REQUIRED, 'CUT_FIELDS_MISSING_OR_UNRECOGNIZED')
        root = trusted_root
        expected = (root.expected_episode_id, root.expected_source_identity, root.expected_cut_tick,
                    root.expected_cut_phase, root.expected_trusted_prefix_digest,
                    root.expected_public_snapshot_digest, root.expected_freeze_boundary)
        actual = (cut['episode_id'], cut['source_identity'], cut['cut_tick'], cut['cut_phase'],
                  cut_prefix_digest(cut), cut['public_snapshot_digest'], digest(cut['freeze_boundary_identity']))
        _require(actual == expected and cut['trusted_prefix_digest'] == expected[4], 'EXTERNAL_ROOT_IDENTITY_CONFLICT')
        _require(type(cut['cut_tick']) is int and cut['cut_tick'] in (60, 80, 100)
                 and cut['cut_phase'] == PHASE and cut['evidence_kind'] == SYNTHETIC_CUT)
        physical = cut['physical_cut_state']
        public = cut['public_source']['policy_view']
        _require(physical['tick'] == cut['cut_tick'] and physical['positions'] == public['positions']
                 and physical['assignment'] == cut['current_assignment'] == public['assignment']
                 and physical['terminal_status'] == cut['terminal_status'])
        assignment_key(cut['current_assignment'])
        Config(**public['config'])
        _require(public['beliefs'] == cut['frozen_public_beliefs'], 'PUBLIC_FROZEN_BELIEF_CONFLICT')
        if (public['config']['robots'] != 3
                or any(t['required_robots'] != 2 for t in public['targets'])):
            return dict(status='NOT_APPLICABLE', real_causal_restore_verified=False)
        _validate_consumer(cut)
        _validate_histories_and_raw(cut)
        _require(physical['settled_economic_components'] == cut['settled_economic_components']
                 and physical['change_cost_so_far'] == cut['change_cost_so_far'])
        _require(set(cut['settled_economic_components']) == {'completion', 'flow', 'late', 'effort', 'terminal'})
        _require(all(type(v) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(v) for v in cut['settled_economic_components'].values()))
        _require(type(cut['change_cost_so_far']) in (int, float) and cut['change_cost_so_far'] >= 0)
        _require(cut['trusted_sensor_authority_state']['published_watermark'] == cut['public_profile_watermark'])
        payload = _public_payload(cut)
        _require(digest(payload) == root.expected_public_snapshot_digest, 'PUBLIC_SNAPSHOT_IDENTITY_CONFLICT')
        return dict(status='SYNTHETIC_CUT_INTERFACE_VERIFIED', evidence_kind=SYNTHETIC_CUT,
                    real_causal_restore_verified=False)
    except ProjectionError as exc:
        return dict(status=str(exc))
    except CutRejected as exc:
        return dict(status=str(exc))
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, IndexError, StopIteration, OverflowError):
        return dict(status='CUT_STRUCTURE_CONFLICT')


def import_verified_cut(trusted_cut_snapshot, *, trusted_root=None, requested_certification=None):
    result = verify_trusted_cut(trusted_cut_snapshot, trusted_root=trusted_root,
                                requested_certification=requested_certification)
    if result['status'] != 'SYNTHETIC_CUT_INTERFACE_VERIFIED':
        return result
    detached = deepcopy(trusted_cut_snapshot)
    public = PublicDecisionSnapshot(_public_payload(detached), SYNTHETIC_CUT, authority=PROJECTION_AUTHORITY)
    return dict(result, public_snapshot=public, applicability=public.applicability,
                trusted_state=TrustedModelCutState(json.dumps(detached, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False), SYNTHETIC_CUT),
                future_economic_origin='EXCLUDE_SETTLED_PREFIX_FROM_FUTURE_VALUE')


def recover_from_verified_history(verified_history_prefix, *, trusted_root=None):
    """No generic full-causal replay provider exists in IMP-2A.

    The old D60 belief-only recover() is deliberately not repackaged as a full
    replay. No claimed completeness flag or a supplied seed can bypass this.
    """
    if type(trusted_root) is not ExternalTrustRoot:
        return dict(status='EXTERNAL_TRUST_ROOT_REQUIRED')
    return dict(status='FULL_CAUSAL_HISTORY_PREFIX_UNAVAILABLE',
                reason='VERIFIED_FULL_CAUSAL_REPLAY_PROVIDER_NOT_CONNECTED',
                d60_belief_replay='NOT_VERIFIED', d60_full_causal_cut='NOT_VERIFIED',
                real_d80_d100_causal_restore='NOT_YET_VERIFIED')

=== FILE: research/non_oracle/stfbs_lite_live_cut.py ===
"""Synchronous post-freeze structural capture. No real-source authentication.

Caller must own exclusive single-threaded access during capture. Repeated reads
detect changes; they do not implement a lock or prove absence of ABA mutation.
"""
from copy import deepcopy
import math

from .stfbs_d1a_replay import digest
from research.information_service_online.public import validate_schema

PUBLIC_FIELDS = {'kind', 'tick', 'end_tick', 'config', 'positions', 'assignment',
                 'sensor_profiles', 'targets', 'beliefs', 'histories', 'current_slots',
                 'first_policy_visible_ticks'}
ANN_FIELDS = {'id', 'announcement_tick', 'birth', 'weight', 'deadline', 'service_duration',
              'required_robots', 'coarse_position', 'velocity_prior', 'design_error_bound',
              'motion_model', 'speed_limit'}
BELIEF_FIELDS = {'target_id', 'estimate_tick', 'available_tick', 'position_estimate',
                 'velocity_estimate', 'velocity_source', 'last_observation_tick', 'source', 'status', 'diagnostics'}
DIAGNOSTIC_KEYS = {'starts', 'has_accepted_estimate', 'estimate', 'optimizer_converged',
    'numerical_ill_conditioned', 'ambiguity_detected', 'boundary_active', 'branch_guard_triggered',
    'numeric_contract_violation', 'selected_start', 'Q', 'singular_values', 'start_id', 'start',
    'accepted', 'guard', 'status', 'success', 'optimality', 'nfev', 'njev', 'active_mask', 'cost',
    'x', 'evaluation_calls', 'fun', 'jac', 'phase', 'sensor_id', 'residual', 'jacobian', 'reason', 'estimate_available'}


class LiveCutRejected(ValueError):
    """Fixed codes only; never expose private payloads in exceptions."""


def _require(condition, code):
    if not condition:
        raise LiveCutRejected(code)


def _plain(value, *, diagnostic=False):
    if type(value) is dict:
        if diagnostic:
            _require(set(value) <= DIAGNOSTIC_KEYS, 'UNRECOGNIZED_PUBLIC_DIAGNOSTICS')
        for child in value.values():
            _plain(child, diagnostic=diagnostic)
    elif type(value) in (list, tuple):
        for child in value:
            _plain(child, diagnostic=diagnostic)
    else:
        _require(value is None or type(value) in (str, bool, int, float), 'NON_DATA_OBJECT_REJECTED')
        _require(type(value) is not float or math.isfinite(value), 'NONFINITE_STATE')


def _read(env):
    snapshot = deepcopy(env.private_snapshot())
    consumer = {field: deepcopy(getattr(env.beliefs, attr)) for field, attr in (
        ('consumer_states', 'states'), ('accepted_position_history', 'history'),
        ('pending_observations', 'pending'), ('consumed_records', 'consumed'),
        ('accepted_receipts', 'accepted_receipts'), ('announcements', 'announcements'))}
    control = dict(tick=env.tick, decision_tick=env.decision_tick, frozen=deepcopy(env.frozen),
                   boundary_committed_tick=env._boundary_committed_tick,
                   inflight=deepcopy(env.journal.inflight), failed=env.failed, done=env.done,
                   physical_environment_id=env.physical_environment_id, source_identity=env.source_identity,
                   first_policy_visible_ticks=deepcopy(env.first_visible_ticks))
    _plain((snapshot, consumer, control))
    return dict(snapshot=snapshot, consumer=consumer, control=control)


def _validate_temporal_prefix(snap, tick):
    """Bind dynamic state to the completed production request prefix, not time alone."""
    state, cp = snap['state'], snap['checkpoint']
    _require(state['terminal_settled'] is False, 'PREMATURE_TERMINAL_SETTLEMENT')
    requests = sorted(snap['successful_requests'].values(), key=lambda r: r['result']['start_tick'])
    _require(len(requests) == tick//20, 'COMPLETED_REQUEST_PREFIX_INCOMPLETE')
    frames, fusions, commits, events = [], [], [], []
    previous_cp = None
    for index, request in enumerate(requests):
        result = request['result']
        lo, hi = index*20, (index+1)*20
        _require(result['status'] == 'COMMITTED' and result['replayed'] is False
                 and result['start_tick'] == lo and result['end_tick'] == hi <= tick,
                 'REQUEST_TIME_CONFLICT')
        commit = result['action_commit']
        _require(request['fingerprint'] == digest(dict(physical_environment_id=snap['physical_environment_id'],
                 checkpoint_id=commit['checkpoint_id'], expected_start_tick=lo, assignment=commit['assignment'])),
                 'REQUEST_FINGERPRINT_CONFLICT')
        _require(commit['start_tick'] == lo < tick
                 and commit['action_commit_id'] == result['action_commit_id']
                 and commit['action_commit_id'] == digest({k: v for k, v in commit.items() if k != 'action_commit_id'}),
                 'REQUEST_ACTION_CONFLICT')
        if previous_cp is not None:
            _require(commit['checkpoint_id'] == previous_cp['checkpoint_id'], 'REQUEST_CHECKPOINT_CHAIN_CONFLICT')
        fs = result['frames']
        _require(len(fs) == 21 and [(f['tick'], f['phase']) for f in fs]
                 == [(lo, 'decision')]+[(k, 'physical') for k in range(lo+1, hi+1)], 'FRAME_TIME_OR_PHASE_CONFLICT')
        end = result['checkpoint_after']
        _require(end['tick'] == hi and end['phase'] == 'DECISION_READY'
                 and end['checkpoint_id'] == digest({k: v for k, v in end.items() if k != 'checkpoint_id'}),
                 'REQUEST_END_CHECKPOINT_CONFLICT')
        _require(fs[-1]['positions'] == end['positions'] and fs[-1]['assignment'] == end['assignment']
                 and fs[-1]['metrics'] == result['metrics'], 'REQUEST_END_FRAME_CONFLICT')
        for fusion in result['fusion_records']:
            when = fusion['frame']['tick']
            _require(lo <= when <= hi and fusion['actual_endpoint']['tick'] == when, 'FUSION_TIME_CONFLICT')
            if when == lo:
                refs = {digest(s['slot_key']) for s in commit['prepared_actual_slots']}
                _require(refs and all(digest(s['slot_key']) in refs for s in fusion['actual_endpoint']['slots']),
                         'UNCOMMITTED_BOUNDARY_FUSION')
        frames.extend(fs)
        fusions.extend(result['fusion_records'])
        commits.append(commit)
        events.extend(result['events'])
        previous_cp = end
    _require(snap['frames'] == frames and snap['fusions'] == fusions
             and snap['action_commits'] == commits, 'DYNAMIC_HISTORY_PREFIX_CONFLICT')
    _require(previous_cp == cp and snap['boundary_committed_tick'] == tick-20, 'LATEST_COMPLETED_CUT_CONFLICT')
    _require(cp['events_since_previous_checkpoint'] == requests[-1]['result']['events'], 'CHECKPOINT_EVENT_PREFIX_CONFLICT')
    state_events = state['events']
    _require(len(state_events) >= len(events) and (not events or state_events[-len(events):] == events), 'EVENT_PREFIX_CONFLICT')
    initial = state_events[:len(state_events)-len(events)] if events else state_events
    _require(all(e['kind'] == 'BIRTH' and e['at']['time_seconds'] == 0. for e in initial), 'UNOWNED_EVENT')
    _require([e['event_index'] for e in state_events] == list(range(len(state_events)))
             and [e['at']['time_seconds'] for e in state_events] == sorted(e['at']['time_seconds'] for e in state_events)
             and all(0 <= e['at']['time_seconds'] <= tick*.05 for e in state_events), 'EVENT_TIME_CONFLICT')
    _require(not any(e['at']['time_seconds'] == tick*.05 and e['kind'] in
             ('ASSIGNED', 'WITHDRAWN', 'TEAM_CHANGED', 'ROLE_CHANGED') for e in state_events), 'CURRENT_ASSIGNMENT_EVENT')
    _require(snap['checkpoint_event_cursor'] == len(state_events), 'CHECKPOINT_EVENT_CURSOR_CONFLICT')
    last = frames[-1]
    _require(last['tick'] == tick and last['phase'] == 'physical' and last['statuses'] == state['statuses']
             and last['positions'] == state['positions'] and last['assignment'] == state['assignment'], 'LAST_PHYSICAL_STATE_CONFLICT')
    metrics = last['metrics']
    _require(state['components'] == metrics['reward_components'], 'ECONOMIC_PREFIX_CONFLICT')
    for field, metric in (('change_cost', 'change_cost'), ('flow', 'flow'), ('late', 'late'),
                          ('total_effort', 'control_integral'), ('changes', 'assignment_changes'),
                          ('effort_by_robot', 'effort_by_robot'), ('peak_speed', 'peak_speed')):
        _require(state[field] == metrics[metric], 'CUMULATIVE_STATE_CONFLICT')
    _require(state['changes'] == sum(c['assignment_change_count'] for c in commits)
             and state['change_cost'] == sum(c['change_cost'] for c in commits), 'CUMULATIVE_ASSIGNMENT_CONFLICT')
    _require(sum(state['occupied_by_robot']) == metrics['occupied_robot_seconds'], 'CUMULATIVE_OCCUPANCY_CONFLICT')
    sampler = snap['sampler']
    _require(sampler['requests'] == metrics['actual_cache_requests']
             and sampler['reuses'] == metrics['actual_cache_reuses']
             and len(sampler['attempts']) == metrics['actual_sampling_attempts']
             and len(fusions) == metrics['actual_fusions'], 'CACHE_OR_FUSION_COUNTER_CONFLICT')
    entries = {tuple(r['raw_key']): r for r in sampler['entries']}
    _require(len(entries) == len(sampler['entries']) and sampler['requests'] == len(sampler['attempts'])+sampler['reuses'], 'CACHE_PREFIX_CONFLICT')
    _require(len({tuple(a['raw_key']) for a in sampler['attempts']}) == len(sampler['attempts']), 'DUPLICATE_RAW_ATTEMPT')
    owned = {(snap['physical_environment_id'], s['slot_key']['target_id'], s['slot_key']['robot_id'], s['slot_key']['tick'])
             for f in fusions for s in f['actual_endpoint']['slots']}
    _require(set(entries) == owned, 'UNOWNED_RAW_PREFIX')
    for attempt in sampler['attempts']:
        key = tuple(attempt['raw_key'])
        _require(key in entries and key[3] <= tick and attempt['outcome'] == entries[key]['slot']['state']
                 and attempt['context_digest'] == entries[key]['context_digest']
                 and attempt['slot_digest'] == entries[key]['slot']['slot_digest'], 'RAW_ATTEMPT_PREFIX_CONFLICT')
    for when in state['completion_times']+state['escape_times']:
        _require(when is None or 0 <= when <= tick*.05, 'FUTURE_TERMINAL_TIME')


def _validate(read, view):
    snap, consumer, control = read['snapshot'], read['consumer'], read['control']
    tick = control['tick']
    _require(type(tick) is int and tick in (60, 80, 100), 'ILLEGAL_CUT_TICK')
    _require(control['decision_tick'] == tick and control['frozen'] is not None, 'CUT_NOT_FROZEN')
    _require(control['boundary_committed_tick'] != tick and snap['boundary_committed_tick'] != tick,
             'ASSIGNMENT_ALREADY_COMMITTED')
    _require(control['inflight'] is None and snap['inflight'] is None, 'TRANSACTION_IN_PROGRESS')
    _require(control['failed'] is False and snap['failed'] is False and control['done'] is False,
             'EXECUTOR_NOT_LIVE')
    _require(snap['snapshot_digest'] == digest({k: v for k, v in snap.items() if k != 'snapshot_digest'}),
             'PRIVATE_SNAPSHOT_DIGEST_CONFLICT')
    _validate_temporal_prefix(snap, tick)
    cp, state = snap['checkpoint'], snap['state']
    _require(cp['phase'] == 'DECISION_READY' and cp['tick'] == state['tick'] == tick, 'CHECKPOINT_PHASE_CONFLICT')
    _require(cp['checkpoint_id'] == digest({k: v for k, v in cp.items() if k != 'checkpoint_id'}),
             'CHECKPOINT_IDENTITY_CONFLICT')
    _require(snap['physical_environment_id'] == control['physical_environment_id']
             and snap['source_identity'] == control['source_identity'] == digest(snap['case']), 'SOURCE_IDENTITY_CONFLICT')
    _require(set(view) == PUBLIC_FIELDS and view['kind'] == 'A2_POLICY_INPUT' and view['tick'] == tick,
             'PUBLIC_VIEW_SCHEMA_CONFLICT')
    _require(view['end_tick'] == cp['episode_end_tick'], 'PUBLIC_END_TICK_CONFLICT')
    for a, b in (('positions', 'positions'), ('assignment', 'assignment'), ('config', 'config'),
                 ('histories', 'task_histories'), ('current_slots', 'current_slots'), ('sensor_profiles', 'sensor_profiles')):
        _require(view[a] == cp[b], 'PUBLIC_CHECKPOINT_CONFLICT')
    _require(state['positions'] == cp['positions'] and state['assignment'] == cp['assignment'], 'PHYSICAL_STATE_CONFLICT')
    for history in view['histories']:
        validate_schema(history, 'TaskHistory')
    for slot in view['current_slots']:
        validate_schema(slot, 'MeasurementSlot')
    for action in view['assignment']:
        validate_schema(action, 'Assignment')
    active = [j for j, status in enumerate(state['statuses']) if status == 'active']
    _require([a['id'] for a in view['targets']] == active == [a['id'] for a in cp['targets']], 'VISIBLE_TARGET_CONFLICT')
    _require([state['histories'][str(j)] for j in active] == view['histories'], 'SERVICE_HISTORY_CONFLICT')
    announced = {a['id']: a for a in consumer['announcements'] if a['announcement_tick'] <= tick}
    for target in view['targets']:
        _require(set(target) == ANN_FIELDS and target['id'] in announced
                 and all(target[k] == announced[target['id']][k] for k in ANN_FIELDS), 'PUBLIC_ANNOUNCEMENT_CONFLICT')
    _require(view['beliefs'] == control['frozen'], 'PUBLIC_FROZEN_BELIEF_CONFLICT')
    for belief in view['beliefs'].values():
        _require(set(belief) == BELIEF_FIELDS, 'PUBLIC_BELIEF_SCHEMA_CONFLICT')
        _plain(belief['diagnostics'], diagnostic=True)
    _require(view['first_policy_visible_ticks'] == control['first_policy_visible_ticks'], 'VISIBILITY_HISTORY_CONFLICT')
    for i, profile in enumerate(view['sensor_profiles']):
        _require(set(profile) == {'sensor_id', 'sigma', 'health', 'observed_tick'}
                 and profile['sensor_id'] == f'U{i}' and profile['observed_tick'] <= tick
                 and profile['health'] in ('available', 'missing'), 'PUBLIC_PROFILE_CONFLICT')
    # Frozen output differs from internal states only by the production's
    # age-based public status projection. No freeze or consumption is repeated.
    frozen = deepcopy(consumer['consumer_states'])
    for b in frozen.values():
        if b['last_observation_tick'] is not None and tick-b['last_observation_tick'] > 20:
            b['status'] = 'DEGRADED'
    _require(frozen == control['frozen'], 'INTERNAL_FROZEN_STATE_CONFLICT')
    consumed = consumer['consumed_records']
    keys = [(r['target_id'], r['measurement_tick'], r['available_tick']) for r in consumed]
    _require(len(keys) == len(set(keys)) and all(r['consumed_tick'] <= tick for r in consumed), 'CONSUMED_RECORD_CONFLICT')
    _require([r['consumed_tick'] for r in consumed] == sorted(r['consumed_tick'] for r in consumed), 'CONSUMPTION_ORDER_CONFLICT')
    pending_keys = [(r['target_id'], r['measurement_tick'], r['available_tick']) for r in consumer['pending_observations']]
    _require(len(pending_keys) == len(set(pending_keys)) and not set(keys).intersection(pending_keys), 'PENDING_RECORD_CONFLICT')
    for j, receipt in consumer['accepted_receipts'].items():
        history = consumer['accepted_position_history'][j]
        _require(receipt in consumed and history and receipt['measurement_tick'] == history[-1][0]
                 and receipt['target_id'] == int(j), 'ACCEPTED_RECEIPT_CONFLICT')
    _require(snap['sampler']['physical_environment_id'] == control['physical_environment_id'], 'SAMPLER_IDENTITY_CONFLICT')
    for row in snap['sampler']['entries']:
        key = row['raw_key']
        _require(len(key) == 4 and key[0] == control['physical_environment_id'] and key[3] <= tick,
                 'RAW_KEY_CONFLICT')
    _require(all(commit['start_tick'] < tick for commit in snap['action_commits']), 'ASSIGNMENT_ALREADY_COMMITTED')
    return cp


def capture_live_cut(env, view):
    """Capture under caller-owned single-thread synchronous access, or reject.

    Two complete detached reads cover mutable data, counters and identities.
    No claim is made about a native episode-wide arrival/freeze journal.
    """
    try:
        first = _read(env)
        public = deepcopy({k: view[k] for k in PUBLIC_FIELDS})
        _require(set(view) == PUBLIC_FIELDS, 'PUBLIC_VIEW_SCHEMA_CONFLICT')
        _plain(public)
        cp = _validate(first, public)
        second = _read(env)
        _require(first == second, 'EXECUTOR_CHANGED_DURING_CAPTURE')
        _require(view == public, 'PUBLIC_VIEW_CHANGED_DURING_CAPTURE')
        private = deepcopy(first)
        private.update(cut_phase='POST_FREEZE_PRE_ASSIGNMENT',
                       causal_evidence=dict(order_kind='DERIVED', native_arrival_journal='NOT_VERIFIED',
                           complete_causal_order='NOT_VERIFIED', ordinals_issued=False,
                           relations=[dict(relation='CURRENT_BELIEF_FROZEN_BEFORE_NEW_ASSIGNMENT',
                               sources=['control.decision_tick', 'control.frozen', 'snapshot.boundary_committed_tick',
                                        'snapshot.action_commits', 'snapshot.checkpoint'],
                               rule='matched decision tick, no current commit, DECISION_READY checkpoint')]),
                       public_profile_watermark='NOT_VERIFIED_OBSERVED_TICK_IS_NOT_PUBLICATION_AUTHORITY')
        return dict(status='LIVE_CUT_STRUCTURAL_CAPTURE_PASS', private_live_cut=private,
                    public_policy_view=deepcopy(public), private_digest=digest(private), public_digest=digest(public),
                    checkpoint_id=cp['checkpoint_id'], execution_assumption='EXCLUSIVE_SINGLE_THREAD_SYNCHRONOUS',
                    real_actual_live_cut='NOT_RUN', real_source_authentication='NOT_VERIFIED',
                    full_trusted_cut='NOT_VERIFIED', real_model_initialization='NOT_VERIFIED')
    except LiveCutRejected as exc:
        return dict(status='LIVE_CUT_STRUCTURAL_CAPTURE_FAIL', reason=str(exc))
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, AttributeError, IndexError):
        return dict(status='LIVE_CUT_STRUCTURAL_CAPTURE_FAIL', reason='INCOMPLETE_OR_INVALID_EXECUTOR_STATE')

=== FILE: research/non_oracle/stfbs_lite_local_dev.py ===
"""Local research execution, NOT production authentication or RUN admission.

No approval/budget is issued here. Engineering and actual modes require separate
explicit local approval records. Science is imported only by the Job worker.
Current-user governance is not a malicious-user/TOCTOU isolation boundary.
"""
import ctypes as C
from ctypes import wintypes as W
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import threading

from research.non_oracle.stfbs_lite_real_d60_source import (
    AdmissionRejected, CATEGORIES, DurableJournal, DurableResourceLedger,
    _require, _dispatch_d60, guard_wls_bindings, inspect_attempt_journal,
    inspect_production_aliases, read_durable_journal, REQUIRED_SOURCE_PATHS,
)
from research.non_oracle.stfbs_lite_real_d60_supervisor_win import WindowsSupervisor, _seconds

ENGINEERING = 'LOCAL_DEV_ENGINEERING'
ACTUAL = 'LOCAL_DEV_ACTUAL_D60'
ARTIFICIAL = 'LOCAL_DEV_ENGINEERING_NOT_SCIENTIFIC_EVIDENCE'
STOP = 'POST_FREEZE_PRE_ASSIGNMENT_D60'
LOCAL_PATHS = frozenset(('research/non_oracle/stfbs_lite_local_dev.py',
    'scripts/run_stfbs_lite_local_dev.py', 'scripts/stfbs_lite_local_dev_worker.py'))


def digest_file(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def normalized_digest(value):
    _require(type(value) is str and len(value)==64 and all(c in '0123456789abcdefABCDEF' for c in value),
             'LOCAL_SHA256_INVALID')
    return value.lower()


def decode_json(raw):
    def unique(pairs):
        result = {}
        for key, value in pairs:
            _require(key not in result, 'DUPLICATE_JSON_KEY')
            result[key] = value
        return result
    def invalid(value):
        raise AdmissionRejected('NONFINITE_JSON')
    return json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8-sig'), object_pairs_hook=unique, parse_constant=invalid)


def load_approval(path, expected_digest):
    raw = Path(path).read_bytes()
    _require(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == normalized_digest(expected_digest), 'LOCAL_APPROVAL_BYTES_CONFLICT')
    return decode_json(raw), raw


def validate_approval(record, repository, *, check_worktree=False):
    fields = {'schema', 'mode', 'execution_authorized', 'approval_reference', 'approved_by',
        'git_head', 'source_sha256', 'inputs', 'world_id', 'physical_environment_id',
        'run_id', 'attempt_id', 'runtime', 'budget', 'stop_rule', 'output_directory',
        'attempt_directory', 'overshoot_disposition'}
    _require(type(record) is dict and set(record) == fields, 'LOCAL_APPROVAL_FIELDS_INVALID')
    _require(record['schema'] == 'STFBS_LOCAL_DEV_APPROVAL_V1' and record['mode'] in (ENGINEERING, ACTUAL)
             and record['execution_authorized'] is True, 'EXPLICIT_LOCAL_EXECUTION_APPROVAL_REQUIRED')
    for name in ('approval_reference', 'approved_by', 'world_id', 'physical_environment_id', 'run_id', 'attempt_id'):
        _require(type(record[name]) is str and bool(record[name].strip()), 'LOCAL_IDENTITY_MISSING')
    _require(record['stop_rule'] == STOP and record['overshoot_disposition'] == 'FAIL_ATTEMPT',
             'LOCAL_STOP_OR_DISPOSITION_NOT_APPROVED')
    repository = Path(repository).resolve()
    head = subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'], cwd=repository, text=True).strip()
    branch = subprocess.check_output(['git','branch','--show-current'], cwd=repository, text=True).strip()
    _require(head == record['git_head'] and branch == 'main', 'LOCAL_SOURCE_HEAD_CONFLICT')
    if check_worktree:
        dirty = subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all'], cwd=repository, text=True)
        _require(not dirty.strip(), 'LOCAL_INITIAL_WORKTREE_DIRTY')
    required = REQUIRED_SOURCE_PATHS | LOCAL_PATHS
    _require(type(record['source_sha256']) is dict and required <= set(record['source_sha256']),
             'LOCAL_SOURCE_COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE')
    for relative, sha in record['source_sha256'].items():
        path = repository/relative
        _require(not Path(relative).is_absolute() and path.resolve().is_relative_to(repository), 'LOCAL_SOURCE_ESCAPE')
        _require(digest_file(path) == normalized_digest(sha), 'LOCAL_SOURCE_BYTES_CONFLICT')
    runtime = record['runtime']
    _require(set(runtime) == {'python', 'python_sha256', 'version', 'dependency_sha256'}
             and Path(runtime['python']).resolve() == Path(sys.executable).resolve()
             and runtime['version'] == sys.version and digest_file(runtime['python']) == normalized_digest(runtime['python_sha256']),
             'LOCAL_RUNTIME_CONFLICT')
    _require(type(runtime['dependency_sha256']) is dict and bool(runtime['dependency_sha256']),
             'LOCAL_DEPENDENCY_IDENTITY_REQUIRED')
    for path, sha in runtime['dependency_sha256'].items():
        _require(Path(path).is_absolute() and digest_file(path) == normalized_digest(sha), 'LOCAL_DEPENDENCY_BYTES_CONFLICT')
    budget = record['budget']
    _require(set(budget) == {'total_cpu_seconds', 'wall_seconds', 'wls', 'storage_bytes'}, 'LOCAL_BUDGET_MISSING')
    _seconds(budget['total_cpu_seconds'], cpu=True)
    _seconds(budget['wall_seconds'])
    _require(type(budget['storage_bytes']) is int and budget['storage_bytes'] > 0, 'LOCAL_STORAGE_BUDGET_INVALID')
    _require(set(budget['wls']) == set(CATEGORIES) and all(type(v) is int and v >= 0 for v in budget['wls'].values()),
             'LOCAL_WLS_BUDGET_INVALID')
    for name in ('output_directory','attempt_directory'):
        _require(Path(record[name]).is_absolute(), 'ABSOLUTE_LOCAL_DIRECTORY_REQUIRED')
    output = Path(record['output_directory']).resolve()
    attempts = Path(record['attempt_directory']).resolve()
    _require(output != attempts and not attempts.is_relative_to(output), 'LOCAL_DIRECTORY_CONFLICT')
    if record['mode'] == ACTUAL:
        _require(all(v > 0 for v in budget['wls'].values()) and set(record['inputs']) == {'world','public'},
                 'ACTUAL_INPUTS_AND_BUDGET_REQUIRED')
        for info in record['inputs'].values():
            _require(set(info) == {'path','sha256'} and Path(info['path']).is_absolute()
                     and digest_file(info['path']) == normalized_digest(info['sha256']), 'LOCAL_INPUT_BYTES_CONFLICT')
    else:
        _require(record['inputs'] == {} and all(v == 0 for v in budget['wls'].values()),
                 'ENGINEERING_MUST_HAVE_NO_SCIENCE_INPUT_OR_WLS')
    return record


def storage_usage(root):
    total = 0
    for path in Path(root).rglob('*'):
        _require(not path.is_symlink(), 'LOCAL_OUTPUT_LINK_REJECTED')
        if path.is_file():
            total += path.stat().st_size
    return total


def write_new(root, name, value, limit):
    payload = (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False)+'\n').encode()
    write_bytes_new(root,name,payload,limit)


def write_bytes_new(root, name, payload, limit):
    _require(storage_usage(root)+len(payload) <= limit, 'LOCAL_STORAGE_EXHAUSTED')
    with (Path(root)/name).open('xb') as stream:
        _require(stream.write(payload) == len(payload), 'LOCAL_SHORT_WRITE')
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())


class LocalJournal(DurableJournal):
    def __init__(self, root, attempt_id, limit):
        self.root = Path(root)
        super().__init__(self.root/'worker.jsonl', attempt_id=attempt_id, max_bytes=limit)
        self.incremental_hash=hashlib.sha256()
        self.byte_count=0
        self.invalid=False
        self.full_scan_count=0
        self.full_scan_bytes=0

    def verify_integrity(self):
        _require(not self.invalid,'LOCAL_JOURNAL_PERMANENTLY_INVALID')
        try:
            stat=self.path.stat()
            _require((stat.st_dev,stat.st_ino)==self.identity and stat.st_size==self.byte_count,
                     'LOCAL_JOURNAL_IDENTITY_OR_SIZE_CHANGED')
            digest=hashlib.sha256()
            with self.path.open('rb') as reader:
                for block in iter(lambda:reader.read(1048576),b''):
                    digest.update(block);self.full_scan_bytes+=len(block)
            self.full_scan_count+=1
            _require(digest.digest()==self.incremental_hash.digest(),'LOCAL_JOURNAL_HISTORY_CHANGED')
        except BaseException:
            self.invalid=True
            raise

    def append(self, event):
        from research.non_oracle.stfbs_lite_real_d60_source import content_digest
        _require(not self.invalid,'LOCAL_JOURNAL_PERMANENTLY_INVALID')
        try:
            _require(os.getpid()==self.pid and threading.get_ident()==self.thread,'JOURNAL_WRITER_CONFLICT')
            stat=self.path.stat()
            _require((stat.st_dev,stat.st_ino)==self.identity and stat.st_size==self.byte_count
                     and self.file.tell()==self.byte_count,'LOCAL_JOURNAL_IDENTITY_OR_SIZE_CHANGED')
            row = dict(attempt_id=self.attempt_id, sequence=self.sequence+1, previous=self.previous, event=event)
            row['digest'] = content_digest(row)
            encoded = (json.dumps(row,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n').encode()
            _require(storage_usage(self.root)+len(encoded) <= self.limit, 'LOCAL_STORAGE_EXHAUSTED')
            _require(self.file.write(encoded)==len(encoded),'LOCAL_JOURNAL_SHORT_WRITE')
            self.file.flush()
            os.fsync(self.file.fileno())
            self.incremental_hash.update(encoded)
            self.byte_count+=len(encoded)
            self.bytes_digest=self.incremental_hash.digest()
            self.sequence,self.previous=row['sequence'],row['digest']
            if event['kind'] in ('STEP_COMPLETE','LOCAL_WORKER_COMPLETE'):
                self.verify_integrity()
            return row
        except BaseException:
            self.invalid=True
            raise


def process_identity(api, handle):
    api.k.GetProcessTimes.argtypes = [W.HANDLE]+[C.POINTER(W.FILETIME)]*4
    api.k.GetProcessTimes.restype = W.BOOL
    api.k.GetProcessId.argtypes = [W.HANDLE]
    api.k.GetProcessId.restype = W.DWORD
    times = [W.FILETIME() for _ in range(4)]
    api.check(api.k.GetProcessTimes(handle, *(C.byref(t) for t in times)), 'GetProcessTimes/LOCAL_DEV')
    return dict(pid=int(api.k.GetProcessId(handle)),
                creation_ticks=(times[0].dwHighDateTime << 32) | times[0].dwLowDateTime)


def verify_local_job_handoff(record, handoff, approval_digest):
    """Local current-user governance, NOT independent IPC/authentication."""
    from research.quality_allocation.service_m3_benchmarks.windows_job_monitor.api import API
    api = API()
    _require(handoff['attempt_id'] == record['attempt_id'] and handoff['mode'] == record['mode']
             and handoff['approval_digest'] == approval_digest, 'LOCAL_HANDOFF_IDENTITY_CONFLICT')
    current = api.k.GetCurrentProcess()
    _require(process_identity(api,current) == handoff['worker'] and api.member(current,None),
             'LOCAL_WORKER_MUST_BE_IN_JOB')
    parent = api.k.OpenProcess(0x1000 | 0x100000,False,handoff['parent']['pid'])
    api.check(parent,'OpenProcess/LOCAL_PARENT')
    try:
        _require(process_identity(api,parent) == handoff['parent']
                 and api.k.WaitForSingleObject(parent,0) == 258, 'LOCAL_PARENT_NOT_LIVE')
    finally:
        api.close(parent)
    _require(handoff['parent_verified_target_job'] is True, 'LOCAL_PARENT_JOB_CHECK_MISSING')


class ArtificialEnvironment:
    """Full STEP signature, artificial state only; no scientific imports."""
    def __init__(self):
        self.tick = 0
    def prepare_decision(self):
        return {'tick':self.tick,'evidence_kind':ARTIFICIAL}
    def observe_public(self):
        return {'checkpoint_id':'ARTIFICIAL_D'+str(self.tick)}
    def step(self, actions, checkpoint_id, expected_start_tick, request_id, *, on_commit):
        _require(self.tick == expected_start_tick and checkpoint_id == self.observe_public()['checkpoint_id'],
                 'ARTIFICIAL_STEP_CONFLICT')
        start = self.tick
        on_commit({'tick':start,'evidence_kind':ARTIFICIAL})
        self.tick += 20
        return {'status':'COMMITTED','start_tick':start,'end_tick':self.tick,
                'checkpoint_after':{'tick':self.tick,'checkpoint_id':'ARTIFICIAL_D'+str(self.tick)},
                'evidence_kind':ARTIFICIAL}


def execute_worker_mode(record, journal, *, handoff=None, approval_digest=None):
    if record['mode'] == ENGINEERING:
        candidate = _dispatch_d60(ArtificialEnvironment(),
            decide=lambda view, method: {'actions':[{'target':None,'role':'none'}]*3},
            capture=lambda env,view: {'status':'LIVE_CUT_STRUCTURAL_CAPTURE_PASS','tick':view['tick'], 'evidence_kind':ARTIFICIAL},
            map_candidate=lambda cut: {'candidate_status':'MODEL_INITIALIZATION_CANDIDATE_READY',
                'execution_admission':'MODEL_EXECUTION_ADMISSION_DENIED','evidence_kind':ARTIFICIAL}, journal=journal)
        return candidate, {'scope':ARTIFICIAL,'counts':dict.fromkeys(CATEGORIES,0)}
    _require(record['mode'] == ACTUAL, 'LOCAL_MODE_INVALID')
    _require(handoff is not None and approval_digest is not None, 'LOCAL_ACTUAL_WORKER_CONTEXT_REQUIRED')
    verify_local_job_handoff(record,handoff,approval_digest)
    # These imports occur only after worker approval + Job checks.
    from research.non_oracle.environment import StaggeredEnvironment
    from scripts.run_a1 import Sensing
    from research.non_oracle import policy
    from research.information_service_bridge import public_stream
    from research.cooperative_sensing import estimator
    from research.non_oracle.stfbs_lite_live_cut import capture_live_cut
    from research.non_oracle.stfbs_lite_real_cut_to_model import prepare_real_cut_model_input
    import numpy
    import scipy
    runtime_pins = {str(Path(p).resolve()):normalized_digest(sha) for p,sha in record['runtime']['dependency_sha256'].items()}
    modules = {m.__name__:str(Path(m.__file__).resolve()) for m in (numpy,scipy)}
    _require(all(path in runtime_pins and digest_file(path)==runtime_pins[path] for path in modules.values()),
             'LOCAL_NUMERICAL_RUNTIME_NOT_PINNED')
    journal.append({'kind':'LOCAL_RUNTIME','numpy_version':numpy.__version__,
                    'scipy_version':scipy.__version__,'module_files':modules})
    inputs = {}
    for name, info in record['inputs'].items():
        raw = Path(info['path']).read_bytes()
        _require(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==normalized_digest(info['sha256']), 'LOCAL_INPUT_CHANGED_BEFORE_READ')
        write_bytes_new(record['output_directory'], 'WORLD_INPUT.json' if name=='world' else 'PUBLIC_INPUT.json',
                        raw, record['budget']['storage_bytes'])
        inputs[name] = decode_json(raw)
    world, public = inputs['world'], inputs['public']
    _require(type(public) is dict and type(public.get('announcements')) is list, 'ANNOUNCEMENTS_LIST_REQUIRED')
    inspect_production_aliases()
    ledger = DurableResourceLedger(record['budget']['wls'], journal)
    class AuditedSensing(Sensing):
        def check_streams(self):
            verify_sensing_streams(self, public_stream)
        def __call__(self, *args, **kwargs):
            self.check_streams()
            result = super().__call__(*args, **kwargs)
            self.check_streams()
            return result
    with guard_wls_bindings(ledger,policy=policy,bridge=public_stream,estimator=estimator):
        sensing = AuditedSensing()
        env = StaggeredEnvironment(world,sensing,record['physical_environment_id'],public['announcements'])
        candidate = _dispatch_d60(env,decide=policy.decide,capture=capture_live_cut,
                                  map_candidate=prepare_real_cut_model_input,journal=journal)
        sensing.check_streams()
        _require(candidate.get('candidate_status') == 'MODEL_INITIALIZATION_CANDIDATE_READY', 'LOCAL_MAPPING_NOT_READY')
    return candidate, {'scope':'KNOWN_POLICY_OBSERVATION_SOLVER_BINDINGS_AND_DYNAMIC_SENSING_STREAMS',
                       'arbitrary_external_aliases':'NOT_PROVEN', 'counts':dict(ledger.counts)}


def verify_sensing_streams(sensing, public_stream):
    _require(all(p.estimator_fn is public_stream._estimate for p in sensing.streams.values()),
             'LOCAL_UNGUARDED_PROCESSOR_ALIAS')


def worker_main(approval_path, approval_digest, handoff_path, repository):
    record, _ = load_approval(approval_path,approval_digest)
    validate_approval(record,repository)
    handoff = decode_json(Path(handoff_path).read_bytes())
    verify_local_job_handoff(record,handoff,approval_digest)
    journal = LocalJournal(record['output_directory'],record['attempt_id'],record['budget']['storage_bytes'])
    try:
        journal.append({'kind':'LOCAL_WORKER_START','mode':record['mode'], 'approval_digest':approval_digest,
                        'attempt_id':record['attempt_id'], 'worker_pid':os.getpid(),
                        'evidence_kind':ARTIFICIAL if record['mode']==ENGINEERING else 'LOCAL_DEV_ACTUAL_NOT_SOURCE_AUTHENTICATED'})
        candidate, wls = execute_worker_mode(record,journal,handoff=handoff,approval_digest=approval_digest)
        journal.append({'kind':'LOCAL_WORKER_COMPLETE','mode':record['mode'],'tick':60,
                        'stop_rule':STOP,'candidate_status':candidate['candidate_status'], 'wls':wls,
                        'model_admission':'MODEL_EXECUTION_ADMISSION_DENIED'})
        return 0
    except BaseException as exc:
        try:
            journal.append({'kind':'LOCAL_WORKER_FAILED','type':type(exc).__name__,'message':str(exc)})
        except BaseException:
            pass  # Parent sees missing completion/truncated audit, never PASS.
        raise
    finally:
        journal.close()


def audit_local_result(record, result, rows, approval_digest, *, expected_worker_pid=None):
    _require(result.get('execution_entry') == 'RUN_MONITORED'
             and result.get('attempt_identity') == record['attempt_id']
             and result.get('job_cleanup_status') == 'PASS'
             and result.get('process_tree_status') == 'PROCESS_TREE_EXIT_CONFIRMED'
             and type(result.get('worker_exit_status')) is int and result['worker_exit_status'] == 0
             and result.get('cpu_semantics') == 'TOTAL_CPU_SECONDS' and result.get('cpu_scope') == 'WHOLE_JOB'
             and result.get('stop_reason') == 'NATURAL_EXIT'
             and result.get('accounting_status') == 'FINAL_VALID'
             and result.get('evidence_completeness_status') == 'COMPLETE_IN_MEMORY'
             and result.get('errors') == [], 'LOCAL_RESOURCE_OR_EXIT_INCOMPLETE')
    accounting = result.get('accounting')
    _require(type(accounting) is dict and all(type(accounting.get(k)) is int and accounting[k] >= 0
        for k in ('TotalUserTime','TotalKernelTime','ActiveProcesses')), 'LOCAL_FINAL_ACCOUNTING_MISSING')
    total = accounting['TotalUserTime']+accounting['TotalKernelTime']
    _require(type(result.get('final_cpu_ticks')) is int and type(result.get('total_cpu_ticks')) is int
             and accounting['ActiveProcesses'] == 0 and result.get('final_cpu_ticks') == total
             and result.get('total_cpu_ticks') == total, 'LOCAL_FINAL_ACCOUNTING_CONFLICT')
    _require(result.get('cpu_limit_ticks') == _seconds(record['budget']['total_cpu_seconds'],cpu=True)
             and result.get('wall_limit_seconds') == _seconds(record['budget']['wall_seconds'])
             and result.get('cpu_overshoot_ticks') == 0
             and total <= result['cpu_limit_ticks'], 'LOCAL_RESOURCE_LIMIT_OR_OVERSHOOT')
    elapsed = _seconds(result.get('wall_elapsed_at_tree_exit'))
    _require(elapsed <= record['budget']['wall_seconds'], 'LOCAL_WALL_OVERSHOOT')
    _require(type(result.get('supervisor_cpu_ticks')) is int and result['supervisor_cpu_ticks'] >= 0
             and 'EXCLUDED_FROM_JOB' in result.get('supervisor_cpu_scope',''), 'LOCAL_SUPERVISOR_CPU_AUDIT_MISSING')
    boundary = inspect_attempt_journal(rows)
    _require(boundary['last_complete_step'] == 60 and boundary['incomplete_transaction'] is None
             and not boundary['unfinished_calls'], 'LOCAL_D60_INCOMPLETE')
    starts = [r['event'] for r in rows if r['event']['kind']=='LOCAL_WORKER_START']
    finishes = [r['event'] for r in rows if r['event']['kind']=='LOCAL_WORKER_COMPLETE']
    _require(len(starts)==len(finishes)==1 and starts[0]['mode']==finishes[0]['mode']==record['mode']
             and starts[0]['approval_digest']==approval_digest and starts[0]['attempt_id']==record['attempt_id']
             and finishes[0]['stop_rule']==STOP, 'LOCAL_WORKER_IDENTITY_OR_COMPLETION_CONFLICT')
    _require(rows[0]['event']['kind']=='LOCAL_WORKER_START' and rows[-1]['event']['kind']=='LOCAL_WORKER_COMPLETE'
             and (expected_worker_pid is None or starts[0]['worker_pid']==expected_worker_pid),
             'LOCAL_WORKER_EVENT_ORDER_OR_PID_CONFLICT')
    steps = [(r['event']['start_tick'],r['event']['end_tick']) for r in rows if r['event']['kind']=='STEP_COMPLETE']
    _require(steps == [(0,20),(20,40),(40,60)], 'LOCAL_STEP_ORDER_CONFLICT')
    candidates = [r['event'] for r in rows if r['event']['kind']=='D60_CANDIDATE']
    _require(len(candidates)==1 and candidates[0]['candidate'].get('candidate_status')=='MODEL_INITIALIZATION_CANDIDATE_READY'
             and candidates[0]['candidate']['execution_admission']=='MODEL_EXECUTION_ADMISSION_DENIED',
             'LOCAL_MODEL_OR_CANDIDATE_CONFLICT')
    calls, completed, counts = {}, set(), dict.fromkeys(CATEGORIES,0)
    for row in rows:
        event=row['event']
        if event['kind']=='LOCAL_WORKER_FAILED':
            raise AdmissionRejected('LOCAL_WORKER_FAILED')
        if event['kind']!='WLS':
            continue
        call, category=event['call_id'], event['category']
        _require(category in counts, 'LOCAL_UNKNOWN_WLS_CATEGORY')
        if event['status']=='STARTED':
            _require(call not in calls, 'LOCAL_DUPLICATE_WLS_CALL')
            calls[call]=category
            counts[category]+=1
            _require(counts[category]<=record['budget']['wls'][category], 'LOCAL_WLS_EXCEEDED')
        else:
            _require(event['status']=='RETURNED' and calls.get(call)==category and call not in completed,
                     'LOCAL_WLS_FAILED_OR_CONFLICTING')
            completed.add(call)
    _require(set(calls)==completed and counts==finishes[0]['wls']['counts'], 'LOCAL_WLS_AUDIT_INCOMPLETE')
    if record['mode']==ENGINEERING:
        _require(not calls and starts[0]['evidence_kind']==ARTIFICIAL, 'LOCAL_ENGINEERING_SCIENCE_CONFLICT')
    return dict(boundary=boundary, wls_counts=counts, candidate=candidates[0]['candidate'])


def run_parent(approval_path, approval_digest, repository):
    """Only metadata and Win32 supervision here, never environment/decide/STEP."""
    record, raw=load_approval(approval_path,approval_digest)
    validate_approval(record,repository,check_worktree=True)
    output, store=Path(record['output_directory']), Path(record['attempt_directory'])
    _require(not output.exists(), 'LOCAL_OUTPUT_ALREADY_EXISTS')
    store.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    marker=store/(hashlib.sha256(record['attempt_id'].encode()).hexdigest()+'.consumed')
    payload=json.dumps({'attempt_id':record['attempt_id'],'run_id':record['run_id'],
        'approval_digest':approval_digest,'output':str(output),'status':'LOCAL_CONSUMED_NO_AUTOMATIC_RETRY'}).encode()
    limit=record['budget']['storage_bytes']
    supervisor=None
    result=None
    consumed=False
    output_owned=False
    stage='CONSUME_ATTEMPT'
    try:
        # O_EXCL remains irreversible, even when the subsequent fsync fails.
        with marker.open('xb') as stream:
            consumed=True
            _require(stream.write(payload)==len(payload),'LOCAL_CONSUMPTION_SHORT_WRITE')
            stream.flush(); os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        stage='CREATE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY'
        output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
        output_owned=True
        stage='WRITE_APPROVAL_SNAPSHOT'
        write_bytes_new(output,'approval.json',raw,limit)
        stage='CREATE_SUPERVISOR'
        supervisor=WindowsSupervisor(wall_seconds=record['budget']['wall_seconds'],
            total_cpu_seconds=record['budget']['total_cpu_seconds'],attempt_identity=record['attempt_id'])
        api=supervisor.api
        original_create=api.create
        def create(job,argv,cwd,env,log):
            pi=original_create(job,argv,cwd,env,log)
            try:
                _require(api.member(pi.hProcess,job),'LOCAL_TARGET_JOB_CONTAINMENT_FAILED')
                handoff=dict(attempt_id=record['attempt_id'],mode=record['mode'],approval_digest=approval_digest,
                    parent=process_identity(api,api.k.GetCurrentProcess()), worker=process_identity(api,pi.hProcess),
                    parent_verified_target_job=True, governance='CURRENT_USER_LOCAL_NOT_AUTHENTICATED_IPC')
                write_new(output,'handoff.json',handoff,limit)  # Before resume.
                return pi
            except BaseException:
                # The frozen start() exception path terminates its Job, including
                # this still-suspended member. Release handles not returned to it.
                for handle in (pi.hThread,pi.hProcess):
                    try: api.close(handle)
                    except BaseException: pass
                raise
        api.create=create  # Instance only; frozen supervisor/API files unchanged.
        worker=Path(repository)/'scripts/stfbs_lite_local_dev_worker.py'
        stage='START_AND_MONITOR_WORKER'
        result=supervisor.run_monitored([record['runtime']['python'],'-B',str(worker),
            '--authorization',str(output/'approval.json'),'--approved-sha256',approval_digest,
            '--handoff',str(output/'handoff.json')],cwd=repository,log=output/'worker.log')
        # Handle closure errors must be reflected before success evaluation.
        stage='FINAL_CLEANUP_AND_AUDIT'
        supervisor.close()
        rows=read_durable_journal(output/'worker.jsonl',attempt_id=record['attempt_id'])
        handoff=decode_json((output/'handoff.json').read_bytes())
        audited=audit_local_result(record,result,rows,approval_digest,expected_worker_pid=handoff['worker']['pid'])
        outcome=dict(status='LOCAL_DEV_EXECUTION_COMPLETE',mode=record['mode'],run_id=record['run_id'],
            attempt_id=record['attempt_id'],job=result,audit=audited,
            evidence_kind=ARTIFICIAL if record['mode']==ENGINEERING else 'LOCAL_DEV_ACTUAL_R_POLICY_D60_PREFIX',
            source_authentication='NOT_VERIFIED',model_admission='MODEL_EXECUTION_ADMISSION_DENIED',
            scientific_gain='NOT_ESTABLISHED',production_run_admission='RUN_ADMISSION_BLOCKED',
            storage_scope='PREWRITE_JSON_AND_JOURNAL_PLUS_FINAL_TOTAL_CHECK_NOT_OS_DISK_QUOTA',retry_authorized=False)
        stage='WRITE_SUCCESS_RECEIPT'
        write_new(output,'success.json',outcome,limit)
        return outcome
    except BaseException as exc:
        if not consumed:
            raise  # Never write into evidence belonging to another attempt.
        if supervisor is not None:
            try: supervisor.close()
            except BaseException: pass
            result=supervisor.result
        failure=dict(status='LOCAL_DEV_FAILED_OR_INCOMPLETE',mode=record['mode'],attempt_id=record['attempt_id'],
            run_id=record['run_id'],approval_digest=approval_digest,failure_stage=stage,
            error={'type':type(exc).__name__,'message':str(exc)},job=result,
            retry_authorized=False,source_authentication='NOT_VERIFIED',model_admission='MODEL_EXECUTION_ADMISSION_DENIED')
        try:
            _require(output_owned,'LOCAL_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_NOT_OWNED')
            # Disk records describe the write attempt; only a successful return
            # below confirms flush/fsync. A partial file is never overwritten.
            failure['failure_evidence_persistence']='OUTPUT_RECORD_WRITE_ATTEMPTED'
            write_new(output,'failure.json',failure,limit)
            failure['failure_evidence_persistence']='OUTPUT_FAILURE_RECORD_SAVED'
            failure['failure_evidence_path']=str(output/'failure.json')
        except BaseException as persist_error:
            failure['output_evidence_error']={'type':type(persist_error).__name__,'message':str(persist_error)}
            fallback=marker.with_suffix('.failure.json')
            failure['failure_evidence_persistence']='ATTEMPT_STORE_RECORD_WRITE_ATTEMPTED'
            try:
                encoded=(json.dumps(failure,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False)+'\n').encode()
                _require(len(encoded)<=limit,'LOCAL_FALLBACK_RECORD_TOO_LARGE')
                with fallback.open('xb') as stream:
                    _require(stream.write(encoded)==len(encoded),'LOCAL_FALLBACK_SHORT_WRITE')
                    stream.flush(); os.fsync(stream.fileno())
                failure['failure_evidence_persistence']='ATTEMPT_STORE_FAILURE_RECORD_SAVED'
                failure['failure_evidence_path']=str(fallback)
            except BaseException as fallback_error:
                failure['failure_evidence_persistence']='FAILURE_EVIDENCE_PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE'
                failure['fallback_evidence_error']={'type':type(fallback_error).__name__,'message':str(fallback_error)}
        return failure
    finally:
        if supervisor is not None:
            supervisor.close()

=== FILE: research/non_oracle/stfbs_lite_proxy.py ===
"""G-only fixed-plan proxy; optimistic unknown Q is not a PASS observation."""
from dataclasses import replace
import math
import numpy as np

from pursuit_v2.config import Config
from pursuit_v2.observation_geometry import offset, radius, validate_roles
from pursuit_v2.service import ServiceState, advance_clock
from .policy import command
from .stfbs_lite_candidates import assignment_key, team
from .stfbs_lite_worlds import (DT, H, TOL, point, world_digest,
                                public_input_digest, WORLD_RULE_VERSION)

CERTIFICATE_ROLE = 'DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY'


def certificate(state, duration, start_tick, *, complete_team, proven_escape_time=None,
                premises_verified=False):
    """Use every remaining complete interval, never predicted G failures.

    An escape bound must be proved by the caller for this fixed conditional
    trajectory. Without verified premises no infeasibility claim is emitted.
    """
    out = dict(status='NOT_CERTIFIED', certificate_role=CERTIFICATE_ROLE)
    if (not premises_verified or not isinstance(state, ServiceState)
            or type(start_tick) is not int or not 0 <= start_tick <= H
            or not math.isfinite(duration) or duration <= 0):
        return out
    if proven_escape_time is not None and (math.isnan(proven_escape_time) or proven_escape_time < start_tick*DT):
        return out
    n = H-start_tick if complete_team else 0
    if proven_escape_time is not None:
        n = sum(1 for k in range(start_tick+1, H+1) if proven_escape_time > k*DT+TOL) if complete_team else 0
    upper = math.fsum((state.base, (state.intervals+n)*DT))
    out.update(N_plus=n, U_plus=upper)
    if upper < duration-TOL:
        out['status'] = 'CERTIFIED_INFEASIBLE_UNDER_FIXED_PLAN_BY_H'
    return out


def ledger(cfg, targets, start_tick, outcomes, effort, changed):
    """Positive cost columns, with completion reward separated."""
    start = start_tick*DT
    reward = flow = late = terminal = 0.
    for t in targets:
        o = outcomes[t['id']]
        stop = o['stop_time']
        reward += t['weight'] if o['completion_tick'] is not None else 0.
        terminal += t['weight'] if o['completion_tick'] is None else 0.
        flow += t['weight']*max(0., stop-max(start, t['birth']))
        late += t['weight']*max(0., stop-max(start, t['birth'], t['deadline']))
    columns = dict(completion=reward/cfg.weight_reference,
                   flow=cfg.flow_weight*flow/(cfg.weight_reference*cfg.stage_dt),
                   late=cfg.late_weight*late/(cfg.weight_reference*cfg.stage_dt),
                   effort=cfg.control_weight*effort/cfg.effort_reference,
                   terminal=cfg.unfinished_weight*terminal/cfg.weight_reference,
                   change=cfg.change_cost*changed)
    value = columns['completion']-sum(columns[k] for k in ('flow', 'late', 'effort', 'terminal', 'change'))
    if not all(math.isfinite(x) for x in (*columns.values(), value)):
        raise ValueError('Invalid economic output')
    return columns, value


def run_proxy(view, actions, world):
    """Public envelope plus immutable service clocks and known current Q states.

    An unchanged team's left endpoint is recorded public G/Q, independent of
    the conditional world's current geometry. UNKNOWN is not a valid observed
    service endpoint. Changed teams use an explicitly optimistic proxy endpoint.
    No observation is synthesized and recorded history is never overwritten.
    """
    cfg = Config(**view['config'])
    start = view['tick']
    if world['tick'] != start or start not in (60, 80, 100):
        raise ValueError('Cut mismatch')
    if (world['horizon'] != H or world['generation_rule'] != WORLD_RULE_VERSION
            or world['public_input_digest'] != public_input_digest(view)
            or world['world_digest'] != world_digest(world)):
        raise ValueError('World/public context identity mismatch')
    target_id, members = team(actions)
    ids = {t['id'] for t in view['targets']}
    if target_id not in ids or set(world['motion']) != ids:
        raise ValueError('Foreign task')
    if cfg.geometry_mode != 'angular_standoff_v1' or cfg.capture_mode != 'stepwise_service':
        raise ValueError('Expected frozen angular service geometry')
    positions = np.array(view['positions'], dtype=float, copy=True)
    if positions.shape != (3, 2) or not np.isfinite(positions).all():
        raise ValueError('Invalid robot positions')
    tasks, states, initial, lefts, statuses = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
    left_endpoints, geometry_before = {}, {}
    def geometry(j, at):
        if j != target_id:
            return False
        roles = [r for _, r in members]
        return bool(validate_roles(2, roles, cfg) and all(
            np.linalg.norm(positions[i]-np.array(point(world, j, at))-offset(r, cfg)) <= radius(cfg)
            for i, r in members))
    for t in view['targets']:
        j = t['id']
        old = view['service_states'][j]
        if not isinstance(old, ServiceState) or old.progress >= t['service_duration']:
            raise ValueError('Invalid active clock')
        expected = tuple((i, a['role']) for i, a in enumerate(view['assignment']) if a['target'] == j)
        if old.team != expected:
            raise ValueError('Service history/assignment conflict')
        active_team = members if j == target_id else ()
        inherited = old.team == active_team
        state = old if inherited else replace(old, base=0., intervals=0, team=active_team)
        recorded = view['current_endpoints'][j]
        if expected:
            if (recorded is None or recorded['source'] != 'RECORDED_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT'
                    or recorded['tick'] != start or tuple(recorded['team']) != expected
                    or type(recorded['G']) is not bool or recorded['Q'] not in ('PASS', 'FAIL', 'UNKNOWN')
                    or recorded['Q'] != view['current_q'][j]):
                raise ValueError('Invalid recorded public endpoint')
            if old.progress > 0 and (not recorded['G'] or recorded['Q'] != 'PASS'):
                raise ValueError('Positive progress requires recorded G and Q PASS')
        elif recorded is not None or old.progress != 0:
            raise ValueError('Unassigned task has endpoint/progress')
        # P0 is the transaction inheritance/reset state, before endpoint failure.
        initial[j] = state
        p0 = state.progress
        if active_team and inherited:
            g = recorded['G']
            left = g and recorded['Q'] == 'PASS'
            left_endpoints[j] = dict(source='RECORDED_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT', tick=start,
                                     G=g, Q=recorded['Q'], service_valid=left)
        else:
            g = geometry(j, start)
            left = g
            left_endpoints[j] = dict(source='OPTIMISTIC_Q_PROXY', tick=start,
                                     G=g, Q='UNKNOWN', service_valid=left)
        geometry_before[j] = g
        if not left:
            state = replace(state, base=0., intervals=0)
        states[j], lefts[j], statuses[j] = state, left, 'active'
        tasks[j] = dict(P0=p0, Pmax=p0, NG=0, duration=t['service_duration'],
                        complete_team=j == target_id, completion_tick=None, stop_time=H*DT)
    effort = 0.
    for k in range(start+1, H+1):
        lo, hi = (k-1)*DT, k*DT
        for t in view['targets']:
            j = t['id']
            if statuses[j] != 'active':
                continue
            p = point(world, j, k-1)
            vx = world['motion'][j]['velocity'][0]
            escape = lo if p[0] >= cfg.side else lo+(cfg.side-p[0])/vx if vx > 0 else math.inf
            stop = min(hi, escape)
            elapsed = max(0., stop-lo)
            if j == target_id:
                for i, role in members:
                    u = command(view['beliefs'][j], k-1, [positions[i]], [role], cfg)[0]
                    positions[i] += u*elapsed
                    effort += float(np.sum(u*u))*elapsed
            if escape <= hi+TOL:
                statuses[j] = 'escaped'
                tasks[j]['stop_time'] = escape
                continue
            if j == target_id:
                right = geometry(j, k)
                # NG is geometry-only, independent of known initial Q failure.
                if geometry_before[j] and right:
                    tasks[j]['NG'] += 1
                states[j], done, _ = advance_clock(states[j], t['service_duration'], members,
                                                  lefts[j] and right, hi)
                tasks[j]['Pmax'] = max(tasks[j]['Pmax'], states[j].progress)
                lefts[j] = right
                geometry_before[j] = right
                if done:
                    statuses[j] = 'completed'
                    tasks[j].update(completion_tick=k, stop_time=hi)
    changed = sum(a != b for a, b in zip(actions, view['assignment']))
    columns, value = ledger(cfg, view['targets'], start, tasks, effort, changed)
    diagnostics = {}
    for t in view['targets']:
        j = t['id']
        p = point(world, j, start)
        vx = world['motion'][j]['velocity'][0]
        escape = start*DT if p[0] >= cfg.side else start*DT+(cfg.side-p[0])/vx if vx > 0 else math.inf
        diagnostics[j] = certificate(initial[j], t['service_duration'], start,
                                     complete_team=j == target_id, proven_escape_time=escape,
                                     premises_verified=True)
    return dict(proxy_role='OPTIMISTIC_Q_PROXY', assignment_key=assignment_key(actions),
                world_digest=world['world_digest'], tasks=tasks, ledger=columns, value=value,
                effort_integral=effort, certificates=diagnostics, positions=positions.tolist(),
                left_endpoints=left_endpoints)
