"""Thin adapter. Job lifecycle/termination/accounting remain in the certified core."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time
from .windows_job_monitor.supervisor import GateSupervisor,Budget,save_new


class JobPilotSupervisor:
    def __init__(self,out,total_limit=600.,cpu_limit=15.,wall_limit=60.,max_calls=260):
        self.out=Path(out);self.out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
        self.budget=Budget(total_limit);self.cpu_limit=cpu_limit;self.wall_limit=wall_limit
        self.max_calls=max_calls;self.records=[]
        self.journal=(self.out/'pilot_ledger.jsonl').open('x',encoding='utf-8')

    @property
    def total(self):return self.budget.used

    def run(self,source,index,method,budget,phase,repeat,*,synthetic=None,synthetic_cpu=.2,
            cpu_limit=None,wall_limit=None,allow_expected=False):
        if self.budget.exhausted():raise RuntimeError('Shared cumulative CPU budget exhausted before Job creation')
        if len(self.records)>=self.max_calls:raise RuntimeError('Frozen Pilot call cap reached')
        folder=self.out/f'call_{len(self.records):03d}'
        req=dict(kind='synthetic' if synthetic else 'solver',source=str(Path(source).resolve()),
                 index=index,method=method,budget=budget)
        if synthetic:req.update(synthetic=synthetic,synthetic_cpu=synthetic_cpu)
        # One core instance per invocation. Its 25s facility budget is redundant
        # to the stricter 15s Pilot limit; g9 is the SAME shared 600s live ledger.
        core=GateSupervisor(folder)
        try:
            raw=core.run(phase+'_'+str(index)+'_'+method,sys.executable,
                Path(__file__).with_name('resume_worker.py'),mode=json.dumps(req,sort_keys=True),cpu=0.,
                cpu_limit=self.cpu_limit if cpu_limit is None else cpu_limit,
                wall_limit=self.wall_limit if wall_limit is None else wall_limit,g9=self.budget)
        finally:core.close()
        record=dict(index=index,method=method,budget=budget,phase=phase,repeat=repeat,
            completed=raw.get('reason')=='completed',job_uuid=raw.get('uuid'),job_result=raw,
            worker_lifetime_cpu=raw.get('final_accounting',{}).get('cpu'),
            worker_wall=raw.get('wall'),total_worker_cpu=self.total,
            stop_reason='aggregate_cpu_limit' if raw.get('reason')=='g9_cpu_limit' else raw.get('reason'))
        result_file=Path(raw['folder'])/'solver_result.json'
        if record['completed']:
            result=json.loads(result_file.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
            memberships=[json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for p in Path(raw['folder']).glob('membership_*.json')]
            assert memberships and all(m['member'] for m in memberships)
            assert any(m['pid']==result['worker_pid'] for m in memberships)
            assert raw['final_accounting']['ActiveProcesses']==0 and raw['handles_closed'] and raw['cleanup_passed']
            assert result['solve_cpu_ns']/1e9<=record['worker_lifetime_cpu']+.05
            assert all(v['currsize']==0 for v in result['cold_caches'].values())
            record.update(result=result,membership=memberships,cpu_monitor_valid=True)
        self.records.append(record)
        self.journal.write(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n');self.journal.flush()
        if not record['completed'] and not allow_expected:raise RuntimeError('Pilot Job failed: '+str(record))
        return record

    def close(self):self.journal.close()


def integration_gate(out,source):
    out=Path(out);out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    definition=dict(max_jobs=8,job_total_cpu=20.,wall_limit=120.,supervisor_cpu=10.,poll=.05,
        cases=['parallel','timing','crash','cpu_limit','wall_limit','cumulative_up_to_3','reject_before_create'],
        single_cpu=4.,single_wall=15.,cpu_trigger=1.5,wall_trigger=1.,cumulative_limit=2.2,
        cpu_overshoot_max=.25,wall_overshoot_max=.2)
    save_new(out/'frozen_inputs.json',definition)
    sup=JobPilotSupervisor(out/'workers',total_limit=20.,cpu_limit=4.,wall_limit=15.,max_calls=8)
    wall=time.perf_counter();cpu=time.process_time();tests=[];audit_cpu=0.
    try:
        def run(name,**kw):
            if time.perf_counter()-wall>120 or time.process_time()-cpu>10:raise RuntimeError('R2 supervisory quota')
            return sup.run(source,0,'R2_SYNTHETIC',None,'R2_'+name,0,**kw)
        a=run('A',synthetic='parallel');assert len(a['membership'])==3;tests.append('A')
        b=run('B',synthetic='busy');assert b['worker_lifetime_cpu']>b['result']['solve_cpu_ns']/1e9
        before=time.process_time()
        while time.process_time()-before<.10:pass
        audit_cpu=time.process_time()-before;tests.append('B')
        c=run('C',synthetic='crash',allow_expected=True);assert c['stop_reason']=='abnormal_parent_exit';tests.append('C')
        d=run('D_cpu',synthetic='busy',synthetic_cpu=10.,cpu_limit=1.5,allow_expected=True)
        assert d['stop_reason']=='cpu_limit' and d['job_result']['cpu_overshoot']<=.25
        d=run('D_wall',synthetic='sleep',wall_limit=1.,allow_expected=True)
        assert d['stop_reason']=='wall_limit' and d['job_result']['wall_overshoot']<=.2;tests.append('D')
        # Use a fresh shared synthetic budget for E, never the Pilot 600s ledger.
        cumulative=JobPilotSupervisor(out/'cumulative',total_limit=2.2,cpu_limit=4.,wall_limit=15.,max_calls=3)
        try:
            for _ in range(3):
                row=cumulative.run(source,0,'R2_SYNTHETIC',None,'R2_E',0,synthetic='busy',synthetic_cpu=.8,allow_expected=True)
                if cumulative.budget.exhausted():break
            assert cumulative.budget.exhausted() and row['stop_reason']=='aggregate_cpu_limit'
            n=len(cumulative.records)
            try:cumulative.run(source,0,'R2_SYNTHETIC',None,'R2_E_refusal',0,synthetic='busy')
            except RuntimeError:pass
            else:raise AssertionError('R2 exhausted budget accepted')
            assert len(cumulative.records)==n
            tests.append('E')
        finally:cumulative.close()
        allrows=sup.records+cumulative.records
        for r in allrows:assert r['job_result']['cleanup_passed'] and r['job_result']['final_accounting']['ActiveProcesses']==0
        assert len(allrows)<=8 and sup.total+cumulative.total<=20.
        result=dict(passed=True,tests=tests,jobs=len(allrows),job_cpu=sup.total+cumulative.total,
            supervisor_cpu=time.process_time()-cpu,wall=time.perf_counter()-wall,external_audit_cpu=audit_cpu,
            pilot_quota_consumed=0,cumulative_rows=cumulative.budget.rows)
        assert result['supervisor_cpu']<=10 and result['wall']<=120
        save_new(out/'result.json',result);return result
    finally:sup.close()

def busy(seconds):
    start=time.process_time();value=1
    while time.process_time()-start<seconds:value=(value*1664525+1013904223)&0xffffffff
    return time.process_time()-start


def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--out',required=True);p.add_argument('--job',required=True)
    p.add_argument('--mode',required=True);p.add_argument('--cpu');args=p.parse_args()
    out=Path(args.out);req=json.loads(args.mode);api=API()

            audit=out/('audit_'+str(os.getpid()));(audit/'evidence/runtime_access').mkdir(parents=True)
            sitecustomize._root=str(audit)
    except ImportError:pass
    h=api.check(api.k.OpenJobObjectW(4,False,args.job),'OpenJobObjectW')
    try:member=api.member(api.k.GetCurrentProcess(),h)
    finally:api.close(h)

    save_new(out/f'membership_{os.getpid()}.json',dict(pid=os.getpid(),ppid=os.getppid(),member=member,kind=req['kind']))
    if req['kind']=='leaf':
        cpu=busy(req['cpu']);save_new(out/f'leaf_end_{os.getpid()}.json',dict(pid=os.getpid(),cpu=cpu));return
    from research.quality_allocation.service_m3_benchmarks import measure
    children=[];relations=[]

    def child(cpu):
        payload=json.dumps(dict(kind='leaf',cpu=cpu))
        proc=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-B',__file__,'--out',str(out),'--job',args.job,'--mode',payload])
        h=api.check(api.k.OpenJobObjectW(4,False,args.job),'OpenJobObjectW')
        try:included=api.member(proc._handle,h)
        finally:api.close(h)
        relations.append(dict(launcher_pid=proc.pid,parent_pid=os.getpid(),member=included));children.append(proc)
        if not included:raise RuntimeError('R2 child outside Job')
        return proc

    if req['kind']=='synthetic':
        busy(.05) # before measure.worker's unchanged solve clock
        def synthetic_solve(obs,method,budget):
            mode=req['synthetic'];start=time.process_time()
            if mode=='parallel':
                child(.10);child(.10);busy(.20)
                for c in children:
                    if c.wait()!=0:raise RuntimeError('R2 child failed')
            elif mode=='crash':
                child(10.)
                deadline=time.perf_counter()+4
                while len(list(out.glob('membership_*.json')))<2:
                    if time.perf_counter()>deadline:raise RuntimeError('R2 child not started')
                    time.sleep(.01)
                save_new(out/'abnormal_parent.json',dict(pid=os.getpid(),relations=relations));os._exit(7)

                actions=[],accuracy_met=True,stop_reason='synthetic_completed',relations=relations,
                synthetic_segment_cpu=time.process_time()-start)
        measure.solve=synthetic_solve # isolated child-only injection; no algorithm scoring invoked
    elif req['kind']!='solver':raise ValueError('Invalid payload kind')
    measure.worker(req['source'],req['index'],req['method'],req['budget'],out/'solver_result.json')
    if req['kind']=='synthetic':busy(.05)
    save_new(out/'worker_completed.json',dict(pid=os.getpid(),member=member,relations=relations))

# Isolated copy of validated shared evaluator: only constructor validation and trace changed.
from dataclasses import replace
from pursuit_v2 import observation_geometry as geometry
"""B: independent robot motion cache; joint timers and stopping remain candidate-specific."""
import numpy as np
from pursuit_v2.observation_geometry import offset as role_offset
from pursuit_v2.service import DT,TOL,ServiceState,ServiceRollout,canonical_team,advance_clock,tick
from research.quality_allocation.service_m3_angular.reference import benefit


class SharedEvaluator:
    def __init__(self,case,specs):
        from research.quality_allocation.service_m3_angular.domain import require_angular
        require_angular(case)
        self.case=case
        self.components={}
        self.control_substeps=0
        self.requests=[]
        self.cache_hits=0
        self.scope=(case.identity,geometry.identity(case.obs.config))
        self.specs={s.index:s for s in specs}

    def component(self,w,j,i,role):
        key=self.scope+(w,j,i,role)
        if key in self.components:
            self.cache_hits+=1
            return self.components[key]
        case=self.case; cfg=case.obs.config; path=case.path(w,j)
        first,last=tick(case.obs.time),tick(case.until)
        offset=role_offset(role,cfg)
        pos=case.obs.positions[i].copy()[None,:]
        positions=[pos[0].copy()]; valid=[]; commands=[]; squares=[]; speeds=[]; lengths=[]
        escape=path.escape_time(cfg.side)
        for n in range(first,last+1):
            at=n*DT
            valid.append(bool(np.linalg.norm(pos-path.position(at)-offset,axis=1)[0]<=geometry.radius(cfg)))
            if n==last:
                break
            lo,hi=n*DT,(n+1)*DT
            elapsed=max(0.,min(hi,escape)-lo)
            command=path.velocity_at(lo)+cfg.travel_gain*(path.position(lo)+offset-pos)
            speed=np.linalg.norm(command,axis=1)
            command*=np.minimum(1.,cfg.max_speed/np.maximum(speed,1e-15))[:,None]
            if escape<=lo+TOL:
                command[:]=0.; elapsed=0.
            else:
                self.control_substeps+=1
            positions.append((pos+command*elapsed)[0].copy())
            commands.append(command[0].copy()); squares.append((command**2)[0].copy())
            speeds.append(float(np.linalg.norm(command,axis=1)[0])); lengths.append(elapsed)
            pos+=command*elapsed
        result=dict(positions=np.array(positions),valid=np.array(valid),commands=np.array(commands),
                    squares=np.array(squares),speeds=np.array(speeds),lengths=np.array(lengths),
                    times=np.arange(first,last+1)*DT,escape=escape)
        self.components[key]=result
        return result

    def evaluate(self,specs):
        self.requests.append([s.index for s in specs])
        return {s.index:self.one(s) for s in specs}

    def one(self,spec):
        if self.specs.get(spec.index)!=spec: raise ValueError('Candidate identity mismatch')
        case=self.case; cfg=case.obs.config; rows=[]
        for w in range(len(case.worlds)):
            path=case.path(w,spec.target)
            parts=[self.component(w,spec.target,i,r) for i,r in zip(spec.robots,spec.roles)]
            positions=np.stack([p['positions'] for p in parts],axis=1)
            valid=np.all(np.stack([p['valid'] for p in parts],axis=1),axis=1)
            squares=np.ascontiguousarray(np.stack([p['squares'] for p in parts],axis=1))
            speeds=np.stack([p['speeds'] for p in parts],axis=1)
            team=canonical_team(zip(spec.robots,spec.roles))
            state=dict(case.obs.service_states)[spec.target]
            events=[]; frames=[]; effort=peak=0.; completion=escaped=None
            if state.team!=team:
                if state.progress>0:
                    events.append(dict(time=case.obs.time,reason='team_changed',progress_before=state.progress))
                state=replace(state,base=0.,intervals=0,team=team)
            escape=parts[0]['escape']
            reason='episode_end' if case.until>=cfg.end_time-TOL else 'horizon_truncated'
            if escape<=case.obs.time+TOL:
                escaped,reason=escape,'escaped'
            elif not valid[0] and state.progress>0:
                events.append(dict(time=case.obs.time,reason='observation_invalid',progress_before=state.progress))
                state=replace(state,base=0.,intervals=0,team=team)
            pos=positions[0].copy()

            def frame(at,ready,legal=True):
                pass  # Research timing excludes optional per-candidate diagnostic frames.

            frame(case.obs.time,valid[0] and escaped is None)
            first,last=tick(case.obs.time),tick(case.until)
            for k in range(last-first):
                hi=(first+k+1)*DT
                if completion is not None or escaped is not None:
                    frame(hi,False); continue
                pos=positions[k+1].copy()
                effort+=float(np.sum(squares[k]))*float(parts[0]['lengths'][k])
                peak=max(peak,float(speeds[k].max()))
                if escape<=hi+TOL:
                    escaped,reason=escape,'escaped'
                    if escape<hi-TOL:
                        frame(escape,False,False)
                    frame(hi,False); continue
                state,done,more=advance_clock(state,path.service_duration,team,bool(valid[k] and valid[k+1]),hi)
                events.extend(more)
                if done:
                    completion,reason=hi,'completed'
                frame(hi,valid[k+1])
            result=ServiceRollout(pos,state,completion,escaped,effort,peak,frames,events,reason)
            rows.append((result,benefit(case,path,completion,effort)))
        return rows

"""Offline, excluded from all measured solve CPU and Lazy query counts."""
from fractions import Fraction
from dataclasses import asdict
import math
import time

from pursuit_v2.service_m3 import make_service_m3_policy

def check_case(case,with_policy=False):
    specs=candidates(case); lightweight=SharedEvaluator(case,specs); old=OriginalShared(case)
    values=[]; world_scores=[]
    for s in specs:
        ref=evaluate(case,s); lean,_=independent(case,s)
        shared=lightweight.one(s); original=old.one(s)
        for a,b,c,d in zip(ref,lean,shared,original):
            assert a[1].hex()==b[1].hex()==c[1].hex()==d[1].hex(),(case.name,s.index,'score')
            for row in (b,c,d):
                assert a[0].completion_time==row[0].completion_time
                assert a[0].escape_time==row[0].escape_time
                assert a[0].effort.hex()==row[0].effort.hex()
                assert a[0].state==row[0].state
                assert np.array_equal(a[0].positions,row[0].positions)
                assert a[0].termination_reason==row[0].termination_reason
        values.append(mean_score(ref));world_scores.append([v for _,v in ref])
    loose,ld=all_bounds(case,specs,'L0'); clock,cd=all_bounds(case,specs,'L1')
    for s,v in zip(specs,values):
        assert v<=clock[s.index]<=loose[s.index]
        for w,value in enumerate(world_scores[s.index]):
            assert value<=cd[s.index][w]['value']<=ld[s.index][w]['value']
    upper=math.prod(1+math.perm(case.obs.config.robots,t.required_robots) for t in case.obs.targets)
    if upper>30000: raise RuntimeError('Independent Cartesian cap exceeded; no truncation')
    scores={s.key:Fraction.from_float(v) for s,v in zip(specs,values)}
    baseline=Fraction.from_float(float(physical_baseline(case))); fee=Fraction.from_float(case.obs.config.change_cost)
    optimum=None; legal=0
    # independent_plans builds combinations/permutations itself, never uses DP plans.
    for keys in independent_plans(case):
        actions=assignment(case,keys)
        cost=fee*sum(a!=b for a,b in zip(actions,case.obs.assignment))
        value=baseline+sum((scores[k] for k in keys),Fraction())-cost
        legal+=1
        if optimum is None or value>optimum: optimum=value
    for kind in ('L0','L1'):
        from .lazy import lazy
        for budget in (None,0,1,2):
            r=lazy(case,specs,budget=budget,bound_kind=kind)
            assert r['L']<=optimum<=r['U']
            selected=tuple(specs[i].key for i in r['selected'])
            actions=assignment(case,selected)
            actual=baseline+sum((scores[k] for k in selected),Fraction())-fee*sum(a!=b for a,b in zip(actions,case.obs.assignment))
            assert actual==r['L']
            assert all(r['known'][i] is not None for i in r['selected'])
            if budget is None: assert r['L']==r['U']==optimum
            if kind=='L1':
                orig=original_lazy(case,specs,budget=budget)
                for key in ('L','U','selected','exact','full_target_batches','partial_incumbents','requests'):
                    assert orig[key]==r[key],(case.name,key)
    if with_policy:
        for method in ('F0','F1','L0','L1'):
            r=solve(case.obs,method); assert r['L']==r['U']==optimum
        policy=make_service_m3_policy('M3_service_angular_v1').decide(case.obs)
        assert Fraction(policy.log['certificate']['L'])==optimum
    return dict(candidates=len(specs),world_candidate_pairs=len(specs)*len(case.worlds),
                cartesian_upper=upper,legal_plans=legal,Jstar=str(optimum),
                candidate_manifest=[dict(**asdict(s),mask=s.mask) for s in specs],
                candidate_manifest_sha256=digest([dict(**asdict(s),mask=s.mask) for s in specs]),
                world_manifest_sha256=digest([[p.to_dict() for p in w] for w in case.worlds]),
                values_hex=[v.hex() for v in values],passed=True)


def validate_main(rows):
    results=[]
    for row in rows:
        case=public_request(restore(row['observation']))
        assert len(candidates(case))==row['expected_candidates']
        result=check_case(case,with_policy=True); result['id']=row['id']; results.append(result)
        print('Correctness passed:',row['id'],flush=True)
    return results

"""Common request contract; independent/full/shared/lazy research adapters."""
import math
import time
from research.quality_allocation.service_m3_angular.worlds import public_request
from research.quality_allocation.service_m3_angular.model import candidates
from research.quality_allocation.service_m3_angular.reference import benefit, mean_score
from research.quality_allocation.service_m3_angular.additive import dp, assignment
from pursuit_v2.service import rollout_fixed_service, DT
from .shared import SharedEvaluator
from .lazy import lazy


def independent(case,spec):
    rows=[]; count=0
    for w in range(len(case.worlds)):
        path=case.path(w,spec.target)
        r=rollout_fixed_service(case.obs.config,path,case.obs.positions[list(spec.robots)],
            tuple(zip(spec.robots,spec.roles)),case.obs.time,case.until,
            dict(case.obs.service_states)[spec.target],trace=False)
        stop=r.completion_time if r.completion_time is not None else (
            r.escape_time if r.escape_time is not None else case.until)
        count+=max(0,math.ceil((stop-case.obs.time)/DT-1e-8))*len(spec.robots)
        rows.append((r,benefit(case,path,r.completion_time,r.effort)))
    return rows,count


def solve(obs,method,budget=None):
    if method not in ('F0','F1','L0','L1'): raise ValueError('Unknown mechanism')
    begin=time.process_time_ns(); case=public_request(obs); specs=candidates(case)
    setup=time.process_time_ns()-begin
    if method.startswith('L'):
        result=lazy(case,specs,budget=budget,bound_kind=method)
    else:
        if budget is not None: raise ValueError('Full evaluation has no batch budget')
        begin=time.process_time_ns(); count=0
        ev=SharedEvaluator(case,specs) if method=='F1' else None
        scores=[]
        for spec in specs:
            if ev: rows=ev.one(spec)
            else:
                rows,n=independent(case,spec); count+=n
            scores.append(mean_score(rows))
        eval_ns=time.process_time_ns()-begin
        begin=time.process_time_ns(); selected,L=dp(case,specs,scores)
        result=dict(selected=selected,L=L,U=L,known=scores,total=len(specs),exact=len(specs),
            components=len(ev.components) if ev else 0,component_cache_hits=ev.cache_hits if ev else 0,
            robot_control_substeps=ev.control_substeps if ev else count,dp_calls=1,
            full_target_batches=0,partial_incumbents=[],accuracy_met=True,stop_reason='accuracy',
            bound_cpu_ns=0,evaluation_cpu_ns=eval_ns,dp_cpu_ns=time.process_time_ns()-begin)
    actions=assignment(case,tuple(specs[i].key for i in result['selected']))
    result.update(method=method,setup_cpu_ns=setup,actions=[a.to_dict() for a in actions],
        observation_identity=case.observation_identity,request_identity=case.identity,
        dp_state_expansions='not_measured',candidate_count=len(specs),budget=budget)
    return result

=== FILE: research/quality_allocation/service_m3_benchmarks/windows_job_monitor/api.py ===
"""Explicit x64 Win32 ABI; no Job is created on import."""
import ctypes as C
from ctypes import wintypes as W
import os
import subprocess

SIZE=C.c_size_t
HANDLE=W.HANDLE
DWORD=W.DWORD
LARGE=C.c_int64


class Accounting(C.Structure):
    _fields_=[('TotalUserTime',LARGE),('TotalKernelTime',LARGE),
              ('ThisPeriodTotalUserTime',LARGE),('ThisPeriodTotalKernelTime',LARGE),
              ('TotalPageFaultCount',DWORD),('TotalProcesses',DWORD),
              ('ActiveProcesses',DWORD),('TotalTerminatedProcesses',DWORD)]


class BasicLimit(C.Structure):
    _fields_=[('PerProcessUserTimeLimit',LARGE),('PerJobUserTimeLimit',LARGE),
              ('LimitFlags',DWORD),('MinimumWorkingSetSize',SIZE),('MaximumWorkingSetSize',SIZE),
              ('ActiveProcessLimit',DWORD),('Affinity',SIZE),('PriorityClass',DWORD),('SchedulingClass',DWORD)]


class IO(C.Structure):
    _fields_=[(n,C.c_uint64) for n in ('ReadOperationCount','WriteOperationCount','OtherOperationCount',
                                    'ReadTransferCount','WriteTransferCount','OtherTransferCount')]


class ExtendedLimit(C.Structure):
    _fields_=[('BasicLimitInformation',BasicLimit),('IoInfo',IO),('ProcessMemoryLimit',SIZE),
              ('JobMemoryLimit',SIZE),('PeakProcessMemoryUsed',SIZE),('PeakJobMemoryUsed',SIZE)]


class Startup(C.Structure):
    _fields_=[('cb',DWORD),('lpReserved',W.LPWSTR),('lpDesktop',W.LPWSTR),('lpTitle',W.LPWSTR)]+[
        (n,DWORD) for n in ('dwX','dwY','dwXSize','dwYSize','dwXCountChars','dwYCountChars','dwFillAttribute','dwFlags')]+[
        ('wShowWindow',W.WORD),('cbReserved2',W.WORD),('lpReserved2',C.c_void_p),
        ('hStdInput',HANDLE),('hStdOutput',HANDLE),('hStdError',HANDLE)]


class StartupEx(C.Structure):
    _fields_=[('StartupInfo',Startup),('lpAttributeList',C.c_void_p)]


class ProcessInfo(C.Structure):
    _fields_=[('hProcess',HANDLE),('hThread',HANDLE),('dwProcessId',DWORD),('dwThreadId',DWORD)]


class Security(C.Structure):
    _fields_=[('nLength',DWORD),('lpSecurityDescriptor',C.c_void_p),('bInheritHandle',W.BOOL)]


def layout():
    values={x.__name__:C.sizeof(x) for x in (Accounting,BasicLimit,ExtendedLimit,Startup,StartupEx,ProcessInfo,Security)}
    if C.sizeof(C.c_void_p)!=8 or values!=dict(Accounting=48,BasicLimit=64,ExtendedLimit=144,
            Startup=104,StartupEx=112,ProcessInfo=24,Security=24):
        raise RuntimeError('Unsupported Win32 ABI layout: '+str(values))
    if Accounting.ActiveProcesses.offset!=40 or ExtendedLimit.IoInfo.offset!=64:
        raise RuntimeError('Invalid Win32 field offsets')
    return values


class API:
    def __init__(self):
        if os.name!='nt': raise RuntimeError('Windows only')
        layout(); self.k=C.WinDLL('kernel32',use_last_error=True);self.closed=[]
        signatures={
          'CreateJobObjectW':([C.c_void_p,W.LPCWSTR],HANDLE),
          'OpenJobObjectW':([DWORD,W.BOOL,W.LPCWSTR],HANDLE),
          'SetInformationJobObject':([HANDLE,C.c_int,C.c_void_p,DWORD],W.BOOL),
          'QueryInformationJobObject':([HANDLE,C.c_int,C.c_void_p,DWORD,C.c_void_p],W.BOOL),
          'IsProcessInJob':([HANDLE,HANDLE,C.POINTER(W.BOOL)],W.BOOL),
          'GetCurrentProcess':([],HANDLE),
          'InitializeProcThreadAttributeList':([C.c_void_p,DWORD,DWORD,C.POINTER(SIZE)],W.BOOL),
          'UpdateProcThreadAttribute':([C.c_void_p,DWORD,SIZE,C.c_void_p,SIZE,C.c_void_p,C.c_void_p],W.BOOL),
          'DeleteProcThreadAttributeList':([C.c_void_p],None),
          'CreateProcessW':([W.LPCWSTR,W.LPWSTR,C.c_void_p,C.c_void_p,W.BOOL,DWORD,C.c_void_p,W.LPCWSTR,C.c_void_p,C.POINTER(ProcessInfo)],W.BOOL),
          'ResumeThread':([HANDLE],DWORD),
          'TerminateJobObject':([HANDLE,W.UINT],W.BOOL),
          'TerminateProcess':([HANDLE,W.UINT],W.BOOL),
          'GetExitCodeProcess':([HANDLE,C.POINTER(DWORD)],W.BOOL),
          'WaitForSingleObject':([HANDLE,DWORD],DWORD),
          'OpenProcess':([DWORD,W.BOOL,DWORD],HANDLE),
          'CloseHandle':([HANDLE],W.BOOL),
          'CreateFileW':([W.LPCWSTR,DWORD,DWORD,C.c_void_p,DWORD,DWORD,HANDLE],HANDLE)}
        for n,(args,result) in signatures.items():
            fn=getattr(self.k,n);fn.argtypes=args;fn.restype=result

    def check(self,result,name):
        if not result:
            code=C.get_last_error();raise OSError(code,name+': '+C.FormatError(code))
        return result

    def close(self,handle):
        if handle:
            self.check(self.k.CloseHandle(handle),'CloseHandle');self.closed.append(int(handle))

    def job(self,name):
        h=self.check(self.k.CreateJobObjectW(None,name),'CreateJobObjectW')
        try:
            info=ExtendedLimit();info.BasicLimitInformation.LimitFlags=0x2000 # KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE only; no breakaway
            self.check(self.k.SetInformationJobObject(h,9,C.byref(info),C.sizeof(info)),'SetInformationJobObject')
            return h
        except BaseException:self.close(h);raise

    def member(self,process,job):
        b=W.BOOL();self.check(self.k.IsProcessInJob(process,job,C.byref(b)),'IsProcessInJob');return bool(b.value)

    def accounting(self,job):
        a=Accounting();self.check(self.k.QueryInformationJobObject(job,1,C.byref(a),C.sizeof(a),None),'QueryInformationJobObject')
        result={name:int(getattr(a,name)) for name,_ in a._fields_}
        result['cpu']=(a.TotalUserTime+a.TotalKernelTime)/1e7
        return result

    def pids(self,job):
        class PIDList(C.Structure):
            _fields_=[('assigned',DWORD),('count',DWORD),('ids',SIZE*128)]
        a=PIDList();self.check(self.k.QueryInformationJobObject(job,3,C.byref(a),C.sizeof(a),None),'QueryInformationJobObject/PIDs')
        if a.count>128:raise RuntimeError('Job PID list overflow')
        return [int(i) for i in a.ids[:a.count]]

    def exit_code(self,process):
        code=DWORD();self.check(self.k.GetExitCodeProcess(process,C.byref(code)),'GetExitCodeProcess');return int(code.value)

    def create(self,job,argv,cwd,env,log):
        """Atomic job-list association, suspended start, restricted inherited std handles."""
        handles=[]; attrs=None; initialized=False
        try:
            security=Security(C.sizeof(Security),None,True)
            for filename,access,disposition in [(str(log),0x40000000,1),('NUL',0x80000000,3)]:
                h=self.k.CreateFileW(filename,access,3,C.byref(security),disposition,0,None)
                if h==C.c_void_p(-1).value:self.check(False,'CreateFileW')
                handles.append(h)
            size=SIZE();self.k.InitializeProcThreadAttributeList(None,2,0,C.byref(size))
            if C.get_last_error()!=122:raise RuntimeError('Unexpected attribute-list sizing result')
            attrs=C.create_string_buffer(size.value)
            self.check(self.k.InitializeProcThreadAttributeList(attrs,2,0,C.byref(size)),'InitializeProcThreadAttributeList');initialized=True
            jobs=(HANDLE*1)(job); std=(HANDLE*2)(*handles)
            for key,value in [(0x2000D,jobs),(0x20002,std)]:
                self.check(self.k.UpdateProcThreadAttribute(attrs,0,key,value,C.sizeof(value),None,None),'UpdateProcThreadAttribute')
            startup=StartupEx();startup.StartupInfo.cb=C.sizeof(startup)
            startup.lpAttributeList=C.cast(attrs,C.c_void_p);startup.StartupInfo.dwFlags=0x100
            startup.StartupInfo.hStdOutput=handles[0];startup.StartupInfo.hStdError=handles[0];startup.StartupInfo.hStdInput=handles[1]
            pi=ProcessInfo();command=C.create_unicode_buffer(subprocess.list2cmdline(list(map(str,argv))))
            block=C.create_unicode_buffer('\0'.join(k+'='+v for k,v in sorted(env.items(),key=lambda x:x[0].upper()))+'\0\0')
            flags=0x80000|0x400|0x4|0x8000000 # EXTENDED_STARTUPINFO, unicode env, suspended, no window
            self.check(self.k.CreateProcessW(str(argv[0]),command,None,None,True,flags,block,str(cwd),C.byref(startup),C.byref(pi)),'CreateProcessW')
            return pi
        finally:
            if initialized:self.k.DeleteProcThreadAttributeList(attrs)
            for h in reversed(handles):self.close(h)

    def resume(self,thread):
        previous=self.k.ResumeThread(thread)
        if previous==0xffffffff:self.check(False,'ResumeThread')
        if previous!=1:raise RuntimeError('Unexpected initial suspend count: '+str(previous))

    def terminate(self,job):self.check(self.k.TerminateJobObject(job,99),'TerminateJobObject')

"""Frozen synthetic workloads only: busy/sleep/children/abnormal exit."""
import argparse
import ctypes
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]))
from research.quality_allocation.service_m3_benchmarks.windows_job_monitor.api import API


def save(path,value):
    with path.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:json.dump(value,f,indent=2)


def busy(cpu):
    start=time.process_time_ns();value=1
    while (time.process_time_ns()-start)/1e9<cpu:
        value=(value*1664525+1013904223)&0xffffffff
    return (time.process_time_ns()-start)/1e9


def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--out',required=True);p.add_argument('--job',required=True)
    p.add_argument('--mode',required=True);p.add_argument('--cpu',type=float,required=True);args=p.parse_args()
    out=Path(args.out);api=API();job=api.check(api.k.OpenJobObjectW(4,False,args.job),'OpenJobObjectW')
    # Query-only handle held while verifying identity; close before doing work.
    member=api.member(api.k.GetCurrentProcess(),job);api.close(job)
    if not member:raise RuntimeError('Synthetic interpreter outside expected Job')
    try:
        import sitecustomize
        if hasattr(sitecustomize,'_root'):
            audit=out/('audit_'+str(os.getpid()));(audit/'evidence/runtime_access').mkdir(parents=True)
            sitecustomize._root=str(audit)
    except ImportError:pass
    pid=os.getpid();save(out/f'start_{pid}.json',dict(pid=pid,ppid=os.getppid(),member=member,mode=args.mode))
    start=time.process_time_ns();children=[];relations=[];solver=0.

    def child(cpu,wait=False):
        cmd=[sys.executable,'-B',__file__,'--out',str(out),'--job',args.job,'--mode','leaf','--cpu',str(cpu)]
        proc=subprocess.Popen(cmd)
        h=api.check(api.k.OpenJobObjectW(4,False,args.job),'OpenJobObjectW')
        try:included=api.member(proc._handle,h)
        finally:api.close(h)
        relations.append(dict(parent_pid=pid,launcher_pid=proc.pid,member=included))
        if not included:raise RuntimeError('Child launcher outside Job')
        children.append(proc)
        if wait:proc.wait()
        return proc

    if args.mode in ('busy','leaf'):solver=busy(args.cpu)
    elif args.mode=='sleep':time.sleep(2.)
    elif args.mode=='parallel':
        child(.35);child(.35);solver=busy(.10)
        for proc in children:
            if proc.wait()!=0:raise RuntimeError('Synthetic child failed')
    elif args.mode=='short':
        for _ in range(3):
            if child(.25,True).returncode!=0:raise RuntimeError('Short child failed')
        solver=busy(.05)
    elif args.mode=='audit':
        busy(.10);solver=busy(.30);busy(.05)
    elif args.mode=='crash':
        proc=child(10.)
        # Ensure actual child interpreter has started before parent exits.
        until=time.perf_counter()+3.
        while len(list(out.glob('start_*.json')))<2:
            if time.perf_counter()>until:raise RuntimeError('Child startup acknowledgement timeout')
            time.sleep(.01)
        save(out/f'crash_{pid}.json',dict(pid=pid,relations=relations,expected_exit=7))
        os._exit(7)
    else:raise ValueError(args.mode)
    elapsed=(time.process_time_ns()-start)/1e9
    save(out/f'end_{pid}.json',dict(pid=pid,ppid=os.getppid(),member=member,process_internal_cpu=elapsed,
                                  solver_cpu=solver,relations=relations,completed=True))


if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Job lifecycle, live dual ledgers and append-only accounting. No M3 imports."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import time
import uuid
from .api import API


def save_new(path,value):
    with Path(path).open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:json.dump(value,f,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False)


class Budget:
    def __init__(self,limit):self.limit=limit;self.rows=()
    @property
    def used(self):return sum(r[1] for r in self.rows)
    def exhausted(self,current=0.):return self.used+current>=self.limit
    def charge(self,ident,cpu):
        if cpu<0 or any(r[0]==ident for r in self.rows):raise ValueError('Invalid or duplicate final charge')
        self.rows+=((ident,cpu),)


class GateSupervisor:
    def __init__(self,out,api=None):
        self.out=Path(out);self.out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
        self.api=api or API();self.budget=Budget(25.);self.attempts=0;self.results=[]
        self.wall_start=time.perf_counter();self.cpu_start=time.process_time()
        self.journal=(self.out/'job_creation_ledger.jsonl').open('x',encoding='utf-8')

    def event(self,value):self.journal.write(json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n');self.journal.flush()

    def guard(self,current=0.):
        if time.perf_counter()-self.wall_start>=180:return 'gate_wall_limit'
        if time.process_time()-self.cpu_start>=10:return 'supervisor_cpu_limit'
        if self.budget.exhausted(current):return 'gate_cpu_limit'
        return None

    def run(self,label,exe,load,*,mode='busy',cpu=.45,cpu_limit=4.,wall_limit=15.,g9=None,fault=None):
        refusal=self.guard() or ('g9_cpu_limit' if g9 and g9.exhausted() else None)
        if refusal:
            self.event(dict(event='request_rejected_before_create',label=label,reason=refusal,attempts=self.attempts))
            return dict(label=label,reason=refusal,rejected_before_create=True,created=False)
        if self.attempts>=13:raise RuntimeError('13 Job creation attempts exhausted')
        self.attempts+=1; ident=uuid.uuid4().hex; folder=self.out/ident;folder.mkdir()
        name='Local\\M3CpuGate_'+ident
        row=dict(label=label,uuid=ident,job_name=name,supervisor_pid=os.getpid(),folder=str(folder),
            mode=mode,requested_cpu=cpu,cpu_limit=cpu_limit,wall_limit=wall_limit,
            created=False,samples=[],reason=None,api_error=None,handles_closed=False,cleanup_passed=False)
        self.event(dict(event='job_create_attempt',label=label,uuid=ident,attempt=self.attempts))
        start=time.perf_counter();job=None;pi=None;final=None;seen=set();closed_start=len(self.api.closed)
        try:
            job=self.api.job(name);row['created']=True
            if self.api.member(self.api.k.GetCurrentProcess(),job):raise RuntimeError('Supervisor inside tested Job')
            row['supervisor_outside_job']=True
            argv=[str(exe),'-B',str(load),'--out',str(folder),'--job',name,'--mode',mode,'--cpu',str(cpu)]
            if fault=='create':argv[0]=str(folder/'nonexistent_interpreter.exe')
            row['argv']=argv
            env=dict(os.environ)
            # Base interpreter does not use the venv-specific startup audit shim.
            if Path(exe).parent.name.lower()!='scripts':env['PYTHONPATH']=str(Path.cwd())
            pi=self.api.create(job,argv,Path.cwd(),env,folder/'stdout_stderr.log')
            row['launcher_pid']=int(pi.dwProcessId);seen.add(int(pi.dwProcessId))
            row['launcher_member']=self.api.member(pi.hProcess,job)
            if not row['launcher_member']:raise RuntimeError('Launcher not associated at creation')
            if fault=='associated':row['reason']='injected_after_association';raise InterruptedError('Injected before ResumeThread')
            self.api.resume(pi.hThread);self.api.close(pi.hThread);pi.hThread=None
            previous=0.
            while True:
                a=self.api.accounting(job);pids=self.api.pids(job);seen.update(pids)
                elapsed=time.perf_counter()-start
                if a['cpu']<previous:raise RuntimeError('Nonmonotonic Job CPU')
                previous=a['cpu']
                row['samples'].append(dict(wall=elapsed,accounting=a,pids=pids,
                    gate_cpu=self.budget.used+a['cpu'],g9_cpu=g9.used+a['cpu'] if g9 else None))
                code=self.api.exit_code(pi.hProcess)
                reason=self.guard(a['cpu'])
                if not reason and g9 and g9.exhausted(a['cpu']):reason='g9_cpu_limit'
                if not reason and a['cpu']>=cpu_limit:reason='cpu_limit'
                if not reason and elapsed>=wall_limit:reason='wall_limit'
                if not reason and code not in (0,259):reason='abnormal_parent_exit'
                if reason:
                    row.update(reason=reason,trigger_cpu=a['cpu'],trigger_wall=elapsed,trigger_exit_code=code)
                    break
                if a['ActiveProcesses']==0:
                    row['reason']='completed';break
                time.sleep(.05)
        except Exception as e:
            row['api_error']=dict(type=type(e).__name__,message=str(e),win32_code=getattr(e,'errno',None))
            if row['reason'] is None:row['reason']='injected_create_failure' if fault=='create' and isinstance(e,OSError) and e.errno in (2,3) else 'api_failure'
        finally:
            try:
                if job:
                    terminate_start=time.perf_counter()
                    current=self.api.accounting(job)
                    if current['ActiveProcesses']:
                        row['termination_requested']=True;self.api.terminate(job)
                    else:row['termination_requested']=False
                    deadline=time.perf_counter()+5.
                    while True:
                        final=self.api.accounting(job)
                        if final['ActiveProcesses']==0:break
                        if time.perf_counter()>=deadline:raise RuntimeError('Job members did not exit within cleanup deadline')
                        time.sleep(.01)
                    row['termination_seconds']=time.perf_counter()-terminate_start
                    row['final_accounting']=final
                    if row['samples'] and final['cpu']<row['samples'][-1]['accounting']['cpu']:
                        raise RuntimeError('Final Job CPU decreased')
                    if pi:row['launcher_exit_code']=self.api.exit_code(pi.hProcess)
                    row['seen_pids']=sorted(seen)
                    # ActiveProcesses=0 is the authoritative group-wide check;
                    # also verify retained identities observed during this call.
                    residual=[]
                    for pid in sorted(seen):
                        handle=self.api.k.OpenProcess(0x100000,False,pid)
                        if not handle:
                            import ctypes
                            error=ctypes.get_last_error()
                            if error!=87:raise OSError(error,'OpenProcess cleanup check')
                        else:
                            try:
                                # Job active count may reach zero slightly before
                                # the kernel process object becomes signaled.
                                remaining=max(0,int((deadline-time.perf_counter())*1000))
                                if self.api.k.WaitForSingleObject(handle,remaining)!=0:residual.append(pid)
                            finally:self.api.close(handle)
                    row['residual_pids']=residual
                    if residual:raise RuntimeError('Residual test PIDs')
                    row['termination_seconds']=time.perf_counter()-terminate_start
                    self.budget.charge(ident,final['cpu'])
                    if g9:g9.charge(ident,final['cpu'])
                    self.event(dict(event='final_cpu_charge',uuid=ident,cpu=final['cpu'],gate_used=self.budget.used,
                                    g9_used=g9.used if g9 else None,active=final['ActiveProcesses']))
                    row['final_charge_before_job_close']=True
                    row['cleanup_passed']=True
            except Exception as e:
                row['cleanup_error']=repr(e);row['cleanup_passed']=False
            finally:
                for handle in ([pi.hThread,pi.hProcess] if pi else []):
                    if handle:self.api.close(handle)
                if job:self.api.close(job)
                row['handles_closed']=True;row['closed_handle_values']=self.api.closed[closed_start:]
                row['wall']=time.perf_counter()-start
                if final:
                    row['cpu_overshoot']=max(0.,final['cpu']-cpu_limit)
                    row['wall_overshoot']=max(0.,row['wall']-wall_limit) if row['reason']=='wall_limit' else 0.
                    row['cpu_after_trigger']=final['cpu']-row.get('trigger_cpu',final['cpu'])
                self.results.append(row);save_new(folder/'result.json',row)
        if not row['cleanup_passed']:raise RuntimeError('Job cleanup failed: '+str(row))
        return row

    def close(self):self.journal.close()

=== FILE: research/quality_allocation/service_migration/additive.py ===
"""C: exact dyadic table optimization and independently generated joint choices."""
from fractions import Fraction
from itertools import combinations, product

from pursuit_v2.types import Assignment,IDLE
from research.quality_allocation.certified_solver import solve,SCALE
from .reference import physical_baseline

Q = Fraction.from_float


def independent_plans(case):
    from .domain import require_legacy
    require_legacy(case)
    """No candidate generator/DP outputs define this Cartesian search space."""
    choices=[]
    for target in case.obs.targets:
        options=[None]
        for group in combinations(range(case.obs.config.robots),target.required_robots):
            rolesets=[('center',)] if target.required_robots==1 else [('upper','lower'),('lower','upper')]
            options.extend((target.id,group,roles) for roles in rolesets)
        choices.append(options)
    for plan in product(*choices):
        selected=tuple(c for c in plan if c is not None)
        identities=[i for _,robots,_ in selected for i in robots]
        if len(identities)==len(set(identities)):
            yield selected


def assignment(case, keys):
    from .domain import require_legacy
    require_legacy(case)
    actions=[IDLE]*case.obs.config.robots
    for target,robots,roles in keys:
        for i,r in zip(robots,roles):
            if actions[i]!=IDLE:
                raise ValueError('Conflicting robots')
            actions[i]=Assignment(target,r)
    return tuple(actions)


def table_value(case, keys, scores):
    from .domain import require_legacy
    require_legacy(case)
    actions=assignment(case,keys)
    changes=sum(a!=b for a,b in zip(actions,case.obs.assignment))
    return Q(float(physical_baseline(case)))+sum((Q(float(scores[k])) for k in keys),Fraction())-Q(case.obs.config.change_cost)*changes


def enumerate_optimum(case, specs, values):
    from .domain import require_legacy
    require_legacy(case)
    scores={s.key:v for s,v in zip(specs,values)}
    rows=[]
    for keys in independent_plans(case):
        rows.append((keys,table_value(case,keys,scores)))
    keys,value=max(rows,key=lambda r:r[1])
    return keys,value,rows


def dp(case,specs,values):
    from .domain import require_legacy
    require_legacy(case)
    selected,units=solve(case.obs,specs,values)
    value=Q(float(physical_baseline(case)))+Fraction(units,SCALE)
    return selected,value

=== FILE: research/quality_allocation/service_migration/bounds.py ===
"""D: optimistic service clock + zero effort, not the old capture bound.

For finite operations and nonnegative O weights: all-valid service from the
eligible initial clock cannot finish later than an actual interrupted clock.
Completion benefits decrease with completion time; failed completion has only
nonpositive control cost. The SAME binary64 expression is used for optimistic
and evaluated scores, composed of monotone operations. A nextafter is outward
display/storage protection, not an empirical additive margin. This is not a
universal floating-point/geometry program proof.
"""
import math
import numpy as np
from pursuit_v2.service import ServiceState,advance_clock,canonical_team,tick,DT,TOL
from pursuit_v2.types import role_offset
from .reference import benefit


def world_bound(case,spec,w):
    from .domain import require_legacy
    require_legacy(case)
    path=case.path(w,spec.target); cfg=case.obs.config
    team=canonical_team(zip(spec.robots,spec.roles))
    state=dict(case.obs.service_states)[spec.target]
    offsets=np.array([role_offset(r,cfg) for r in spec.roles])
    pos=case.obs.positions[list(spec.robots)]
    valid=bool(np.all(np.linalg.norm(pos-path.position(case.obs.time)-offsets,axis=1)<=cfg.capture_radius+TOL))
    inherited=state.team==team and valid
    if not inherited:
        state=ServiceState(team=team)
    eligible=state.progress
    earliest=None
    for n in range(tick(case.obs.time)+1,tick(case.until)+1):
        state,done,_=advance_clock(state,path.service_duration,team,True,n*DT)
        if done:
            earliest=n*DT
            break
    escape=path.escape_time(cfg.side)
    possible=earliest is not None and escape>earliest+TOL
    # No completion: B=-nonnegative control cost <=0, not identically zero.
    optimistic=benefit(case,path,earliest,0.) if possible else 0.
    upper=math.nextafter(max(0.,optimistic),math.inf) if optimistic>0 else 0.
    if not math.isfinite(upper):
        raise ArithmeticError('Non-finite bound: outside finite gate contract')
    return dict(value=upper,eligible_progress=eligible,inherited=inherited,
                earliest=earliest,completion_branch_possible=possible,
                failure_branch_upper=0.,escape=escape if math.isfinite(escape) else None)


def all_bounds(case,specs):
    from .domain import require_legacy
    require_legacy(case)
    details={s.index:[world_bound(case,s,w) for w in range(len(case.worlds))] for s in specs}
    values=[]
    for s in specs:
        average=sum(row['value'] for row in details[s.index])/len(case.worlds)
        values.append(math.nextafter(average,math.inf) if average>0 else 0.)
    return values,details

=== FILE: research/quality_allocation/service_migration/domain.py ===
"""The migration gate is certified only for its original legacy domain."""
def require_legacy(case):
    cfg = case.obs.config
    if (cfg.geometry_mode != 'legacy_anchor' or cfg.capture_mode != 'stepwise_service'
            or any(t.required_robots not in (1, 2) for t in case.obs.targets)):
        raise ValueError('Migration gate not adapted to new observation geometry')

=== FILE: research/quality_allocation/service_migration/fixtures.py ===
"""Versioned, hand-specified fixtures. No seed search or result-driven tuning."""
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict, replace
from itertools import combinations, permutations
import hashlib
import json
import numpy as np

from pursuit_v2.config import Config
from pursuit_v2.types import Target, Observation, Assignment, IDLE
from pursuit_v2.service import ServiceState


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Spec:
    index: int
    target: int
    robots: tuple
    roles: tuple

    @property
    def mask(self):
        return sum(1 << i for i in self.robots)

    @property
    def key(self):
        return self.target, self.robots, self.roles


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Case:
    name: str
    obs: Observation
    until: float
    worlds: tuple  # each world is a tuple of predicted Target paths
    expectation: str = 'audit'

    def path(self, world, target):
        return next(t for t in self.worlds[world] if t.id == target)

    def payload(self):
        return dict(name=self.name, config=self.obs.config.to_dict(), start=self.obs.time,
                    until=self.until, positions=self.obs.positions.tolist(),
                    public_targets=[t.to_dict() for t in self.obs.targets],
                    assignment=[a.to_dict() for a in self.obs.assignment],
                    service_states=[(j, asdict(s)) for j, s in self.obs.service_states],
                    worlds=[[t.to_dict() for t in world] for world in self.worlds],
                    expectation=self.expectation)

    @property
    def identity(self):
        return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(self.payload(), sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False).encode()).hexdigest()


def candidates(case):
    from .domain import require_legacy
    require_legacy(case)
    assert all(not t.arc_rates and not t.turns for t in case.obs.targets), 'Private future in public input'
    specs = []
    for target in case.obs.targets:
        roles = ('center',) if target.required_robots == 1 else ('upper', 'lower')
        for robots in combinations(range(case.obs.config.robots), target.required_robots):
            for assignment in permutations(roles):
                specs.append(Spec(len(specs), target.id, robots, assignment))
    return specs


def make_case(name, robots, task_rows, positions, start=0., until=3.,
              states=(), old=None, rates=(0.,), expectation='audit', speed_max=.8):
    cfg = Config(robots=robots, task_count=len(task_rows), side=20., max_stages=2,
                 capture_mode='stepwise_service', target_speed_max=speed_max)
    worlds = []
    for rate in rates:
        world = []
        for j, (xy, velocity, q, weight, duration) in enumerate(task_rows):
            world.append(Target(j, 0., xy, velocity, q, weight, 4.,
                                arc_rates=((start if start else 1., rate), (6., 0.)),
                                service_duration=duration))
        worlds.append(tuple(world))
    pos = np.array(positions, float)
    pos.setflags(write=False)
    public = tuple(t.observed(start) for t in worlds[0])
    obs = Observation(cfg, int(start//cfg.stage_dt), pos, public,
                      tuple(old) if old else (IDLE,)*robots, (), (), start,
                      tuple(states) if states else tuple((t.id, ServiceState()) for t in public))
    assert all(s.progress <= start-t.birth+1e-10 for t in public for j,s in obs.service_states if j==t.id)
    for world in worlds:
        for path, observed in zip(world, public):
            np.testing.assert_allclose(path.position(start), observed.position(start), atol=1e-12)
            np.testing.assert_allclose(path.velocity_at(start), observed.velocity_at(start), atol=1e-12)
    return Case(name, obs, until, tuple(worlds), expectation)

        make_case('pair_shared_v1', 4,

def clock_boundary_cases():
    base=frozen_cases()[1]
    result=[]
    for duration in (5e-11,.10000000005,.1000000002,.12):
        worlds=tuple(tuple(replace(t,service_duration=duration) for t in world) for world in base.worlds)
        obs=replace(base.obs,targets=tuple(t.observed(base.obs.time) for t in worlds[0]))
        result.append(replace(base,name=f'boundary_H_{duration}',worlds=worlds,obs=obs,expectation='boundary'))
    return tuple(result)

=== FILE: research/quality_allocation/service_migration/lazy_gate.py ===
"""Research-only target-batch lazy gate. No offline reference score input/cache."""
from fractions import Fraction
from .shared import SharedEvaluator
from .reference import mean_score
from .additive import dp
from .bounds import all_bounds


def lazy(case,specs,epsilon=0.):
    from .domain import require_legacy
    require_legacy(case)
    if epsilon<0:
        raise ValueError('Negative quality gap')
    upper_values,detail=all_bounds(case,specs)
    known=[None]*len(specs)
    evaluator=SharedEvaluator(case)
    requests=[]; partial=[]; complete=set(); history=[]
    dp_calls=0

    def refine(j,indices,kind):
        batch=[specs[i] for i in indices if known[i] is None]
        if not batch:
            return
        rows=evaluator.evaluate(batch)
        for spec in batch:
            value=mean_score(rows[spec.index])
            if value>upper_values[spec.index]:
                raise ArithmeticError('Service upper bound violated during lazy evaluation')
            known[spec.index]=value
        requests.append(dict(target=j,kind=kind,candidates=[s.index for s in batch]))
        if kind=='incumbent':
            partial.extend(s.index for s in batch)
        if all(known[s.index] is not None for s in specs if s.target==j):
            complete.add(j)

    for spec in specs:
        if all(case.obs.assignment[i].target==spec.target and case.obs.assignment[i].role==r
               for i,r in zip(spec.robots,spec.roles)):
            refine(spec.target,[spec.index],'incumbent')
    previous_upper=None
    for _ in range(len(specs)+1):
        optimistic=[v if v is not None else upper_values[i] for i,v in enumerate(known)]
        upper_plan,U=dp(case,specs,optimistic)
        selected,L=dp(case,specs,known)
        dp_calls+=2
        U=U if previous_upper is None else min(previous_upper,U)
        if U<L:
            raise ArithmeticError('Inverted service certificate')
        history.append(dict(L=str(L),U=str(U),gap=str(U-L),exact=sum(v is not None for v in known)))
        previous_upper=U
        if U-L<=Fraction.from_float(float(epsilon)):
            break
        pending=sorted({specs[i].target for i in upper_plan if known[i] is None})
        if not pending:
            raise ArithmeticError('No refinable optimistic candidate')
        for j in pending[:1]:
            refine(j,[s.index for s in specs if s.target==j],'target_batch')
    else:
        raise ArithmeticError('Lazy did not terminate')
    return dict(selected=selected,L=L,U=U,history=history,exact=sum(v is not None for v in known),
                total=len(specs),full_targets=sorted(complete),partial_incumbents=partial,
                requests=requests,components=len(evaluator.components),
                robot_control_substeps=evaluator.control_substeps,dp_calls=dp_calls,
                stop_reason='accuracy',known=known,bounds=upper_values,bound_details=detail)

=== FILE: research/quality_allocation/service_migration/reference.py ===
"""A: full service rollout and O-accounting, separate from old capture reward."""
import numpy as np
from pursuit_v2.service import rollout_fixed_service


def stop_without_service(case, path):
    from .domain import require_legacy
    require_legacy(case)
    return min(case.until, path.escape_time(case.obs.config.side))


def unattended(case, path):
    from .domain import require_legacy
    require_legacy(case)
    cfg, start = case.obs.config, case.obs.time
    stop = stop_without_service(case, path)
    flow = -cfg.flow_weight*path.weight*max(0.,stop-max(start,path.birth))/(cfg.weight_reference*cfg.stage_dt)
    late = -cfg.late_weight*path.weight*max(0.,stop-max(start,path.birth,path.deadline))/(cfg.weight_reference*cfg.stage_dt)
    terminal = -cfg.unfinished_weight*path.weight/cfg.weight_reference if case.until >= cfg.end_time-1e-10 else 0.
    return float(flow+late+terminal)


def benefit(case, path, completion, effort):
    from .domain import require_legacy
    require_legacy(case)
    """Fixed binary64 operation order; monotone positive completion terms minus cost."""
    cfg, start = case.obs.config, case.obs.time
    bar = stop_without_service(case,path)
    success = completion is not None
    stop = completion if success else bar
    finish = path.weight/cfg.weight_reference if success else 0.
    flow = cfg.flow_weight*path.weight*max(0.,bar-stop)/(cfg.weight_reference*cfg.stage_dt)
    origin = max(start,path.birth,path.deadline)
    late = cfg.late_weight*path.weight*(max(0.,bar-origin)-max(0.,stop-origin))/(cfg.weight_reference*cfg.stage_dt)
    terminal = cfg.unfinished_weight*path.weight/cfg.weight_reference if success and case.until >= cfg.end_time-1e-10 else 0.
    control = cfg.control_weight*effort/cfg.effort_reference
    return float(((finish+flow)+late)+terminal-control)


def physical_baseline(case):
    from .domain import require_legacy
    require_legacy(case)
    return sum(sum(unattended(case,p) for p in world) for world in case.worlds)/len(case.worlds)


def evaluate(case, spec):
    from .domain import require_legacy
    require_legacy(case)
    states = dict(case.obs.service_states)
    rows = []
    for w in range(len(case.worlds)):
        path = case.path(w,spec.target)
        result = rollout_fixed_service(case.obs.config,path,
                    case.obs.positions[list(spec.robots)], tuple(zip(spec.robots,spec.roles)),
                    case.obs.time,case.until,states[spec.target])
        rows.append((result,benefit(case,path,result.completion_time,result.effort)))
    return rows


def mean_score(rows):
    return sum(score for _,score in rows)/len(rows)


def environment_value(case, selected, trace=False):
    from .domain import require_legacy
    require_legacy(case)
    """Run frozen actions in actual 2A-1 environments, including the empty baseline."""
    from pursuit_v2.environment import Environment,TimedEnvironment
    from pursuit_v2.types import Scenario,Assignment,IDLE
    values = []
    traces = []
    for world in case.worlds:
        cfg = case.obs.config
        cls = TimedEnvironment if cfg.motion_model=='continuous_turn' or cfg.turn_max_angle>0 else Environment
        env = cls(cfg,Scenario(case.obs.positions,world))
        if isinstance(env,TimedEnvironment):
            env._time=case.obs.time
        env.stage=case.obs.stage
        env.last_assignment=case.obs.assignment
        env._service_states=list(dict(case.obs.service_states)[j] for j in range(cfg.task_count))
        env.service_progress[:]=[s.progress for s in env._service_states]
        env.service_team=[s.team for s in env._service_states]
        actions=[IDLE]*cfg.robots
        for spec in selected:
            for i,r in zip(spec.robots,spec.roles): actions[i]=Assignment(spec.target,r)
        rows=[]
        while env.time < case.until-1e-10:
            live=tuple(a if a.target in env.active_ids else IDLE for a in actions)
            result=env.step(live,trace=trace)
            rows.append(result.info)
        values.append(env.total_reward-env.total_change_cost)
        traces.append(rows)
    return sum(values)/len(values),traces

=== FILE: research/quality_allocation/service_migration/shared.py ===
"""B: independent robot motion cache; joint timers and stopping remain candidate-specific."""
import numpy as np
from pursuit_v2.types import role_offset
from pursuit_v2.service import DT,TOL,ServiceState,ServiceRollout,canonical_team,advance_clock,tick
from .reference import benefit


class SharedEvaluator:
    def __init__(self,case):
        from .domain import require_legacy
        require_legacy(case)
        self.case=case
        self.components={}
        self.control_substeps=0
        self.requests=[]

    def component(self,w,j,i,role):
        key=(w,j,i,role)
        if key in self.components:
            return self.components[key]
        case=self.case; cfg=case.obs.config; path=case.path(w,j)
        first,last=tick(case.obs.time),tick(case.until)
        offset=role_offset(role,cfg)
        pos=case.obs.positions[i].copy()[None,:]
        positions=[pos[0].copy()]; valid=[]; commands=[]; squares=[]; speeds=[]; lengths=[]
        escape=path.escape_time(cfg.side)
        for n in range(first,last+1):
            at=n*DT
            valid.append(bool(np.linalg.norm(pos-path.position(at)-offset,axis=1)[0]<=cfg.capture_radius+TOL))
            if n==last:
                break
            lo,hi=n*DT,(n+1)*DT
            elapsed=max(0.,min(hi,escape)-lo)
            command=path.velocity_at(lo)+cfg.travel_gain*(path.position(lo)+offset-pos)
            speed=np.linalg.norm(command,axis=1)
            command*=np.minimum(1.,cfg.max_speed/np.maximum(speed,1e-15))[:,None]
            if escape<=lo+TOL:
                command[:]=0.; elapsed=0.
            else:
                self.control_substeps+=1
            positions.append((pos+command*elapsed)[0].copy())
            commands.append(command[0].copy()); squares.append((command**2)[0].copy())
            speeds.append(float(np.linalg.norm(command,axis=1)[0])); lengths.append(elapsed)
            pos+=command*elapsed
        result=dict(positions=np.array(positions),valid=np.array(valid),commands=np.array(commands),
                    squares=np.array(squares),speeds=np.array(speeds),lengths=np.array(lengths),
                    times=np.arange(first,last+1)*DT,escape=escape)
        self.components[key]=result
        return result

    def evaluate(self,specs):
        self.requests.append([s.index for s in specs])
        return {s.index:self.one(s) for s in specs}

    def one(self,spec):
        case=self.case; cfg=case.obs.config; rows=[]
        for w in range(len(case.worlds)):
            path=case.path(w,spec.target)
            parts=[self.component(w,spec.target,i,r) for i,r in zip(spec.robots,spec.roles)]
            positions=np.stack([p['positions'] for p in parts],axis=1)
            valid=np.all(np.stack([p['valid'] for p in parts],axis=1),axis=1)
            squares=np.ascontiguousarray(np.stack([p['squares'] for p in parts],axis=1))
            speeds=np.stack([p['speeds'] for p in parts],axis=1)
            team=canonical_team(zip(spec.robots,spec.roles))
            state=dict(case.obs.service_states)[spec.target]
            events=[]; frames=[]; effort=peak=0.; completion=escaped=None
            if state.team!=team:
                if state.progress>0:
                    events.append(dict(time=case.obs.time,reason='team_changed',progress_before=state.progress))
                state=ServiceState(team=team)
            escape=parts[0]['escape']
            reason='episode_end' if case.until>=cfg.end_time-TOL else 'horizon_truncated'
            if escape<=case.obs.time+TOL:
                escaped,reason=escape,'escaped'
            elif not valid[0] and state.progress>0:
                events.append(dict(time=case.obs.time,reason='observation_invalid',progress_before=state.progress))
                state=ServiceState(team=team)
            pos=positions[0].copy()

            def frame(at,ready,legal=True):
                frames.append(dict(time=at,positions=pos.tolist(),valid=bool(ready),
                                   progress=min(path.service_duration,state.progress),effort=effort,legal_check=legal))

            frame(case.obs.time,valid[0] and escaped is None)
            first,last=tick(case.obs.time),tick(case.until)
            for k in range(last-first):
                hi=(first+k+1)*DT
                if completion is not None or escaped is not None:
                    frame(hi,False); continue
                pos=positions[k+1].copy()
                effort+=float(np.sum(squares[k]))*float(parts[0]['lengths'][k])
                peak=max(peak,float(speeds[k].max()))
                if escape<=hi+TOL:
                    escaped,reason=escape,'escaped'
                    if escape<hi-TOL:
                        frame(escape,False,False)
                    frame(hi,False); continue
                state,done,more=advance_clock(state,path.service_duration,team,bool(valid[k] and valid[k+1]),hi)
                events.extend(more)
                if done:
                    completion,reason=hi,'completed'
                frame(hi,valid[k+1])
            result=ServiceRollout(pos,state,completion,escaped,effort,peak,frames,events,reason)
            rows.append((result,benefit(case,path,completion,effort)))
        return rows

=== FILE: research/quality_allocation/service_migration/validation.py ===
"""Ordered A/B/C/D audits. Later gates execute only after earlier assertions pass."""
from dataclasses import asdict
from fractions import Fraction
import numpy as np
from pursuit_v2.types import role_offset
from pursuit_v2.service import DT,TOL,tick
from .fixtures import candidates
from .reference import evaluate,mean_score,environment_value,physical_baseline
from .additive import independent_plans,table_value,enumerate_optimum,dp,Q
from .shared import SharedEvaluator
from .bounds import all_bounds
from .lazy_gate import lazy


def audit_a(cases):
    output=[]; references={}
    for case in cases:
        specs=candidates(case)
        rows={s.index:evaluate(case,s) for s in specs}
        scores={s.key:mean_score(rows[s.index]) for s in specs}
        by_key={s.key:s for s in specs}
        plans=[]; max_difference=0.
        for keys in independent_plans(case):
            predicted=table_value(case,keys,scores)
            actual,traces=environment_value(case,[by_key[k] for k in keys])
            difference=abs(float(predicted)-actual)
            assert difference<=1e-12,(case.name,keys,actual,float(predicted),difference)
            max_difference=max(max_difference,difference)
            plans.append(dict(keys=keys,table_value=str(predicted),environment_value=actual,
                              absolute_difference=difference,environment_steps=traces))
        references[case.name]=(specs,rows)
        output.append(dict(case=case.name,input_sha256=case.identity,baseline=physical_baseline(case),
                           max_accounting_difference=max_difference,legal_plans=len(plans),plans=plans,
                           candidates=[dict(spec=asdict(s),initial_state=asdict(dict(case.obs.service_states)[s.target]),
                                            world_id=case.identity,world_scores=[v for _,v in rows[s.index]],
                                            mean_score=scores[s.key],rollouts=[asdict(r) for r,_ in rows[s.index]])
                                       for s in specs]))
    return output,references


def audit_b(cases,references):
    output=[]
    for case in cases:
        specs,ref=references[case.name]
        evaluator=SharedEvaluator(case)
        shared=evaluator.evaluate(specs)
        differences=[]; completion_groups={}
        for spec in specs:
            for w,((actual,value),(expected,ref_value)) in enumerate(zip(shared[spec.index],ref[spec.index])):
                assert actual.completion_time==expected.completion_time
                assert actual.escape_time==expected.escape_time
                assert actual.state==expected.state
                assert actual.termination_reason==expected.termination_reason
                assert actual.interruptions==expected.interruptions
                assert len(actual.frames)==len(expected.frames)
                assert value==ref_value,(case.name,spec.index,w,'binary64 score mismatch',value,ref_value)
                max_position=max_energy=max_command=0.
                for a,b in zip(actual.frames,expected.frames):
                    assert (a['time'],a['valid'],a['legal_check'])==(b['time'],b['valid'],b['legal_check'])
                    assert a['progress']==b['progress']
                    max_position=max(max_position,float(np.max(np.abs(np.array(a['positions'])-b['positions']))))
                    max_energy=max(max_energy,abs(a['effort']-b['effort']))
                    if not b['legal_check']:
                        continue
                    stop=expected.completion_time if expected.completion_time is not None else expected.escape_time
                    at=b['time']
                    if at>=case.until-TOL or (stop is not None and at>=stop-TOL):
                        continue
                    path=case.path(w,spec.target)
                    pos=np.array(b['positions'])
                    offsets=np.array([role_offset(r,case.obs.config) for r in spec.roles])
                    command=path.velocity_at(at)+case.obs.config.travel_gain*(path.position(at)+offsets-pos)
                    speed=np.linalg.norm(command,axis=1)
                    command*=np.minimum(1.,case.obs.config.max_speed/np.maximum(speed,1e-15))[:,None]
                    k=tick(at)-tick(case.obs.time)
                    rebuilt=np.stack([evaluator.components[(w,spec.target,i,r)]['commands'][k]
                                      for i,r in zip(spec.robots,spec.roles)])
                    max_command=max(max_command,float(np.max(np.abs(command-rebuilt))))
                assert max(max_position,max_energy,max_command)<=1e-12
                differences.append(dict(candidate=spec.index,world=w,max_position=max_position,
                                        max_energy=max_energy,max_command=max_command,score_bitwise_equal=True))
                if actual.completion_time is not None:
                    for i,r in zip(spec.robots,spec.roles):
                        completion_groups.setdefault((w,spec.target,i,r),set()).add(actual.completion_time)
        varied=[dict(component=key,completion_times=sorted(v)) for key,v in completion_groups.items() if len(v)>1]
        output.append(dict(case=case.name,input_sha256=case.identity,comparisons=differences,
                           components=len(evaluator.components),robot_control_substeps=evaluator.control_substeps,
                           components_used_with_different_completion_times=varied,
                           component_data=[dict(key=k,**v) for k,v in evaluator.components.items()]))
    assert any(r['components_used_with_different_completion_times'] for r in output), 'No differing stop-prefix witness'
    return output


def audit_c(cases,references):
    output=[]; optima={}
    for case in cases:
        specs,rows=references[case.name]
        scores=[mean_score(rows[s.index]) for s in specs]
        keys,optimum,plans=enumerate_optimum(case,specs,scores)
        selected,solved=dp(case,specs,scores)
        assert solved==optimum
        chosen=tuple(specs[i].key for i in selected)
        mapping={s.key:v for s,v in zip(specs,scores)}
        assert table_value(case,chosen,mapping)==solved
        assert chosen in [p for p,_ in plans]
        optima[case.name]=optimum
        output.append(dict(case=case.name,input_sha256=case.identity,dp_selected=selected,
                           dp_value=str(solved),independent_optimum=str(optimum),independent_selected=keys,
                           plans=[dict(keys=k,value=str(v)) for k,v in plans]))
    return output,optima


def audit_d(cases,references,optima):
    output=[]
    for case in cases:
        specs,rows=references[case.name]
        upper,details=all_bounds(case,specs)
        margins=[]
        for spec in specs:
            for w,(_,score) in enumerate(rows[spec.index]):
                u=details[spec.index][w]['value']
                assert u>=score,(case.name,spec.index,w,u,score)
                margins.append(u-score)
            assert upper[spec.index]>=mean_score(rows[spec.index])
        # A fresh lazy evaluator has no access to the offline rows above.
        result=lazy(case,specs,epsilon=0.)
        optimum=optima[case.name]
        assert result['L']<=optimum<=result['U']
        for row in result['history']:
            assert Fraction(row['L'])<=optimum<=Fraction(row['U'])
        assert result['U']==result['L']==optimum
        assert len(set(i for q in result['requests'] for i in q['candidates']))==result['exact']
        if case.expectation=='skip':
            assert result['exact']<len(specs),'PREDEFINED skip_v1 did not skip; preserve this counterexample'
            assert any(mean_score(rows[s.index])>0 for s in specs)
        if case.expectation=='full':
            assert result['exact']==len(specs),'PREDEFINED full_v1 did not require full target batch'
        result['L'],result['U']=str(result['L']),str(result['U'])
        result['independent_optimum']=str(optimum)
        output.append(dict(case=case.name,input_sha256=case.identity,min_world_margin=min(margins),
                           lazy=result,offline_audit_candidates=len(specs),offline_audit_counted_in_lazy=False))
    return output

=== FILE: research/quality_allocation/worlds.py ===
from __future__ import annotations

from pursuit_v2.service import reject_service

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
import math
import numpy as np

from pursuit_v2.physics import _stepwise_checks, _is_stepwise_check
from pursuit_v2.risk import forecast_paths, risk_horizon
from .candidates import identity


def validate_model(obs):
    reject_service(obs.config)
    cfg = obs.config
    if cfg.capture_mode != 'stepwise_instant' or cfg.motion_model != 'continuous_turn':
        raise ValueError('First version requires continuous_turn / stepwise_instant')
    if cfg.step_dt != 0.05 or cfg.risk_prediction_dt != 0.05:
        raise ValueError('Execution and prediction must both use 0.05')
    if any(t.turns or t.arc_rates for t in obs.targets):
        raise ValueError('Public observations must not contain private future trajectories')
    if obs.positions.shape != (cfg.robots, 2) or len(obs.assignment) != cfg.robots:
        raise ValueError('Expected independent robot positions and assignments')
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(obs.positions)):
        raise ValueError('Non-finite public positions')


@dataclass
class Grid:
    times: np.ndarray
    positions: np.ndarray
    velocities: np.ndarray
    legal: np.ndarray
    escape: float
    end: float


def make_grid(obs, path, horizon):
    cfg, start = obs.config, obs.time
    end = min(cfg.end_time, start + horizon * cfg.stage_dt)
    escape = path.escape_time(cfg.side)
    grid = [start + i * cfg.step_dt for i in range(round((end-start)/cfg.step_dt)+1)]
    grid.append(end)
    if start < escape < end:
        grid.append(escape)
    grid.extend(t for t, _, _ in path.turns if start < t < end)
    grid.extend(t for t, _ in path.arc_rates if start < t < end)
    grid.extend(_stepwise_checks(cfg, start, end))
    times = np.asarray(sorted(set(round(t, 10) for t in grid
                                  if start-1e-10 <= t <= end+1e-10)))
    if path.arc_rates:
        position_rows, velocity_rows = [], []
        for i, t in enumerate(times):
            position, velocity = path._arc_state(t)
            position_rows.append(position)
            if i < len(times)-1:
                velocity_rows.append(velocity)
        positions = np.asarray(position_rows)
        velocities = np.asarray(velocity_rows)
    else:
        positions = np.asarray([path.position(t) for t in times])
        velocities = np.asarray([path.velocity_at(t) for t in times[:-1]])
    legal = np.asarray([bool((i == 0 and start < cfg.end_time-1e-10) or
                             (i > 0 and _is_stepwise_check(cfg, float(t))))
                        and escape > t+1e-10 for i, t in enumerate(times)])
    return Grid(times, positions, velocities, legal, escape, end)


@dataclass
class TargetWorlds:
    obs: object
    target: object
    horizon: int
    paths: tuple
    _grids: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    _components: dict = field(default_factory=dict)

    def grid(self, sample):
        if sample not in self._grids:
            self._grids[sample] = make_grid(self.obs, self.paths[sample], self.horizon)
        return self._grids[sample]


def freeze_worlds(obs):
    validate_model(obs)
    result = {}
    for target in obs.targets:
        horizon = risk_horizon(obs, target)
        paths = forecast_paths(obs, target, horizon)
        result[target.id] = TargetWorlds(obs, target, horizon, paths)
    fingerprint = identity([[j, w.horizon, [p.to_dict() for p in w.paths]]
                            for j, w in result.items()])
    return result, fingerprint
