def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def read(path):return json.loads(Path(path).read_bytes())
def save(path,value):
    with Path(path).open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:json.dump(value,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)
def active_registry():
    if _REGISTRY is None:raise RuntimeError('Protected patch runner required')
    return _REGISTRY

def static_preflight():
    base=read(REPORT/'BASELINE.json')
    if subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()!=HEAD:raise ValueError('HEAD_MISMATCH')
    if Path(base['authority_must_not_exist']).exists():raise ValueError('FORMAL_ROOT_ACTIVE')
    for name,wanted in base['source_pins'].items():
        if name not in base['allowed_modifications'] and sha(ROOT/name)!=wanted:raise ValueError('PROTECTED_SOURCE_CHANGED: '+name)
    for name,wanted in {**base['runtime_pins'],**base['external_files']}.items():
        if sha(name)!=wanted:raise ValueError('PROTECTED_EXTERNAL_CHANGED: '+name)
    for name,wanted in base['historical_files'].items():
        if sha(ROOT/name)!=wanted:raise ValueError('HISTORICAL_CHANGED: '+name)
    changed=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','HEAD','--name-only'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).splitlines()
    if changed!=base['allowed_modifications']:raise ValueError('BUSINESS_WHITELIST')
    others=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).splitlines()
    if any(n not in base['new_files'] and not n.startswith('reports/stfbs_lite_d1b_qm_b3_minimal_patch_001/') for n in others):raise ValueError('NEW_FILE_WHITELIST')
    path=base['allowed_modifications'][0]
    before=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:'+path],cwd=ROOT).replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')
    expected=before.replace(b'from .stfbs_d1b_qm_execution import prepare_branch,bind_shared_budget',b'from .stfbs_d1b_qm_execution import prepare_branch')
    expected=expected.replace(b'    bind_shared_budget(branch,budget)  # Recheck the untouched pre-sampling takeover window.\n',b'')
    actual=(ROOT/path).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')
    if actual!=expected.replace(b'\r\n',b'\n'):raise ValueError('EXACT_PATCH_MISMATCH')
    before_tree=ast.parse(before.decode());after_tree=ast.parse(actual.decode())
    for tree in (before_tree,after_tree):
        for node in tree.body:
            if isinstance(node,ast.FunctionDef) and node.name=='prepare_b3_branch':
                if tree is before_tree:
                    node.body[0].names=[a for a in node.body[0].names if a.name!='bind_shared_budget']
                    node.body=[n for n in node.body if not (isinstance(n,ast.Expr) and isinstance(n.value,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.value.func,ast.Name) and n.value.func.id=='bind_shared_budget')]
    if ast.dump(before_tree)!=ast.dump(after_tree):raise ValueError('AST_PATCH_MISMATCH')
    for path in PATCH_FILES:compile((ROOT/path).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'),str(ROOT/path),'exec')
    tree=ast.parse((ROOT/PATCH_FILES[2]).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
    found=[n.name for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name.startswith('test_')]
    if sorted(found)!=sorted(NAMES) or len(found)!=4:raise ValueError('FOUR_TEST_WHITELIST')
    pins=read(REPORT/'SOURCE_PINS_V2.json')
    expected_paths=set(base['source_pins'])|set(PATCH_FILES)
    if pins['baseline_sha256']!=sha(REPORT/'BASELINE.json'):raise ValueError('BASELINE_CHANGED')
    if set(pins['source_pins'])!=expected_paths:raise ValueError('FREEZE_PATH_MISMATCH')
    for name,want in pins['source_pins'].items():
        if sha(ROOT/name)!=want:raise ValueError('FROZEN_TEST_SOURCE_CHANGED: '+name)
    return dict(source_pins=pins['source_pins'],patch_source_pins={n:pins['source_pins'][n] for n in PATCH_FILES})

def verify_launch(root,args):
    """Called before importing any test or scientific module."""
    import psutil
    from ctypes import wintypes as W
    root=Path(root).resolve();policy_path=Path(args.run_policy).resolve()
    if not sys.flags.isolated or not sys.dont_write_bytecode:raise ValueError('ISOLATED_NO_BYTECODE_REQUIRED')
    if sha(policy_path)!=args.policy_sha256:raise ValueError('RUN_POLICY_DIGEST_MISMATCH')
    p=read(policy_path);launch_path=Path(args.launch_ticket).resolve();launch=read(launch_path)
    if p['task']!=TASK or p['suite']!=SUITE or args.suite!=SUITE or p['test_ids']!=list(IDS):raise ValueError('RUN_G0_SUITE_IDENTITY')
    if Path(p['root']).resolve()!=root or Path.cwd().resolve()!=root:raise ValueError('RUN_G0_ROOT_OR_CWD')
    if Path(sys.argv[0]).resolve()!=Path(p['entry_script']).resolve() or Path(sys.executable).resolve()!=Path(p['python']).resolve():raise ValueError('RUN_G0_SCRIPT_OR_PYTHON')
    expected=[args.policy_sha256 if s=='<RUN_POLICY_SHA256>' else s for s in p['allowed_child_command']]
    me=psutil.Process();parent=psutil.Process(os.getppid())
    if me.cmdline()!=expected or parent.cmdline()!=p['watchdog_command']:raise ValueError('RUN_G0_COMMAND_MISMATCH')
    if launch['child_pid']!=os.getpid() or launch['watchdog_pid']!=parent.pid or p['watchdog_pid']!=parent.pid:raise ValueError('RUN_G0_PID_BINDING')
    if parent.create_time()!=p['watchdog_create_time'] or not parent.create_time()<=me.create_time()<=time.time()+1:raise ValueError('RUN_G0_PROCESS_CREATION_BINDING')
    if Path(p['watchdog_script']).resolve() not in [Path(a).resolve() for a in parent.cmdline() if a.endswith('.py')]:raise ValueError('RUN_G0_PARENT_SCRIPT')
    if (p['wall_limit'],p['cpu_limit'],p['attempts'])!=(180,120,1) or launch['wall_limit']!=180 or launch['assigned_before_resume'] is not True or launch.get('approval_sha256') is not None:raise ValueError('RUN_G0_LIMIT_OR_JOB_TICKET')
    if launch_path!=Path(p['evidence_dir'])/'LAUNCH.json':raise ValueError('RUN_G0_LAUNCH_PATH')
    api=ctypes.WinDLL('kernel32',use_last_error=True);api.GetCurrentProcess.restype=W.HANDLE
    api.IsProcessInJob.argtypes=[W.HANDLE,W.HANDLE,ctypes.POINTER(W.BOOL)];api.IsProcessInJob.restype=W.BOOL
    member=W.BOOL()
    if not api.IsProcessInJob(api.GetCurrentProcess(),None,ctypes.byref(member)):raise ctypes.WinError(ctypes.get_last_error())
    if not member.value:raise ValueError('RUN_G0_NOT_IN_WINDOWS_JOB')
    for name,s in p['source_pins'].items():
        if sha(root/name)!=s:raise ValueError('RUN_G0_SOURCE_IDENTITY: '+name)
    if subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip()!=p['head']:raise ValueError('RUN_G0_HEAD_CHANGED')
    if sha(sys.executable)!=p['python_sha256']:raise ValueError('RUN_G0_PYTHON_IDENTITY')
    for path,want in read(REPORT/'BASELINE.json')['runtime_pins'].items():
        if sha(path)!=want:raise ValueError('CHILD_RUNTIME_CHANGED: '+path)
    attempt=read(policy_path.parent/'TEST_ATTEMPT.json')
    if attempt['policy_sha256']!=args.policy_sha256 or attempt['attempt']!=1 or attempt['watchdog_pid']!=parent.pid:raise ValueError('RUN_G0_ATTEMPT_BINDING')
    return p,dict(status='PASS',child_pid=me.pid,parent_pid=parent.pid,parent_create_time=parent.create_time(),child_create_time=me.create_time(),actual_command=me.cmdline(),watchdog_command=parent.cmdline(),cwd=str(Path.cwd()),in_windows_job=True,policy_sha256=args.policy_sha256,launch_sha256=sha(launch_path),isolated=True,no_bytecode=True)

def verify_receipts(report):
    report=Path(report);p=read(report/'RUN_POLICY.json');attempt=read(report/'TEST_ATTEMPT.json')
    w=read(Path(p['evidence_dir'])/'WATCHDOG_RECEIPT.json');launch=read(Path(p['evidence_dir'])/'LAUNCH.json')
    bind=read(report/'LAUNCH_BINDING.json');tests=read(report/'DETERMINISTIC_TEST_RESULTS.json');ledger=read(report/'FORBIDDEN_CALL_LEDGER.json')
    if p['task']!=TASK or p['suite']!=SUITE or p['test_ids']!=list(IDS) or attempt['policy_sha256']!=sha(report/'RUN_POLICY.json'):raise ValueError('POLICY_NOT_VERIFIED')
    if (w['wall_limit'],w['cpu_limit'],w['attempts'],w['status'],w['exit_code'])!=(180,120,1,'EXITED',0):raise ValueError('SUPERVISION_NOT_VERIFIED')
    if type(w['attempts']) is not int or w['attempts']!=1:raise ValueError('ATTEMPT_TYPE_INVALID')
    if w['cpu_complete'] is not True or w['active_processes']!=0 or w.get('descendant_cleanup'):raise ValueError('JOB_ACCOUNTING_NOT_VERIFIED')
    for key,limit in (('tree_cpu_seconds',120),('process_cpu_seconds',120),('wall_seconds',180)):
        v=w.get(key)
        if type(v) not in (int,float) or not math.isfinite(v) or not 0<=v<=limit:raise ValueError('RESOURCE_NOT_VERIFIED: '+key)
    if launch['wall_limit']!=180 or not launch['assigned_before_resume'] or not bind['in_windows_job']:raise ValueError('JOB_BINDING_NOT_VERIFIED')
    if launch['child_pid']!=w['child_pid'] or bind['child_pid']!=w['child_pid'] or launch['watchdog_pid']!=w['watchdog_pid'] or bind['parent_pid']!=w['watchdog_pid']:raise ValueError('PID_NOT_VERIFIED')
    if bind['policy_sha256']!=sha(report/'RUN_POLICY.json') or bind['actual_command']!=w['command']:raise ValueError('COMMAND_NOT_VERIFIED')
    if tests['executed_ids']!=list(IDS) or len(set(tests['executed_ids']))!=4 or not tests['all_passed'] or tests['skips'] or tests['unexpected_successes']:raise ValueError('TWELVE_TESTS_NOT_VERIFIED')
    if ledger['ever_overwritten'] or any(ledger['forbidden_attempts'].values()) or any(ledger['actual_scientific_execution'].values()):raise ValueError('ZERO_SCIENCE_NOT_VERIFIED')
    if any(c['broken'] for c in ledger['guard_checks']) or any(not x['guard_installed'] for x in ledger['installed_entries']):raise ValueError('GUARDS_NOT_VERIFIED')
    if any(s.get('kind')=='fusion substitute' and not s['closed'] for s in ledger['fake_fuse_scopes']):raise ValueError('FAKE_SCOPE_NOT_CLOSED')
    for name,s in p['source_pins'].items():
        if sha(Path(p['root'])/name)!=s:raise ValueError('POSTRUN_SOURCE_CHANGED')
    static_preflight()
    return dict(status='PASS',task=TASK,suite=SUITE,policy_sha256=sha(report/'RUN_POLICY.json'),production_launch_marker=w.get('production_launch'),production_marker_note='None approval is correct for this engineering suite; no H1 validator used',test_count=4,zero_science=True)

                try:reg.integrity('after '+t.id())
                except Exception:self.addError(t,sys.exc_info())
                failed=any(x.id()==t.id() for x,_ in self.errors+self.failures)
                self.records.append(dict(id=t.id(),execution_count=1,status='FAIL' if failed else 'PASS',started=self.started[t.id()],ended=time.time(),evidence_kind=LABEL))
                super().stopTest(t)
        result=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=stream,verbosity=2,resultclass=Result).run(unittest.TestSuite([module.PatchTests(name) for name in NAMES]))
    except BaseException as error:fatal=dict(error=repr(error),traceback=traceback.format_exc())
    finally:
        try:reg.integrity('patch final exit')
        except Exception as error:
            if fatal is None:fatal=dict(error=repr(error),traceback=traceback.format_exc())
        ledger=reg.ledger();ledger['forbidden_attempts']['ALL']=len(reg.calls)
        save(REPORT/'FORBIDDEN_CALL_LEDGER.json',ledger)
        with (REPORT/'TEST_OUTPUT.log').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:f.write(stream.getvalue())
    passed=bool(result is not None and result.wasSuccessful() and result.executed==list(IDS) and not result.skipped and not fatal)
    summary=dict(task=TASK,suite=SUITE,policy_sha256=args.policy_sha256,executed_ids=[] if result is None else result.executed,cases=[] if result is None else result.records,
        all_passed=passed,skips=[] if result is None else [str(x) for x in result.skipped],unexpected_successes=[] if result is None else [x.id() for x in result.unexpectedSuccesses],
        errors=[] if result is None else [dict(id=t.id(),trace=s) for t,s in result.errors],failures=[] if result is None else [dict(id=t.id(),trace=s) for t,s in result.failures],fatal=fatal,started=start,ended=time.time(),evidence_kind=LABEL)
    save(REPORT/'DETERMINISTIC_TEST_RESULTS.json',summary)
    good=passed and not reg.calls and not reg.overwritten
    print(stream.getvalue())
    return 0 if good else 1

if __name__=='__main__':raise SystemExit(main())

from pathlib import Path

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--suite',required=True);parser.add_argument('--launch-ticket',required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--run-policy',required=True);parser.add_argument('--policy-sha256',required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args();root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    raw=Path(args.run_policy).read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()!=args.policy_sha256:raise ValueError('Untrusted policy digest')
    initial=json.loads(raw)
    if Path(initial['root']).resolve()!=root or Path(initial['entry_script']).resolve()!=Path(__file__).resolve():raise ValueError('Untrusted repository/script')
    sys.path.insert(0,str(root))

    policy,binding=verify_launch(root,args)

    try:
        import unittest,importlib
        module=importlib.import_module('tests.test_stfbs_d1b_qm_run_g0')
        if Path(module.__file__).resolve()!=root/'tests/test_stfbs_d1b_qm_run_g0.py':raise ValueError('Wrong test module')
        actual_names=sorted(n for n in vars(module.RunG0Tests) if n.startswith('test_'))
        if actual_names!=sorted(NAMES):raise ValueError('Runtime whitelist mismatch')
        loaded=[]
        for name,m in list(sys.modules.items()):
            if name.split('.')[0] in ('research','pursuit_v2','scripts','tests'):
                file=getattr(m,'__file__',None)
                if file and not Path(file).resolve().is_relative_to(root):raise ValueError('Non-repository project import: '+name)
                if file:loaded.append(dict(module=name,path=str(Path(file).resolve())))
        save(report/'LOADED_MODULE_ORIGINS.json',loaded)
        registry.integrity('after whitelist module import')
        class Result(unittest.TextTestResult):
            def __init__(self,*a,**kw):
                super().__init__(*a,**kw);self.executed=[];self.case_records=[]
            def startTest(self,test):
                identifier=test.id()
                if identifier not in IDS or identifier in self.executed:raise ValueError('Extra/duplicate formal test')
                registry.current_test=identifier;registry.integrity('before '+identifier)
                self.executed.append(identifier);super().startTest(test)
            def stopTest(self,test):
                try:registry.integrity('after '+test.id())
                except Exception:self.addError(test,sys.exc_info())
                failed=any(x.id()==test.id() for x,_ in self.errors+self.failures)
                self.case_records.append(dict(id=test.id(),status='FAIL' if failed else 'PASS',double_evidence=[s for s in registry.scopes if s['test']==test.id()]))
                super().stopTest(test)
        suite=unittest.TestSuite([module.RunG0Tests(name) for name in NAMES])
        result=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=stream,verbosity=2,resultclass=Result).run(suite)
        registry.integrity('all ten finished')
    except Exception as error:
        fatal=dict(error=repr(error),traceback=traceback.format_exc())
    finally:
        try:registry.integrity('final exit')
        except Exception as e:
            if fatal is None:fatal=dict(error=repr(e),traceback=traceback.format_exc())
        ledger=registry.ledger();save(report/'FORBIDDEN_CALL_LEDGER.json',ledger)
        with (report/'TEST_OUTPUT.log').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:f.write(stream.getvalue())
    summary=dict(task=policy['task'],suite=policy['suite'],policy_sha256=args.policy_sha256,

        all_passed=bool(result is not None and result.wasSuccessful() and result.executed==list(IDS) and not fatal),
        errors=[] if result is None else [dict(id=t.id(),trace=s) for t,s in result.errors],failures=[] if result is None else [dict(id=t.id(),trace=s) for t,s in result.failures],
        skips=[] if result is None else [str(x) for x in result.skipped],unexpected_successes=[] if result is None else [x.id() for x in result.unexpectedSuccesses],fatal=fatal)
    save(report/'DETERMINISTIC_TEST_RESULTS.json',summary)
    good=summary['all_passed'] and not registry.calls and not registry.overwritten

=== FILE: scripts/stfbs_d1b_qm_run_g1_watchdog.py ===
"""Future approved batch supervisor. No CLI toggle or in-policy SHA grants authority."""
import argparse,json,sys,time,hashlib,math
from pathlib import Path

def validate_final_resource_receipt(receipt,approved_cpu_limit,approved_wall_limit):
    """Pure final validation; receipt limits never confer approval themselves."""
    r=receipt if type(receipt) is dict else {}
    def finite_number(value):return type(value) is int or type(value) is float and math.isfinite(value)
    cpu=r.get('tree_cpu_seconds');wall=r.get('wall_seconds')
    cpu_cap=r.get('cpu_limit');wall_cap=r.get('wall_limit')
    approved_valid=all(finite_number(v) and v>0 for v in (approved_cpu_limit,approved_wall_limit))
    measurement_valid=all(finite_number(v) and v>=0 for v in (cpu,wall))
    receipt_limits_valid=all(finite_number(v) and v>0 for v in (cpu_cap,wall_cap))
    numeric_valid=approved_valid and measurement_valid and receipt_limits_valid
    limits_match=approved_valid and receipt_limits_valid and cpu_cap==approved_cpu_limit and wall_cap==approved_wall_limit
    cpu_within=approved_valid and finite_number(cpu) and cpu>=0 and cpu<=approved_cpu_limit
    wall_within=approved_valid and finite_number(wall) and wall>=0 and wall<=approved_wall_limit
    single=type(r.get('attempts')) is int and r['attempts']==1
    exit_valid=(r.get('status')=='EXITED' and type(r.get('exit_code')) is int and r['exit_code']==0)
    cleanup_valid=type(r.get('active_processes')) is int and r['active_processes']==0
    reasons=[]
    if not approved_valid:reasons.append('INVALID_APPROVED_LIMIT')
    if not measurement_valid or not receipt_limits_valid:reasons.append('INVALID_RESOURCE_MEASUREMENT')
    if approved_valid and receipt_limits_valid and not limits_match:reasons.append('APPROVED_LIMIT_MISMATCH')
    if approved_valid and finite_number(cpu) and cpu>approved_cpu_limit:reasons.append('TREE_CPU_LIMIT_EXCEEDED')
    if approved_valid and finite_number(wall) and wall>approved_wall_limit:reasons.append('WALL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED')
    if not single:reasons.append('INVALID_ATTEMPT_COUNT')
    if not exit_valid:reasons.append('INVALID_EXIT_STATE')
    if r.get('cpu_complete') is not True:reasons.append('CPU_ACCOUNTING_INCOMPLETE')
    if not cleanup_valid:reasons.append('PROCESS_CLEANUP_NOT_VERIFIED')
    return dict(status='PASS' if not reasons else 'BLOCKED',numeric_valid=numeric_valid,
        approved_cpu_limit=approved_cpu_limit,approved_wall_limit=approved_wall_limit,
        receipt_cpu_limit=cpu_cap,receipt_wall_limit=wall_cap,tree_cpu_seconds=cpu,wall_seconds=wall,
        limits_match=limits_match,cpu_within_limit=cpu_within,wall_within_limit=wall_within,
        single_attempt_valid=single,exit_valid=exit_valid,cleanup_valid=cleanup_valid,
        cpu_accounting_complete=r.get('cpu_complete') is True,failure_reasons=reasons)

def final_resource_audit(receipt,approved_cpu_limit,approved_wall_limit,ledger,source_pins_unchanged):
    """The same final decision is used by main() and synthetic tests."""
    resource=validate_final_resource_receipt(receipt,approved_cpu_limit,approved_wall_limit)
    ledger_complete=type(ledger) is dict and ledger.get('status')=='COMPLETE'
    sources_valid=source_pins_unchanged is True
    reasons=list(resource['failure_reasons'])
    if not ledger_complete:reasons.append('RESOURCE_LEDGER_INCOMPLETE')
    if not sources_valid:reasons.append('SOURCE_PINS_CHANGED_OR_UNVERIFIED')
    valid=resource['status']=='PASS' and ledger_complete and sources_valid
    return dict(status='PASS' if valid else 'BLOCKED',source_pins_unchanged=source_pins_unchanged,
        receipt=receipt,journal_status=ledger.get('status') if type(ledger) is dict else None,no_retry=True,
        resource_validation=resource,ledger_complete=ledger_complete,failure_reasons=reasons)

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--approval-file',required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args();root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1];sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
    from research.non_oracle.stfbs_d1b_qm_run_release import authorize_policy
    permit=authorize_policy(args.approval_file)  # Independent user root required before output/attempt creation.
    import psutil
    output=Path(permit.bindings['output_dir']);output.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    approval_sha=hashlib.sha256(Path(args.approval_file).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    with (output/'ATTEMPT.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(dict(batch_id=permit.bindings['batch_id'],attempt_id=permit.bindings['attempt_id'],watchdog_pid=psutil.Process().pid,watchdog_create_time=psutil.Process().create_time(),approval_sha256=approval_sha,started_utc=time.time(),attempt=1,automatic_retry=False),f,indent=2)

def static_preflight():
    base=read(REPORT/'BASELINE.json')
    if subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()!=HEAD:raise ValueError('PATCH_HEAD_MISMATCH')
    for name,wanted in base['source_pins'].items():
        if name not in base['allowed_modifications'] and sha(ROOT/name)!=wanted:raise ValueError('PROTECTED_FILE_CHANGED: '+name)
    for name,wanted in base['runtime_pins'].items():
        if sha(name)!=wanted:raise ValueError('RUNTIME_CHANGED: '+name)
    changed=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','HEAD','--name-only'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).splitlines()
    if any(n not in base['allowed_modifications'] for n in changed):raise ValueError('UNAPPROVED_SOURCE_MODIFICATION')
    others=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).splitlines()
    if any(n not in base['new_files'] and not n.startswith('reports/stfbs_lite_d1b_qm_run_release_patch_001/') for n in others):raise ValueError('UNAPPROVED_NEW_FILE')
    for path in PATCH_FILES:compile((ROOT/path).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'),str(ROOT/path),'exec')
    tree=ast.parse((ROOT/PATCH_FILES[2]).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))

    if len(found)!=8 or sorted(found)!=sorted(NAMES):raise ValueError('PATCH_EIGHT_METHOD_WHITELIST_MISMATCH')

def verify_launch(root,args):
    """Called before importing any test or scientific module."""
    import psutil
    from ctypes import wintypes as W
    root=Path(root).resolve();policy_path=Path(args.run_policy).resolve()
    if not sys.flags.isolated or not sys.dont_write_bytecode:raise ValueError('ISOLATED_NO_BYTECODE_REQUIRED')
    if sha(policy_path)!=args.policy_sha256:raise ValueError('RUN_POLICY_DIGEST_MISMATCH')
    p=read(policy_path);launch_path=Path(args.launch_ticket).resolve();launch=read(launch_path)
    if p['task']!=TASK or p['suite']!=SUITE or args.suite!=SUITE or p['test_ids']!=list(IDS):raise ValueError('RUN_G0_SUITE_IDENTITY')
    if Path(p['root']).resolve()!=root or Path.cwd().resolve()!=root:raise ValueError('RUN_G0_ROOT_OR_CWD')
    if Path(sys.argv[0]).resolve()!=Path(p['entry_script']).resolve() or Path(sys.executable).resolve()!=Path(p['python']).resolve():raise ValueError('RUN_G0_SCRIPT_OR_PYTHON')
    expected=[args.policy_sha256 if s=='<RUN_POLICY_SHA256>' else s for s in p['allowed_child_command']]
    me=psutil.Process();parent=psutil.Process(os.getppid())
    if me.cmdline()!=expected or parent.cmdline()!=p['watchdog_command']:raise ValueError('RUN_G0_COMMAND_MISMATCH')
    if launch['child_pid']!=os.getpid() or launch['watchdog_pid']!=parent.pid or p['watchdog_pid']!=parent.pid:raise ValueError('RUN_G0_PID_BINDING')
    if parent.create_time()!=p['watchdog_create_time'] or not parent.create_time()<=me.create_time()<=time.time()+1:raise ValueError('RUN_G0_PROCESS_CREATION_BINDING')
    if Path(p['watchdog_script']).resolve() not in [Path(a).resolve() for a in parent.cmdline() if a.endswith('.py')]:raise ValueError('RUN_G0_PARENT_SCRIPT')
    if (p['wall_limit'],p['cpu_limit'],p['attempts'])!=(180,120,1) or launch['wall_limit']!=180 or launch['assigned_before_resume'] is not True or launch.get('approval_sha256') is not None:raise ValueError('RUN_G0_LIMIT_OR_JOB_TICKET')
    if launch_path!=Path(p['evidence_dir'])/'LAUNCH.json':raise ValueError('RUN_G0_LAUNCH_PATH')
    api=ctypes.WinDLL('kernel32',use_last_error=True);api.GetCurrentProcess.restype=W.HANDLE

    member=W.BOOL()

    if not member.value:raise ValueError('RUN_G0_NOT_IN_WINDOWS_JOB')

def verify_receipts(report):
    report=Path(report);p=read(report/'RUN_POLICY.json');attempt=read(report/'TEST_ATTEMPT.json')
    w=read(Path(p['evidence_dir'])/'WATCHDOG_RECEIPT.json');launch=read(Path(p['evidence_dir'])/'LAUNCH.json')
    bind=read(report/'LAUNCH_BINDING.json');tests=read(report/'DETERMINISTIC_TEST_RESULTS.json');ledger=read(report/'FORBIDDEN_CALL_LEDGER.json')
    if p['task']!=TASK or p['suite']!=SUITE or p['test_ids']!=list(IDS) or attempt['policy_sha256']!=sha(report/'RUN_POLICY.json'):raise ValueError('POLICY_NOT_VERIFIED')
    if (w['wall_limit'],w['cpu_limit'],w['attempts'],w['status'],w['exit_code'])!=(180,120,1,'EXITED',0):raise ValueError('SUPERVISION_NOT_VERIFIED')
    if not w['cpu_complete'] or w['active_processes']!=0 or w.get('descendant_cleanup'):raise ValueError('JOB_ACCOUNTING_NOT_VERIFIED')
    for key,limit in (('tree_cpu_seconds',120),('process_cpu_seconds',120),('wall_seconds',180)):
        v=w.get(key)
        if type(v) not in (int,float) or not math.isfinite(v) or not 0<=v<=limit:raise ValueError('RESOURCE_NOT_VERIFIED: '+key)
    if launch['wall_limit']!=180 or not launch['assigned_before_resume'] or not bind['in_windows_job']:raise ValueError('JOB_BINDING_NOT_VERIFIED')
    if launch['child_pid']!=w['child_pid'] or bind['child_pid']!=w['child_pid'] or launch['watchdog_pid']!=w['watchdog_pid'] or bind['parent_pid']!=w['watchdog_pid']:raise ValueError('PID_NOT_VERIFIED')
    if bind['policy_sha256']!=sha(report/'RUN_POLICY.json') or bind['actual_command']!=w['command']:raise ValueError('COMMAND_NOT_VERIFIED')
    if tests['executed_ids']!=list(IDS) or len(set(tests['executed_ids']))!=8 or not tests['all_passed'] or tests['skips'] or tests['unexpected_successes']:raise ValueError('TWELVE_TESTS_NOT_VERIFIED')
    if ledger['ever_overwritten'] or any(ledger['forbidden_attempts'].values()) or any(ledger['actual_scientific_execution'].values()):raise ValueError('ZERO_SCIENCE_NOT_VERIFIED')
    if any(c['broken'] for c in ledger['guard_checks']) or any(not x['guard_installed'] for x in ledger['installed_entries']):raise ValueError('GUARDS_NOT_VERIFIED')
    if any(s.get('kind')=='fusion substitute' and not s['closed'] for s in ledger['fake_fuse_scopes']):raise ValueError('FAKE_SCOPE_NOT_CLOSED')
    for name,s in p['source_pins'].items():
        if sha(Path(p['root'])/name)!=s:raise ValueError('POSTRUN_SOURCE_CHANGED')
    return dict(status='PASS',task=TASK,suite=SUITE,policy_sha256=sha(report/'RUN_POLICY.json'),production_launch_marker=w.get('production_launch'),production_marker_note='None approval is correct for this engineering suite; no H1 validator used',test_count=8,zero_science=True)

import argparse,hashlib,json,sys,io,traceback
from pathlib import Path

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--suite',required=True);parser.add_argument('--launch-ticket',required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--run-policy',required=True);parser.add_argument('--policy-sha256',required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args();root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    raw=Path(args.run_policy).read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()!=args.policy_sha256:raise ValueError('Untrusted policy digest')
    initial=json.loads(raw)
    if Path(initial['root']).resolve()!=root or Path(initial['entry_script']).resolve()!=Path(__file__).resolve():raise ValueError('Untrusted repository/script')
    sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
    from research.non_oracle.stfbs_d1b_qm_run_audit import verify_launch,install_guards,save,IDS,NAMES
    policy,binding=verify_launch(root,args)
    report=Path(args.run_policy).resolve().parent;save(report/'LAUNCH_BINDING.json',binding)
    registry=install_guards()  # All guards before test-module loading.
    stream=io.StringIO();result=None;fatal=None
    try:
        import unittest,importlib
        module=importlib.import_module('tests.test_stfbs_d1b_qm_run_release')
        if Path(module.__file__).resolve()!=root/'tests/test_stfbs_d1b_qm_run_release.py':raise ValueError('Wrong test module')
        actual_names=sorted(n for n in vars(module.ReleaseTests) if n.startswith('test_'))
        if actual_names!=sorted(NAMES):raise ValueError('Runtime whitelist mismatch')
        loaded=[]
        for name,m in list(sys.modules.items()):
            if name.split('.')[0] in ('research','pursuit_v2','scripts','tests'):
                file=getattr(m,'__file__',None)
                if file and not Path(file).resolve().is_relative_to(root):raise ValueError('Non-repository project import: '+name)
                if file:loaded.append(dict(module=name,path=str(Path(file).resolve())))
        save(report/'LOADED_MODULE_ORIGINS.json',loaded)
        registry.integrity('after whitelist module import')
        class Result(unittest.TextTestResult):
            def __init__(self,*a,**kw):
                super().__init__(*a,**kw);self.executed=[];self.case_records=[]
            def startTest(self,test):
                identifier=test.id()
                if identifier not in IDS or identifier in self.executed:raise ValueError('Extra/duplicate formal test')
                registry.current_test=identifier;registry.integrity('before '+identifier)
                self.executed.append(identifier);super().startTest(test)
            def stopTest(self,test):
                try:registry.integrity('after '+test.id())
                except Exception:self.addError(test,sys.exc_info())
                failed=any(x.id()==test.id() for x,_ in self.errors+self.failures)
                self.case_records.append(dict(id=test.id(),status='FAIL' if failed else 'PASS',double_evidence=[s for s in registry.scopes if s['test']==test.id()]))
                super().stopTest(test)
        suite=unittest.TestSuite([module.ReleaseTests(name) for name in NAMES])
        result=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=stream,verbosity=2,resultclass=Result).run(suite)
        registry.integrity('all twelve finished')
    except Exception as error:
        fatal=dict(error=repr(error),traceback=traceback.format_exc())
    finally:
        try:registry.integrity('final exit')

=== FILE: scripts/supervise_sw3_formal.py ===
"""External one-shot resource guard. Never retries the formal child."""
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import shutil
import atexit
from pathlib import Path
import psutil


def main():
    report=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
    config=json.loads((report/"LAUNCH.json").read_bytes())
    started=time.time()
    reason=None
    samples=report/"RESOURCE_SAMPLES.jsonl"
    with (report/"stdout.log").open("xb") as out,(report/"stderr.log").open("xb") as err:
        child=subprocess.Popen(config["command"],cwd=config["cwd"],stdout=out,stderr=err)
        def terminate_unfinished():
            if child.poll() is None:
                subprocess.run(["taskkill","/PID",str(child.pid),"/T","/F"],capture_output=True)
                child.wait(timeout=30)
        atexit.register(terminate_unfinished)
        (report/"CHILD.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(pid=child.pid,started=started)))
        peak=0
        with samples.open("x",encoding="utf-8") as log:
            while True:
                processes=[]
                try:
                    parent=psutil.Process(child.pid)
                    processes=[parent]+parent.children(recursive=True)
                except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
                    pass
                rows=[]
                for p in processes:
                    try:
                        t=p.cpu_times();m=p.memory_info()
                        rows.append(dict(pid=p.pid,rss=m.rss,cpu=t.user+t.system))
                    except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
                        pass
                total=sum(r["rss"] for r in rows);peak=max(peak,total)
                free=shutil.disk_usage(config["cwd"]).free
                elapsed=time.time()-started
                events=Path(config["output"])/"events"
                log.write(json.dumps(dict(elapsed=elapsed,processes=rows,total_rss=total,
                    disk_free=free,gates=len(list(events.glob("*.json"))) if events.exists() else 0))+"\n")
                log.flush()
                code=child.poll()
                if code is not None:
                    break
                if elapsed>config["wall_limit_seconds"]:reason="WALL_LIMIT"
                elif total>config["tree_rss_limit_bytes"]:reason="MEMORY_LIMIT"
                elif free<config["minimum_disk_free_bytes"]:reason="DISK_LIMIT"
                if reason:
                    for p in reversed(processes):
                        try:p.kill()
                        except psutil.NoSuchProcess:pass
                    child.wait(timeout=30)
                    code=child.returncode
                    break
                time.sleep(2)
    (report/"TIMING.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(pid=child.pid,exit_code=code,
        stop_reason=reason,wall_seconds=time.time()-started,peak_tree_rss=peak),indent=2))
    return 0 if code==0 and reason is None else 1

if __name__=="__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

=== FILE: scripts/sw3_test_appcontainer.py ===
"""Native Windows AppContainer launcher for SW3 TEST-0."""
from contextlib import ExitStack, contextmanager
import ctypes as c
from ctypes import wintypes as w
import subprocess
import msvcrt
import os
from uuid import uuid4

P = c.c_void_p


class Startup(c.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("cb", w.DWORD), ("reserved", w.LPWSTR), ("desktop", w.LPWSTR),
                ("title", w.LPWSTR), ("values", w.DWORD * 8), ("show", w.WORD),
                ("reserved_count", w.WORD), ("reserved_bytes", P), ("handles", w.HANDLE * 3)]


class Extended(c.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("startup", Startup), ("attributes", P)]


class Process(c.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("process", w.HANDLE), ("thread", w.HANDLE), ("pid", w.DWORD), ("tid", w.DWORD)]


class Capabilities(c.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("sid", P), ("capabilities", P), ("count", w.DWORD), ("reserved", w.DWORD)]


def bind(dll, name, args, result=w.BOOL):
    method = getattr(c.WinDLL(dll, use_last_error=True), name)
    method.argtypes, method.restype = args, result
    return method


def kernel(name, args, result=w.BOOL):
    return bind("kernel32", name, args, result)


def check(value):
    if not value:
        raise c.WinError(c.get_last_error())


@contextmanager
def profile():
    name = "Codex.SW3.Test." + uuid4().hex
    sid = P()
    create = bind("userenv", "CreateAppContainerProfile",
                  [w.LPCWSTR, w.LPCWSTR, w.LPCWSTR, P, w.DWORD, c.POINTER(P)], c.c_long)
    delete = bind("userenv", "DeleteAppContainerProfile", [w.LPCWSTR], c.c_long)
    hr = create(name, name, "SW3 limited prediction worker", None, 0, c.byref(sid))
    if hr != 0:
        raise OSError(f"CreateAppContainerProfile HRESULT {hr:#x}")
    sid_text = w.LPWSTR()
    try:
        check(bind("advapi32", "ConvertSidToStringSidW", [P, c.POINTER(w.LPWSTR)])(
            sid, c.byref(sid_text)))
        yield sid, sid_text.value
    finally:
        if sid_text:
            kernel("LocalFree", [P], P)(c.cast(sid_text, P))
        bind("advapi32", "FreeSid", [P], P)(sid)
        delete(name)


@contextmanager
def diagnostic_handles(stdout, stderr, empty_stdin):
    with ExitStack() as stack:
        handles = []
        for path, mode in ((empty_stdin, "rb"), (stdout, "xb"), (stderr, "xb")):
            stream = stack.enter_context(path.open(mode, buffering=0))
            handle = msvcrt.get_osfhandle(stream.fileno())
            os.set_handle_inheritable(handle, True)
            handles.append(handle)
        yield (w.HANDLE * 3)(*handles)


def run(sid, executable, args, cwd, environment, *, stdout, stderr, empty_stdin,
        timeout_ms=180000):
    init = kernel("InitializeProcThreadAttributeList", [P, w.DWORD, w.DWORD, c.POINTER(c.c_size_t)])
    size = c.c_size_t()
    init(None, 2, 0, c.byref(size))
    buffer = c.create_string_buffer(size.value)
    check(init(buffer, 2, 0, c.byref(size)))
    close = kernel("CloseHandle", [w.HANDLE])
    try:
        cap = Capabilities(sid, None, 0, 0)
        update = kernel("UpdateProcThreadAttribute", [P, w.DWORD, c.c_size_t, P, c.c_size_t, P, P])
        check(update(buffer, 0, 0x20009, c.byref(cap), c.sizeof(cap), None, None))
        startup = Extended()
        startup.startup.cb = c.sizeof(startup)
        startup.attributes = c.cast(buffer, P)
        proc = Process()
        command = c.create_unicode_buffer(subprocess.list2cmdline([str(executable), *args]))
        env = c.create_unicode_buffer("\0".join(
            f"{k}={environment[k]}" for k in sorted(environment, key=str.casefold)) + "\0\0")
        create = kernel("CreateProcessW", [w.LPCWSTR, w.LPWSTR, P, P, w.BOOL, w.DWORD,
                                           P, w.LPCWSTR, c.POINTER(Extended), c.POINTER(Process)])
        with diagnostic_handles(stdout, stderr, empty_stdin) as handles:
            check(update(buffer, 0, 0x20002, handles, c.sizeof(handles), None, None))
            startup.startup.values[7] = 0x100  # STARTF_USESTDHANDLES
            startup.startup.handles = handles
            check(create(str(executable), command, None, None, True, 0x08080400, env,
                         str(cwd), c.byref(startup), c.byref(proc)))
        wait = kernel("WaitForSingleObject", [w.HANDLE, w.DWORD], w.DWORD)
        try:
            waited = wait(proc.process, timeout_ms)
            if waited == 258:
                check(kernel("TerminateProcess", [w.HANDLE, w.UINT])(proc.process, 124))
                if wait(proc.process, 5000) != 0:
                    raise TimeoutError(f"AppContainer worker {proc.pid} did not exit after termination")
            elif waited != 0:
                raise c.WinError(c.get_last_error())
            status = w.DWORD()
            check(kernel("GetExitCodeProcess", [w.HANDLE, c.POINTER(w.DWORD)])(proc.process, c.byref(status)))
            return dict(pid=proc.pid, exit_code=status.value, timed_out=waited == 258)
        finally:
            close(proc.thread)
            close(proc.process)
    finally:
        kernel("DeleteProcThreadAttributeList", [P], None)(buffer)

=== FILE: scripts/sw3_test_worker.py ===
"""AppContainer-side public prediction and artificial access probes."""
from dataclasses import asdict, is_dataclass
import json
import os
import ctypes
from ctypes import wintypes
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import traceback


def encode(value):
    if is_dataclass(value):
        return asdict(value)
    if hasattr(value, "tolist"):
        return value.tolist()
    raise TypeError(type(value))


def access(path, mode):
    if mode == "FILE_WRITE_DATA":
        kernel = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)
        create = kernel.CreateFileW
        create.argtypes = [wintypes.LPCWSTR, wintypes.DWORD, wintypes.DWORD,
                           ctypes.c_void_p, wintypes.DWORD, wintypes.DWORD, wintypes.HANDLE]
        create.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
        handle = create(path, 2, 7, None, 3, 0, None)
        evidence = dict(access_mask=2, share_mode=7, disposition=3)
        if handle == ctypes.c_void_p(-1).value:
            return dict(allowed=False, winerror=ctypes.get_last_error(), **evidence)
        kernel.CloseHandle.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE]
        return dict(allowed=True, handle_closed=bool(kernel.CloseHandle(handle)), **evidence)
    try:
        with open(path, mode):
            pass
    except OSError as error:
        return dict(allowed=False, exception=type(error).__name__, errno=error.errno, winerror=error.winerror
                    if hasattr(error, "winerror") else None)
    return dict(allowed=True)


def main():
    root = Path.cwd()
    output = root / "output"
    try:
        job = json.loads((root / "input" / "job.json").read_bytes())
        phase = job.get("phase", "prediction")
        if phase == "startup":
            (output / "receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(phase=phase,
                python_initialized=True, worker_executed=True, pid=os.getpid())), encoding="utf-8")
            return
        with os.add_dll_directory(str(root / "native")):
            sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "science"))
            from research.non_oracle.sw3_f1_prediction import predict_method

            if phase == "dependencies":
                import numpy
                import scipy
                (output / "receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(phase=phase,
                    numpy=numpy.__version__, scipy=scipy.__version__, worker_executed=True)),
                    encoding="utf-8")
                return
            for key, view in job["inputs"].items():
                if not key.isascii() or not key.isalnum():
                    raise ValueError("Invalid public job key")
                for method in ("M0", "M1", "M2"):
                    product = predict_method(view, method)
                    (output / f"{key}_{method}.json").write_text(
                        json.dumps(product, default=encode, allow_nan=False), encoding="utf-8")
            probes = {key: dict(path=spec[0], mode=spec[1], **access(*spec))
                      for key, spec in job["probes"].items()}
            (output / "receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(probes=probes,
                sys_path=sys.path, environment=sorted(os.environ), executable=sys.executable)),
                encoding="utf-8")
    except Exception:
        (output / "error.txt").write_text(traceback.format_exc(), encoding="utf-8")
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path
import unittest

from pursuit_v2.config import Config
from pursuit_v2.types import Target
from research.non_oracle.environment import StaggeredEnvironment
from scripts.gq_windows.a0_identity import exact_tree
from scripts.run_a2_value2_locked import compare_before_action, load_open


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))


class FactorialDesignTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_crossed_worlds_have_only_the_registered_differences(self):
        a = read("configs/a2_switch_two_target_v1.json")
        b = read("configs/a2_value2_two_target_v1.json")
        for case, position, velocity in (("x1", a, b), ("x2", b, a)):
            expected = copy.deepcopy(a)
            expected["targets"][1]["position_at_birth"] = position["targets"][1]["position_at_birth"]
            expected["targets"][1]["velocity"] = velocity["targets"][1]["velocity"]
            exact_tree(read(f"configs/a2_factorial_{case}_v1.json"), expected, f"/{case}")

    def test_schema_and_no_early_announcement(self):
        ann = read("configs/a2_value2_public_announcements_v1.json")["announcements"]
        old = read("configs/a2_switch_public_announcements_v1.json")["announcements"]
        exact_tree(old, ann, "/announcements")
        env = object.__new__(StaggeredEnvironment)
        for case in ("x1", "x2"):
            world = read(f"configs/a2_factorial_{case}_v1.json")
            Config(**world["config"])
            for t in world["targets"]:
                Target(**t)
            env._validate_announcements(world, ann)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                env._validate_announcements(world, [ann[0], dict(ann[1], announcement_tick=40)])

    def test_historical_open_cannot_be_used_for_crossed_world(self):
        old = Path("runs/a2_value2_open_001")
        if not old.is_dir():
            self.skipTest("Local historical evidence is unavailable")
        ann = read("configs/a2_value2_public_announcements_v1.json")
        for case in ("x1", "x2"):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(Exception, "/world"):
                load_open(old, read(f"configs/a2_factorial_{case}_v1.json"), ann)

    def test_reused_comparison_accepts_no_fork_and_late_fork(self):
        opened = dict(policy_input={"tick": 100}, choice={"actions": [0], "exact_value": "0"}, evidence={})
        locked = dict(opened, locked={"selected": {"actions": [0], "exact_value": "0"}, "protection": None})
        self.assertIsNone(compare_before_action(opened, locked, [], [], "R", 100))
        locked["locked"]["selected"]["actions"] = [1]
        self.assertEqual(compare_before_action(opened, locked, [], [], "R", 100)["FIRST_FORK_TICK"], 100)

=== FILE: tests/test_a2_prediction_feedback_sw2.py ===
import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import TestCase
from unittest.mock import patch

from research.non_oracle.belief import Beliefs
from research.non_oracle.environment import NonOracleEnvironment
from research.non_oracle.shadow_feedback_prediction import WorldHypothesis, consume_model, predict_feedback
from research.information_service_online.execution import ActualMeasurementCache, OnlineEnvironment


def view60():
    p = Path("runs/a2_switch_episode_001/R_D60.json")
    view = json.loads(p.read_bytes())["policy_input"]
    view["beliefs"] = {int(k):v for k,v in view["beliefs"].items()}
    return view


def receipt(tick, point, **kwargs):
    wls = dict(estimate=point,has_accepted_estimate=True,optimizer_converged=True,
               numerical_ill_conditioned=False,ambiguity_detected=False,boundary_active=False,
               numeric_contract_violation=False)
    return dict(provenance="SIMULATED",observation_origin="MODEL",receipt_id=str(tick),
                tick=tick,available_tick=tick,wls=wls) | kwargs


class FeedbackTests(TestCase):
    def test_equivalence_latency_admission_and_speed_cap(self):
        view = view60()
        target = view["targets"][1]
        q = [receipt(60,[9.,10.]),receipt(61,[float("nan"),10.]),receipt(65,[10.,10.]),
             receipt(65,[11.,10.]),receipt(80,[12.,10.],available_tick=81)]
        ref = Beliefs([target])
        for r in q:
            ref.enqueue(dict(source="ACTUAL",target_id=1,measurement_tick=r["tick"],
                             available_tick=r["available_tick"],estimate=r["wls"]))
        mirror,hist,decisions = consume_model(q,view["beliefs"][1],target["speed_limit"])
        self.assertEqual(mirror,ref.freeze(80)[1])
        self.assertEqual(hist,ref.history[1])
        self.assertEqual([r["accepted"] for r in decisions],[True,False,True,False,False])
        self.assertEqual(mirror["velocity_estimate"],[.8,0.])

    def test_provenance_boundaries(self):
        view = view60()
        ref = Beliefs([view["targets"][1]])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ref.enqueue(dict(source="SIMULATED"))
        r = receipt(60,[9.,10.])
        for forged in (dict(r,source="ACTUAL"),dict(r,observation_origin="ACTUAL")):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                consume_model([forged],view["beliefs"][1],.8)
        mirror,*_ = consume_model([r],view["beliefs"][1],.8)
        self.assertEqual(mirror["source"],"ACTUAL_WLS")
        for obj in (mirror,r):
            with self.assertRaises((KeyError,ValueError)):
                ref.enqueue(obj)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                consume_model([obj],view["beliefs"][1],.8) if obj is mirror else consume_model([dict(obj,source="ACTUAL")],view["beliefs"][1],.8)
        self.assertEqual(ref.pending,[])

    def test_zero_production_calls_and_branch_independence(self):
        view = view60()
        before = copy.deepcopy(view)
        with (patch.object(Beliefs,"enqueue",side_effect=AssertionError) as enqueue,
              patch.object(OnlineEnvironment,"step",side_effect=AssertionError) as step,
              patch.object(NonOracleEnvironment,"_fuse",side_effect=AssertionError) as fusion,
              patch.object(ActualMeasurementCache,"query",side_effect=AssertionError) as sampler):
            a = predict_feedback(view,WorldHypothesis("nominal",(9.,10.3),(0.,0.)))
            b = predict_feedback(view,WorldHypothesis("offline",(9.2,10.1),(.4,0.),True))
        for mock in (enqueue,step,fusion,sampler):
            mock.assert_not_called()
        self.assertEqual(view,before)
        self.assertEqual(len(a["prefix"]["rows"]),21)
        for branch in ("F0","F1"):
            self.assertEqual(a[branch]["first_new_fusion_tick"],81)
            self.assertTrue(all(r["segment_id"]==a["segment"]["segment_id"] for r in a[branch]["rows"]))
        a["F0"]["rows"][0]["positions"][0][0] = -1
        self.assertNotEqual(a["F1"]["rows"][0]["positions"][0][0],-1)
        self.assertNotEqual(a["prefix"]["rows"][-1]["positions"][0][0],-1)
        for x,y in zip(a["prefix"]["rows"],b["prefix"]["rows"],strict=True):
            self.assertEqual(x["control"],y["control"])
            self.assertEqual(x["positions"],y["positions"])
            self.assertNotEqual(x["result"]["stream_id"],y["result"]["stream_id"])
        decisions = b["feedback"]["consumption"]
        self.assertEqual(sum(d["accepted"] and r["Q"]=="FAIL"
                             for d,r in zip(decisions,b["prefix"]["rows"],strict=True)),10)
        a["feedback"]["internal_science_mirror"]["position_estimate"][0] = -1
        self.assertNotEqual(b["feedback"]["internal_science_mirror"]["position_estimate"][0],-1)
        self.assertEqual(view,before)

=== FILE: tests/test_a2_prediction_shadow.py ===
import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path
import unittest

import numpy as np

from research.non_oracle.shadow_service_prediction import Hypothesis, predict_windows
from scripts.gq_windows.a0_identity import exact_tree

ROOTS = [Path("runs")/p for p in ("a2_switch_episode_001","a2_value2_open_001")]


def load(root):
    row = json.loads((root/"R_D60.json").read_bytes())
    return row


def inputs(row):
    view = copy.deepcopy(row["policy_input"])
    view["beliefs"] = {int(j):b for j,b in view["beliefs"].items()}
    return view,row["choice"]["rows"][6]["key"]


def compare_frames(predicted, expected, *, actual):
    if len(predicted)!=len(expected):
        raise AssertionError("Frame count")
    for a,b in zip(predicted,expected):
        tick = a["tick"]
        endpoint = b["actual_endpoints"]["1"] if actual else b
        q = endpoint["quality"]["status"] if actual else endpoint["Q"]
        p = b["progress"]["1"] if actual else b["progress"]
        exact_tree([tick,a["G"],a["Q"],a["progress"]],[b["tick"],endpoint["G"],q,p],f"/tick/{tick}")
        for k in ("positions","control"):
            np.testing.assert_allclose(a[k],b[k],rtol=0,atol=1e-12,err_msg=f"tick {tick} {k}")


class ShadowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        if not all((p/"R_D60.json").is_file() for p in ROOTS):
            raise unittest.SkipTest("Local frozen VALUE evidence is required")
        cls.rows = [load(p) for p in ROOTS]
        cls.view, cls.key = inputs(cls.rows[0])
        cls.hypotheses = [Hypothesis((9.,10.3),(0.,0.)),Hypothesis((9.2,10.1),(.4,0.)),
                          Hypothesis((9.03,10.29),(.02,0.))]

    def test_a_nominal(self):
        for k in ("policy_input","choice","evidence"):
            exact_tree(self.rows[0][k],self.rows[1][k],"/"+k)
        a, = predict_windows(self.view,self.key,self.hypotheses[:1])
        old = self.rows[0]["choice"]["rows"][6]
        compare_frames(a["frames"][1:],old["frames"][:20],actual=False)
        resets = [{"kind":"RESET",**{k:v for k,v in r.items() if k not in ("tick","reasons")}}
                  for r in a["resets"]]
        exact_tree(resets,[e for e in old["events"] if e["kind"]=="RESET" and e["time"]<=4],"/reset")

    def test_b_value1(self):
        a, = predict_windows(self.view,self.key,self.hypotheses[1:2])
        compare_frames(a["frames"],self.rows[0]["step"]["frames"],actual=True)
        self.assertEqual(a["final_progress"],0.)
        self.assertEqual([(r["tick"],r["reasons"],r["progress_before"]) for r in a["resets"]],
                         [(62,["GEOMETRY_INVALID"],.05)])

    def test_c_value2(self):
        a, = predict_windows(self.view,self.key,self.hypotheses[2:])
        compare_frames(a["frames"],self.rows[1]["step"]["frames"],actual=True)
        self.assertEqual((a["first_qualified_tick"],a["longest_intervals"],a["resets"]),(74,6,[]))
        self.assertAlmostEqual(a["final_progress"],.30)

    def test_d_shared_control_is_exact_and_view_unchanged(self):
        before = copy.deepcopy(self.view)
        shared = predict_windows(self.view,self.key,self.hypotheses)
        independent = predict_windows(self.view,self.key,self.hypotheses,share_control=False)
        self.assertEqual(shared,independent)
        self.assertEqual(before,self.view)
        for a,b in zip(shared[1]["frames"],shared[2]["frames"]):
            self.assertEqual(a["control"],b["control"])
            self.assertEqual(a["positions"],b["positions"])
        self.assertNotEqual(shared[1]["final_progress"],shared[2]["final_progress"])

    def test_e_escaping_hypothesis_refused(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,"escape"):
            predict_windows(self.view,self.key,[Hypothesis((19.9,10.),(.4,0.))])

from copy import deepcopy

def compare_reference(view,h):
    native = predict_feedback(public_input(view)[0],h)
    from contextlib import ExitStack
    with ExitStack() as stack:
        probes = [stack.enter_context(patch.object(cls,name,side_effect=AssertionError(name))) for cls,name in (
            (Beliefs,"enqueue"),(OnlineEnvironment,"step"),(NonOracleEnvironment,"_fuse"),(ActualMeasurementCache,"query"))]
        result = predict_f1(view,h)
        assert all(p.call_count==0 for p in probes)
    assert result["segment"]==native["segment"]
    left,right = result["feedback"],native["feedback"]
    fields = ("internal_science_mirror","accepted_history")
    assert all(left[k]==right[k] for k in fields)
    stripped = lambda rows:[{k:v for k,v in row.items() if k!="receipt_id"} for row in rows]
    assert stripped(left["consumption"])==stripped(right["consumption"])
    errors = dict(control=0.,positions=0.,bearings=0.)
    differences = []
    for part in ("prefix","F1"):
        x,y = result[part],native[part]
        assert x["first_new_fusion_tick"]==y["first_new_fusion_tick"]==(60 if part=="prefix" else 81)
        assert x["estimator_calls"]==y["estimator_calls"]
        for a,b in zip(x["rows"],y["rows"],strict=True):
            for k in ("tick","G","Q","progress","resets","completed","released","segment_id"):
                assert a[k]==b[k],(h.label,part,a["tick"],k,a[k],b[k])
            assert a["provenance"]["observation_origin"]=="MODEL" and not a["assembly"]["actual"]
            assert a["result"]["stream_id"]!=b["result"]["stream_id"]
            for row in (a,b):
                r = row["result"]
                assert r["frame_id"]==f'{r["stream_id"]}:tick{row["tick"]}'
                assert all(p["packet_id"]==f'{r["frame_id"]}:{p["sensor_id"]}' for p in row["assembly"]["frame"]["records"])
            for k,l,r in (("control",a["control"],b["control"]),("positions",a["positions"],b["positions"]),
                          ("bearings",a["result"]["payload"]["bearings"],b["result"]["payload"]["bearings"])):
                np.testing.assert_allclose(l,r,atol=ATOL,rtol=0,err_msg=f"{h.label}/{part}/{a['tick']}/{k}")
                errors[k]=max(errors[k],float(np.max(np.abs(np.asarray(l)-np.asarray(r)))))
            if a["result"]["estimate_result"]!=b["result"]["estimate_result"]:
                differences.append(dict(part=part,tick=a["tick"]))
            left_est,right_est = (r["result"]["estimate_result"] for r in (a,b))
            assert (left_est is None)==(right_est is None)
            if left_est is not None:
                for k in ("has_accepted_estimate","optimizer_converged","numerical_ill_conditioned",
                          "ambiguity_detected","boundary_active","numeric_contract_violation"):
                    assert left_est[k]==right_est[k],(h.label,part,a["tick"],k)
                if left_est["has_accepted_estimate"]:
                    np.testing.assert_allclose(left_est["estimate"],right_est["estimate"],rtol=0,atol=ATOL)
    assert result["cost"]["wls"]<=41 and "F0" not in result
    return result,dict(max_errors=errors,internal_wls_differences=differences,
                       sw2_calls=sum(native[k]["estimator_calls"] for k in ("prefix","F0","F1")),
                       sw2_f1_calls=sum(native[k]["estimator_calls"] for k in ("prefix","F1")))


class PublicSelectionTests(TestCase):
    def test_library_and_selection(self):
        v = public_view()
        for method,expected in (("M0",["N/N"]),("M1",["N/N","X+/E","Y−/NE"]),
                                ("M2",["N/N","Y−/N","Y+/北"])):
            with patch("research.non_oracle.policy.estimate",side_effect=AssertionError):
                r = select_hypotheses(v,method)
            self.assertEqual(len(r["all_candidates"]),30)
            self.assertEqual([h.label for h in r["all_candidates"][:6]],["N/N","N/E","N/NE","N/SE","N/北","N/南"])
            self.assertEqual([h.label for h in r["selected"]],expected)
        self.assertEqual(digest([-0.]),digest([0.]))
        v2 = deepcopy(v)
        v2["beliefs"]={int(k):b for k,b in v2["beliefs"].items()}
        v2["beliefs"][0]["diagnostics"]={"unread_diagnostic":1}
        self.assertEqual(select_hypotheses(v,"M2")["public_sha256"],select_hypotheses(v2,"M2")["public_sha256"])

    def test_invalid_public_input(self):
        for mutation in (lambda v:v.update(tick=61),lambda v:v.update(private_world={}),
                         lambda v:v["targets"][1].update(velocity_prior=[.1,0.]),
                         lambda v:v["targets"][1].update(design_error_bound=math.inf),
                         lambda v:v["positions"][0].__setitem__(0,math.nan),
                         lambda v:v["targets"][1].update(position_at_birth=[9.,10.])):
            v=public_view()
            mutation(v)
            with self.assertRaises((ValueError,TypeError)):
                select_hypotheses(v,"M0")

    def test_filter_dedup_and_ties(self):
        _,cfg,t = public_input(public_view())
        _,legal = library(dict(t,coarse_position=[19.5,10.]),cfg)
        self.assertNotIn("X+/E",[h.label for h in legal])
        self.assertEqual(pick_m1(legal)[1],legal[1])
        _,dedup = library(dict(t,design_error_bound=1e-100),cfg)
        self.assertEqual(len(dedup),6)
        self.assertEqual(pick_m2(dedup,{h.label:(1,0,0.) for h in dedup}),dedup[:3])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,"BLOCKED"):
            library(dict(t,coarse_position=[20.,10.]),cfg)

    def test_geometry_and_quantization(self):
        v,cfg,_ = public_input(public_view())
        point=[0.,0.]
        team=[dict(robot_id=i,role=r) for i,r in TEAM]
        slots=[s for s in v["current_slots"] if s["slot_key"]["target_id"]==1]
        base=np.array([offset(r,cfg) for _,r in TEAM])
        for i in (0,1):
            for error in (.01,.3,radius(cfg),np.nextafter(radius(cfg),0),np.nextafter(radius(cfg),math.inf)):
                pos=base.copy()
                pos[i,0]+=error
                official=assemble_left_state(tick=60,target_id=1,target_position=point,
                    positions=pos.tolist()+[[2.,2.]],sensor_profiles=v["sensor_profiles"],current_slots=slots,
                    team=team,stream_id="SW3:model-test",actual=False)
                self.assertEqual(margin(pos,point,cfg)>=0,official["G"])
        self.assertEqual(score([1.]*22+[-1.]*19)[:2],(21,10**12))
        self.assertEqual(score([1/8192]*41)[1],122070312)


class FeedbackTests(TestCase):
    def test_boundary_and_aggregation(self):
        self.assertEqual(outcome({"tick":100,"completed":True})["completion_tick"],100)
        self.assertEqual(outcome({"tick":100,"completed":False})["terminal_status"],"ACTIVE_AT_H")
        r=lambda t,c:dict(public_sha256="cut",offline_diagnostic=False,Y_H=outcome(dict(tick=t,completed=c)),
                         cost=dict(wls=0,frames=0,intervals=0,wall=0,cpu=0))
        both=aggregate([r(91,True),r(97,True),r(91,True),r(100,False)])
        self.assertEqual(both["predicted_completion_ticks"],[91,97])
        self.assertEqual(both["completion_time_envelope"],[91,97])
        self.assertTrue(both["noncompletion_possible"])
        self.assertIsNone(aggregate([r(100,False)])["completion_time_envelope"])
        self.assertEqual(aggregate([r(100,False)])["predicted_completion_ticks"],[])
        fixture=r(91,True)
        cloned=aggregate([fixture,fixture])
        cloned["results"][0]["Y_H"]["completion_tick"]=1
        self.assertEqual(fixture["Y_H"]["completion_tick"],91)
        separate=r(91,True)
        cloned=aggregate([fixture,separate])
        cloned["results"][0]["Y_H"]["completion_tick"]=1
        self.assertEqual(cloned["results"][1]["Y_H"]["completion_tick"],91)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            aggregate([dict(fixture,offline_diagnostic=True)])

    def test_unchanged_input_and_forged_source(self):
        v=public_view()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            consume_model([dict(source="ACTUAL")],v["beliefs"]["1"],.8)
        a=deepcopy(v)
        result=predict_f1(v,select_hypotheses(v,"M0")["selected"][0])
        self.assertEqual(result["actual_simulation_end_tick"],97)
        self.assertEqual(result["F1"]["rows"][-1]["tick"],97)
        self.assertEqual(result["F1"]["rows"][-1]["released"],[0,1])
        self.assertEqual(result["Y_H"]["observation_end_tick"],100)
        production=Beliefs([v["targets"][1]])
        mirror=result["feedback"]["internal_science_mirror"]
        self.assertEqual(mirror["source"],"ACTUAL_WLS")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            production.enqueue(mirror)
        self.assertEqual(production.pending,[])
        result["prefix"]["rows"][0]["positions"][0][0]=-1
        self.assertEqual(v,a)
        self.assertNotEqual(result["F1"]["rows"][0]["positions"][0][0],-1)

from copy import deepcopy
from unittest import TestCase
from unittest.mock import patch

from research.non_oracle import sw3_physical_admissibility_v1 as admission
from research.non_oracle.sw3_c1_private_worlds import private_world
from scripts.run_a2_prediction_sw3_dev import FAMILIES, read


class AdmissibilityTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.template = read("configs/a2_value2_two_target_v1.json")

    def test_first_rejection_and_next_hash(self):
        old = private_world(self.template, "dev", 11, 0, [])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "eastward envelope"):
            admission.construct(old["world"])
        new = admission.sample(self.template, "dev", 11, 0, [])
        first = new["attempts"][0]
        self.assertEqual(first["draws"], old["attempts"][0]["draws"])
        self.assertEqual(first["rejection"], "HEADING_OUT_OF_PHYSICAL_ENVELOPE")
        self.assertEqual([r["a"] for r in new["attempts"]], list(range(new["accepted_a"] + 1)))
        self.assertEqual(new["attempts"][1]["draws"][0],
                         admission.draw_component("dev", 11, 0, 1, 0))
        self.assertNotEqual(first["draws"], new["attempts"][1]["draws"])

    def test_twelve_constructible_distinct_worlds(self):
        for family in FAMILIES:
            previous = []
            for w in range(4):
                result = admission.sample(self.template, "dev", family, w, previous)
                self.assertEqual(result["status"], "ACCEPTED")
                self.assertLessEqual(len(result["attempts"]), 32)
                world = result["world"]
                self.assertNotIn(world, previous)
                admission.construct(world)
                previous.append(world)

    def test_exhaustion_and_duplicate(self):
        with patch.object(admission, "reject_motion", return_value="DUPLICATE"):
            result = admission.sample(self.template, "dev", 11, 0, [])
        self.assertEqual(result["status"], "EXHAUSTED")
        self.assertEqual([r["a"] for r in result["attempts"]], list(range(32)))
        first = admission.sample(self.template, "dev", 11, 0, [])
        draws = first["attempts"][-1]["draws"]
        with patch.object(admission, "draw_component", side_effect=lambda s, n, w, a, j, **kw: draws[j]):
            result = admission.sample(self.template, "dev", 11, 1, [first["world"]])
        self.assertTrue(all(r["rejection"] == "DUPLICATE" for r in result["attempts"]))

    def test_fixed_and_unknown_errors_propagate(self):
        bad = deepcopy(self.template)
        bad["positions_initial"] = []
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "independent positions"):
            admission.sample(bad, "dev", 11, 0, [])
        with patch.object(admission, "construct", side_effect=[None, RuntimeError("unknown")]):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "unknown"):
                admission.sample(self.template, "dev", 11, 0, [])

class IsolationAndLabelTests(TestCase):
    def test_mock_four_public_views_and_seals(self):
        v=read("runs/a2_value2_open_001/R_D60.json")["policy_input"]
        views=[deepcopy(v) for _ in range(4)]
        handoff=compare_family(views)
        views[-1]["positions"][0][0]+=.1
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,"/positions/0/0"):
            compare_family(views)
        forged=deepcopy(v)
        forged["beliefs"]["0"]["diagnostics"]={"world_id":"private"}
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,"/beliefs/0/diagnostics/world_id"):
            public_handoff(forged)
        summary=dict(predicted_completion_status_set=[True],predicted_completion_ticks=[97],
                     completion_time_envelope=[97,97],noncompletion_possible=False)
        sealed=seal_prediction(v,"M0",summary,sequence=0)
        self.assertEqual(verify_prediction_seal(v,sealed),handoff["public_sha256"])
        private=archive_private({"fixture":True},{"source":"ACTUAL"})
        self.assertEqual(association_receipt(v,sealed,private,sequence=1)["sequence"],1)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            association_receipt(v,sealed,private,sequence=0)
        sealed["body"]["summary"]["predicted_completion_ticks"]=[98]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            verify_prediction_seal(v,sealed)

    def test_constructed_horizon_boundary_and_invalid_label(self):
        at=dict(event_tick=100,time_seconds=5.)
        event=dict(target_id=1,kind="COMPLETED",at=at,event_index=3)
        step=dict(status="COMMITTED",end_tick=100,events=[event])
        state=dict(tick=100,statuses=["active","completed"],events=[event],assignment=[{"target":None}]*3,
                   archives={"1":dict(terminal_status="completed",terminal_at=at,closing_event_index=3,released_robots=[0,1])})
        self.assertEqual(extract_label(step,state)["completion_tick"],100)
        active=dict(state,statuses=["active","active"],archives={},events=[])
        self.assertFalse(extract_label(dict(step,events=[]),active)["completed_by_H"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            extract_label(step,dict(active,statuses=["active","escaped"]))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            extract_label(dict(step,status="FAILED"),active)

from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest import TestCase
from unittest.mock import patch

from scripts import run_a2_prediction_sw3_dev as dev


class DevGateTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.view=dev.read("runs/a2_value2_open_001/R_D60.json")["policy_input"]

    def test_unapproved_families_and_private_input(self):
        for n in (3,7,10,5,1,8,2,0,9,True):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                dev.require_family(n)
        for forbidden in ({"position_now":[9,10]}, {"checkpoint_id":"private"}):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                dev.public_handoff(self.view|forbidden)

    def test_preparation_only_freezes_once_at_d60(self):
        prepared=[]
        view=self.view
        class FakeEnvironment:
            def __init__(self,*args):
                self.tick=0
                self.freezes=[]
                prepared.append(self)
            def prepare_decision(self):
                self.freezes.append(self.tick)
                if self.tick==60:
                    return deepcopy(view)
                return dict(targets=[{"id":0}],beliefs={0:{}})
            @property
            def decision_tick(self):
                return self.freezes[-1]
            def observe_public(self):
                return {"checkpoint_id":str(self.tick)}
        def commit(env,tick,target):
            self.assertLess(tick,60)
            self.assertEqual(target,0)
            env.tick+=20
            return {"fusion_records":[]},{"wls":0}
        with (TemporaryDirectory(dir=dev.ROOT.parent.resolve()) as tmp,
              patch.object(dev,"StaggeredEnvironment",FakeEnvironment),
              patch.object(dev,"private_world",return_value={"status":"ACCEPTED","world":{}}),
              patch.object(dev,"announcements_for",return_value={"announcements":[]}),
              patch.object(dev,"commit",side_effect=commit)):
            dev.prepare_family(11,Path(tmp),{}, {})
        self.assertEqual(len(prepared),4)
        for env in prepared:
            self.assertEqual(env.freezes,[0,20,40,60])
            self.assertEqual(env.tick,60)

    def test_mismatch_stops_before_prediction_and_labels(self):
        wrong=deepcopy(self.view)
        wrong["positions"][0][0]+=.1
        p=[dict(env=SimpleNamespace(tick=60),view=x) for x in (self.view,self.view,self.view,wrong)]
        with (TemporaryDirectory(dir=dev.ROOT.parent.resolve()) as tmp,patch.object(dev,"prepare_family",return_value=p),
              patch.object(dev,"predict_and_seal") as predict,patch.object(dev,"finish") as finish):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,"/positions/0/0"):
                dev.run_family(11,Path(tmp),{}, {})
            predict.assert_not_called()
            finish.assert_not_called()

    def test_full_seal_and_tampering(self):
        summary=dict(predicted_completion_status_set=[True],predicted_completion_ticks=[95],
                     completion_time_envelope=[95,95],noncompletion_possible=False)
        calls=[]
        def predict(view,method):
            calls.append(method)
            k=1 if method=="M0" else 3
            return dict(method=method,selection=dict(public_sha256=dev.public_handoff(view)["public_sha256"],
                selected=list(range(k)),geometry_endpoints=0,screening_wls=0),
                prediction=summary|dict(results=[{}]*k,cost=dict(wls=0)))
        with TemporaryDirectory(dir=dev.ROOT.parent.resolve()) as tmp:
            folder=Path(tmp)
            dev.save(folder/"D60.json",dev.public_handoff(self.view))
            with patch.object(dev,"commit") as commit:
                with self.assertRaises(FileNotFoundError):
                    dev.finish({},folder,self.view)
                commit.assert_not_called()
            seals=dev.predict_and_seal(folder,self.view,{},predict=predict)
            self.assertEqual(calls,list(dev.METHODS))
            self.assertEqual(list(seals),calls)
            with (folder/"M2_prediction.json").open("ab") as stream:
                stream.write(b" ")
            with patch.object(dev,"commit") as commit:
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,"content changed"):
                    dev.finish({},folder,self.view)
                commit.assert_not_called()

import copy
