ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

def actions(target, robots=(0, 1), roles=('dual_neg45', 'dual_pos45')):
    result = [dict(target=None, role='none') for _ in range(3)]
    for robot, role in zip(robots, roles):
        result[robot] = dict(target=target, role=role)
    return result

class A2Tests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.world = json.loads((ROOT/'configs/a2_two_target_staggered_min.json').read_text())
        cls.ann = json.loads((ROOT/'configs/a2_public_announcements.json').read_text())['announcements']
        cls.prefix = cls.build(cls.world)
        cls.views = []
        for tick in (0, 20, 40):
            cls.views.append(cls.prefix.prepare_decision())
            result = cls.step(cls.prefix, actions(0))
            assert result['status'] == 'COMMITTED'
        assert cls.prefix.tick == 60 and not cls.prefix.done

    @classmethod
    def build(cls, world):
        return StaggeredEnvironment(copy.deepcopy(world), Sensing(), 'A2_TEST', cls.ann)

    @staticmethod
    def step(env, choice):
        return env.step(choice, env.observe_public()['checkpoint_id'], env.tick, f'test_{env.tick}')

    def at_birth(self):
        env = copy.deepcopy(self.prefix)
        return env, env.prepare_decision()

    def test_birth_and_hidden_observations(self):
        for view in self.views:
            self.assertEqual([t['id'] for t in view['targets']], [0])
            self.assertEqual(set(view['beliefs']), {0})
            self.assertTrue(all(s['slot_key']['target_id']==0 for s in view['current_slots']))
        self.assertTrue(all(f['frame']['target_id']==0 for f in self.prefix.fusions))
        env, view = self.at_birth()
        self.assertEqual([t['id'] for t in view['targets']], [0, 1])
        self.assertEqual(view['beliefs'][1]['status'], 'PRIOR_ONLY')
        self.assertIsNone(view['beliefs'][1]['last_observation_tick'])
        self.assertEqual(view['beliefs'][1]['estimate_tick'], 60)

    def test_unannounced_assignment_rejected(self):
        env = self.build(self.world)
        env.prepare_decision()
        self.assertEqual(self.step(env, actions(1))['status'], 'REJECTED')

    def test_invalid_announcement(self):
        ann = copy.deepcopy(self.ann)
        ann[1]['announcement_tick'] = 40
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'coincide'):
            StaggeredEnvironment(self.world, Sensing(), 'BAD', ann)

    def test_truth_isolation_before_and_after_birth(self):
        world = copy.deepcopy(self.world)
        world['targets'][1]['position_at_birth'] = [12., 11.]
        other = self.build(world)
        for original in self.views:
            self.assertEqual(other.prepare_decision(), original)
            self.step(other, actions(0))
        _, baseline = self.at_birth()
        changed = other.prepare_decision()
        self.assertEqual(baseline, changed)
        baseline['end_tick'] = changed['end_tick'] = 61
        self.assertEqual(decide(baseline), decide(changed))

    def test_cross_target_change_and_no_backfill(self):
        env, view = self.at_birth()
        result = self.step(env, actions(1))
        commit = result['action_commit']; transitions = commit['transitions']
        self.assertEqual([x['kind'] for x in transitions], ['WITHDRAW', 'FIRST_ASSIGNMENT'])
        self.assertEqual(commit['assignment_change_count'], 2)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(commit['change_cost'], .02)
        self.assertEqual(result['frames'][0]['progress']['1'], 0.)
        self.assertTrue(any(x['target_id']==1 and x['measurement_tick']==60 for x in env.beliefs.pending))
        self.assertEqual(view['beliefs'][1]['status'], 'PRIOR_ONLY')
        env.prepare_decision()
        self.assertTrue(any(x['target_id']==1 and x['measurement_tick']==60 and x['consumed_tick']==80 for x in env.beliefs.consumed))

    def test_team_and_role_resets(self):
        for label, choice in [('MEMBER_CHANGE', actions(0,(0,2))), ('ROLE_CHANGE', actions(0,roles=('dual_pos45','dual_neg45')))]:
            with self.subTest(label=label):
                env, _ = self.at_birth(); result = self.step(env, choice)
                t = result['action_commit']['transitions'][0]
                self.assertEqual(t['kind'], label)
                self.assertEqual(t['clock_after']['intervals'], 0)
                self.assertEqual(t['clock_after']['base'], 0.)

    def test_keep_prediction_and_natural_release(self):
        env, view = self.at_birth(); original = copy.deepcopy(view)
        view['end_tick'] = 61
        key = dict(target=0, robots=[0,1], roles=['dual_neg45','dual_pos45'])
        with patch('research.non_oracle.policy.endpoint', return_value=(False,'PASS')):
            row = evaluate(view, key)
        self.assertTrue(row['kept_history']); self.assertEqual(row['frames'][0]['progress'], 0.)
        self.assertEqual(view['histories'], original['histories'])
        result = self.step(env, actions(0)); self.assertEqual(result['action_commit']['transitions'][0]['kind'], 'KEEP')
        self.assertEqual(result['action_commit']['change_cost'], 0.)
        archive = env.private_snapshot()['state']['archives']['0']
        self.assertEqual(archive['release_change_cost'], 0.)
        self.assertEqual([t['id'] for t in env.prepare_decision()['targets']], [1])

    def test_modes_candidate_coverage_and_plan_evidence(self):
        env, born = self.at_birth()
        for view, count, legal in [(copy.deepcopy(self.views[0]),6,7),(born,12,13)]:
            view['end_tick'] = view['tick']+1
            a=decide(view,'R'); b=decide(view,'S_NEW')
            self.assertEqual(a,b); self.assertEqual(len(a['rows']),count)
            evidence=decision_evidence(view,a,env.beliefs.accepted_receipts)
            self.assertEqual(evidence['legal_plan_count'],legal)
            prior=evidence['targets'][-1];self.assertIsNone(prior['observation_age_ticks'])
            self.assertEqual(prior['announcement_age_ticks'],0)
            if count==12:
                observed=evidence['targets'][0]
                self.assertEqual(observed['corresponding_consumed_tick'],60)
                self.assertEqual(observed['observation_age_ticks'],0)

    def test_cache_cannot_cross_birth(self):
        _, after=self.at_birth()
        before=copy.deepcopy(self.views[0]);cache={}
        key=dict(target=0,robots=[0,1],roles=['dual_neg45','dual_pos45'])
        before['end_tick']=1;after['end_tick']=61
        evaluate(before,key,cache);old=set(cache)
        self.assertEqual(evaluate(after,key,cache),evaluate(after,key))
        self.assertTrue(set(cache)-old)
        self.assertTrue({k[0] for k in old}.isdisjoint({k[0] for k in set(cache)-old}))

    def test_rejected_duplicate_does_not_change_observation_provenance(self):
        env, view = self.at_birth()
        receipt = env.beliefs.accepted_receipts[0].copy()
        tick = receipt['measurement_tick']
        env.beliefs.enqueue(dict(source='ACTUAL', target_id=0, measurement_tick=tick,
                                 available_tick=tick, estimate=view['beliefs'][0]['diagnostics']))
        env.beliefs.freeze(80)
        self.assertEqual(env.beliefs.consumed[-1]['consumed_tick'], 80)
        self.assertEqual(env.beliefs.accepted_receipts[0], receipt)

if __name__=='__main__': unittest.main()

"""核对冻结输入。自主前缀单独执行一次，回归测试不重复运行它。"""
import json

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

def load(name):
    return json.loads((ROOT / 'configs' / name).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

class SwitchInputs(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_only_registered_world_parameters_change(self):
        expected = load('a2_two_target_staggered_min.json')
        expected['targets'][0]['service_duration'] = 2.25
        expected['targets'][1].update(weight=1.5, deadline=5.0)
        self.assertEqual(load('a2_switch_two_target_v1.json'), expected)

    def test_only_registered_announcement_parameters_change(self):
        expected = load('a2_public_announcements.json')
        expected['announcements'][0]['service_duration'] = 2.25
        expected['announcements'][1].update(weight=1.5, deadline=5.0)
        self.assertEqual(load('a2_switch_public_announcements_v1.json'), expected)

    def test_public_metadata_matches_world(self):
        world = load('a2_switch_two_target_v1.json')
        announcements = load('a2_switch_public_announcements_v1.json')['announcements']
        self.assertEqual(len(world['targets']), len(announcements))
        fields = ('id', 'birth', 'weight', 'deadline', 'service_duration', 'required_robots')
        for target, announcement in zip(world['targets'], announcements):
            self.assertEqual({k: target[k] for k in fields}, {k: announcement[k] for k in fields})
            self.assertEqual(announcement['announcement_tick'], round(target['birth'] / world['config']['step_dt']))

from fractions import Fraction

class Value2DesignTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        if not Path("reports/a2_value2_preflight_001/HISTORICAL_PINS.json").is_file():
            raise unittest.SkipTest("Frozen local design evidence is required")
        cls.result = analyse()

    def test_schema_and_announcement_boundary(self):
        world = read("configs/a2_value2_two_target_v1.json")
        ann = read("configs/a2_value2_public_announcements_v1.json")["announcements"]
        Config(**world["config"])
        for data in world["targets"]:
            Target(**data)
        env = object.__new__(StaggeredEnvironment)
        env._validate_announcements(world, ann)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            env._validate_announcements(world,[ann[0],dict(ann[1],announcement_tick=40)])
        self.assertEqual(ann[1]["announcement_tick"],60)

    def test_frozen_positive_progress_and_real_nonzero_error(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.result["locked_t0_progress"],.6)
        self.assertEqual(self.result["locked_t0_remaining"],1.65)
        self.assertGreater(self.result["position_error"],0)
        self.assertEqual(self.result["velocity_error"],.02)

    def test_both_endpoints_and_reset(self):
        self.assertIsNone(first_service([True,False,True],1))
        self.assertIsNone(first_service([True]*21,21))
        self.assertEqual(first_service([True]*22,21),(0,21))
        self.assertEqual(first_service([True,True,False]+[True]*22,21),(3,24))

    def test_integer_windows(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.result["service_intervals"],21)
        self.assertEqual(self.result["zero_slack_tick"],99)
        self.assertEqual(self.result["minimum_slack_ticks"],4)
        self.assertEqual(self.result["first_sustainable_tick"],74)
        self.assertEqual(self.result["conditional_complete_tick"],95)
        self.assertEqual(self.result["slack_ticks"],25)
        self.assertEqual(self.result["assumed_observation_consumption_tick"],80)
        self.assertEqual(self.result["locked_release_tick"],93)
        self.assertEqual(next_cut(93,20),100)
        self.assertEqual(next_cut(80,20),80)
        self.assertEqual(self.result["locked_t1_slack_best_case"],-.05)

    def test_conditional_accounting(self):
        d = self.result["ledger"]["delta"]
        self.assertEqual(Fraction(d["completion"])+Fraction(d["terminal"]),Fraction(3,16))
        self.assertAlmostEqual(d["flow"],.0021875)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(d["late"],.001875)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(d["change"],-.02)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(sum(v for k,v in d.items() if k!="net"),d["net"])

    def test_frozen_history_and_static_entrypoint(self):

                         sha("configs/a2_switch_public_announcements_v1.json"))

import copy
from pathlib import Path
import unittest

from scripts.run_a2_value2_locked import compare_before_action, compare_prefork_step, load_open, read


class DynamicForkTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def rows(self, tick, fork=False):
        opened = dict(policy_input=dict(tick=tick, belief=[1.,2.]),
                      choice=dict(actions=[0], rows=[.25,.5], exact_value="1/4"), evidence={})
        locked = copy.deepcopy(opened)
        locked["locked"] = dict(protection={"target":1} if fork else None,
                                selected=dict(actions=[1] if fork else [0],exact_value="1/8"))
        return opened, locked

    def test_early_late_and_no_fork(self):
        for fork in (60,100,None):
            result = None
            for tick in range(0,120,20):
                result = compare_before_action(*self.rows(tick,tick==fork),[],[],"R",tick)
                if result is not None:
                    break
            self.assertEqual(result["FIRST_FORK_TICK"] if result else None,fork)
            if result:
                self.assertEqual(result["OPEN_ACTION"],[0])
                self.assertEqual(result["LOCKED_ACTION"],[1])

    def test_fork_cannot_mask_scientific_differences(self):
        for change in ("belief","candidate","order","consumed"):
            a,b = self.rows(80,True)
            observed = []
            if change=="belief":
                b["policy_input"]["belief"][0] += .01
            elif change=="candidate":
                b["choice"]["rows"][0] += .01
            elif change=="order":
                b["choice"]["rows"].reverse()
            else:
                observed = [dict(consumed_tick=80)]
            with self.assertRaises(Exception):
                compare_before_action(a,b,[],observed,"R",80)

    def test_fixed_identity_paths(self):
        a = dict(fusion_records=[dict(context=dict(work_instance_id="A2_R"))])
        b = dict(fusion_records=[dict(context=dict(work_instance_id="A2_VALUE2_LOCKED_R"))])
        self.assertEqual(compare_prefork_step(a,b,"R",20),1)
        b["fusion_records"][0]["context"]["work_instance_id"]="A2_VALUE1_LOCKED_R"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,"work_instance_id"):
            compare_prefork_step(a,b,"R",20)

    def test_old_open_is_rejected_for_new_world(self):
        root = Path("runs/a2_switch_episode_001")
        if not root.is_dir():
            self.skipTest("Local historical evidence is unavailable")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(Exception,"/world"):
            load_open(root,read(Path("configs/a2_value2_two_target_v1.json")),
                      read(Path("configs/a2_value2_public_announcements_v1.json")))

from types import SimpleNamespace

def read(name):
    return json.loads((OPEN / (name + ".json")).read_bytes())


class ValueLockTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        if not (OPEN / "R_D60.json").is_file():
            raise unittest.SkipTest("Local frozen A2-S2 OPEN evidence is required")
        cls.r = read("R_D60")
        cls.s = read("S_NEW_D60")

    def setUp(self):
        self.view = copy.deepcopy(self.r["policy_input"])
        self.choice = copy.deepcopy(self.r["choice"])
        self.clock = self.view["histories"][0]["segments"][0]["latest_clock"]

    def test_exact_frozen_plan_and_all_exclusions(self):
        lock = protected_team(self.view)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(lock["progress"], .6)
        chosen = select(self.view, self.choice, lock)
        self.assertEqual(chosen["selected_indices"], [0])
        self.assertEqual(chosen["exact_value"], "-354669055230257/1125899906842624")
        self.assertEqual(self.choice, self.r["choice"])
        self.assertEqual(self.choice, self.s["choice"])
        self.assertEqual(self.choice["selected_indices"], [6])
        self.assertEqual(self.choice["exact_value"], "-41523928784916923/288230376151711744")
        evidence = audit_selection(self.view, self.choice, lock, chosen)
        self.assertEqual(len(evidence["original_legal_plans"]), 13)
        self.assertEqual(evidence["feasible_ranking"], [[0]])
        self.assertEqual(chosen["actions"][2], {"target": None, "role": "none"})
        for plan in evidence["original_legal_plans"]:
            with self.subTest(plan=plan["selected"]):
                self.assertEqual(plan["lock_feasible"], plan["selected"] == [0])

    def test_zero_then_recovered(self):
        self.clock["intervals"] = 0
        self.assertIsNone(protected_team(self.view))
        self.clock["intervals"] = 1
        self.assertAlmostEqual(protected_team(self.view)["progress"], .05)

    def test_invalid_clock(self):
        for field, value in (("base", -1), ("base", float("nan")), ("base", float("inf")),
                             ("intervals", -1), ("intervals", 1.5), ("intervals", True), ("intervals", 61)):
            with self.subTest(field=field, value=value):
                self.clock.update(base=0., intervals=12)
                self.clock[field] = value
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "clock"):
                    protected_team(self.view)

    def test_mismatched_role_team_and_inactive_release(self):
        self.view["assignment"][0]["role"] = "dual_pos45"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "teams differ"):
            protected_team(self.view)
        self.view["targets"].pop(0)
        self.view["assignment"] = [{"target": None, "role": "none"} for _ in range(3)]
        self.assertIsNone(protected_team(self.view))

    def test_missing_active_segment_with_assignment(self):
        self.view["histories"][0]["active_segment_id"] = None
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "without active"):
            protected_team(self.view)

    def test_nonpositive_keep_retained(self):
        keep = self.choice["rows"][0]
        keep["absolute_O"] = keep["baseline"] - 10.
        keep["v"] = float(keep["absolute_O"] - keep["baseline"])
        lock = protected_team(self.view)
        selected = select(self.view, self.choice, lock)
        self.assertEqual(audit_selection(self.view, self.choice, lock, selected)["feasible_ranking"], [[0]])

    def test_no_lock_native_tie(self):
        self.clock["intervals"] = 0
        self.view["assignment"] = [{"target": None, "role": "none"} for _ in range(3)]
        self.view["histories"][0]["active_segment_id"] = None
        rows = self.choice["rows"]
        for row in rows:
            row.update(absolute_O=1., baseline=0., v=1.)
        specs = [SimpleNamespace(**row["key"], index=i, mask=sum(1 << r for r in row["key"]["robots"]))
                 for i, row in enumerate(rows)]
        obs = SimpleNamespace(assignment=tuple(Assignment(**a) for a in self.view["assignment"]),
                              config=SimpleNamespace(change_cost=self.view["config"]["change_cost"]))
        chosen, _ = solve(obs, specs, [1.] * len(rows))
        self.assertEqual(chosen, (0,))
        self.choice.update(selected_indices=[0], actions=self.r["policy_input"]["assignment"],
                           exact_value="282465768628677509/288230376151711744")
        selected = select(self.view, self.choice, protected_team(self.view))
        self.assertEqual(selected["selected_indices"], [0])
        audit_selection(self.view, self.choice, None, selected)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            audit_selection(self.view, self.choice, None, dict(selected, selected_indices=[1]))

    def test_lock_uses_no_world_or_prediction_fields(self):
        expected = protected_team(self.view)
        self.view.pop("beliefs")
        self.view.pop("current_slots")
        self.assertEqual(protected_team(self.view), expected)

    def test_open_inventory_and_scientific_rejections(self):
        runs = load_open(OPEN, read("WORLD_INPUT"), read("PUBLIC_INPUT"))
        self.assertEqual(len(runs["S_NEW"]), 6)
        compare_cut(self.r, self.s, "R", 60)
        for field in ("beliefs", "assignment"):
            modified = copy.deepcopy(self.r)
            modified["policy_input"].pop(field)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(Exception, field):
                compare_cut(self.r, modified, "R", 60)
        modified = copy.deepcopy(self.r)
        modified["choice"]["rows"][0]["v"] += .125
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(Exception, "/choice/rows/0/v"):
            compare_cut(self.r, modified, "R", 60)
        for field in ("control", "progress"):
            step = copy.deepcopy(self.r["step"])
            step["frames"][0][field] = []
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(Exception, field):
                compare_prefork_step(self.r["step"], step, "R", 60)

    def test_narrow_identity_admission(self):
        before = {"fusion_records": [{"context": {"work_instance_id": "A2_R"}}]}
        after = {"fusion_records": [{"context": {"work_instance_id": "A2_VALUE1_LOCKED_R"}}]}
        self.assertEqual(compare_prefork_step(before, after, "R", 0), 1)
        after["fusion_records"][0]["context"]["work_instance_id"] = "foreign"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "/fusion_records/0/context/work_instance_id"):
            compare_prefork_step(before, after, "R", 0)

class AcceptanceTests(unittest.TestCase):

ORIGIN='D:/1st/gq_windows_release_verification/both_360_validation_001'
class VirtualReader:
 raw={}
 def __init__(self,root):self.files={}
 def relative(self,name,expected=None):
  s=str(name).replace('\\','/');s=s[len(ORIGIN)+1:] if s.startswith(ORIGIN+'/') else s
  if s.startswith('/') or '..' in s.split('/') or ':' in s:raise EvidenceError('INVALID_EVIDENCE',s,'outside run directory')
  if expected is not None and s!=expected:raise EvidenceError('INVALID_EVIDENCE',s,'wrong artifact reference')
  if s not in self.raw:raise EvidenceError('INCOMPLETE',s,'missing artifact')
  return s
 def read(self,name,expected=None):
  s=self.relative(name,expected);self.files[s]='fixture';return json.loads(self.raw[s])
 def path(self,name,expected=None):
  raw=self.raw[self.relative(name,expected)]
  class Bytes:
   def read_bytes(self):return raw
  return Bytes()
class IntegrationTests(unittest.TestCase):
 @classmethod

  v=json.loads(VirtualReader.raw[name]);mutate(v);VirtualReader.raw[name]=json.dumps(v).encode()

"""Inventory primitives only; these tests never grant scientific acceptance."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import unittest
import uuid
from scripts.gq_windows.a0_evidence import Reader, EvidenceError, inventory

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

class EvidenceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.root=ROOT/'reports/a0_i_fixture_tests'/uuid.uuid4().hex
        self.root.mkdir(parents=True)
        (self.root/'FIXTURE.json').write_text(json.dumps({'source_type':'FIXTURE'}))

    def reject(self, call, status, reason):
        with self.assertRaises(EvidenceError) as caught:
            call()
        self.assertEqual(caught.exception.status,status)
        self.assertIn(reason,caught.exception.reason)

    def test_missing_evidence(self):
        self.reject(lambda:inventory(self.root),'INCOMPLETE','missing artifact')

    def test_path_escape(self):
        self.reject(lambda:Reader(self.root).read('../outside.json'),'INVALID_EVIDENCE','outside run directory')

    def test_wrong_reference(self):
        self.reject(lambda:Reader(self.root).read('FIXTURE.json','EXPECTED.json'),'INVALID_EVIDENCE','wrong artifact reference')

    def test_duplicate_key(self):
        (self.root/'bad.json').write_text('{"x":1,"x":2}')
        self.reject(lambda:Reader(self.root).read('bad.json'),'INVALID_EVIDENCE','duplicate JSON member')

    def test_nonfinite(self):
        (self.root/'bad.json').write_text('{"x":NaN}')
        self.reject(lambda:Reader(self.root).read('bad.json'),'INVALID_EVIDENCE','NaN')

    def test_valid_repeated_reference(self):
        r=Reader(self.root)
        self.assertEqual(r.read('FIXTURE.json'),r.read('FIXTURE.json','FIXTURE.json'))
        self.assertEqual(len(r.files),1)

if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()

from unittest import TestCase
from unittest.mock import patch
from copy import deepcopy
from research.non_oracle.stfbs_d1a_audit_registration import verified_registration
from research.non_oracle.stfbs_d1a_model import Branch,Budget,nominal_world
from research.non_oracle.stfbs_d1a_history_audit import audit_branch_independent,audit_histories,register_context,model_segment_id
from research.non_oracle.stfbs_d1a_replay import digest
from tests.test_stfbs_d1a_history_repair import fake_fuse

EVIDENCE=[]
def fixture():
    v,s,contexts,manifest=verified_registration()  # Before Branch construction.
    b=Branch(v,s,nominal_world(v),'KEEP',Budget())
    with patch.object(Branch,'fuse',fake_fuse):
        b.assign(deepcopy(v['assignment']))
        b.tick=80
        for h in b.histories.values():h['cutoff_tick']=80
        b.segment(0)['latest_endpoint']=fake_fuse(b,0,b.segment(0),80)
        a=deepcopy(b.actions);a[0]['role'],a[1]['role']=a[1]['role'],a[0]['role'];b.assign(a)
    context=contexts['KEEP'];audit_branch_independent(b,context=context)
    prefix={int(k):h for k,h in __import__('json').loads(context.prefix_json).items()}
    events=[e for j,h in b.histories.items() for e in h['events'][len(prefix[j]['events']):]]
    segments=[s for j,h in b.histories.items() for s in h['segments'][len(prefix[j]['segments']):]]
    endpoints=[s['latest_endpoint'] for h in b.histories.values() for s in h['segments'] if s['latest_endpoint'].get('observation_origin')=='MODEL']
    assert events and segments and endpoints
    EVIDENCE.append(dict(case='NONEMPTY_BASELINE',events=deepcopy(events),segments=deepcopy(segments),endpoints=deepcopy(endpoints),source=manifest))
    return b,context

def expect_failure(test,b,ctx,name,mutate,pattern):
    bad=b._transaction_clone();mutate(bad)
    try:audit_branch_independent(bad,context=ctx)
    except ValueError as e:
        test.assertRegex(str(e),pattern);EVIDENCE.append(dict(case=name,reason=str(e),pattern=pattern,context_supplied=True))
    else:test.fail('Tamper accepted: '+name)

class HardeningTests(TestCase):
    def test_source_and_nonempty(self):
        b,c=fixture();self.assertEqual(audit_branch_independent(b,context=c)['status'],'PASS')
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):audit_branch_independent(b)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'External trusted'):audit_branch_independent(b,context=None)
    def test_old_false_positive(self):
        b,c=fixture();h=deepcopy(b.histories)
        for label in ('legal_without_context','tampered_without_context'):
            if label.startswith('tampered'):h[0]['segments'][-1]['events'].clear()
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'External trusted audit context required') as caught:
                audit_histories(h,b.actions,b.status,b.tick)
            EVIDENCE.append(dict(case=label,reason=str(caught.exception),semantic_test=False))
    def test_separate_record_identity(self):
        b,c=fixture()
        expect_failure(self,b,c,'ID-EVENT',lambda x:x.histories[0]['events'][-1].update(model_branch_id='SWITCH'),'Untrusted new event identity')
        expect_failure(self,b,c,'ID-SEGMENT',lambda x:x.segment(0).update(model_branch_id='SWITCH'),'Untrusted new segment identity')
        expect_failure(self,b,c,'ID-ENDPOINT',lambda x:x.segment(0)['latest_endpoint'].update(branch='SWITCH'),'Untrusted endpoint identity')
    def test_full_relabel_and_internal_context(self):
        b,c=fixture()
        def relabel(x):
            x.name='SWITCH';x._audit_context=register_context('SWITCH',x.histories)
            for h in x.histories.values():
                mapping={}
                for s in h['segments']:
                    if s.get('contract_id')=='D1A_MODEL_SERVICE_SEGMENT_V1':
                        old=s['segment_id'];s['model_branch_id']='SWITCH';s['segment_id']=model_segment_id(s);mapping[old]=s['segment_id']
                    if s['latest_endpoint'].get('observation_origin')=='MODEL':s['latest_endpoint']['branch']='SWITCH'
                h['active_segment_id']=mapping.get(h['active_segment_id'],h['active_segment_id'])
                for s in h['segments']:
                    s['previous_segment_id']=mapping.get(s['previous_segment_id'],s['previous_segment_id'])
                    for e in s['events']:
                        if e.get('observation_origin')=='MODEL':e['model_branch_id']='SWITCH'
                        e['segment_id']=mapping.get(e.get('segment_id'),e.get('segment_id'))
                    s.pop('segment_history_digest',None);s['segment_history_digest']=digest(s)
                for e in h['events']:
                    if e.get('observation_origin')=='MODEL':e['model_branch_id']='SWITCH'
                    e['segment_id']=mapping.get(e.get('segment_id'),e.get('segment_id'))
                h.pop('history_digest',None);h['history_digest']=digest(h)
        expect_failure(self,b,c,'FULL_RELABEL',relabel,'Trusted branch mismatch')
        def replace_context(x):
            x._audit_context=register_context('KEEP',x.histories)
            x.histories[0]['events'][0]['kind']='SPOOF'
            x._audit_context=register_context('KEEP',x.histories)
        expect_failure(self,b,c,'INTERNAL_CONTEXT_REPLACED',replace_context,'D60 event prefix modified')
    def test_semantic_negatives(self):
        b,c=fixture()
        with patch.object(Branch,'fuse',fake_fuse):
            b.tick=100
            for h in b.histories.values():h['cutoff_tick']=100
            b.segment(0)['latest_endpoint']=fake_fuse(b,0,b.segment(0),100)
            b.assign([dict(target=None,role='none')]*3)
        # Preset a complete unassigned state one interval later, without motion
        # execution. This makes deletion/overlap a positive-duration defect.
        b.tick=101
        for h in b.histories.values():h['cutoff_tick']=101
        audit_branch_independent(b,context=c)
        cases=[
            ('PREFIX',lambda x:x.histories[0]['events'][0].update(kind='SPOOF'),'D60 event prefix modified'),
            ('COVERAGE_GAP',lambda x:x.histories[0]['unassigned_intervals'].pop(),'History incomplete coverage'),
            ('MUTEX',lambda x:x.histories[0]['segments'][-1].update(closure=None),'Current state not unique|History coverage overlap/gap'),
            ('EVENT_INDEX',lambda x:x.histories[0]['events'][-1].update(event_index=999),'Segment event reference|Missing segment event link'),
            ('EVENT_REFERENCE',lambda x:x.histories[0]['unassigned_intervals'][-1].update(opening_event_index=999),'Gap opening reference/time'),
            ('SEGMENT_ID',lambda x:x.histories[0]['segments'][-1].update(segment_id='bad'),'MODEL segment identity'),
            ('PREDECESSOR',lambda x:x.histories[0]['segments'][-1].update(previous_segment_id='bad'),'Segment predecessor/order'),
            ('CLOSE_TIME',lambda x:x.histories[0]['segments'][-1]['closure'].update(at=dict(time_seconds=4.,event_tick=80)),'Closure event/time'),
            ('CLOSE_REASON',lambda x:x.histories[0]['segments'][-1]['closure'].update(reason='ESCAPED'),'Closure event reason'),
            ('ACTUAL_SPOOF',lambda x:x.histories[0]['events'][-1].update(observation_origin='ACTUAL'),'Untrusted new event identity')]
        for name,change,reason in cases:expect_failure(self,b,c,name,change,reason)

        before=deepcopy(raw)

    def test_stub_orchestration(self):
        for failure in (None,'history','verify','service','physical_economic','budget','context','source'):
            calls=[];instances=[];saved={};progress={};budget=SimpleNamespace(counts={'MODEL':0},check=lambda:None)
            contexts={'KEEP':object(),'SWITCH':object()}
            class StubBranch:
                def __init__(self,v,s,w,name,b):
                    self.name=name;self.budget=b;instances.append(self);calls.append('construct:'+name)
                def run(self,plan):
                    calls.append('stub_run:'+self.name);self.budget.counts['MODEL']+=1
                    return dict(world={'motion':{0:{}}},net=0.,components={'flow':0.},change_cost=0.)
            def check(label,obj=None,**kwargs):
                calls.append(label)
                if label=='history':
                    self.assertIs(obj,instances[-1]);self.assertIs(kwargs['context'],contexts[obj.name])
                if label==failure:raise ValueError('injected '+label)
                return {'status':'PASS'}
            with ExitStack() as stack:
                stack.enter_context(patch.object(driver,'Branch',StubBranch))
                stack.enter_context(patch.object(driver,'audit_branch_independent',lambda obj,**kw:check('history',obj,**kw)))
                stack.enter_context(patch.object(driver,'verify',lambda *a,**k:check('verify')))
                stack.enter_context(patch.object(driver,'service_audit',lambda *a:check('service')))
                stack.enter_context(patch.object(driver,'audit',lambda *a:check('physical_economic')))
                if failure=='budget':budget.check=lambda:check('budget')
                if failure=='context':contexts.pop('KEEP')
                if failure=='source':
                    stack.enter_context(patch.object(driver,'audit_input',side_effect=ValueError('source mismatch')))
                def run():return driver.run_pair({'targets':[{'id':0}]},{},contexts,{},dict(KEEP=[],SWITCH=[]),budget,lambda k,v:saved.update({k:v}),progress)
                if failure:
                    with self.assertRaises(ValueError):run()
                    self.assertLessEqual(len(instances),1);self.assertNotIn('MODEL_PAIR_RESULT.json',saved)
                else:
                    pair,checks=run();self.assertEqual(pair['status'],'PAIR_AUDITS_PASS_PENDING_G0_G5_REVIEW')
                    self.assertEqual(calls,['construct:KEEP','stub_run:KEEP','history','verify','service','physical_economic','construct:SWITCH','stub_run:SWITCH','history','verify','service','physical_economic'])
                    self.assertIs(instances[0].budget,instances[1].budget)
            EVIDENCE.append(dict(group='C1',failure=failure,status='PASS',calls=calls,progress=deepcopy(progress),shared_budget=True,stub_only=True))

from copy import deepcopy
from unittest import TestCase

def fake_fuse(self,j,s,tick):
    self.fusions+=1
    self.cache.counts['new']+=1
    self.consumer.pending.append(dict(artificial=True))
    return dict(tick=tick,target_id=j,team=deepcopy(s['team']),branch=self.name,G=True,quality=dict(status='PASS'),provenance='SIMULATED',observation_origin='MODEL')

def branch():
    v,s,_=recover('runs/a2_switch_episode_001');return Branch(v,s,nominal_world(v),'REPAIR_TEST',Budget())

def switch():return [dict(target=1,role='dual_neg45'),dict(target=1,role='dual_pos45'),dict(target=None,role='none')]

def snapshot(b):
    return pickle.dumps({k:v for k,v in b.__dict__.items() if k!='budget'})

class HistoryRepairTests(TestCase):
    def test_keep_switch_withdraw_unassigned(self):
        with patch.object(Branch,'fuse',fake_fuse):
            b=branch();before=deepcopy(b.segment(0));b.assign(deepcopy(b.actions))
            self.assertEqual(b.segment(0)['latest_clock'],before['latest_clock']);self.assertEqual(b.fusions,0)
            b.assign(switch());b._history_check();self.assertIsNone(b.segment(0));self.assertIsNotNone(b.segment(1))
            self.assertEqual(b.histories[1]['unassigned_intervals'][-1]['end_at']['time_seconds'],3.)
            b.assign([dict(target=None,role='none')]*3);b._history_check()
            count=len(b.histories[1]['segments']);b.assign(deepcopy(b.actions));self.assertEqual(count,len(b.histories[1]['segments']))
    def test_atomic_validation_and_prepare_failures(self):
        with patch.object(Branch,'fuse',fake_fuse):
            b=branch();before=snapshot(b)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):b.assign([dict(target=1,role='bad')]*3)
            self.assertEqual(snapshot(b),before)
            for phase in ('before_prepare','after_fusion','before_commit'):
                def fail(staged,at):
                    if at==phase:raise RuntimeError('injected')
                with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):b.assign(switch(),prepare_fault=fail)
                self.assertEqual(snapshot(b),before)
            def paid_failure(staged,at):
                if at=='after_fusion':
                    staged.budget.counts['MODEL_OBSERVATION_WLS']+=1  # Artificial cost-ledger token, no estimator.
                    raise RuntimeError('injected after simulated compute')
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):b.assign(switch(),prepare_fault=paid_failure)
            self.assertEqual(snapshot(b),before)
            self.assertEqual(b.budget.counts['MODEL_OBSERVATION_WLS'],1)
    def test_member_role_and_cut_boundaries(self):
        with patch.object(Branch,'fuse',fake_fuse):

                b.tick=tick

                actions=[dict(target=0,role='dual_pos45'),dict(target=0,role='dual_neg45'),dict(target=None,role='none')]
                b.assign(actions);b._history_check()
            b.assign([dict(target=None,role='none'),dict(target=0,role='dual_neg45'),dict(target=0,role='dual_pos45')]);b._history_check()
    def test_terminal_transitions_and_no_fees(self):

            if status=='completed':b.segment(0)['latest_clock'].update(base=b.targets[0]['service_duration'],intervals=0)
            if status=='escaped':b.world['motion'][0]['position'][0]=20.

            if status=='unfinished':b.finish(1,'unfinished',6.)
            b.seal_history_cut()
            audit_branch(b)
            b.change_cost+=.01
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):audit_branch(b)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):b.finish(0,status,b.tick*.05)
        b=branch();b.world['motion'][1]['position'][0]=20.;b.finish(1,'escaped',3.);b._history_check()
        h=deepcopy(b.histories);h[1]['unassigned_intervals'][-1].update(end_at=None,closing_event_index=None)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):audit_histories(h,b.actions,b.status,60,{1:3.})

    def test_fusion_failure_and_final_staging_corruption(self):

            fake_fuse(staged,j,s,tick)

    def test_artificial_history_tampering(self):
        with patch.object(Branch,'fuse',fake_fuse):

            audit_branch_independent(b,context=context)

            mutations=[
                lambda h:h[0]['unassigned_intervals'].pop(),
                lambda h:h[1]['unassigned_intervals'][-1].update(end_at=None,closing_event_index=None),
                lambda h:h[0]['unassigned_intervals'][-1].update(start_tick=59),

                lambda h:h[1]['events'][-1].update(event_index=999),

                lambda h:h[1]['segments'][-1].update(segment_id='bad'),
                lambda h:h[1]['segments'][-1].update(previous_segment_id='bad'),
                lambda h:h[1]['segments'][-1]['events'].clear(),
                lambda h:h[0]['segments'][-1]['closure'].update(at=dict(time_seconds=2.,event_tick=40)),
                lambda h:h[0]['segments'][-1]['closure'].update(reason='COMPLETED')]
            patterns=['Current state not unique|History incomplete coverage','Current state not unique|History coverage overlap/gap','Gap opening reference/time','Gap opening reference/time','Segment event reference|Missing segment event link','Gap closing reference','MODEL segment identity','Segment predecessor/order','Missing segment event link','Closure event/time','Closure event reason']
            for mutate,pattern in zip(mutations,patterns):
                h=deepcopy(b.histories);mutate(h)
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,pattern):validate(h)

                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'Closure reason'):audit_histories(hist,v['assignment'],{j:'active' for j in hist},v['tick'],context=contexts['SWITCH'])
                for h in hist.values():
                    if (h['active_segment_id'] is not None)==bool([g for g in h['unassigned_intervals'] if g['end_at'] is None]):found+=1

                summaries[both].append(dict(status=deepcopy(b.status),actions=deepcopy(b.actions),components=deepcopy(b.components),events=sorted(semantic_events,key=lambda e:(e['target_id'],e['at']['time_seconds'],e['kind']))))

class PhysicsTests(TestCase):

        b.fuse=ideal

import json,sys,tempfile,subprocess,hashlib,os,io,tarfile,shutil
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import TestCase

EVIDENCE=[]
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
REPORT=ROOT/'reports/stfbs_lite_d1a_h1_preflight_lock_001'

class LockTests(TestCase):
    def test_real_git_isolated_copy(self):
        head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
        index=ROOT/'.git/index';index_sha=hashlib.sha256(index.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=REPORT) as tmp:
            r=Path(tmp).resolve();self.assertTrue(r.is_relative_to(REPORT.resolve()))
            archive=subprocess.check_output(['git','archive','HEAD','research','pursuit_v2','scripts'])
            with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive)) as tar:
                self.assertTrue(all((m.isfile() or m.isdir()) and (r/m.name).resolve().is_relative_to(r) for m in tar.getmembers()))
                tar.extractall(r,filter='data')
            private_index=r/'fixture-index';shutil.copyfile(index,private_index)
            env=dict(os.environ,GIT_INDEX_FILE=str(private_index))
            def git(root,*args):
                return subprocess.check_output(['git','--no-optional-locks','--git-dir='+str(ROOT/'.git'),'--work-tree='+str(r),*args],env=env)
            name='research/non_oracle/policy.py';p=r/name;pins={name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
            with patch.object(lock,'REQUIRED_SOURCES',(name,)),patch.object(lock,'git',git):
                self.assertEqual(lock.check_source_lock(r,pins)['status'],'PASS')
                original=p.read_bytes();p.write_bytes(original+b'\n# isolated source negative\n')
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'Uncommitted'):lock.check_source_lock(r,pins)
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'SHA256'):lock.check_source_lock(r,pins,worktree_check=lambda root:None)
                p.write_bytes(original)
                (r/'research/non_oracle/untracked_import.py').write_text('raise RuntimeError("do not import")')
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'Untracked importable'):lock.check_source_lock(r,pins)
                EVIDENCE.append(dict(case='SOURCE_REAL_GIT',cases=['SOURCE-1','SOURCE-2','SOURCE-3','SOURCE-6'],status='PASS',HEAD=head,git_status_provider='actual git diff/ls-files on isolated archived HEAD with private index',main_worktree_modified=False))
        self.assertEqual(subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),head)
        self.assertEqual(hashlib.sha256(index.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),index_sha)
        EVIDENCE.append(dict(case='SOURCE-7_REAL_GIT',status='PASS',original_index_sha256=index_sha,HEAD_unchanged=True))

    def test_source_cases(self):
        original=ROOT/'research/non_oracle/policy.py';before=hashlib.sha256(original.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=REPORT) as tmp:
            r=Path(tmp);name='research/non_oracle/policy.py';p=r/name;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True);p.write_bytes(original.read_bytes())
            pins={name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
            state={'unstaged':b'','staged':b'','untracked':b''}
            def git(root,*args):
                if args[0]=='diff':return state['staged' if '--cached' in args else 'unstaged']
                return state['untracked'] if '--others' in args else name.encode()+b'\0'
            with patch.object(lock,'REQUIRED_SOURCES',(name,)),patch.object(lock,'git',git):
                self.assertEqual(lock.check_source_lock(r,pins)['status'],'PASS')
                EVIDENCE.append(dict(case='SOURCE-1',status='PASS',scope='isolated real copied science bytes; deterministic Git status provider'))
                p.write_bytes(p.read_bytes()+b'\n# test-only mutation\n');state['unstaged']=(name+'\0').encode()
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'Uncommitted'):lock.check_source_lock(r,pins)
                EVIDENCE.append(dict(case='SOURCE-2',status='PASS',HEAD='fixed synthetic identity',reason='worktree',original_file_modified=False))
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'SHA256'):lock.check_source_lock(r,pins,worktree_check=lambda root:None)
                EVIDENCE.append(dict(case='SOURCE-3',status='PASS',reason='independent SHA comparison with worktree seam passing'))
                state['unstaged']=b'';p.unlink()
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'source missing'):lock.check_source_lock(r,pins)
                EVIDENCE.append(dict(case='SOURCE-4',status='PASS'))
                p.write_bytes(original.read_bytes())
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'dependency pins'):lock.check_source_lock(r,{})
                EVIDENCE.append(dict(case='SOURCE-5',status='PASS'))
                untracked=r/'research/non_oracle/unapproved.py';untracked.write_text('raise RuntimeError("must never import")')
                state['untracked']=b'research/non_oracle/unapproved.py\0'
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'Untracked importable'):lock.check_source_lock(r,pins)
                # Executable cache and staged mutations are not quietly treated as data.
                state['untracked']=b'research/non_oracle/__pycache__/unapproved.pyc\0'
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'Untracked importable'):lock.check_source_lock(r,pins)
                state['untracked']=b'';state['staged']=(name+'\0').encode()
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'Uncommitted'):lock.check_source_lock(r,pins)
                EVIDENCE.append(dict(case='SOURCE-6',status='PASS',also=['ignored executable bytecode','staged source']))
                state['staged']=b'';state['untracked']=b'reports/normal.json\0'
                self.assertEqual(lock.check_source_lock(r,pins)['status'],'PASS')
        self.assertEqual(hashlib.sha256(original.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),before)
        EVIDENCE.append(dict(case='SOURCE-7',status='PASS',original_SHA256=before,original_never_modified=True))

    def test_watchdog_processes(self):
        for label,code,limit,status in (
            ('normal','print("normal-marker",flush=True)',5,'EXITED'),
            ('abnormal','import sys;print("error-marker",file=sys.stderr,flush=True);sys.exit(7)',5,'ABNORMAL_EXIT'),
            ('timeout','import time; print("started",flush=True); time.sleep(10)',.3,'TIMED_OUT'),
            ('tree_timeout','import subprocess,sys,time; subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,"-c","import time;time.sleep(10)"]);time.sleep(10)',1,'TIMED_OUT')):
            out=REPORT/('watchdog_'+label)
            if out.exists():
                n=2
                while out.with_name(out.name+'_'+str(n)).exists():n+=1
                out=out.with_name(out.name+'_'+str(n))
            receipt=supervise([sys.executable,'-B','-c',code],out,wall_limit=limit)
            EVIDENCE.append(dict(case='WATCHDOG_'+label,receipt=receipt,evidence=str(out.relative_to(ROOT))))
            self.assertEqual(receipt['status'],status,receipt)
            self.assertTrue(receipt['cpu_complete'],receipt);self.assertEqual(receipt['active_processes'],0)
            self.assertEqual(receipt['attempts'],1);self.assertIsNotNone(receipt['process_cpu_seconds'])
            if label=='normal':
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'Not a formal'):verify_watchdog_receipt(receipt)
            else:self.assertNotEqual(receipt['exit_code'],0)
            if label=='tree_timeout':self.assertGreaterEqual(receipt['total_processes'],2)

class StateTests(TestCase):

    def test_raw_identity_matrix(self):

        a=ModelRawCache('KEEP');b=ModelRawCache('SWITCH');ctx=dict(position=[0,0],sigma=.02,health='missing');calls=[]
        def produce():calls.append(1);return deepcopy(slot)
        self.assertEqual(a.query('KEEP',1,0,60,ctx,produce),slot)
        for stream in ('segmentA','segmentB','role_changed','new_flow'):
            self.assertEqual(a.query('KEEP',1,0,60,ctx,produce),slot)
        self.assertEqual(len(calls),1)
        for field,value in (('position',[1,0]),('sigma',.03),('health','available')):
            changed=deepcopy(ctx);changed[field]=value
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):a.query('KEEP',1,0,60,changed,produce)
        b.query('SWITCH',1,0,60,ctx,produce);self.assertEqual(len(calls),2)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):a.query('SWITCH',1,0,60,ctx,produce)
        a.rows[('KEEP',1,0,60)]['slot']['state']='VALID'
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):a.query('KEEP',1,0,60,ctx,produce)
        self.assertEqual(b.rows[('SWITCH',1,0,60)]['slot']['state'],'MISSING')
    def test_inherited_slots(self):

    def test_model_belief_differential(self):
        _,seed,_=recover('runs/a2_switch_episode_001');ref=Beliefs(seed['announcements'],deferred=True)
        model=ModelBeliefConsumer(seed)

        estimate=dict(has_accepted_estimate=True,optimizer_converged=True,numerical_ill_conditioned=False,ambiguity_detected=False,boundary_active=False,numeric_contract_violation=False,estimate=[9.,10.])
        for tick in (60,64,65,65,70):

            ref.enqueue(r);r.update(source='MODEL',provenance='SIMULATED',observation_origin='MODEL');model.enqueue(r)

        frozen=model.freeze(120);self.assertEqual(frozen[1]['status'],'DEGRADED');self.assertEqual(model.states[1]['status'],'OBSERVED')

def snapshot(b):return pickle.dumps({k:v for k,v in b.__dict__.items() if k!='budget'})

def synthetic_cut80(b):
    """A labelled pure-state fixture, not an integration from 60 to 80."""
    active_registry().note_double('synthetic old interval (79,80] and empty-queue freeze80; no physical intervals executed')
    b.tick=80;b._sensor_authority.publish_from_executor(80)
    for h in b.histories.values():h['cutoff_tick']=80
    old=b.segment(0);old['latest_endpoint']=fake_fuse(b,0,old,80)
    old['latest_clock']['intervals']=20  # Explicit synthetic clock, not physical service.
    b.frozen=b.consumer.freeze(80);b._last_public_cut=80

    label='LEFT'+str(tick)
    FUSIONS.append(dict(branch=branch.name,tick=tick,label=label,ledger=callback.ledger_id,team=deepcopy(segment['team'])))
    branch.consumer.enqueue(dict(target_id=j,measurement_tick=tick,available_tick=tick,estimate=None,
                                 provenance='SIMULATED',observation_origin='MODEL',evidence_kind=TEST_DOUBLE,label=label))
    return dict(tick=tick,target_id=j,team=deepcopy(segment['team']),branch=branch.name,G=True,
                quality=dict(status='PASS',evidence_kind=TEST_DOUBLE),provenance='SIMULATED',observation_origin='MODEL',evidence_kind=TEST_DOUBLE)
fake_fuse.evidence_kind=TEST_DOUBLE

def make(branch_id='QM_B0_KEEP',budget=None):
    f=build_fixture();pins=json.loads((ROOT/'reports/stfbs_lite_d1b_qm1b_eng_001/RUN_POLICY.json').read_bytes())['source_pins']
    reg=register_fixture(f,branch_id,pins)
    budget=D1BBudget() if budget is None else budget
    return prepare_branch(f,branch_id,budget,reg),reg,f

class SyntheticPort:
    evidence_kind=TEST_DOUBLE
    def __init__(self,b):
        self.b=b;self.trace=[];self.freezes=[];self.consumed_at={}
        self._sensor_authority=SimpleNamespace(publish_from_executor=lambda tick:self.publish(tick))
    def __getattr__(self,n):return getattr(self.b,n)
    def publish(self,tick):
        self.trace.append(('PUBLIC',tick));self.b._sensor_authority.publish_from_executor(tick)
    def policy_view(self):
        tick=self.b.tick
        if tick!=self.b._last_public_cut:
            self.consumed_at[tick]=[x['label'] for x in self.b.consumer.pending]
            self.freezes.append(tick);self.trace.append(('FREEZE',tick))
        return self.b.policy_view()
    def assign(self,actions):
        self.trace.append(('ASSIGN',self.b.tick));self.b.assign(actions)
    def advance(self):
        # Synthetic jump to decision cuts, never invokes Branch.advance or movement.
        b=self.b;b.tick=80 if b.tick==60 else 100
        for h in b.histories.values():h['cutoff_tick']=b.tick
        self.trace.extend([('OLD_MOTION_SYNTHETIC',b.tick),('RIGHT',b.tick),('SETTLE',b.tick)])
        profile=b._sensor_authority.physical_profile_at(b.tick)
        self.right_sigma=profile[1]['sigma']
        s=b.segment(0)
        s['latest_endpoint']=dict(tick=b.tick,target_id=0,team=deepcopy(s['team']),branch=b.name,G=True,
                                  quality=dict(status='PASS',evidence_kind=TEST_DOUBLE),provenance='SIMULATED',observation_origin='MODEL',evidence_kind=TEST_DOUBLE)
        b.consumer.enqueue(dict(target_id=0,measurement_tick=b.tick,available_tick=b.tick,estimate=None,
                                provenance='SIMULATED',observation_origin='MODEL',label='RIGHT'+str(b.tick),evidence_kind=TEST_DOUBLE))

class QM1BTests(TestCase):
    def test_execution_branch_identity_isolation(self):
        active_registry().note_double('pure independent branch state and synthetic caches/pending')
        budget=D1BBudget();a,_,_=make('QM_B0_KEEP',budget);b,_,_=make('QM_B1_MEMBER_CHANGE',budget)

        a.consumer.pending.append({'synthetic':TEST_DOUBLE});a.streams['synthetic']={'x':[]}

LABEL='TEST_DOUBLE_NOT_PHYSICAL_EVIDENCE'


def synthetic_estimator(payload):return dict(evidence_kind=LABEL,result='SYNTHETIC_RETURN_ONLY')
synthetic_estimator.evidence_kind=LABEL


def stable(budget):
    d=deepcopy(budget.snapshot())
    d.pop('cpu_seconds');d.pop('wall_seconds')
    return d


def used_budget(tag):
    b=D1BBudget(test_cap=3,test_estimator=synthetic_estimator,journal_path=REPORT/(tag+'.jsonl'),batch_id='B3_PATCH_ENGINEERING_ONLY')
    with b.for_branch('QM_PROBE_OLD'),b.for_frame(tag+':synthetic60'):
        b.estimator('MODEL_OBSERVATION_WLS')({'evidence_kind':LABEL})
    assert b.accounting['outer_wls_started']==b.accounting['outer_wls_returned']==1
    assert b.accounting['least_squares_started']==0 and not b.real_ready
    assert inspect_journal(b.journal.path)['status']=='COMPLETE'
    return b


def registration(fixture):
    pins=read(REPORT/'RUN_POLICY.json')['source_pins']
    return register_verified_fixture(ROOT,fixture,'QM_B3_UNKNOWN',pins,SourceAnchor('ENGINEERING_TEST_ONLY_NOT_REAL_SCIENCE',json.dumps(pins,sort_keys=True)))


def state(b):
    return dict(tick=b.tick,fusions=b.fusions,cache_rows=len(b.cache.rows),cache_counts=dict(b.cache.counts),
                streams=len(b.streams),feedback=len(b.feedback),pending=len(b.consumer.pending),measurements=len(b.consumer.model_measurements),
                actions=deepcopy(b.actions),segments=sum(len(h['segments']) for h in b.histories.values()),boundaries=len(b.boundaries))


class PatchTests(TestCase):
    def create_b3(self,tag):
        fixture=build_fixture();shared=used_budget(tag);before=stable(shared);reg=registration(fixture)
        calls=[]
        def trace(frame,event,arg):
            if event=='call' and frame.f_code.co_filename.endswith(('stfbs_d1b_qm_execution.py','stfbs_d1b_qm_run_release.py','stfbs_d1b_qm_run_audit.py')):
                name=frame.f_code.co_name
                if name in ('prepare_b3_branch','prepare_branch','bind_shared_budget','verify_verified_registration','verify_source_pins'):
                    calls.append(dict(function=name,file=frame.f_code.co_filename,line=frame.f_code.co_firstlineno,
                                      matching_shared_budget=frame.f_locals.get('budget') is shared,
                                      provided_pins_match=frame.f_locals.get('provided')==read(REPORT/'RUN_POLICY.json')['source_pins'] if name=='verify_source_pins' else None))
        previous=sys.getprofile()
        try:
            sys.setprofile(trace)
            b=release.prepare_b3_branch(fixture,shared,reg)
        finally:sys.setprofile(previous)
        self.assertIs(b.budget,shared);self.assertEqual(stable(shared),before)
        self.assertEqual(sum(x['function']=='bind_shared_budget' for x in calls),1)
        self.assertEqual(sum(x['function']=='prepare_b3_branch' for x in calls),1)
        self.assertEqual(sum(x['function']=='verify_verified_registration' for x in calls),1)
        self.assertTrue(any(x['function']=='verify_source_pins' and x['provided_pins_match'] for x in calls))
        self.assertEqual(state(b),dict(tick=60,fusions=0,cache_rows=0,cache_counts=dict(requests=0,new=0,reuses=0,conflicts=0,inherited_reuses=0),streams=0,feedback=0,pending=0,measurements=0,actions=[dict(target=None,role='none') for _ in range(3)],segments=0,boundaries=0))
        self.assertIs(type(b._sensor_authority),release.MissingSensorAuthority)
        authority=b._sensor_authority
        self.assertEqual(authority.physical_profile_at(79)[1]['health'],'available')
        self.assertEqual(authority.physical_profile_at(80)[1]['health'],'missing')
        self.assertEqual(authority.public_snapshot().watermark,60)
        with self.assertRaises(PublicQueryRejected):authority.public_snapshot().public_profile_at(80)
        slot=release.missing_slot_structure(authority,80)
        self.assertEqual((slot['state'],slot['packet']),('MISSING',None))
        authority.publish_from_executor(80)
        self.assertEqual(authority.public_snapshot().public_profile_at(80)[1]['health'],'missing')
        evidence=dict(evidence_kind=LABEL,calls=calls,synthetic_shared_budget_history_calls=1,real_scientific_calls=0,
                      budget_before=before,budget_after=stable(shared),initial_state=state(b),registration_digest=reg.registration.registration_digest,
                      source_anchor=reg.anchor.source_version,patched_source_sha256=sha(ROOT/'research/non_oracle/stfbs_d1b_qm_run_release.py'),
                      missing_slot=slot,public_watermark_before=60,public_watermark_after=80)
        return b,shared,evidence

            elif case in ('pending','model_measurements'):
                row=dict(target_id=0,measurement_tick=60,available_tick=60,position=[9.,10.],provenance='SIMULATED',observation_origin='MODEL')

            elif case=='boundaries':b.boundaries=[deepcopy(historical['boundaries'][0])]

            rows.append(dict(case=case,status='PASS',before=pre,after=state(b),budget_identity_preserved=True,shared_budget_unchanged=True))

def policy_anchor():
    p=json.loads((REPORT/'RUN_POLICY.json').read_bytes());return p['source_pins'],SourceAnchor(p['head']+':RUN_G0_SOURCE_MANIFEST',json.dumps(p['source_pins'],sort_keys=True))

def registration(fixture,name):
    pins,anchor=policy_anchor();return register_verified_fixture(ROOT,fixture,name,pins,anchor)

def admission(sigma=.16):
    rows=[]
    for index,value in enumerate((.04,.08,.16,.32)):
        rows.append(dict(probe_id='QM_PROBE_DEGRADED_'+str(index+1),sigma=value,old_G=True,new_G=True,old_Q='PASS',new_Q='FAIL' if value==sigma else 'PASS',evidence_kind=TEST_DOUBLE))
        if value==sigma:break
    return freeze_admission(rows,'SYNTHETIC_G0_NOT_A_REAL_RUN')

def make(name='QM_B0_KEEP',budget=None):
    f=build_fixture();reg=registration(f,name);budget=D1BBudget() if budget is None else budget
    if name in PROBES:b=prepare_probe_branch(f,name,budget,reg)
    elif name=='QM_B3_UNKNOWN':b=prepare_b3_branch(f,budget,reg)
    else:b=prepare_dynamic_branch(f,name,budget,reg,selected_sigma=.16,admission=admission())
    return b,reg,f

def fake_fuse(b,j,s,tick):
    active_registry().note_double('transaction-owned synthetic left endpoint, no real fusion')
    cb=b.budget.estimator('MODEL_OBSERVATION_WLS');assert cb.ledger_id==b.budget.ledger_id and cb.branch_id==b.name
    CALLS.append((b.name,tick))
    b.consumer.enqueue(dict(target_id=j,measurement_tick=tick,available_tick=tick,estimate=None,label='LEFT'+str(tick),provenance='SIMULATED',observation_origin='MODEL',evidence_kind=TEST_DOUBLE))
    return dict(branch=b.name,tick=tick,target_id=j,team=deepcopy(s['team']),G=True,quality=dict(status='PASS',evidence_kind=TEST_DOUBLE),provenance='SIMULATED',observation_origin='MODEL',evidence_kind=TEST_DOUBLE)
fake_fuse.evidence_kind=TEST_DOUBLE

class SyntheticPort:
    evidence_kind=TEST_DOUBLE
    def __init__(self,b):
        self.b=b;self.trace=[];self.frozen_inputs={}
        self._sensor_authority=SimpleNamespace(publish_from_executor=self.publish)
    def __getattr__(self,n):return getattr(self.b,n)
    def publish(self,tick):self.trace.append(('PUBLIC',tick));self.b._sensor_authority.publish_from_executor(tick)
    def policy_view(self):
        if self.b.tick!=self.b._last_public_cut:
            self.frozen_inputs[self.b.tick]=[x['label'] for x in self.b.consumer.pending];self.trace.append(('FREEZE',self.b.tick))
        return self.b.policy_view()
    def assign(self,actions):self.trace.append(('ASSIGN',self.b.tick));self.b.assign(actions)
    def advance(self):
        # Pure synthetic cut, not a Branch.advance invocation or a trajectory.
        b=self.b;b.tick=80 if b.tick==60 else 100
        for h in b.histories.values():h['cutoff_tick']=b.tick
        s=b.segment(0);s['latest_endpoint']=dict(tick=b.tick,target_id=0,team=deepcopy(s['team']),branch=b.name,G=True,quality=dict(status='PASS',evidence_kind=TEST_DOUBLE),provenance='SIMULATED',observation_origin='MODEL',evidence_kind=TEST_DOUBLE)
        b.consumer.enqueue(dict(target_id=0,measurement_tick=b.tick,available_tick=b.tick,estimate=None,label='RIGHT'+str(b.tick),provenance='SIMULATED',observation_origin='MODEL',evidence_kind=TEST_DOUBLE))
        self.trace.extend([('OLD_RIGHT',b.tick),('SETTLE',b.tick)])

def evidence(name='QM_B0_KEEP',team=None,start=60):
    active_registry().note_double('complete synthetic raw/frame/result/history cross-record evidence, not a Q result')
    team=team or [dict(robot_id=0,role='dual_neg45'),dict(robot_id=1,role='dual_pos45')]
    stream=name+':T0:first'+str(start);fid=stream+':tick80'
    positions=[[9.,10.],[10.,10.],[11.,10.]]
    profiles=[dict(sensor_id='U'+str(i),sigma=.16 if i==1 else .02,health='available',observed_tick=80) for i in range(3)]
    cache={};slots=[];packets=[]
    for member in team:
        i=member['robot_id'];packet=dict(sensor_id='U'+str(i),position=positions[i],bearing=.1*i,sigma=profiles[i]['sigma'],measurement_tick=80,available_tick=80,status='ok')
        slot=seal_slot(dict(slot_key=dict(target_id=0,robot_id=i,tick=80),state='VALID',packet=packet,slot_digest=None));slots.append(slot)
        context=dict(position=positions[i],sigma=profiles[i]['sigma'],health='available')
        cache[(name,0,i,80)]=dict(slot=deepcopy(slot),slot_digest=digest(slot),context_digest=digest(context))
        packets.append(dict(packet,packet_id=stream+':tick80:U'+str(i)))
    frame=dict(contract_id='STAGE2A5B-A-MINIMAL-v0.2',stream_id=stream,frame_id=fid,target_id=0,tick=80,measurement_time=4.,available_time=4.,records=packets)
    prepared=prepare_frame(frame,[x['sensor_id'] for x in packets])
    quality=dict(status='PASS',frame_id=fid,evidence_kind=TEST_DOUBLE)
    endpoint=dict(branch=name,tick=80,target_id=0,team=deepcopy(team),G=True,quality=quality,provenance='SIMULATED',observation_origin='MODEL')
    result=dict(prepared,execution_contract_id='SYNTHETIC_G0',frame_id=fid,stream_id=stream,target_id=0,tick=80,start_tick=start,estimate_result=dict(evidence_kind=TEST_DOUBLE),quality=deepcopy(quality),skipped=False,estimator_called=False,duplicate=False)
    segment=dict(segment_id=name+':synthetic-segment'+str(start),target_id=0,segment_index=0,previous_segment_id=None,start_tick=start,team=deepcopy(team),closure=None,model_branch_id=name,latest_endpoint=deepcopy(endpoint),events=[],provenance='SIMULATED',observation_origin='MODEL',evidence_kind=TEST_DOUBLE)
    records=dict(feedback=[dict(frame=frame,result=result,endpoint=deepcopy(endpoint),slots=slots)],histories={0:dict(segments=[segment])},cache=cache,physical_profiles={80:profiles},positions={80:positions})
    f=build_fixture();reg=registration(f,name)
    return endpoint,records,reg.registration,segment['segment_id']
