def expectation_for_bytes(raw):return ApprovalExpectation(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'INDEPENDENT_TEST_EXPECTATION',LABEL)

def solver_stub(value):return value
solver_stub.evidence_kind=LABEL

def estimate_stub(payload):return {'has_accepted_estimate':False,'evidence_kind':LABEL}
estimate_stub.evidence_kind=LABEL

def fake_endpoint(b,j,segment,tick):
    active_registry().note_double('complete synthetic packet/frame/estimate result; pure Q algebra only')
    target=[9.+.4*((tick-60)*.05),10.];stream=f'{b.name}:T{j}:first{segment["first_fusion_tick"]}';fid=stream+':tick'+str(tick)
    packets=[];slots=[]
    for member in segment['team']:
        i=member['robot_id'];profile=b._sensor_authority.physical_profile_at(tick)[i];pos=b.positions[i].tolist()
        packet=dict(sensor_id='U'+str(i),position=pos,bearing=(math.atan2(target[1]-pos[1],target[0]-pos[0])+math.pi)%(2*math.pi)-math.pi,
                    sigma=profile['sigma'],measurement_tick=tick,available_tick=tick,status='ok')
        slot=seal_slot(dict(slot_key=dict(target_id=j,robot_id=i,tick=tick),state='VALID',packet=packet,slot_digest=None))
        slot=b.cache.query(b.name,j,i,tick,dict(position=pos,sigma=profile['sigma'],health=profile['health']),lambda:deepcopy(slot))
        slots.append(slot);packets.append(dict(slot['packet'],packet_id=fid+':U'+str(i)))
    frame=dict(contract_id='STAGE2A5B-A-MINIMAL-v0.2',stream_id=stream,frame_id=fid,target_id=j,tick=tick,measurement_time=tick*.05,available_time=tick*.05,records=packets)
    prepared=prepare_frame(frame,[x['sensor_id'] for x in packets])
    estimate=dict(has_accepted_estimate=True,estimate=target,optimizer_converged=True,numerical_ill_conditioned=False,ambiguity_detected=False,boundary_active=False,branch_guard_triggered=False,numeric_contract_violation=False,starts=[],evidence_kind=LABEL)
    quality=assess_quality(prepared['payload'],estimate);quality['frame_id']=fid
    G=all(float(np.linalg.norm(b.positions[m['robot_id']]-target-offset(m['role'],b.cfg)))<=radius(b.cfg) for m in segment['team'])
    endpoint=dict(tick=tick,target_id=j,team=deepcopy(segment['team']),G=G,quality=quality,provenance='SIMULATED',observation_origin='MODEL',branch=b.name)
    result=dict(prepared,frame_id=fid,stream_id=stream,target_id=j,tick=tick,start_tick=segment['first_fusion_tick'],estimate_result=estimate,quality=quality,estimator_called=False,skipped=False,duplicate=False,execution_contract_id='SYNTHETIC_TEST_DOUBLE')
    b.consumer.enqueue(dict(target_id=j,measurement_tick=tick,available_tick=tick,estimate=estimate,provenance='SIMULATED',observation_origin='MODEL'))
    b.feedback.append(dict(frame=frame,result=result,endpoint=deepcopy(endpoint),slots=slots));ENDPOINT_CALLS.append((b.name,tick))
    return endpoint
fake_endpoint.evidence_kind=LABEL

def synthetic_source(name='QM_B1_MEMBER_CHANGE',sigma=.16):
    global SOURCES
    SOURCES+=1;f=build_fixture();b=QMBranch(f,name=name,degraded_sigma=sigma)
    b.budget=D1BBudget(test_cap=0,test_estimator=estimate_stub)
    selected={'research/non_oracle/stfbs_d1b_qm_scenario.py':pins()['research/non_oracle/stfbs_d1b_qm_scenario.py']}
    reg=register_fixture(f,name,selected)
    with active_registry().fake_scope('synthetic committed history and MODEL-like evidence, no physical ticks',fake_endpoint):
        with b.budget.for_branch(name):b.assign(initial_team())
        b.tick=80;b.positions[:,0]+=.4
        for h in b.histories.values():h['cutoff_tick']=80
        b.segment(0)['latest_endpoint']=fake_endpoint(b,0,b.segment(0),80)
        if name=='QM_B1_MEMBER_CHANGE':
            b._sensor_authority.publish_from_executor(80);b.policy_view()
            with b.budget.for_branch(name):b.assign(changed_team())
    audit=audit_registered(b,reg);records=records_from_branch(b);records['positions'][80]=b.positions.tolist()
    records['physical_profiles'][79]=b._sensor_authority.physical_profile_at(79)
    payload=dict(batch_id='SYNTHETIC_BATCH',branch_id=name,result=result_from_branch(b),records=serial_records(records),external_history_audit=audit,evidence_kind=LABEL)
    source=create_test_source(payload,reg,REPORT/f'synthetic_source_{SOURCES}.json')
    return source,b,f

class SyntheticPort:
    evidence_kind=LABEL
    def __init__(self,b):self.b=b;self._sensor_authority=SimpleNamespace(publish_from_executor=lambda t:self.b._sensor_authority.publish_from_executor(t))
    def __getattr__(self,key):return getattr(self.b,key)
    def policy_view(self):return self.b.policy_view()
    def assign(self,actions):self.b.assign(actions)
    def advance(self):
        n=80 if self.b.tick==60 else 100;self.b.tick=n
        self.b.positions[:,0]+=.4
        for h in self.b.histories.values():h['cutoff_tick']=n
        self.b.segment(0)['latest_endpoint']=fake_endpoint(self.b,0,self.b.segment(0),n)

class FakeProcessor:
    def __init__(self,ids,tick,stream,target,*,estimator_fn):self.ids=ids;self.stream=stream;self.estimator=estimator_fn
    def process(self,frame):
        active_registry().note_double('one fake special processor, no BridgeFrameProcessor.process')
        prepared=prepare_frame(frame,self.ids);r=self.estimator(prepared['payload'])
        return dict(prepared,estimate_result=r,estimator_called=True,frame_id=frame['frame_id'],stream_id=self.stream,evidence_kind=LABEL)
FakeProcessor.evidence_kind=LABEL

class SyntheticOps:
    evidence_kind=LABEL
    def __init__(self,fail=False):self.calls=[];self.fail=fail
    def probe(self,name):self.calls.append(name);return name
    def old_quality(self,source):return dict(G=True,Q='PASS')
    def candidate(self,old,new,sigma):return dict(old_G=True,new_G=True,old_Q='PASS',new_Q='PASS' if self.fail or sigma<.16 else 'FAIL',sigma=sigma)
    def candidate_values(self,row):return row
    def admit(self,rows):self.calls.append('ADMIT');return rows
    def dynamic(self,name,sigma,admission):self.calls.append(name);return name
    def dynamic_realized(self,*args):return True
    def b3(self):self.calls.append('QM_B3_UNKNOWN');return 'B3'
    def f1(self,b1):self.calls.append('F1')
    def special(self,name,source):self.calls.append(name)
    def final_science(self,*args):return dict(evidence_kind=LABEL)

class ReleaseTests(TestCase):
    def test_release_denies_missing_or_forged_authorization(self):
        t=ticket();raw=json.dumps(t,sort_keys=True).encode();expected=expectation_for_bytes(raw)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(PermissionError,'APPROVAL_NOT_VERIFIED'):validate_approval_bytes(raw,None,t)
        inside=dict(t,expected_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionError):validate_approval_bytes(json.dumps(inside).encode(),None,t)
        changed=dict(t,outer_limit=293);changed['self_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(changed).encode()).hexdigest()
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionError):validate_approval_bytes(json.dumps(changed).encode(),expected,t)
        self.assertEqual(validate_approval_bytes(raw,expected,t)['status'],'PURE_VALIDATION_PASS')
        for field,value in [('source_pins',{}),('fixture_digest','bad'),('outer_limit',293),('inner_limit',2629),('cpu_limit',481),('wall_limit',601),('output_dir','wrong'),('attempt_id','wrong')]:
            bad=dict(t);bad[field]=value;data=json.dumps(bad).encode()
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(PermissionError,'binding mismatch'):validate_approval_bytes(data,expectation_for_bytes(data),t)
        self.assertFalse(AUTHORITY_PATH.exists())
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(PermissionError,'independent user channel absent'):authorize_policy(REPORT/'no_approval_exists.json')

    def test_release_context_and_real_port_gate_with_doubles(self):
        t=ticket();raw=json.dumps(t).encode();check=validate_approval_bytes(raw,expectation_for_bytes(raw),t)
        self.assertEqual(execute_test_plan(check,SyntheticOps())['status'],'EXECUTED_AWAITING_FINAL_AUDIT')
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionError):
            with runtime_scope(check,dict(actual_windows_job=True,attempt_id=t['attempt_id'])):pass
        f=build_fixture();b=QMBranch(f,name='QM_B0_KEEP');b.budget=D1BBudget()
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionError):execute_test_plan(check,b)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(PermissionError,'APPROVAL_NOT_VERIFIED'):DynamicSchedule(b,b.name).start()
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionError):D1BBudget.from_release(check,REPORT/'must_not_exist.jsonl')
        self.assertFalse((REPORT/'must_not_exist.jsonl').exists());self.assertEqual(b.boundaries,[]);self.assertEqual(b.fusions,0)
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionError):b.budget.bind_real_estimator(check)

    def test_probe_and_dynamic_dispatch_without_science(self):
        active_registry().note_double('complete batch with synthetic operation port, no physical executor')
        ops=SyntheticOps();result=coordinate_batch(ops)
        self.assertEqual(result['selected_sigma'],.16)
        self.assertEqual(ops.calls,['QM_PROBE_OLD','QM_PROBE_DEGRADED_1','QM_PROBE_DEGRADED_2','QM_PROBE_DEGRADED_3','ADMIT','QM_B0_KEEP','QM_B1_MEMBER_CHANGE','QM_B3_UNKNOWN','F1','QM_F2_VALID_HISTORY','QM_F3_STREAM_A','QM_F3_STREAM_B'])
        fail=SyntheticOps(True);stopped=coordinate_batch(fail);self.assertEqual(stopped['status'],'NO_Q_ONLY_FAIL_FOUND');self.assertTrue(all(v=='NOT_EXECUTED_GATE_NOT_MET' for v in stopped['stages'].values()));self.assertEqual(len(fail.calls),5)
        for script in ('stfbs_d1b_qm_run_g1.py','stfbs_d1b_qm_run_g1_watchdog.py'):
            tree=ast.parse((ROOT/'scripts'/script).read_text());self.assertTrue(any(isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='main' for n in tree.body))
        with active_registry().fake_scope('transaction-owned left60 and left80 synthetic endpoints',fake_endpoint):
            f=build_fixture();b=QMBranch(f,name='QM_B1_MEMBER_CHANGE');b.budget=D1BBudget(test_cap=0,test_estimator=estimate_stub);start=len(ENDPOINT_CALLS)
            s=DynamicSchedule(SyntheticPort(b),b.name);s.start();s.advance_one();s.advance_one()
            self.assertEqual([n for name,n in ENDPOINT_CALLS[start:]],[60,80,80,100])

    def test_outer_wls_cap_and_failure_journal(self):
        path=REPORT/'outer_calls.jsonl';observed=[]
        def fake(payload):
            rows=[json.loads(x) for x in path.read_text().splitlines()];observed.append(rows[-1]['status']);return payload
        fake.evidence_kind=LABEL
        b=D1BBudget(test_cap=1,test_estimator=fake,journal_path=path)
        with b.for_frame('QM_B0_KEEP:T0:test:tick80'):
            cb=b.estimator('MODEL_OBSERVATION_WLS',branch_id='QM_B0_KEEP');cb({})
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(BudgetRejected,'OUTER_CAP'):cb({})
        self.assertEqual(observed,['STARTED']);self.assertEqual(b.accounting['outer_wls_started'],1);self.assertEqual(b.accounting['budget_rejected'],1)
        b.journal.close();self.assertEqual(inspect_journal(path)['status'],'COMPLETE')
        def broken(payload):raise ArithmeticError('synthetic outer failure')
        broken.evidence_kind=LABEL
        f=D1BBudget(test_cap=1,test_estimator=broken,journal_path=REPORT/'outer_failure.jsonl')
        with f.for_frame('failure'):
            with self.assertRaises(ArithmeticError):f.estimator('MODEL_SPECIAL_TEST_WLS',branch_id='QM_F2_VALID_HISTORY')({})
        self.assertEqual(f.accounting['outer_wls_failed'],1);self.assertEqual(f.counts['MODEL_SPECIAL_TEST_WLS'],1);f.journal.close()

    def test_inner_solver_alias_cap_and_failure_journal(self):
        holder={};entered=[]
        def solver(value):
            entered.append(value);rows=[json.loads(x) for x in holder['path'].read_text().splitlines()];self.assertEqual(rows[-1]['status'],'STARTED');self.assertEqual(rows[-1]['level'],'INNER');return value
        solver.evidence_kind=LABEL;module=SimpleNamespace(least_squares=solver)
        def estimate(payload):return [module.least_squares(k) for k in range(9)]
        estimate.evidence_kind=LABEL
        def outer(payload):return holder['b'].invoke_alias(module,estimate,payload)
        outer.evidence_kind=LABEL
        path=REPORT/'inner_calls.jsonl';b=D1BBudget(test_cap=1,test_estimator=outer,test_inner_cap=9,journal_path=path);holder.update(b=b,path=path)
        with b.for_frame('nine'):b.estimator('MODEL_OBSERVATION_WLS',branch_id='QM_B0_KEEP')({})
        self.assertIs(module.least_squares,solver);self.assertEqual(b.accounting['outer_wls_started'],1);self.assertEqual(b.accounting['least_squares_started'],9);b.journal.close()
        path=REPORT/'inner_cap.jsonl';limited=D1BBudget(test_cap=1,test_estimator=outer,test_inner_cap=2,journal_path=path);holder.update(b=limited,path=path);before=len(entered)
        with limited.for_frame('limited'):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(BudgetRejected,'INNER_CAP'):limited.estimator('MODEL_OBSERVATION_WLS',branch_id='QM_B0_KEEP')({})
        self.assertEqual(len(entered)-before,2);self.assertIs(module.least_squares,solver);self.assertEqual(limited.accounting['outer_wls_failed'],1);limited.journal.close()
        def fail_solver(value):raise ArithmeticError('synthetic inner failure')
        fail_solver.evidence_kind=LABEL;failed_module=SimpleNamespace(least_squares=fail_solver)
        def fail_estimate(payload):return failed_module.least_squares(1)
        fail_estimate.evidence_kind=LABEL
        def failed_outer(payload):return failed.invoke_alias(failed_module,fail_estimate,payload)
        failed_outer.evidence_kind=LABEL
        failed=D1BBudget(test_cap=1,test_estimator=failed_outer,journal_path=REPORT/'inner_failure.jsonl')
        with failed.for_frame('failure'):
            with self.assertRaises(ArithmeticError):failed.estimator('MODEL_SPECIAL_TEST_WLS',branch_id='QM_F3_STREAM_A')({})
        self.assertEqual(failed.accounting['least_squares_failed'],1);self.assertIs(failed_module.least_squares,fail_solver);failed.journal.close()

    def test_shared_budget_clone_and_special_identities(self):
        b=D1BBudget(test_cap=3,test_estimator=estimate_stub);f=build_fixture();branch=QMBranch(f,name='QM_B0_KEEP');branch.budget=b
        self.assertIs(branch._transaction_clone().budget,b)
        for name in SPECIAL_IDS:
            with b.for_branch(name),b.for_frame(name+':test'):
                cb=b.estimator('MODEL_SPECIAL_TEST_WLS');self.assertEqual(cb.branch_id,name);cb({})
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'special category'):b.estimator('MODEL_OBSERVATION_WLS',branch_id=name)
        self.assertEqual(b.counts['MODEL_SPECIAL_TEST_WLS'],3)
        path=REPORT/'unfinished_started.jsonl';journal=CallJournal(path,'TEST')
        journal.append(level='OUTER',status='STARTED',outer_call_id='O1',inner_call_id=None);journal.close()
        self.assertEqual(inspect_journal(path)['status'],'RESOURCE_LEDGER_INCOMPLETE')

    def test_f2_trusted_valid_history_source_and_inheritance(self):
        source,b,_=synthetic_source();bundle=verify_special_source('QM_F2_VALID_HISTORY',source,test=True)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(bundle.source_json)['source_verification'],'BEFORE_HISTORY_CACHE_INITIALIZATION')
        cache=inherited_cache(bundle,test=True);frame=special_frame(bundle,cache)
        self.assertEqual(cache.counts['new'],0);self.assertEqual(cache.counts['inherited_reuses'],2)
        self.assertEqual([x['sensor_id'] for x in frame['records']],['U0','U2'])
        original=json.loads(bundle.slots_json)
        for item,record in zip(original,frame['records']):
            copied=dict(record);copied.pop('packet_id');self.assertEqual(copied,item['slot']['packet'])
        budget=D1BBudget(test_cap=1,test_estimator=estimate_stub);result=run_special('QM_F2_VALID_HISTORY',source,budget,test_processor_factory=FakeProcessor)
        self.assertEqual(budget.counts['MODEL_SPECIAL_TEST_WLS'],1);self.assertEqual(result['raw_counts']['new'],0)
        for field,value in [('sigma',.2),('health','missing'),('position',[0.,0.])]:
            context=dict(original[0]['context']);context[field]=value
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'Historical raw context conflict'):cache.query('QM_F2_VALID_HISTORY',0,0,80,context,lambda:None)
        wrong,_,_=synthetic_source('QM_B0_KEEP')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'F2_SOURCE_NOT_AVAILABLE'):verify_special_source('QM_F2_VALID_HISTORY',wrong,test=True)
        data=Path(source.path).read_bytes();Path(source.path).write_bytes(data+b' ')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'SOURCE_FILE_HASH_MISMATCH'):verify_special_source('QM_F2_VALID_HISTORY',source,test=True)

    def test_f2_unqueried_fixture_contract_preserved(self):
        f=build_fixture();before=deepcopy(f.view)
        save(REPORT/'FULL_FIXTURE_IDENTITY.json',dict(fixture_digest=digest(dict(view=f.view,seed=f.seed,identity=f.identity)),world_digest=f.world['world_digest'],motion_rule=f.world['motion_rule'],fixture_identity=f.identity,scope='STRUCTURAL_UNFUSED_MODEL_ONLY'))
        self.assertTrue(all(s['state']=='UNQUERIED' for s in f.view['current_slots']));self.assertFalse(f.identity['fused'])
        source,_,_=synthetic_source();verify_special_source('QM_F2_VALID_HISTORY',source,test=True)
        self.assertEqual(f.view,before);self.assertEqual(validate_fixture(f)['status'],'STRUCTURALLY_VALIDATED_UNFUSED_MODEL_FIXTURE')
        bad=deepcopy(f);bad.view['current_slots'][0]['state']='VALID'
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'unfused/unassigned'):validate_fixture(bad)
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionError):inherited_cache(verify_special_source('QM_F2_VALID_HISTORY',source,test=True))

    def test_f3_independent_stream_positive_and_negative_contract(self):
        a,_,_=synthetic_source('QM_B0_KEEP');b,_,_=synthetic_source();shared=D1BBudget(test_cap=2,test_estimator=estimate_stub)
        ra=run_special('QM_F3_STREAM_A',a,shared,test_processor_factory=FakeProcessor);rb=run_special('QM_F3_STREAM_B',b,shared,test_processor_factory=FakeProcessor)
        self.assertNotEqual(ra['frame']['stream_id'],rb['frame']['stream_id']);self.assertEqual(shared.counts['MODEL_SPECIAL_TEST_WLS'],2)
        bundle=verify_special_source('QM_F3_STREAM_A',a,test=True);cache=inherited_cache(bundle,test=True)
        cache.history[0]['slot']['packet']['bearing']+=.1
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'Inherited measurement changed'):special_frame(bundle,cache)
        cache=inherited_cache(bundle,test=True);cache.branch='QM_F3_STREAM_B'
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'cache branch mismatch'):special_frame(bundle,cache)
        packet_bad=deepcopy(ra['frame']);packet_bad['records'][0]['sigma']*=2
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'verified raw source'):validate_special_frame(packet_bad,'QM_F3_STREAM_A',bundle)
        for result in (ra,rb):
            self.assertEqual(result['raw_counts']['new'],0)
            frame=deepcopy(result['frame']);frame['stream_id']='QM_F3_STREAM_A:wrong'
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):validate_special_frame(frame,result['special_id'])
            pending=dict(branch_id=result['special_id'],target_id=0,stream_id=result['frame']['stream_id'])
            self.assertTrue(validate_pending_identity(pending,result['special_id']))
            for field,value in [('branch_id','wrong'),('target_id',1),('stream_id','wrong')]:
                bad=dict(pending);bad[field]=value
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):validate_pending_identity(bad,result['special_id'])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'F3_SOURCE_NOT_AVAILABLE'):verify_special_source('QM_F3_STREAM_A',b,test=True)
        self.assertEqual(shared.counts['MODEL_SPECIAL_TEST_WLS'],2)

    def test_admission_requires_trusted_raw_frame_wls_evidence(self):
        old,_,_=synthetic_source('QM_PROBE_OLD',.02);new,_,_=synthetic_source('QM_PROBE_DEGRADED_3',.16)
        candidate=candidate_from_sources(old,new,.16,test=True);row=json.loads(candidate.row_json)

def receipt_fixture():
    return dict(status='EXITED',exit_code=0,cpu_complete=True,active_processes=0,attempts=1,
                cpu_limit=480,wall_limit=600,tree_cpu_seconds=1.25,wall_seconds=2.5,evidence_kind=LABEL)

def json_safe(value):
    if type(value) is float and not math.isfinite(value):return dict(original_type='float',representation=repr(value))
    if isinstance(value,dict):return {k:json_safe(v) for k,v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value,(tuple,list)):return [json_safe(v) for v in value]
    return value

def resource_case(case,identifier,receipt,expected,*,cpu=480,wall=600,reason=None,ledger=None,sources=True):
    result=final_resource_audit(receipt,cpu,wall,dict(status='COMPLETE') if ledger is None else ledger,sources)
    case.assertEqual(result['status'],expected)
    if reason:case.assertIn(reason,result['failure_reasons'])
    RESOURCE_CASES.append(dict(id=identifier,input=json_safe(receipt),approved_cpu=json_safe(cpu),approved_wall=json_safe(wall),result=json_safe(result),evidence_kind=LABEL))
    return result

class SyntheticOps:
    evidence_kind=LABEL
    def __init__(self,mode):self.mode=mode;self.calls=[];self.dynamic_results={};self.final_result=dict(EXECUTION_VALID=True,Q_ONLY_FAILURE_OBSERVED=True,GQ_RESTORED=False,SERVICE_RESUMED=False,TASK_COMPLETED=False,evidence_kind=LABEL)
    def probe(self,name):self.calls.append('probe:'+name);return dict(branch_id=name,evidence_kind=LABEL)
    def old_quality(self,old):
        self.calls.append('old_quality');return dict(G=True,Q='FAIL' if self.mode=='A' else 'PASS',status='PASS',audit_scope='REFERENCE_SOURCE_GQ_ONLY_NOT_COMPLETE_EXECUTION_AUDIT',evidence_kind=LABEL)
    def candidate(self,old,new,sigma):
        self.calls.append('candidate:'+str(sigma))
        q='UNKNOWN' if self.mode=='B' and sigma==.08 else 'PASS'
        if self.mode in ('C','SUCCESS') and sigma==.08:q='FAIL'
        return dict(old_G=True,new_G=True,old_Q='PASS',new_Q=q,sigma=sigma,probe_id=new['branch_id'],evidence_kind=LABEL)
    def candidate_values(self,row):self.calls.append('values:'+str(row['sigma']));return row
    def admit(self,rows):self.calls.append('admit');return dict(selected_sigma=rows[-1]['sigma'],evidence_kind=LABEL)
    def dynamic(self,name,sigma,admission):
        self.calls.append('dynamic:'+name)
        result=dict(branch_id=name,raw_output='SYNTHETIC_RAW_RETAINED',sigma=sigma,raw_task_completed=True,evidence_kind=LABEL)
        self.dynamic_results[name]=result;return result
    def dynamic_realized(self,b0,b1,sigma):self.calls.append('dynamic_realized');return self.mode!='C'
    def b3(self):self.calls.append('b3');return dict(evidence_kind=LABEL)
    def f1(self,b1):self.calls.append('f1')
    def special(self,name,source):self.calls.append('special:'+name)
    def final_science(self,*args):self.calls.append('final_science');return self.final_result

    def test_resource_receipt_accepts_valid_and_exact_limit(self):
        for label,measured_cpu,measured_wall in [('normal',1.25,2.5),('zero',0,0),('cpu_equal',480,2.5),('wall_equal',1.25,600),('both_equal',480,600)]:
            r=receipt_fixture();r.update(tree_cpu_seconds=measured_cpu,wall_seconds=measured_wall)
            result=resource_case(self,label,r,'PASS')
            self.assertTrue(result['resource_validation']['numeric_valid']);self.assertTrue(result['resource_validation']['single_attempt_valid'])
        tree=ast.parse((ROOT/'scripts/stfbs_d1b_qm_run_g1_watchdog.py').read_text())
        main=next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='main')
        calls=[n for n in ast.walk(main) if isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Name) and n.func.id=='final_resource_audit']
        self.assertEqual(len(calls),1)

    def test_resource_receipt_rejects_nonfinite_negative_missing_and_bool(self):

            self.assertFalse(result['resource_validation']['single_attempt_valid'])
        r=receipt_fixture();r.pop('attempts');resource_case(self,'missing_attempts',r,'BLOCKED',reason='INVALID_ATTEMPT_COUNT')
        for field,value in [('status','TIMED_OUT'),('status',None),('exit_code',1),('exit_code',False),('cpu_complete',False),('cpu_complete',1),('active_processes',1),('active_processes',False)]:

        for field in ('status','exit_code','cpu_complete','active_processes'):
            r=receipt_fixture();r.pop(field);resource_case(self,'missing_exit:'+field,r,'BLOCKED')

def candidates(view):
    keys = c.catalogue(view)
    rows = [dict(absolute_O=1., baseline=0., v=1.) for _ in keys]
    return c.select_candidates(view, keys, rows, source=c.FIXTURE)


def selector_input(view, matrix):
    actions = candidates(view)['candidates']
    worlds = w.generate_worlds(view)['worlds'][:3]
    ctx = s.table_context(actions, worlds, economy_digest='synthetic-economy')
    rows = [dict(assignment_key=a['assignment_key'], world_digest=h['world_digest'],
                 context_digest=ctx, source=c.FIXTURE, value=float(matrix[i][j]))
            for i, a in enumerate(actions) for j, h in enumerate(worlds)]
    return actions, worlds, rows, dict(economy_digest='synthetic-economy', context_digest=ctx)


def test_candidate_counts_keys_and_idle_member_switch(view):
    out = candidates(view)
    assert len(out['audit']) == 13
    assert {kind: sum(a['kind'] == kind for a in out['audit']) for kind in
            ('KEEP', 'SWITCH', 'MEMBER_CHANGE', 'EXCLUDED')} == dict(KEEP=1, SWITCH=6, MEMBER_CHANGE=4, EXCLUDED=2)
    for a in out['candidates']:
        group = [b for b in out['audit'] if b['kind'] == a['kind']]
        optimum = max(Fraction(b['exact_value']) for b in group)
        assert a['assignment_key'] == min(b['assignment_key'] for b in group if Fraction(b['exact_value']) == optimum)
    # Explicitly give an original-idle-member SWITCH the largest score.
    keys = c.catalogue(view)
    rows = [dict(absolute_O=0., baseline=0., v=0.) for _ in keys]
    index = next(i for i, k in enumerate(keys) if k['target'] == 1 and k['robots'] == [0, 2])
    rows[index] = dict(absolute_O=100., baseline=0., v=100.)
    out = c.select_candidates(view, keys, rows, source=c.FIXTURE)
    switch = next(a for a in out['candidates'] if a['kind'] == 'SWITCH')
    assert switch['actions'][2]['target'] == 1


@pytest.mark.parametrize('mutation', ['tick', 'repeat', 'visible', 'team', 'source', 'position'])
def test_applicability_rejection(view, mutation):
    if mutation == 'tick': view['tick'] = 61
    if mutation == 'repeat': view['attempted_ticks'] = [60]
    if mutation == 'visible': view['visible_ids'] = [0]
    if mutation == 'team': view['assignment'][1]['target'] = None
    if mutation == 'source': view['public_provenance'] = 'PRIVATE'
    if mutation == 'position': view['positions'][0][0] = math.nan
    assert c.applicability(view) != 'APPLICABLE'


@pytest.mark.parametrize('bad', ['missing', 'order', 'nan', 'arithmetic', 'baseline', 'source'])
def test_score_contract(view, bad):
    keys = c.catalogue(view)
    rows = [dict(absolute_O=1., baseline=0., v=1.) for _ in keys]
    source = c.FIXTURE
    if bad == 'missing': rows.pop()
    if bad == 'order': keys.reverse()
    if bad == 'nan': rows[0]['v'] = math.nan
    if bad == 'arithmetic': rows[0]['v'] = 2.
    if bad == 'baseline': rows[0] = dict(absolute_O=2., baseline=1., v=1.)
    if bad == 'source': source = 'REAL_A2'
    with pytest.raises(ValueError): c.select_candidates(view, keys, rows, source=source)

def test_six_accounting_columns(view):
    cfg = Config(**view['config'])
    outcomes = {0: dict(stop_time=4., completion_tick=80), 1: dict(stop_time=5., completion_tick=None)}
    columns, value = p.ledger(cfg, view['targets'], 60, outcomes, 12., 2)
    expected = dict(completion=2/8, flow=cfg.flow_weight*6/24,
                    late=cfg.late_weight*2/24, effort=cfg.control_weight*12/cfg.effort_reference,
                    terminal=cfg.unfinished_weight*2/8, change=cfg.change_cost*2)
    assert columns == expected
    assert value == expected['completion']-sum(expected[k] for k in ('flow', 'late', 'effort', 'terminal', 'change'))


def proxy_table(view):
    actions = candidates(view)['candidates']
    worlds = w.generate_worlds(view)['worlds'][:4]
    results = {(a['assignment_key'], h['world_digest']): p.run_proxy(view, a['actions'], h)
               for a in actions for h in worlds}
    return actions, worlds, results


def test_screen_ordinal_not_digest_and_h3_difference(view):
    actions, worlds, results = screening_table(view)
    # Real generated digests do not sort in ordinal order. Never mutate them.
    assert sorted(worlds[1:], key=lambda h: h['world_digest'])[0]['world_ordinal'] != 1
    for i, h in enumerate(worlds):
        for a in actions:
            r = results[a['assignment_key'], h['world_digest']]
            set_proxy_value(r, 0. if a['kind'] == 'KEEP' or i == 0 else 1.)
    out = w.screen_worlds(actions, worlds, results, view=view)
    assert out['H2']['world_ordinal'] == 1
    assert out['H3']['world_ordinal'] == 2
    assert out['h3_score'] == 1.
    for r in results.values():
        for task in r['tasks'].values(): task.update(P0=0., NG=0)
    assert w.screen_worlds(actions, worlds, results, view=view)['status'] == 'H2_NONTRIVIAL_BOUNDARY_UNAVAILABLE'


def test_h2_completed_boundary_and_no_alternative(view):
    actions, worlds, results = screening_table(view)
    for h in worlds:
        for a in actions:
            for task in results[a['assignment_key'], h['world_digest']]['tasks'].values():
                if task['complete_team']:
                    task.update(Pmax=2., NG=1, completion_tick=119 if h['world_ordinal'] == 2 else 100)
    assert w.screen_worlds(actions, worlds, results, view=view)['H2']['world_ordinal'] == 2
    keep_results = {k: v for k, v in results.items() if k[0] == actions[0]['assignment_key']}
    assert w.screen_worlds(actions[:1], worlds, keep_results, view=view)['status'] == 'H3_NO_ALTERNATIVE_ACTION'


def set_proxy_value(result, value):
    result['value'] = float(value)
    result['ledger'] = dict(completion=max(0., float(value)), flow=max(0., -float(value)),
                            late=0., effort=0., terminal=0., change=0.)


def screening_table(view):
    """Complete, identity-bound artificial proxy metrics; not physical evidence."""
    actions = candidates(view)['candidates']
    worlds = w.generate_worlds(view)['worlds']
    results = {}
    for a in actions:
        assigned, _ = c.team(a['actions'])
        for h in worlds:
            r = dict(proxy_role='OPTIMISTIC_Q_PROXY', assignment_key=a['assignment_key'],
                     world_digest=h['world_digest'], tasks={
                         t['id']: dict(P0=0., Pmax=1. if t['id'] == assigned else 0.,
                                       NG=1 if t['id'] == assigned else 0, duration=t['service_duration'],
                                       complete_team=t['id'] == assigned, completion_tick=None)
                         for t in view['targets']})
            set_proxy_value(r, 0.)
            results[a['assignment_key'], h['world_digest']] = r
    return actions, worlds, results

@pytest.mark.parametrize('bad', ['missing', 'nan', 'inf', 'duplicate', 'source', 'identity', 'context', 'world', 'budget'])
def test_bad_value_table_fallback(view, bad):
    a, worlds, rows, kw = selector_input(view, [[1]*3]*3)
    if bad == 'missing': rows.pop()
    if bad == 'nan': rows[0]['value'] = math.nan
    if bad == 'inf': rows[0]['value'] = math.inf
    if bad == 'duplicate': rows.append(deepcopy(rows[0]))
    if bad == 'source': rows[0]['source'] = 'MODEL'
    if bad == 'identity': rows[0]['assignment_key'] = ((99, 1),)*3
    if bad == 'context': rows[0]['context_digest'] = 'other-economy'
    if bad == 'world': worlds[1]['world_digest'] = worlds[0]['world_digest']
    if bad == 'budget': kw['budget_available'] = False
    assert s.select(a, worlds, rows, **kw)['status'] == 'KEEP_FALLBACK'
    assert s.select(a, worlds, rows, keep_legal=False, a2_available=True, **kw)['status'] == ('BLOCKED_NO_LEGAL_ACTION' if bad == 'budget' else 'A2_FALLBACK_REQUIRED')
    assert s.select(a, worlds, rows, keep_legal=False, **kw)['status'] == 'BLOCKED_NO_LEGAL_ACTION'

def test_recorded_g_is_not_recomputed_from_world(view):
    # A slightly shifted conditional position is outside current tolerance but
    # reachable at the right endpoint. The recorded left G must remain true.
    view['targets'][0]['design_error_bound'] = .31
    world = next(h for h in w.generate_worlds(view)['worlds']
                 if h['motion'][0]['position'] == (5.155, 5.)
                 and h['motion'][0]['velocity'] == (0., 0.))
    # Steer right endpoint to the conditional anchors, without rewriting history.
    def controlled_command(belief, tick, positions, roles, cfg):
        return np.array([[3., 0.]]) if tick == 60 else policy.command(belief, tick, positions, roles, cfg)
    with patch.object(p, 'command', side_effect=controlled_command):
        out = p.run_proxy(view, view['assignment'], world)
    assert out['left_endpoints'][0]['G'] is True
    assert out['tasks'][0]['NG'] >= 1
    assert out['tasks'][0]['Pmax'] >= .55
    # Conversely a recorded G=false cannot become true at the current endpoint.
    view['current_endpoints'][0]['G'] = False
    view['service_states'][0] = replace(view['service_states'][0], base=0.)
    nominal = w.generate_worlds(view)['worlds'][0]
    out = p.run_proxy(view, view['assignment'], nominal)
    assert out['left_endpoints'][0]['G'] is False
    assert out['tasks'][0]['completion_tick'] == 101
    assert out['tasks'][0]['NG'] == 40

def test_non_nominal_filter_leaves_insufficient_worlds(view):
    for t in view['targets']:
        t.update(design_error_bound=0., speed_limit=0.)
    # nominal at the east edge remains active; east perturbations are outside.
    view['targets'][0].update(design_error_bound=1., speed_limit=.1)
    view['beliefs'][0]['position_estimate'] = [19.5, 20.]
    view['beliefs'][0]['velocity_estimate'] = [.1, 0.]
    # Remove position perturbations: only the nominal velocity survives speed bound.
    view['targets'][0]['design_error_bound'] = 0.
    assert w.generate_worlds(view)['status'] == 'WORLD_SET_INSUFFICIENT'
    # A nonzero position library can also be filtered to fewer than three:
    # enormous r makes all nonzero perturbations leave the initial physical domain.
    view['targets'][0]['design_error_bound'] = 100.
    out = w.generate_worlds(view)
    assert out['status'] == 'WORLD_SET_INSUFFICIENT'
    assert len(out['worlds']) == 1 and out['worlds'][0]['is_h1']
    assert w.screen_worlds([], out['worlds'], {}, view=view)['status'] == 'WORLD_SET_INSUFFICIENT'


@pytest.mark.parametrize('bad', ['digest', 'motion', 'context', 'ordinal', 'order', 'subset',
                                'h1', 'horizon', 'rule', 'tick', 'rehashed_motion'])
def test_screen_rejects_noncanonical_worlds(view, bad):
    actions, worlds, results = screening_table(view)
    if bad == 'digest': worlds[1]['world_digest'] = 'replaced'
    if bad in ('motion', 'rehashed_motion'):
        worlds[1]['motion'][0]['position'] = (6., 6.)
        if bad == 'rehashed_motion': worlds[1]['world_digest'] = w.world_digest(worlds[1])
    if bad == 'context': view['public_profiles'][0]['sigma'] = .1
    if bad == 'ordinal': worlds[1]['world_ordinal'] = 0
    if bad == 'order': worlds[1], worlds[2] = worlds[2], worlds[1]
    if bad == 'subset': worlds = worlds[:3]
    if bad == 'h1': worlds[1]['is_h1'] = True
    if bad == 'horizon': worlds[1]['horizon'] = 119
    if bad == 'rule': worlds[1]['generation_rule'] = 'foreign'
    if bad == 'tick': worlds[1]['tick'] = 80
    assert w.screen_worlds(actions, worlds, results, view=view)['status'] == 'SCREENING_VALIDATION_FAILED'


@pytest.mark.parametrize('bad', ['identity', 'assignment', 'source', 'missing_cell', 'extra_cell', 'duplicate',
                                'missing_task', 'extra_task', 'p0_nan', 'pmax_inf', 'ng_bool', 'ng_float',
                                'duration_nan', 'ct_float', 'value_nan', 'value_inf', 'ledger_missing',
                                'ledger_inf', 'ledger_mismatch'])
def test_screen_rejects_invalid_proxy_table(view, bad):
    actions, worlds, results = screening_table(view)
    cell = next(iter(results))
    r = results[cell]
    task = r['tasks'][0]
    if bad == 'identity': r['world_digest'] = 'foreign'
    if bad == 'assignment': r['assignment_key'] = actions[1]['assignment_key']
    if bad == 'source': r['proxy_role'] = 'MODEL'
    if bad == 'missing_cell': del results[cell]
    if bad == 'extra_cell': results[(cell[0], 'foreign')] = deepcopy(r)
    if bad == 'duplicate': results = list(results.items())+[(cell, deepcopy(r))]
    if bad == 'missing_task': del r['tasks'][0]
    if bad == 'extra_task': r['tasks'][99] = deepcopy(task)
    if bad == 'p0_nan': task['P0'] = math.nan
    if bad == 'pmax_inf': task['Pmax'] = math.inf
    if bad == 'ng_bool': task['NG'] = True
    if bad == 'ng_float': task['NG'] = 1.
    if bad == 'duration_nan': task['duration'] = math.nan
    if bad == 'ct_float': task['completion_tick'] = 90.
    if bad == 'value_nan': r['value'] = math.nan
    if bad == 'value_inf': r['value'] = math.inf
    if bad == 'ledger_missing': del r['ledger']['flow']
    if bad == 'ledger_inf': r['ledger']['flow'] = math.inf
    if bad == 'ledger_mismatch': r['value'] = 1.
    assert w.screen_worlds(actions, worlds, results, view=view)['status'] == 'SCREENING_VALIDATION_FAILED'


def test_h3_exact_difference_avoids_binary64_overflow_tie(view):
    actions, worlds, results = screening_table(view)
    large = float.fromhex('0x1.fffffffffffffp+1023')
    lesser = math.nextafter(large, 0.)
    for a in actions:
        for h in worlds:
            value = 0.
            if h['world_ordinal'] in (2, 3):
                magnitude = lesser if h['world_ordinal'] == 2 else large
                value = -magnitude if a['kind'] == 'KEEP' else magnitude
            set_proxy_value(results[a['assignment_key'], h['world_digest']], value)
    out = w.screen_worlds(actions, worlds, results, view=view)
    assert out['H2']['world_ordinal'] == 1
    assert out['H3']['world_ordinal'] == 3  # rounded float differences both overflow
    assert out['h3_score'] == 2*Fraction.from_float(large)


def test_h2_exact_recorded_margin_and_reproducibility(view):
    actions, worlds, results = screening_table(view)
    for a in actions:
        for h in worlds:
            for task in results[a['assignment_key'], h['world_digest']]['tasks'].values():
                if task['complete_team']:
                    task['Pmax'] = math.nextafter(2.-w.TOL, 0.) if h['world_ordinal'] == 2 else 1.
    before = deepcopy((view, actions, worlds, results))
    out = w.screen_worlds(actions, worlds, results, view=view)
    assert out['H2']['world_ordinal'] == 2
    expected = abs(math.nextafter(2.-w.TOL, 0.)-(2.-w.TOL))
    assert out['h2_score'] == Fraction.from_float(expected)
    assert w.screen_worlds(actions, worlds, results, view=view) == out
    assert (view, actions, worlds, results) == before


def test_h3_exact_finite_difference_breaks_rounded_tie(view):
    actions, worlds, results = screening_table(view)
    base = float(2**53)
    for a in actions:
        for h in worlds:
            value = 0.
            if h['world_ordinal'] in (2, 3):
                value = (-.5 if h['world_ordinal'] == 2 else -1.) if a['kind'] == 'KEEP' else base
            set_proxy_value(results[a['assignment_key'], h['world_digest']], value)
    assert base-(-.5) == base-(-1.)  # binary64 subtraction erases this distinction
    out = w.screen_worlds(actions, worlds, results, view=view)
    assert out['H3']['world_ordinal'] == 3
    assert out['h3_score'] == Fraction(2**53+1)


def test_complete_real_g_only_proxy_table_satisfies_contract(view):
    # Four legal worlds, all evaluated; no arbitrary subset and no WLS/MODEL.
    for t in view['targets']:
        t['design_error_bound'] = 0.
    actions = candidates(view)['candidates']
    worlds = w.generate_worlds(view)['worlds']
    assert len(worlds) == 4
    results = {(a['assignment_key'], h['world_digest']): p.run_proxy(view, a['actions'], h)
               for a in actions for h in worlds}
    assert w.screen_worlds(actions, worlds, results, view=view)['status'] == 'WORLD_SET_FROZEN'

def forbid_computation(monkeypatch):
    from research.non_oracle import policy, environment, stfbs_d1a_model, stfbs_d1b_qm_model
    from research.cooperative_sensing import estimator
    import scipy.optimize

    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
        raise AssertionError('Forbidden A2/WLS/freeze/physical execution')

    for name in ('decide', 'evaluate', 'endpoint', 'estimate'):
        monkeypatch.setattr(policy, name, forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(estimator, 'estimate', forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(estimator, 'least_squares', forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(scipy.optimize, 'least_squares', forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Beliefs, 'freeze', forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(environment.NonOracleEnvironment, 'prepare_decision', forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(stfbs_d1a_model.Branch, 'advance', forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(stfbs_d1a_model.Branch, 'run', forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(stfbs_d1b_qm_model.QMBranch, 'run', forbidden)


def event(j, index, kind, when, segment_id=None):
    return dict(event_index=index, target_id=j, kind=kind, segment_id=segment_id,
                at=dict(time_seconds=when*.05, event_tick=when), progress_before=0., progress_after=0.)


def slot(j, i, tick, state='UNQUERIED'):
    return dict(slot_key=dict(target_id=j, robot_id=i, tick=tick), state=state,
                packet=None, slot_digest=None)


def seal_external_fixture(cut):
    """Artificial issuer in test code, not a production trust-root factory."""
    cut['public_snapshot_digest'] = digest(pa._public_payload(cut))
    cut['trusted_prefix_digest'] = cs.cut_prefix_digest(cut)
    return cs.ExternalTrustRoot(cut['episode_id'], cut['source_identity'], cut['cut_tick'], cut['cut_phase'],
                               cut['trusted_prefix_digest'], cut['public_snapshot_digest'],
                               digest(cut['freeze_boundary_identity']), cs.SYNTHETIC_ROOT)


def consumer_boundary(cut):
    cut['freeze_boundary_identity']['consumer_digest'] = digest(dict(
        states=cut['consumer_states'], history=cut['accepted_position_history'],
        consumed=cut['consumed_records'], receipts=cut['accepted_receipts']))


def fixture(tick):
    cfg = Config(robots=3, task_count=2, capture_mode='stepwise_service', geometry_mode='angular_standoff_v1')
    actions = [dict(target=0, role='dual_neg45'), dict(target=0, role='dual_pos45'), dict(target=None, role='none')]
    members = [dict(robot_id=i, role=a['role']) for i, a in enumerate(actions[:2])]
    announcements = [dict(id=j, announcement_tick=0, birth=0., weight=2., deadline=6.,
                          service_duration=2., required_robots=2, coarse_position=[5.+j, 5.],
                          velocity_prior=[0., 0.], design_error_bound=.4, speed_limit=1.,
                          motion_model='constant_velocity') for j in (0, 1)]
    consumer = Beliefs(announcements)
    histories = {}
    zero = dict(base=0., intervals=0, team=deepcopy(members))
    endpoint = dict(tick=tick, target_id=0, team=deepcopy(members), G=True,
                    quality=dict(status='UNKNOWN', radius_proxy=None),
                    slots=[slot(0, i, tick, 'MISSING') for i in (0, 1)])
    seg = dict(contract_id='gq_online_service_segment_v1', target_id=0, segment_index=0,
               previous_segment_id=None, start_tick=0, team=deepcopy(members), opened_by='FIRST_ASSIGNMENT',
               initial_clock=deepcopy(zero), latest_clock=deepcopy(zero), latest_endpoint=endpoint,
               closure=None, events=[])
    seg['segment_id'] = segment_identity(seg)
    e = event(0, 0, 'ASSIGNED', 0, seg['segment_id'])
    seg['events'] = [deepcopy(e)]
    histories['0'] = dict(target_id=0, birth_tick=0, cutoff_tick=tick, active_segment_id=seg['segment_id'],
                          segments=[seg], unassigned_intervals=[], events=[e])
    e1 = event(1, 1, 'BORN', 0)
    histories['1'] = dict(target_id=1, birth_tick=0, cutoff_tick=tick, active_segment_id=None,
                          segments=[], unassigned_intervals=[dict(start_tick=0, end_at=None, opened_by='BIRTH',
                          opening_event_index=1, closing_event_index=None)], events=[e1])
    current = [slot(j, i, tick, 'MISSING' if j == 0 and i < 2 else 'UNQUERIED')
               for j in (0, 1) for i in range(3)]
    raw = []
    for s in current[:2]:
        context = dict(episode_id='synthetic-episode', acquisition='synthetic-slot')
        raw.append(dict(slot=deepcopy(s), slot_digest=digest(s), context=context, context_digest=digest(context)))
    states = {str(j): b for j, b in consumer.states.items()}
    policy = dict(tick=tick, config=cfg.to_dict(), positions=[[5., 4.5], [5., 5.5], [7., 7.]],
                  assignment=deepcopy(actions), targets=deepcopy(announcements), beliefs=deepcopy(states))
    economics = dict(completion=0., flow=-.1, late=-.02, effort=-.03, terminal=0.)
    cut = dict(episode_id='synthetic-episode', cut_tick=tick, cut_phase=cs.PHASE,
               source_identity='synthetic-independent-issuer', trusted_prefix_digest='', public_snapshot_digest='',
               freeze_boundary_identity=dict(cut_tick=tick, freeze_ordinal=10, consumer_digest=''),
               physical_cut_state=dict(tick=tick, positions=deepcopy(policy['positions']), assignment=deepcopy(actions),
                   terminal_status={'0': 'active', '1': 'active'}, settled_economic_components=deepcopy(economics),
                   change_cost_so_far=.02, private_future_motion={'secret': [99, 99]}),
               current_assignment=deepcopy(actions), terminal_status={'0': 'active', '1': 'active'},
               task_histories=histories, service_segments=[deepcopy(seg)], consumer_states=states,
               accepted_position_history={'0': [], '1': []}, pending_observations=[], consumed_records=[],
               accepted_receipts={}, frozen_public_beliefs=deepcopy(states), raw_cache_history=raw,
               current_slots=current, public_profile_watermark=tick,
               trusted_sensor_authority_state=dict(published_watermark=tick, private_future_schedule=[{'secret': 99}]),
               settled_economic_components=economics, change_cost_so_far=.02,
               public_source=dict(policy_view=policy, published_announcements=deepcopy(announcements),
                   published_profiles=[dict(sensor_id=f'U{i}', observed_tick=tick, sigma=.02, health='available') for i in range(3)],
                   visible_ids=[0, 1], attempted_ticks=[]),
               observation_arrivals=[], freeze_boundaries={str(tick): 10}, evidence_kind=cs.SYNTHETIC_CUT)
    consumer_boundary(cut)
    return cut, seal_external_fixture(cut)


@pytest.mark.parametrize('tick', [60, 80, 100])
def test_import_synthetic_cut_at_actual_tick(tick):
    cut, root = fixture(tick)
    before = deepcopy(cut)
    out = cs.import_verified_cut(cut, trusted_root=root)
    assert out['status'] == 'SYNTHETIC_CUT_INTERFACE_VERIFIED'
    assert out['real_causal_restore_verified'] is False
    assert out['applicability'] == 'APPLICABLE'
    view = out['public_snapshot'].to_view()
    assert view['tick'] == tick and generate_worlds(view)['status'] == 'WORLDS_GENERATED'
    restored = out['trusted_state'].to_restore_payload()
    assert restored == cut
    assert restored['settled_economic_components'] == before['settled_economic_components']
    assert out['future_economic_origin'] == 'EXCLUDE_SETTLED_PREFIX_FROM_FUTURE_VALUE'
    assert cut == before
    assert cs.import_verified_cut(cut, trusted_root=root)['public_snapshot'] == out['public_snapshot']
    view['positions'][0][0] = -99
    restored['trusted_sensor_authority_state']['private_future_schedule'].clear()
    assert out['public_snapshot'].to_view()['positions'] == before['physical_cut_state']['positions']
    assert out['trusted_state'].to_restore_payload() == cut


@pytest.mark.parametrize('field,value', [('expected_episode_id', 'foreign'), ('expected_cut_tick', 80),
    ('expected_cut_phase', 'PRE_FREEZE'), ('expected_source_identity', 'foreign'),
    ('expected_trusted_prefix_digest', 'bad'), ('expected_public_snapshot_digest', 'bad'),
    ('expected_freeze_boundary', 'bad')])
def test_external_root_mismatch(field, value):
    cut, root = fixture(60)
    assert cs.import_verified_cut(cut, trusted_root=replace(root, **{field: value}))['status'] == 'EXTERNAL_ROOT_IDENTITY_CONFLICT'


def test_no_self_authentication_or_synthetic_elevation():
    cut, root = fixture(60)
    assert cs.verify_trusted_cut(cut)['status'] == 'EXTERNAL_TRUST_ROOT_REQUIRED'
    assert cs.verify_trusted_cut(cut, trusted_root=cut)['status'] == 'EXTERNAL_TRUST_ROOT_REQUIRED'
    assert cs.verify_trusted_cut(cut, trusted_root=root, requested_certification='REAL_CAUSAL_RESTORE_VERIFIED')['status'] == 'REAL_CERTIFICATION_NOT_AVAILABLE'
    assert cs.verify_trusted_cut(cut, trusted_root=replace(root, evidence_kind='REAL_EXECUTOR'))['status'] == 'REAL_TRUST_PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED'
    cut['physical_cut_state']['private_future_motion']['secret'][0] = 100
    assert cs.verify_trusted_cut(cut, trusted_root=root)['status'] == 'EXTERNAL_ROOT_IDENTITY_CONFLICT'
    cut['trusted_prefix_digest'] = cs.cut_prefix_digest(cut)
    assert cs.verify_trusted_cut(cut, trusted_root=root)['status'] == 'EXTERNAL_ROOT_IDENTITY_CONFLICT'


def test_public_projection_no_private_reference_or_bypass():
    cut, root = fixture(60)
    cut['public_source']['policy_view']['targets'][0]['private_schedule'] = 'SECRET'
    cut['public_source']['published_announcements'][0]['private_schedule'] = 'SECRET'
    cut['frozen_public_beliefs']['0']['diagnostics'] = {'private_future': 'SECRET'}
    cut['consumer_states']['0']['diagnostics'] = {'private_future': 'SECRET'}
    cut['public_source']['policy_view']['beliefs']['0']['diagnostics'] = {'private_future': 'SECRET'}
    consumer_boundary(cut)
    root = seal_external_fixture(cut)
    out = cs.import_verified_cut(cut, trusted_root=root)
    assert out['status'] == 'SYNTHETIC_CUT_INTERFACE_VERIFIED'
    assert 'SECRET' not in out['public_snapshot']._json
    assert 'private' not in out['public_snapshot']._json
    assert 'trusted_prefix' not in out['public_snapshot']._json
    with pytest.raises(pa.ProjectionError): pa.PublicDecisionSnapshot({}, cs.SYNTHETIC_CUT)
    with pytest.raises(FrozenInstanceError): out['public_snapshot'].evidence_kind = 'REAL'


@pytest.mark.parametrize('missing', ['design_error_bound', 'speed_limit', 'motion_model', 'coarse_position', 'velocity_prior'])
def test_missing_announcements_fail_closed(missing):
    cut, root = fixture(60)
    del cut['public_source']['published_announcements'][0][missing]
    # Independent root can bind even an invalid candidate. Structural validation
    # must still refuse it; never substitute private physical fields.
    cut['trusted_prefix_digest'] = cs.cut_prefix_digest(cut)
    root = replace(root, expected_trusted_prefix_digest=cut['trusted_prefix_digest'])
    assert cs.import_verified_cut(cut, trusted_root=root)['status'] == 'PUBLIC_ANNOUNCEMENT_FIELDS_MISSING'


@pytest.mark.parametrize('bad', ['future_announcement', 'model', 'profile_watermark', 'future_profile', 'phase',
                                'physical_position', 'service_clock', 'raw_conflict', 'economic', 'assignment',
                                'receipt', 'frozen_belief', 'boundary'])
def test_reject_semantic_conflicts_even_with_matching_external_binding(bad):
    cut, root = fixture(80)
    if bad == 'future_announcement': cut['public_source']['published_announcements'][0]['announcement_tick'] = 100
    if bad == 'model': cut['public_source']['published_announcements'][0]['motion_model'] = 'unknown'
    if bad == 'profile_watermark': cut['public_profile_watermark'] = 100
    if bad == 'future_profile': cut['public_source']['published_profiles'][0]['observed_tick'] = 100
    if bad == 'phase': cut['cut_phase'] = 'POST_ASSIGNMENT'
    if bad == 'physical_position': cut['physical_cut_state']['positions'][0][0] = 999
    if bad == 'service_clock': cut['task_histories']['0']['segments'][0]['latest_clock']['base'] = .5
    if bad == 'raw_conflict': cut['raw_cache_history'][0]['slot']['state'] = 'VALID'
    if bad == 'economic': cut['settled_economic_components']['flow'] = -.2
    if bad == 'assignment': cut['current_assignment'][0]['target'] = 1
    if bad == 'receipt': cut['accepted_receipts']['0'] = {}
    if bad == 'frozen_belief': cut['frozen_public_beliefs']['0']['position_estimate'][0] = 999
    if bad == 'boundary': cut['freeze_boundary_identity']['freeze_ordinal'] = 9
    # Preserve original expected public digest so invalid source paths can reject
    # before projection rather than trying to mint a successful snapshot.
    cut['trusted_prefix_digest'] = cs.cut_prefix_digest(cut)
    root = replace(root, expected_trusted_prefix_digest=cut['trusted_prefix_digest'],
                   expected_cut_phase=cut['cut_phase'], expected_freeze_boundary=digest(cut['freeze_boundary_identity']))
    assert cs.import_verified_cut(cut, trusted_root=root)['status'] != 'SYNTHETIC_CUT_INTERFACE_VERIFIED'


def add_queue(cut, *, after_freeze, future_delivery=False):
    tick = cut['cut_tick']
    obs = dict(source='ACTUAL', target_id=0, measurement_tick=tick,
               available_tick=tick+1 if future_delivery else tick, estimate=None)
    pending = after_freeze or future_delivery
    cut['observation_arrivals'] = [dict(arrival_ordinal=11 if after_freeze else 1,
                                      consumed_tick=None if pending else tick, observation=obs)]
    cut['pending_observations'] = [deepcopy(obs)] if pending else []
    cut['consumed_records'] = [] if pending else [dict(target_id=0, measurement_tick=tick, available_tick=tick, consumed_tick=tick)]
    consumer_boundary(cut)


@pytest.mark.parametrize('tick', [60, 80, 100])
@pytest.mark.parametrize('after,future', [(True, False), (False, False), (False, True)])
def test_queue_freeze_boundary_not_available_tick_alone(tick, after, future):
    cut, _ = fixture(tick)
    add_queue(cut, after_freeze=after, future_delivery=future)
    root = seal_external_fixture(cut)
    out = cs.import_verified_cut(cut, trusted_root=root)
    assert out['status'] == 'SYNTHETIC_CUT_INTERFACE_VERIFIED'
    assert out['trusted_state'].to_restore_payload()['pending_observations'] == cut['pending_observations']


@pytest.mark.parametrize('bad', ['lost_pending', 'early_consume', 'lost_consumed', 'duplicate_arrival'])
def test_queue_conflict_refused(bad):
    cut, _ = fixture(100)
    add_queue(cut, after_freeze=bad != 'lost_consumed')
    if bad == 'lost_pending': cut['pending_observations'] = []
    if bad == 'early_consume': cut['observation_arrivals'][0]['consumed_tick'] = 100
    if bad == 'lost_consumed': cut['consumed_records'] = []
    if bad == 'duplicate_arrival': cut['observation_arrivals'].append(deepcopy(cut['observation_arrivals'][0]))
    consumer_boundary(cut)
    root = seal_external_fixture(cut)
    assert cs.import_verified_cut(cut, trusted_root=root)['status'] != 'SYNTHETIC_CUT_INTERFACE_VERIFIED'


def test_full_history_unavailable_cannot_be_seed_import():
    cut, root = fixture(60)
    for prefix in (None, {}, {'complete': True, 'seed': cut}, cut):

        assert out['status'] == 'FULL_CAUSAL_HISTORY_PREFIX_UNAVAILABLE'
        assert out['d60_belief_replay'] == 'NOT_VERIFIED'
        assert out['d60_full_causal_cut'] == 'NOT_VERIFIED'
    assert cs.recover_from_verified_history(cut)['status'] == 'EXTERNAL_TRUST_ROOT_REQUIRED'

def add_accepted_observation(cut):
    tick = cut['cut_tick']
    estimate = dict(has_accepted_estimate=True, optimizer_converged=True,
                    numerical_ill_conditioned=False, ambiguity_detected=False,
                    boundary_active=False, numeric_contract_violation=False, estimate=[5., 5.])
    obs = dict(source='ACTUAL', target_id=0, measurement_tick=tick, available_tick=tick, estimate=estimate)
    cut['observation_arrivals'] = [dict(arrival_ordinal=1, consumed_tick=tick, observation=obs)]
    receipt = dict(target_id=0, measurement_tick=tick, available_tick=tick, consumed_tick=tick)
    cut['consumed_records'] = [receipt]
    cut['accepted_receipts'] = {'0': deepcopy(receipt)}
    cut['accepted_position_history']['0'] = [[tick, [5., 5.]]]
    b = cut['consumer_states']['0']
    b.update(estimate_tick=tick, available_tick=tick, last_observation_tick=tick,
             position_estimate=[5., 5.], source='ACTUAL_WLS', status='OBSERVED', diagnostics=estimate)
    cut['frozen_public_beliefs'] = deepcopy(cut['consumer_states'])
    cut['public_source']['policy_view']['beliefs'] = deepcopy(cut['frozen_public_beliefs'])
    consumer_boundary(cut)


@pytest.mark.parametrize('tick', [60, 80, 100])
def test_accepted_receipt_and_pending_coexist_without_refreeze(tick):
    cut, _ = fixture(tick)
    add_accepted_observation(cut)
    pending = dict(source='ACTUAL', target_id=1, measurement_tick=tick, available_tick=tick, estimate=None)
    cut['observation_arrivals'].append(dict(arrival_ordinal=11, consumed_tick=None, observation=pending))
    cut['pending_observations'] = [deepcopy(pending)]
    root = seal_external_fixture(cut)
    out = cs.import_verified_cut(cut, trusted_root=root)
    assert out['status'] == 'SYNTHETIC_CUT_INTERFACE_VERIFIED'
    payload = out['trusted_state'].to_restore_payload()
    assert payload['accepted_receipts'] == cut['accepted_receipts']
    assert payload['pending_observations'] == [pending]
    assert out['public_snapshot'].to_view()['beliefs'][0]['last_observation_tick'] == tick


@pytest.mark.parametrize('bad', ['receipt', 'position', 'flags', 'consumed_duplicate', 'accepted_duplicate'])
def test_accepted_consumer_conflicts_rejected(bad):

def terminal_fixture():
    cut, _ = fixture(100)
    h = cut['task_histories']['1']
    end = event(1, 2, 'ESCAPED', 99)
    end['processed_tick'] = 99
    h['events'].append(end)
    h['cutoff_tick'] = 99
    h['unassigned_intervals'][0].update(end_at=deepcopy(end['at']), closing_event_index=2)
    cut['terminal_status']['1'] = 'escaped'
    cut['physical_cut_state']['terminal_status']['1'] = 'escaped'
    cut['public_source']['policy_view']['targets'] = cut['public_source']['policy_view']['targets'][:1]
    cut['public_source']['visible_ids'] = [0]
    cut['current_slots'] = cut['current_slots'][:3]
    return cut


def test_terminal_task_never_reactivated_and_not_applicable():
    cut = terminal_fixture()
    root = seal_external_fixture(cut)
    out = cs.import_verified_cut(cut, trusted_root=root)
    assert out['status'] == 'SYNTHETIC_CUT_INTERFACE_VERIFIED'
    assert out['applicability'] == 'NOT_APPLICABLE'
    assert out['public_snapshot'].to_view()['active_ids'] == [0]
    assert out['trusted_state'].to_restore_payload()['terminal_status']['1'] == 'escaped'
    cut['terminal_status']['1'] = cut['physical_cut_state']['terminal_status']['1'] = 'active'
    cut['trusted_prefix_digest'] = cs.cut_prefix_digest(cut)
    root = replace(root, expected_trusted_prefix_digest=cut['trusted_prefix_digest'])
    assert cs.import_verified_cut(cut, trusted_root=root)['status'] != 'SYNTHETIC_CUT_INTERFACE_VERIFIED'


def test_new_assignment_transaction_at_cut_is_rejected():
    cut, _ = fixture(60)
    ep = cut['task_histories']['0']['events'][0]
    ep['at'] = dict(time_seconds=3., event_tick=60)
    cut['trusted_prefix_digest'] = cs.cut_prefix_digest(cut)
    # A root over a structurally wrong state cannot authorize changing phases.
    root = seal_external_fixture(cut)
    assert cs.import_verified_cut(cut, trusted_root=root)['status'] == 'CURRENT_CUT_ASSIGNMENT_ALREADY_COMMITTED'


def test_delayed_receipt_freeze_status_projection_only():
    cut, _ = fixture(100)
    add_accepted_observation(cut)
    entry = cut['observation_arrivals'][0]
    entry['observation']['measurement_tick'] = 60
    entry['observation']['available_tick'] = 60
    entry['consumed_tick'] = 60
    cut['freeze_boundaries'] = {'60': 5, '100': 10}
    receipt = dict(target_id=0, measurement_tick=60, available_tick=60, consumed_tick=60)
    cut['consumed_records'] = [receipt]
    cut['accepted_receipts'] = {'0': deepcopy(receipt)}
    cut['accepted_position_history']['0'][0][0] = 60
    cut['consumer_states']['0'].update(estimate_tick=60, available_tick=60, last_observation_tick=60)
    cut['frozen_public_beliefs'] = deepcopy(cut['consumer_states'])
    cut['frozen_public_beliefs']['0']['status'] = 'DEGRADED'
    cut['public_source']['policy_view']['beliefs'] = deepcopy(cut['frozen_public_beliefs'])
    consumer_boundary(cut)
    root = seal_external_fixture(cut)
    out = cs.import_verified_cut(cut, trusted_root=root)
    assert out['status'] == 'SYNTHETIC_CUT_INTERFACE_VERIFIED'
    assert out['public_snapshot'].to_view()['beliefs'][0]['status'] == 'DEGRADED'
    assert cut['consumer_states']['0']['status'] == 'OBSERVED'

"""Real archived A2_R reconstruction; no new sensing, WLS or physical steps."""
from copy import deepcopy
from dataclasses import replace
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from research.non_oracle import stfbs_lite_archive_root as ar
from research.non_oracle import stfbs_lite_actual_recovery as recovery
from research.non_oracle import stfbs_lite_cut_state as imp2a
from research.non_oracle.stfbs_d1a_replay import digest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def forbid_new_science(monkeypatch):
    from research.cooperative_sensing import estimator
    from research.non_oracle import policy, environment, stfbs_d1a_model, stfbs_d1b_qm_model
    from research.information_service_online.execution import OnlineEnvironment, ActualMeasurementCache
    from research.information_service_bridge.public_stream import BridgeFrameProcessor
    import scipy.optimize

    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
        raise AssertionError('New science forbidden in archived-state reconstruction')

    for owner, names in (
        (estimator, ('estimate', 'least_squares')), (scipy.optimize, ('least_squares',)),
        (policy, ('decide', 'evaluate', 'endpoint', 'estimate')),
        (OnlineEnvironment, ('step', '_advance_tick', '_sample', '_fuse')),
        (ActualMeasurementCache, ('query', 'record_outcome')),
        (environment.NonOracleEnvironment, ('prepare_decision', '_fuse')),
        (BridgeFrameProcessor, ('process',)),
        (stfbs_d1a_model.Branch, ('run', 'advance', 'assign', 'fuse')),
        (stfbs_d1b_qm_model.QMBranch, ('run', 'advance', 'assign', 'fuse')),
    ):
        for name in names:
            monkeypatch.setattr(owner, name, forbidden)
    # Beliefs.freeze/enqueue/activate_visible remain enabled intentionally.


@pytest.fixture(scope='module')
def bound():
    return ar.bind_actual_archive(ROOT)


@pytest.mark.parametrize('tick,consumed,raw_count,fee', [(60,61,122,.02), (80,82,164,.04), (100,102,204,.04)])
def test_real_archive_cut_reconstruction(bound, tick, consumed, raw_count, fee):
    before = bound._documents_json
    result = recovery.recover_actual_cut(bound, tick)
    assert result['status'] == 'ARCHIVED_ACTUAL_CUT_RECONSTRUCTION_PASS', result
    cut = result['cut'].to_dict()
    docs = bound.documents()
    view = docs[f'R_D{tick}.json']['policy_input']
    prev = docs[f'R_D{tick-20}.json']['step']
    assert cut['cut_tick'] == prev['end_tick'] == view['tick'] == tick
    assert cut['cut_phase'] == 'POST_FREEZE_PRE_ASSIGNMENT'
    assert cut['checkpoint_id'] == prev['checkpoint_after']['checkpoint_id']
    assert cut['checkpoint_id'] == docs[f'R_D{tick}.json']['step']['action_commit']['checkpoint_id']
    assert cut['public_policy_view'] == view
    assert cut['frozen_public_beliefs'] == view['beliefs']
    assert cut['physical_cut_state']['positions'] == view['positions']
    assert cut['current_assignment'] == view['assignment']
    assert list(cut['task_histories'].values()) == view['histories']
    assert len(cut['consumed_records']) == consumed
    assert cut['pending_observations'] == []
    assert len(cut['raw_cache_history']) == raw_count
    assert cut['settled_economic_components'] == prev['frames'][-1]['metrics']['reward_components']
    assert cut['change_cost_so_far'] == fee
    assert cut['future_value_origin'] == 'EXCLUDE_SETTLED_PREFIX'
    assert cut['imp2a_field_mapping']['trusted_prefix_digest'].startswith('NOT_ISSUED')
    assert cut['archive_binding']['status'] == result['archive_bytes'] == 'ARCHIVE_BYTES_BOUND'
    assert result['real_source_authentication'] == result['full_trusted_cut'] == 'NOT_VERIFIED'
    assert bound._documents_json == before


def test_d60_reference_seed_is_comparison_not_replay_input(bound):
    cut = recovery.recover_actual_cut(bound, 60)['cut'].to_dict()
    seed = bound.d60_reference_seed()
    assert cut['consumer_states'] == seed['internal_states_at_D60']
    assert cut['accepted_position_history'] == seed['accepted_position_history']

    assert cut['consumed_records'] == seed['consumed_records']


def test_same_tick_consumer_and_raw_transaction_boundary(bound):
    c60 = recovery.recover_actual_cut(bound, 60)['cut'].to_dict()
    c80 = recovery.recover_actual_cut(bound, 80)['cut'].to_dict()
    assert any(r['target_id'] == 0 and r['measurement_tick'] == r['consumed_tick'] == 60 for r in c60['consumed_records'])
    assert not any(r['target_id'] == 1 for r in c60['consumed_records'])
    assert any(r['target_id'] == 1 and r['measurement_tick'] == 60 and r['consumed_tick'] == 80 for r in c80['consumed_records'])
    keys60 = {tuple(r['raw_key']) for r in c60['raw_cache_history']}
    keys80 = {tuple(r['raw_key']) for r in c80['raw_cache_history']}
    assert ('A2_R', 0, 0, 60) in keys60
    assert ('A2_R', 1, 0, 60) not in keys60
    assert ('A2_R', 1, 0, 60) in keys80
    prepared = bound.documents()['R_D60.json']['step']['action_commit']['prepared_actual_slots']
    assert all(('A2_R', s['slot_key']['target_id'], s['slot_key']['robot_id'], s['slot_key']['tick']) not in keys60 for s in prepared)


@pytest.mark.parametrize('tick', [80, 100])
def test_accepted_history_receipts_are_derived_from_saved_estimates(bound, tick):
    cut = recovery.recover_actual_cut(bound, tick)['cut'].to_dict()
    for j, positions in cut['accepted_position_history'].items():
        assert [x[0] for x in positions] == sorted(set(x[0] for x in positions))
        if positions:
            receipt = cut['accepted_receipts'][j]
            assert receipt in cut['consumed_records']
            assert receipt['measurement_tick'] == positions[-1][0]
            state = cut['consumer_states'][j]
            assert state['position_estimate'] == positions[-1][1]
            assert state['estimate_tick'] == positions[-1][0]
    assert cut['freeze_boundary_identity']['ordinal_kind'].startswith('DERIVED_')
    assert all('#/step/fusion_records/' in x['source_ref'] for x in cut['observation_arrivals'])


def test_original_context_and_packet_identity_unchanged(bound):
    cut = recovery.recover_actual_cut(bound, 100)['cut'].to_dict()
    entries = {tuple(x['raw_key']): x for x in bound.documents()['R.json']['final']['sampler']['entries']}
    for row in cut['raw_cache_history']:
        assert set(row['original_context']) == {'position', 'sigma', 'health'}
        assert digest(row['original_context']) == row['context_digest']
        assert row['raw_key'][0] == row['episode_binding']['physical_environment_id'] == 'A2_R'
        assert {k: row[k] for k in ('raw_key', 'context_digest', 'slot')} == entries[tuple(row['raw_key'])]


def test_archive_read_or_expected_manifest_tamper_rejected(monkeypatch):
    original = Path.read_bytes
    for target in ('R_D80.json', 'BASELINE.json'):
        def altered(path, chosen=target):
            raw = original(path)
            return raw+b' ' if path.name == chosen else raw
        with monkeypatch.context() as patch:
            patch.setattr(Path, 'read_bytes', altered)
            with pytest.raises(ar.ArchiveBindingError): ar.bind_actual_archive(ROOT)


def test_bound_archive_cannot_be_replaced_by_self_issued_expectations(bound):
    assert recovery.recover_actual_cut(None, 60)['status'].endswith('FAIL')
    fake = replace(bound, _seal=None)
    assert recovery.recover_actual_cut(fake, 60)['reason'] == 'BOUND_ACTUAL_ARCHIVE_REQUIRED'
    docs = bound.documents()
    docs['R_D60.json']['policy_input']['positions'][0][0] += 1
    fake = replace(bound, _documents_json=json.dumps(docs))
    assert recovery.recover_actual_cut(fake, 60)['reason'] == 'BOUND_DOCUMENT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH'


def resync_embedded(docs):
    docs['R.json']['records'] = [deepcopy(docs[f'R_D{k}.json']) for k in (0,20,40,60,80,100)]


def resync_final(docs):
    f = docs['R.json']['final']
    f['snapshot_digest'] = digest({k: v for k, v in f.items() if k != 'snapshot_digest'})


@pytest.mark.parametrize('bad', ['environment', 'episode', 'checkpoint', 'position', 'missing_fusion',
                                'fusion_order', 'consumed', 'early_t1', 'raw_context', 'raw_environment',
                                'economic', 'service_clock', 'sampler_environment', 'missing_prepared', 'receipt_evidence'])
def test_semantic_tampering_rejected_in_memory_audit(bound, bad):
    docs = bound.documents()
    if bad == 'environment': docs['R.json']['final']['physical_environment_id'] = 'A2_S_NEW'
    if bad == 'episode': docs['R.json']['final']['source_identity'] = 'foreign'
    if bad == 'checkpoint': docs['R_D60.json']['step']['action_commit']['checkpoint_id'] = 'foreign'
    if bad == 'position': docs['R_D80.json']['policy_input']['positions'][0][0] += 1
    if bad == 'missing_fusion': docs['R_D40.json']['step']['fusion_records'].pop()
    if bad == 'fusion_order': docs['R_D40.json']['step']['fusion_records'].reverse()
    if bad == 'consumed': docs['R.json']['observations_consumed'].pop(0)
    if bad == 'early_t1':
        docs['R_D40.json']['step']['fusion_records'].append(deepcopy(docs['R_D60.json']['step']['fusion_records'][0]))
    if bad == 'raw_context':
        row = docs['R.json']['final']['sampler']['entries'][0]
        context = dict(position=row['slot']['packet']['position'], sigma=.02, health='available', episode_id='A2_R')
        row['context_digest'] = digest(context)
        docs['R.json']['final']['sampler']['attempts'][0]['context_digest'] = row['context_digest']
        resync_final(docs)
    if bad == 'raw_environment':
        docs['R.json']['final']['sampler']['entries'][0]['raw_key'][0] = 'MODEL'
        resync_final(docs)
    if bad == 'economic': docs['R_D60.json']['step']['metrics']['change_cost'] += .02
    if bad == 'service_clock': docs['R_D80.json']['policy_input']['histories'][0]['cutoff_tick'] = 100
    if bad == 'receipt_evidence': docs['R_D80.json']['evidence']['targets'][0]['corresponding_consumed_tick'] = 80
    if bad == 'sampler_environment':
        docs['R.json']['final']['sampler']['physical_environment_id'] = 'MODEL'
        resync_final(docs)
    if bad == 'missing_prepared':
        docs['R_D60.json']['step']['action_commit']['prepared_actual_slots'].pop()
        commit = docs['R_D60.json']['step']['action_commit']
        commit['action_commit_id'] = digest({k: v for k, v in commit.items() if k != 'action_commit_id'})
        docs['R_D60.json']['step']['action_commit_id'] = commit['action_commit_id']
    resync_embedded(docs)
    # The private helper can audit corrupted copies, but does not issue a bound
    # reconstruction PASS. Public admission independently checks sealed bytes.
    with pytest.raises((recovery.ReconstructionError, KeyError, ValueError)):
        recovery._recover_documents(docs, 80)


def test_actual_archive_cannot_claim_imp2a_synthetic_pass(bound):
    cut = recovery.recover_actual_cut(bound, 60)['cut'].to_dict()
    root = imp2a.ExternalTrustRoot('A2_R', cut['source_identity'], 60, cut['cut_phase'],
                                 '', '', '', 'ARCHIVE_BYTES_BOUND')
    assert imp2a.verify_trusted_cut(cut, trusted_root=root)['status'] == 'REAL_TRUST_PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED'
    fake_synthetic = replace(root, evidence_kind=imp2a.SYNTHETIC_ROOT)
    assert imp2a.verify_trusted_cut(cut, trusted_root=fake_synthetic)['status'] != 'SYNTHETIC_CUT_INTERFACE_VERIFIED'


def test_isolation_repeatability_and_original_files_unchanged(bound):
    before = {p: hashlib.sha256((ROOT/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in ar.ARCHIVES}
    first = recovery.recover_actual_cut(bound, 80)
    second = recovery.recover_actual_cut(bound, 80)
    assert first == second
    result = first['cut'].to_dict()
    result['accepted_position_history'].clear()
    result['raw_cache_history'][0]['original_context']['position'][0] = -999
    assert first['cut'].to_dict() == second['cut'].to_dict()
    assert before == {p: hashlib.sha256((ROOT/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in ar.ARCHIVES}

@pytest.mark.parametrize('change', ['documents_and_digests', 'seed', 'reference_role',
                                  'reference_hash', 'baseline', 'manifest', 'identical_copy'])
def test_unissued_replacements_cannot_inherit_binding(bound, change):
    docs, refs = bound.documents(), bound.references()
    fields = {}
    if change == 'documents_and_digests':
        docs['PUBLIC_INPUT.json']['source'] += ' altered non-computational annotation'
        refs['document_digests']['PUBLIC_INPUT.json'] = digest(docs['PUBLIC_INPUT.json'])
        fields.update(_documents_json=json.dumps(docs), _references_json=json.dumps(refs))
    elif change == 'seed':
        seed = bound.d60_reference_seed()
        seed['untrusted_annotation'] = 'replacement'
        fields['_seed_json'] = json.dumps(seed)
    elif change != 'identical_copy':
        if change == 'reference_role': refs['files'][0]['role'] = 'replacement'
        if change == 'reference_hash': refs['files'][0]['sha256'] = '0'*64
        if change == 'baseline': refs['baseline_commit'] = '0'*40
        if change == 'manifest': refs['manifest'] = 'self-issued.json'
        fields['_references_json'] = json.dumps(refs)
    forged = replace(bound, **fields)
    assert forged._seal is bound._seal
    with pytest.raises(ar.ArchiveBindingError):
        ar.checked_documents(forged)
    for tick in (60, 80, 100):
        out = recovery.recover_actual_cut(forged, tick)
        assert out['status'] == 'ARCHIVED_ACTUAL_CUT_RECONSTRUCTION_FAIL'
        assert 'ARCHIVE_BYTES_BOUND' not in json.dumps(out)


def test_issued_content_fingerprint_covers_all_fields(bound):
    # Even forced mutation of the same instance must fail. Restore after each
    # probe so the genuine issued object is left untouched for other tests.
    for field in ('_documents_json', '_references_json', '_seed_json'):
        original = getattr(bound, field)
        try:
            object.__setattr__(bound, field, original+' ')
            with pytest.raises(ar.ArchiveBindingError): ar.checked_documents(bound)
        finally:
            object.__setattr__(bound, field, original)
    assert ar.checked_documents(bound) == bound.documents()


def test_issued_registration_tracks_lifetime_without_retaining_archive():
    import gc
    import weakref
    issued = ar.bind_actual_archive(ROOT)
    identity = id(issued)
    reference = weakref.ref(issued)
    assert identity in ar._ISSUED
    del issued
    gc.collect()
    assert reference() is None and identity not in ar._ISSUED

@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def block_science(monkeypatch):
    from research.non_oracle import belief, environment, policy, stfbs_d1a_model, stfbs_d1b_qm_model
    from research.cooperative_sensing import estimator
    from research.information_service_online.execution import OnlineEnvironment, ActualMeasurementCache
    from research.information_service_bridge.public_stream import BridgeFrameProcessor
    import scipy.optimize

    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
        raise AssertionError('Forbidden transition during structural capture')

    for owner, names in ((belief.Beliefs, ('freeze', 'enqueue')),
        (environment.NonOracleEnvironment, ('prepare_decision',)),
        (OnlineEnvironment, ('step', '_advance_tick', '_sample', '_fuse')),
        (ActualMeasurementCache, ('query',)), (BridgeFrameProcessor, ('process',)),
        (policy, ('decide', 'evaluate', 'endpoint', 'estimate')),
        (estimator, ('estimate', 'least_squares')), (scipy.optimize, ('least_squares',)),
        (stfbs_d1a_model.Branch, ('run', 'advance', 'assign', 'fuse')),
        (stfbs_d1b_qm_model.QMBranch, ('run', 'advance'))):
        for name in names:
            monkeypatch.setattr(owner, name, forbidden)


def read(path):
    return json.loads((ROOT/path).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))


def reseal(env):
    snapshot = env.snapshot
    snapshot['checkpoint']['checkpoint_id'] = digest({k: v for k, v in snapshot['checkpoint'].items() if k != 'checkpoint_id'})
    snapshot['snapshot_digest'] = digest({k: v for k, v in snapshot.items() if k != 'snapshot_digest'})

def test_capture_detached_and_repeatable(port):
    env, view = port
    before = deepcopy((env.snapshot, vars(env.beliefs), view))
    out = live.capture_live_cut(env, view)
    assert out['status'] == 'LIVE_CUT_STRUCTURAL_CAPTURE_PASS', out
    assert out == live.capture_live_cut(env, view)
    assert (env.snapshot, vars(env.beliefs), view) == before
    private, public = out['private_live_cut'], out['public_policy_view']
    assert public == view and set(public) == live.PUBLIC_FIELDS
    assert private['snapshot'] == env.snapshot
    for field, attr in [('consumer_states', 'states'), ('accepted_position_history', 'history'),
                        ('pending_observations', 'pending'), ('consumed_records', 'consumed'), ('accepted_receipts', 'accepted_receipts')]:
        assert private['consumer'][field] == getattr(env.beliefs, attr)
    public['positions'][0][0] = -1
    assert private['snapshot']['state']['positions'][0][0] != -1
    private['snapshot']['state']['positions'][0][0] = -2
    assert env.snapshot == before[0]
    assert public['positions'][0][0] == -1
